sanskrit_iast: upadiṣṭo dharmaḥ prativedam |
meaning: उपदिष्टो धर्मः प्रतिवेदम् ।
text: The sacred law is taught in each Veda.

sanskrit_iast: tasyānu vyākhyāsyāmaḥ |
meaning: तस्यानु व्याख्यास्यामः ।
text: We will explain (it) in accordance with that.

sanskrit_iast: smārto dvitīyaḥ |
meaning: स्मार्तो द्वितीयः ।
text: (The sacred law), taught in the Tradition (Sm ri ti, stands) second.

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyaḥ śiṣṭāgamaḥ |
meaning: तृतीयः शिष्टागमः ।
text: The practice of the Śishṭas (stands) third.

sanskrit_iast: śiṣṭāḥ khalu vigatamatsarā nirahaṃkārāḥ kumbhīdhānyāalolupā dambhadarpalobhamohakrodhavivarjitāḥ |
meaning: शिष्टाः खलु विगतमत्सरा निरहंकाराः कुम्भीधान्याअलोलुपा दम्भदर्पलोभमोहक्रोधविवर्जिताः ।
text: Śishṭas, forsooth, (are those) who are free from envy, free from pride, contented with a store of grain sufficient for ten days, free from covetousness, and free from hypocrisy, arrogance, greed, perplexity, and anger.

sanskrit_iast: dharmeṇādhigato yeṣāṃ vedaḥ saparibṛṃhaṇaḥ | śiṣṭās tadanumānajñāḥ śrutipratyakṣahetavaḥ || iti |
meaning: धर्मेणाधिगतो येषां वेदः सपरिबृंहणः । शिष्टास् तदनुमानज्ञाः श्रुतिप्रत्यक्षहेतवः ॥ इति ।
text: '(Those are called) Śishṭas who, in accordance with the sacred law, have studied the Veda together with its appendages, know how to draw inferences from that, (and) are able to adduce proofs perceptible by the senses from the revealed texts.'

sanskrit_iast: tadabhāve daśāvarā pariṣat |
meaning: तदभावे दशावरा परिषत् ।
text: On failure of them, an assembly consisting at least of ten members (shall decide disputed points of law).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | cāturvaidyaṃ vikalpī ca aṅgavid dharmapāṭhakaḥ | āśramasthās trayo viprāḥ parṣad eṣā daśāvarā |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । चातुर्वैद्यं विकल्पी च अङ्गविद् धर्मपाठकः । आश्रमस्थास् त्रयो विप्राः पर्षद् एषा दशावरा ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'Four men, who each know one of the four Vedas, a Mīmāṃsaka, one who knows the Aṅgas, one who recites (the works on) the sacred law, and three Brāhmaṇas belonging to (three different) orders, (constitute) an assembly consisting, at least, of ten members.'

sanskrit_iast: pañca vā syus trayo vā syur eko vā syād aninditaḥ | prativaktā tu dharmasya netare tu sahasraśaḥ |
meaning: पञ्च वा स्युस् त्रयो वा स्युर् एको वा स्याद् अनिन्दितः । प्रतिवक्ता तु धर्मस्य नेतरे तु सहस्रशः ।
text: 'There may be five, or there may be three, or there may be one blameless man, who decides (questions regarding) the sacred law. But a thousand fools (can)not (do it).'

sanskrit_iast: yathā dārumayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ | brāhmaṇaś cānadhīyānas trayas te nāmadhārakāḥ |
meaning: यथा दारुमयो हस्ती यथा चर्ममयो मृगः । ब्राह्मणश् चानधीयानस् त्रयस् ते नामधारकाः ।
text: 'As an elephant made of wood, as an antelope made of leather, such is an unlearned Brāhmaṇa: those three having nothing but the name (of their kind).'

sanskrit_iast: yad vadanti tamomūḍhā mūrkhā dharmam ajānataḥ | tat pāpaṃ śatadhā bhūtvā vaktqn samadhigacchati |
meaning: यद् वदन्ति तमोमूढा मूर्खा धर्मम् अजानतः । तत् पापं शतधा भूत्वा वक्त्qन् समधिगच्छति ।
text: 'That sin which dunces, perplexed by ignorance and unacquainted with the sacred law, declare (to be duty), falls, increased a hundredfold, on those who propound it.'

sanskrit_iast: bahudvārasya dharmasya sūkṣmā duranugā gatiḥ | tasmān na vācyo hy ekena bahujñenāpi saṃśaye |
meaning: बहुद्वारस्य धर्मस्य सूक्ष्मा दुरनुगा गतिः । तस्मान् न वाच्यो ह्य् एकेन बहुज्ञेनापि संशये ।
text: 'Narrow and difficult to find is the path of the sacred law, towards which many gates lead. Hence, if there is a doubt, it must not be propounded by one man (only), however learned he may be.'

sanskrit_iast: dharmaśāstrarathārūḍhā vedakhaḍgadharā dvijāḥ | krīḍārtham api yad brūyuḥ sa dharmaḥ paramaḥ smṛtaḥ |
meaning: धर्मशास्त्ररथारूढा वेदखड्गधरा द्विजाः । क्रीडार्थम् अपि यद् ब्रूयुः स धर्मः परमः स्मृतः ।
text: 'What Brāhmaṇas, riding in the chariot of the law (and) wielding the sword of the Veda, propound even in jest, that is declared to be the highest law.'

sanskrit_iast: yathāśmani sthitaṃ toyaṃ mārutārkau praṇāśayet | tadvat kartari yat pāpaṃ jalavat saṃpralīyate |
meaning: यथाश्मनि स्थितं तोयं मारुतार्कौ प्रणाशयेत् । तद्वत् कर्तरि यत् पापं जलवत् संप्रलीयते ।
text: 'As wind and sun will make water, collected on a stone, disappear, even so the sin that (cleaves) to an offender completely vanishes like water.'

sanskrit_iast: śarīraṃ balam āyuś ca vayaḥ kālaṃ ca karma ca | samīkṣya dharmavid buddhyā prāyaścittāni nirdiśet |
meaning: शरीरं बलम् आयुश् च वयः कालं च कर्म च । समीक्ष्य धर्मविद् बुद्ध्या प्रायश्चित्तानि निर्दिशेत् ।
text: 'He who knows the sacred law shall fix the penances with discernment, taking into consideration the constitution, the strength, the knowledge, and the age (of the offender), as well as the time and the deed.'

sanskrit_iast: avratānām amantrāṇāṃ jātimātropajīvinām | sahasraśaḥ sametānāṃ pariṣattvaṃ na vidyate || iti |
meaning: अव्रतानाम् अमन्त्राणां जातिमात्रोपजीविनाम् । सहस्रशः समेतानां परिषत्त्वं न विद्यते ॥ इति ।
text: Many thousands (of Brāhmaṇas) cannot form a (legal) assembly (for declaring the sacred law), if they have not fulfilled their sacred duties, are unacquainted with the Veda, and subsist only by the name of their caste.'

sanskrit_iast: pañcadhā vipratipattir dakṣiṇatas tathottarataḥ |
meaning: पञ्चधा विप्रतिपत्तिर् दक्षिणतस् तथोत्तरतः ।
text: There is a dispute regarding five (practices) both in the south and in the north.

sanskrit_iast: yāni dakṣiṇatas tāni vyākhyāsyāmaḥ |
meaning: यानि दक्षिणतस् तानि व्याख्यास्यामः ।
text: We will explain those (peculiar) to the south.

sanskrit_iast: yathaitad anupetena saha bhojanaṃ striyā saha bhojanaṃparyuṣitabhojanaṃ mātulapitṛsvasṛduhitṛgamanam iti |
meaning: यथैतद् अनुपेतेन सह भोजनं स्त्रिया सह भोजनंपर्युषितभोजनं मातुलपितृस्वसृदुहितृगमनम् इति ।
text: They are, to eat in the company of an uninitiated person, to eat in the company of one's wife, to eat stale food, to marry the daughter of a maternal uncle or of a paternal aunt.

sanskrit_iast: athottarata ūrṇāvikrayaḥ sīdhupānam ubhayatodadbhirvyavahāra āyudhīyakaṃ samudrasaṃyānam iti |
meaning: अथोत्तरत ऊर्णाविक्रयः सीधुपानम् उभयतोदद्भिर्व्यवहार आयुधीयकं समुद्रसंयानम् इति ।
text: Now (the customs peculiar) to the north are, to deal in wool, to drink rum, to sell animals that have teeth in the upper and in the lower jaws, to follow the trade of arms, to go to sea.

sanskrit_iast: itarad itarasmin kurvan duṣyatītarad itarasmin |
meaning: इतरद् इतरस्मिन् कुर्वन् दुष्यतीतरद् इतरस्मिन् ।
text: He who follows (these practices) in any other country than where they prevail, commits sin.

sanskrit_iast: tatra tatra deśaprāmāṇyam eva syāt |
meaning: तत्र तत्र देशप्रामाण्यम् एव स्यात् ।
text: For each (of these customs) the (rule of the) country should be (considered) the authority.

sanskrit_iast: mithyaitad iti gautamaḥ |
meaning: मिथ्यैतद् इति गौतमः ।
text: Gautama declares that that is false.

sanskrit_iast: ubhayaṃ caiva | nādriyeta śiṣṭasmṛtivirodhadarśanāt |
meaning: उभयं चैव । नाद्रियेत शिष्टस्मृतिविरोधदर्शनात् ।
text: And one should not take heed of either (set of practices) because they are opposed to the tradition of the Śishṭas.

sanskrit_iast: prāg ādarśāt pratyak kanakhalād dakṣiṇenahimavantam udak pāriyātram etad āryāvartam | tasmin ya ācāraḥ sapramāṇam |
meaning: प्राग् आदर्शात् प्रत्यक् कनखलाद् दक्षिणेनहिमवन्तम् उदक् पारियात्रम् एतद् आर्यावर्तम् । तस्मिन् य आचारः सप्रमाणम् ।
text: The country of the Āryas (Āryāvarta) lies to the east of the region where (the river Sarasvatī) disappears, to the west of the Black-forest (Kālakavana), to the north of the Pāripātra (mountains), to the south of the Himālaya. The rule of conduct which (prevails) there, is authoritative.

sanskrit_iast: gaṅgāyamunayor antaram ity eke |
meaning: गङ्गायमुनयोर् अन्तरम् इत्य् एके ।
text: Some (declare) the country between the (rivers) Yamunā and Ganges (to be the Āryāvarta).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy atra bhāllavino gāthām udāharanti |
meaning: अथाप्य् अत्र भाल्लविनो गाथाम् उदाहरन्ति ।
text: Now the Bhāllavins quote also the (following) verse:

sanskrit_iast: paścāt sindhur vidharaṇī sūryasyodayanaṃ puraḥ | yāvat kṛṣṇā vidhāvanti tāvad dhi brahmavarcasam || iti |
meaning: पश्चात् सिन्धुर् विधरणी सूर्यस्योदयनं पुरः । यावत् कृष्णा विधावन्ति तावद् धि ब्रह्मवर्चसम् ॥ इति ।
text: 'In the west the boundary-river, in the east the region where the sun rises,--as far as the black antelopes wander (between these two limits), so far spiritual pre-eminence (is found).'

sanskrit_iast: avantayo 'ṅgamagadhāḥ surāṣṭrā dakṣiṇāpathāḥ | upāvṛtsindhusauvīrā ete saṃkīrṇayonayaḥ |
meaning: अवन्तयो ऽङ्गमगधाः सुराष्ट्रा दक्षिणापथाः । उपावृत्सिन्धुसौवीरा एते संकीर्णयोनयः ।
text: The inhabitants of Avantī, of Aṅga, of Magadha, of Surāshṭra, of the Dekhan, of Upāv ri t, of Sindh, and the Sauvīrās are of mixed origin.

sanskrit_iast: āraṭṭān kāraskarān puṇḍrān sauvīrān vaṅgān kaliṅgānprānūnān iti ca gatvā punastomena yajeta sarvapṛṣṭhayā vā |
meaning: आरट्टान् कारस्करान् पुण्ड्रान् सौवीरान् वङ्गान् कलिङ्गान्प्रानूनान् इति च गत्वा पुनस्तोमेन यजेत सर्वपृष्ठया वा ।
text: He who has visited the (countries of the) Āraṭt as, Kāraskaras, Puṇd ras, Sauvīras, Vaṅgas, Kaliṅgas, (or) Prānūnas shall offer a Punastoma or a Sarvap ri sh th ā (ishṭi).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | padbhyāṃ sa kurute pāpaṃ yaḥ kaliṅgān prapadyate | ṛṣayo niṣkṛtiṃ tasya prāhur vaiśvānaraṃ haviḥ |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । पद्भ्यां स कुरुते पापं यः कलिङ्गान् प्रपद्यते । ऋषयो निष्कृतिं तस्य प्राहुर् वैश्वानरं हविः ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'He commits sin through his feet, who travels to the (country of the) Kaliṅgas. The sages declare the Vaiśvānarī ishṭi to be a purification for him.'

sanskrit_iast: bahūnām api doṣāṇāṃ kṛtānāṃ doṣanirṇaye | pavitreṣṭiṃ praśaṃsanti sā hi pāvanamuttamam || iti |
meaning: बहूनाम् अपि दोषाणां कृतानां दोषनिर्णये । पवित्रेष्टिं प्रशंसन्ति सा हि पावनमुत्तमम् ॥ इति ।
text: 'Even if many offences have been committed, they recommend for the removal of the sin the Pavitreshṭi. For that (sacrifice) is a most excellent means of purification.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | vaiśvānarīṃ vrātapatīṃ pavitreṣṭiṃ tathaiva ca | ṛtāv ṛtau prayuñjānaḥ pāpebhyo vipramucyate || pāpebhyovipramucyata iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । वैश्वानरीं व्रातपतीं पवित्रेष्टिं तथैव च । ऋताव् ऋतौ प्रयुञ्जानः पापेभ्यो विप्रमुच्यते ॥ पापेभ्योविप्रमुच्यत इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'He who performs (by turns) in each season the Vaiśvānarī (ishṭi), the Vrātapatī (ishṭi), and the Pavitreshṭi is freed from (all) sins.'

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭācatvāriṃśad varṣāṇi paurāṇaṃ vedabrahmacaryam |
meaning: अष्टाचत्वारिंशद् वर्षाणि पौराणं वेदब्रह्मचर्यम् ।
text: The (term of the) studentship for (learning the) Veda, as kept by the ancients, (is) forty-eight years,

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśatiṃ dvādaśa vā prativedam |
meaning: चतुर्विंशतिं द्वादश वा प्रतिवेदम् ।
text: (Or) twenty-four (years), or twelve for each Veda,

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsarāvamaṃ vā pratikāṇḍam |
meaning: संवत्सरावमं वा प्रतिकाण्डम् ।
text: Or at the least one year for each Kāṇd a,

sanskrit_iast: grahaṇāntaṃ vā jīvitasyāsthiratvāt |
meaning: ग्रहणान्तं वा जीवितस्यास्थिरत्वात् ।
text: Or until (the Veda has been) learned; for life is uncertain.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇakeśo 'gnīn ādadhīteti śrutiḥ |
meaning: कृष्णकेशो ऽग्नीन् आदधीतेति श्रुतिः ।
text: A passage of the revealed texts declares, 'Let him kindle the sacred fires while his hair is (still) black.'

sanskrit_iast: nāsya karma niyacchanti kiṃcid ā mauñjibandhanāt | vṛttyā śūdrasamo hy eṣa yāvad vedena jāyate || iti |
meaning: नास्य कर्म नियच्छन्ति किंचिद् आ मौञ्जिबन्धनात् । वृत्त्या शूद्रसमो ह्य् एष यावद् वेदेन जायते ॥ इति ।
text: They do not put any (religious) restrictions on the acts of a (child) before the investiture with the girdle (is performed). For he is on a level with a Śūdra before (his second) birth through the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: garbhādiḥ saṃkhyā varṣāṇām | tadaṣṭameṣu brāhmaṇam upanayīta |
meaning: गर्भादिः संख्या वर्षाणाम् । तदष्टमेषु ब्राह्मणम् उपनयीत ।
text: The number of years (must be calculated) from the conception. Let him initiate a Brāhmaṇa in the eighth (year) after that,

sanskrit_iast: tryadhikeṣu rājanyam |
meaning: त्र्यधिकेषु राजन्यम् ।
text: A Kshatriya three (years) later (than a Brāhmaṇa),

sanskrit_iast: tasmād ekādhikeṣu vaiśyam |
meaning: तस्माद् एकाधिकेषु वैश्यम् ।
text: A Vaiśya one year later than a (Kshatriya).

sanskrit_iast: vasanto grīṣmaḥ śarad ity ṛtavo varṇānupūrvyeṇa |
meaning: वसन्तो ग्रीष्मः शरद् इत्य् ऋतवो वर्णानुपूर्व्येण ।
text: Spring, summer, and autumn are the seasons (for the initiation) according to the order of the castes.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrītriṣṭubjagatībhir yathākramam |
meaning: गायत्रीत्रिष्टुब्जगतीभिर् यथाक्रमम् ।
text: (Let him perform the initiation reciting), according to the order (of the castes), a Gāyatrī, a Trishṭubh, (or) a G agatī (verse).

sanskrit_iast: ā ṣoḍaśād ā dvāviṃśād ā caturviṃśād anātyaya eṣāṃ krameṇa |
meaning: आ षोडशाद् आ द्वाविंशाद् आ चतुर्विंशाद् अनात्यय एषां क्रमेण ।
text: Up to the sixteenth, the twenty-second, and the twenty-fourth (years) respectively (the time for the initiation) has not passed.

sanskrit_iast: mauñjī dhanurjyā śāṇīti mekhalāḥ |
meaning: मौञ्जी धनुर्ज्या शाणीति मेखलाः ।
text: The girdles (shall consist of a rope) made of Mu ñ g a grass, a bow-string, (or a rope) made of hemp.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇarurubastājināny ajināni |
meaning: कृष्णरुरुबस्ताजिनान्य् अजिनानि ।
text: The skins (shall be) those of a black antelope, of a spotted deer, (or) of a he-goat.

sanskrit_iast: mūrdhalalāṭanāsāgrapramāṇā yājñikasya vṛkṣasya daṇḍāḥ |
meaning: मूर्धललाटनासाग्रप्रमाणा याज्ञिकस्य वृक्षस्य दण्डाः ।
text: The staff shall reach the crown of the head, the forehead, (or) the tip of the nose, (and be made) of a tree fit for a sacrifice. The details have been stated above.

sanskrit_iast: bhavatpūrvāṃ bhikṣāmadhyāṃ yācñāntāṃ bhikṣāṃ caretsaptākṣarāṃ kṣāṃ ca hiṃ ca na vardhayet |
meaning: भवत्पूर्वां भिक्षामध्यां याच्ञान्तां भिक्षां चरेत्सप्ताक्षरां क्षां च हिं च न वर्धयेत् ।
text: Let him beg, (employing a formula) consisting of seven syllables, with the word bhavat in the beginning, with the word bhikshā in the middle, and with the (verb expressing) the request at the end; and let him not pronounce loudly (the syllables) kshā and hi.

sanskrit_iast: bhavatpūrvāṃ brāhmaṇo bhikṣeta bhavanmadhyāṃ rājanyobhavadantāṃ vaiśyaḥ sarveṣu varṇeṣu |
meaning: भवत्पूर्वां ब्राह्मणो भिक्षेत भवन्मध्यां राजन्योभवदन्तां वैश्यः सर्वेषु वर्णेषु ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa (student) shall ask for alms, placing (the word) 'Lady' first, a Kshatriya placing it in the middle, (and) a Vaiśya placing it at the end (of the formula), from (men of) all castes.

sanskrit_iast: te brāhmaṇādyāḥ svakarmasthāḥ |
meaning: ते ब्राह्मणाद्याः स्वकर्मस्थाः ।
text: The (persons fit to be asked) are Brāhmaṇas and so forth, who follow (their lawful) occupations.

sanskrit_iast: sadāraṇyāt samidha āhṛtyādadhyāt |
meaning: सदारण्यात् समिध आहृत्यादध्यात् ।
text: Let him daily fetch fuel out of the forest and offer (it in the sacred fire).

sanskrit_iast: satyavādī hrīmān anahaṃkāraḥ |
meaning: सत्यवादी ह्रीमान् अनहंकारः ।
text: (A student shall be) truthful, modest, and devoid of pride.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvotthāyī jaghanyasaṃveśī |
meaning: पूर्वोत्थायी जघन्यसंवेशी ।
text: He shall rise before (his teacher in the morning) and go to rest after (him in the evening).

sanskrit_iast: sarvatrāpratihataguruvākyo 'nyatra pātakāt |
meaning: सर्वत्राप्रतिहतगुरुवाक्यो ऽन्यत्र पातकात् ।
text: He shall never disobey the words of his teacher except (when he is ordered to commit) a crime causing loss of caste.

sanskrit_iast: yāvadarthasaṃbhāṣī strībhiḥ || | nṛttagītavāditragandhamālyopānacchattradhāraṇāñjanābhyañjanavarjī |
meaning: यावदर्थसंभाषी स्त्रीभिः ॥ । नृत्तगीतवादित्रगन्धमाल्योपानच्छत्त्रधारणाञ्जनाभ्यञ्जनवर्जी ।

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇena savyaṃ savyena copasaṃgṛhṇīyāt |
meaning: दक्षिणं दक्षिणेन सव्यं सव्येन चोपसंगृह्णीयात् ।
text: Let him take hold (of his teacher's) right (foot) with the right (hand), and of the left (foot) with the left hand.

sanskrit_iast: dīrgham āyuḥ svargaṃ cepsan kāmam anyasmai sādhuvṛttāyaguruṇānujñātaḥ |
meaning: दीर्घम् आयुः स्वर्गं चेप्सन् कामम् अन्यस्मै साधुवृत्तायगुरुणानुज्ञातः ।
text: If he desires long life and (bliss in) heaven, (he may act) at his pleasure (in the same manner) towards other holy (men), after having received permission from his teacher.

sanskrit_iast: asāv ahaṃ bho iti śrotre saṃspṛśya manaḥsamādhānārtham |
meaning: असाव् अहं भो इति श्रोत्रे संस्पृश्य मनःसमाधानार्थम् ।
text: (Let him say), 'I N. N., ho! (salute thee),' touching his ears, in order to compose the internal organ.

sanskrit_iast: adhastāj jānvor ā padbhyām |
meaning: अधस्ताज् जान्वोर् आ पद्भ्याम् ।
text: (Let him embrace his teacher's leg) below the knee down to the feet.

sanskrit_iast: nāsīno nāsīnāya na śayāno na śayānāya nāprayatonāprayatāya |
meaning: नासीनो नासीनाय न शयानो न शयानाय नाप्रयतोनाप्रयताय ।
text: (A student shall not embrace his teacher) when he (himself) is seated, or lying down, or impure, nor when (his teacher) is seated, lying down, or impure.

sanskrit_iast: śaktiviṣaye muhūrtam api nāprayataḥ syāt |
meaning: शक्तिविषये मुहूर्तम् अपि नाप्रयतः स्यात् ।
text: If he can (find water to sip), he shall not remain impure even during a muhūrta.

sanskrit_iast: samiddhāry udakumbhapuṣpānnahasto nābhivādayed yaccānyad apy evaṃyuktam |
meaning: समिद्धार्य् उदकुम्भपुष्पान्नहस्तो नाभिवादयेद् यच्चान्यद् अप्य् एवंयुक्तम् ।
text: If he carries a load of fuel or holds a pot, flowers, or food in his hands, he shall not salute; nor (shall he do it) on similar occasions.

sanskrit_iast: na samavāye 'bhivādayed atyantaśaḥ |
meaning: न समवाये ऽभिवादयेद् अत्यन्तशः ।
text: Let him not salute (the teacher) standing too close,

sanskrit_iast: bhrātṛpatnīnāṃ yuvatīnāṃ ca guruptnīnāṃ jātavīryaḥ |
meaning: भ्रातृपत्नीनां युवतीनां च गुरुप्त्नीनां जातवीर्यः ।
text: Nor, if he has reached the age of puberty, the young wives of brothers and the young wives of the teacher.

sanskrit_iast: nauśilāphalakakuñjaraprāsādakaṭeṣu cakravatsu cādoṣamsahāsanam |
meaning: नौशिलाफलककुञ्जरप्रासादकटेषु चक्रवत्सु चादोषम्सहासनम् ।
text: To sit together with (these persons) in a boat, on a rock, on a plank, on an elephant, on the roof of a house, on a mat, or in wheeled vehicles is permissible.

sanskrit_iast: prasādhanotsādanasnāpanocchiṣṭabojanānīti guroḥ |
meaning: प्रसाधनोत्सादनस्नापनोच्छिष्टबोजनानीति गुरोः ।
text: (The pupil) must assist his teacher in making his toilet, shampoo him, attend him while bathing, eat his leavings, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast: ucchiṣṭavarjanaṃ tatputre 'nūcāne vā |
meaning: उच्छिष्टवर्जनं तत्पुत्रे ऽनूचाने वा ।
text: (But he) should avoid the remnants of food left by his (teacher's) son, though he may know the Veda together with the Aṅgas,

sanskrit_iast: prasādhanotsādanasnāpanavarjanaṃ ca tatpatnyām |
meaning: प्रसाधनोत्सादनस्नापनवर्जनं च तत्पत्न्याम् ।
text: And to assist at the toilet of, to shampoo, to attend in the bath, and to eat the remnants of food left by a young wife of his (teacher).

sanskrit_iast: dhāvantam anudhāved gacchantam anugacchet tiṣṭhantam anutiṣṭhet |
meaning: धावन्तम् अनुधावेद् गच्छन्तम् अनुगच्छेत् तिष्ठन्तम् अनुतिष्ठेत् ।
text: Let him run after (his teacher) when he runs, walk after him when he walks, attend him standing when he stands.

sanskrit_iast: nāpsu ślāghamānaḥ snāyāt |
meaning: नाप्सु श्लाघमानः स्नायात् ।
text: Let him not sport in the water while bathing.

sanskrit_iast: daṇḍa iva plavet |
meaning: दण्ड इव प्लवेत् ।
text: Let him swim (motionless) like a stick.

sanskrit_iast: abrāhmaṇād adhyayanam āpadi |
meaning: अब्राह्मणाद् अध्ययनम् आपदि ।
text: To study under a non-Brāhmanical teacher (is permitted) in times of distress.

sanskrit_iast: śuśrūṣānuvrajyā ca yāvadadhyayanam |
meaning: शुश्रूषानुव्रज्या च यावदध्ययनम् ।
text: (The pupil shall) obey and walk after him as long as the instruction (lasts).

sanskrit_iast: tayos tad eva pāvanam |
meaning: तयोस् तद् एव पावनम् ।
text: (According to some this is improper, because) just that (mutual relation) sanctifies both of them.

sanskrit_iast: bhrātṛputraśiṣyeṣu caivam |
meaning: भ्रातृपुत्रशिष्येषु चैवम् ।
text: And (the behaviour) towards brothers, sons, and (other) pupils (of the teacher shall be regulated) in the same manner.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtvijśvaśurapitṛvyamātulānāṃ tu yavīyasāṃpratyutthāyābhibhāṣaṇam |
meaning: ऋत्विज्श्वशुरपितृव्यमातुलानां तु यवीयसांप्रत्युत्थायाभिभाषणम् ।
text: But officiating priests, a father-in-law, paternal and maternal uncles who are younger than (oneself must be honoured by) rising and (by being) addressed.

sanskrit_iast: pratyabhivāda iti kātyaḥ |
meaning: प्रत्यभिवाद इति कात्यः ।
text: Kātya (declares that) the salutation shall be returned.

sanskrit_iast: śiśāv āṅgirase darśanāt |
meaning: शिशाव् आङ्गिरसे दर्शनात् ।
text: For (the propriety of that rule) is apparent (from the story) about Śiśu Āṅgirasa.

sanskrit_iast: dharmārthau yatra na syātāṃ śuśrūṣā vāpi tadvidhā | vidyayā saha martavyaṃ na cainām ūṣare vapet |
meaning: धर्मार्थौ यत्र न स्यातां शुश्रूषा वापि तद्विधा । विद्यया सह मर्तव्यं न चैनाम् ऊषरे वपेत् ।
text: If merit and wealth are not (obtained by teaching), nor (at least) the due obedience, one should die with one's learning; one should not sow it on barren soil.

sanskrit_iast: agnir iva kakṣaṃ dahati brahma pṛṣṭam anādṛtam | tasmād vai śakyaṃ na brūyād brahma mānam akurvatām || iti |
meaning: अग्निर् इव कक्षं दहति ब्रह्म पृष्टम् अनादृतम् । तस्माद् वै शक्यं न ब्रूयाद् ब्रह्म मानम् अकुर्वताम् ॥ इति ।
text: As fire consumes dry grass, even so the Veda, asked for, (but) not honoured, (destroys the enquirer). Therefore let him not proclaim the Veda to those who do not show him honour according to their ability.

sanskrit_iast: evāsmai vaco vedayante |
meaning: एवास्मै वचो वेदयन्ते ।
text: They proclaim to him a command to the following effect;

sanskrit_iast: brahma vai mṛtyave prajāḥ prāyacchat | tasmai brahmacāriṇameva na prāyacchat | so 'bravīd astu mahyam apy etasmin bhāga iti | yām eva rātriṃ samidhaṃ nāharātā iti |
meaning: ब्रह्म वै मृत्यवे प्रजाः प्रायच्छत् । तस्मै ब्रह्मचारिणमेव न प्रायच्छत् । सो ऽब्रवीद् अस्तु मह्यम् अप्य् एतस्मिन् भाग इति । याम् एव रात्रिं समिधं नाहराता इति ।
text: 'Brahman, forsooth, made the created beings over to Death. The student alone it did not make over to him.' He (Death) spake, 'Let me have a share in him.' (Brahman answered), 'That night in which he may neglect to offer a piece of sacred fuel (shall belong to thee),'

sanskrit_iast: tasmād brahmacārī yāṃ rātriṃ samidhaṃ nāharaty āyuṣaeva tām avadāya vasati | tasmād brahmacārī samidham āharen nedāyuṣo 'vadāya vasānīti |
meaning: तस्माद् ब्रह्मचारी यां रात्रिं समिधं नाहरत्य् आयुषएव ताम् अवदाय वसति । तस्माद् ब्रह्मचारी समिधम् आहरेन् नेदायुषो ऽवदाय वसानीति ।
text: 'Therefore a student who passes a night without offering a piece of sacred fuel, cuts it off from the length of his life, Therefore let the student offer a piece of sacred fuel, lest he spend a night, shortening his life.'

sanskrit_iast: dīrgasattraṃ vā eṣa upaiti yo brahmacaryam upaiti | sa yāmupayan samidham ādadhāti sā prāyaṇīyātha yāṃ snāsyansodayanīyātha yā antareṇa sattryā evāsya tāḥ |
meaning: दीर्गसत्त्रं वा एष उपैति यो ब्रह्मचर्यम् उपैति । स यामुपयन् समिधम् आदधाति सा प्रायणीयाथ यां स्नास्यन्सोदयनीयाथ या अन्तरेण सत्त्र्या एवास्य ताः ।
text: 'A long sacrificial session begins he who commences his studentship. That (night) in which, after being initiated, he (first) offers a piece of sacred fuel corresponds to the Prāyaṇīya (Atirātra of a sacrificial session); that night in which (he offers it last), intending to take the final bath, corresponds to the Udayanīya (Atirātra), Those nights which (lie) between (these two terms correspond) just to the nights of his sacrificial session.'

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇo vai brahmacaryam upayaṃś caturdhā bhūtāni praviśaty agniṃ padā mṛtyuṃ padācāryaṃ padātmany evāsyacaturthaḥ pādaḥ pariśiṣyate | sa yad agnau samidham ādadhāti ya evāsyāgnau pādas tameva tena parikrīṇāti taṃ saṃskṛtyātman dhatte sa enam āviśati | atha yad ātmānaṃ daridrīkrityāhrīr bhūtvā bhikṣatebrahmacaryaṃ carati ya evāsya mṛtyau pādas tam eva tena parikrīṇātitaṃ saṃskṛtyātman dhatte sa enam āviśati | atha yad ācāryavacaḥ karoti ya evāsyācārye pādas tameva tena parikrīṇāti taṃ saṃskṛtyātman dhatte sa enam āviśati | atha yat svādhyāyam adhīte ya evāsyātmani pādas tameva tena parikrīṇāti taṃ saṃskṛtyātman dhatte sa enam āviśati | na ha vai snātvā bhikṣeta | api ha vai snātvā bhikṣāṃ caraty api jñātīnām aśanāyāpi pitqṇām anyābhyaḥ kriyābhyaḥ | sa yad anyāṃ bhikṣitavyāṃ na vindetāpi svāmevācāryajāyāṃ bhikṣetātho svāṃ mātaram | nainaṃ saptamy abhikṣitātīyāt | bhaikṣasyācaraṇe doṣaḥ pāvakasyāsamindhane | saptarātram akṛtvaitad avakīrṇivrataṃ caret | tam evaṃ vidvāṃsam evaṃ carantaṃ sarve vedā āviśanti |
meaning: ब्राह्मणो वै ब्रह्मचर्यम् उपयंश् चतुर्धा भूतानि प्रविशत्य् अग्निं पदा मृत्युं पदाचार्यं पदात्मन्य् एवास्यचतुर्थः पादः परिशिष्यते । स यद् अग्नौ समिधम् आदधाति य एवास्याग्नौ पादस् तमेव तेन परिक्रीणाति तं संस्कृत्यात्मन् धत्ते स एनम् आविशति । अथ यद् आत्मानं दरिद्रीक्रित्याह्रीर् भूत्वा भिक्षतेब्रह्मचर्यं चरति य एवास्य मृत्यौ पादस् तम् एव तेन परिक्रीणातितं संस्कृत्यात्मन् धत्ते स एनम् आविशति । अथ यद् आचार्यवचः करोति य एवास्याचार्ये पादस् तमेव तेन परिक्रीणाति तं संस्कृत्यात्मन् धत्ते स एनम् आविशति । अथ यत् स्वाध्यायम् अधीते य एवास्यात्मनि पादस् तमेव तेन परिक्रीणाति तं संस्कृत्यात्मन् धत्ते स एनम् आविशति । न ह वै स्नात्वा भिक्षेत । अपि ह वै स्नात्वा भिक्षां चरत्य् अपि ज्ञातीनाम् अशनायापि पित्qणाम् अन्याभ्यः क्रियाभ्यः । स यद् अन्यां भिक्षितव्यां न विन्देतापि स्वामेवाचार्यजायां भिक्षेताथो स्वां मातरम् । नैनं सप्तम्य् अभिक्षितातीयात् । भैक्षस्याचरणे दोषः पावकस्यासमिन्धने । सप्तरात्रम् अकृत्वैतद् अवकीर्णिव्रतं चरेत् । तम् एवं विद्वांसम् एवं चरन्तं सर्वे वेदा आविशन्ति ।
text: 'A Brāhmaṇa who becomes a student of the Veda, enters existent beings in a fourfold manner, (viz.) with one quarter (he enters) Fire, with one quarter Death, with one quarter the Teacher, the fourth quarter remains in the Soul. When he offers to Fire a piece of sacred fuel, he thereby buys back even that quarter which (resides) in Fire, hallowing it, he places it in himself; that enters into him. Now when making himself poor and, becoming shameless, he asks for alms (and) lives as a student of the Veda, he thereby buys back the quarter which (resides) in Death; hallowing it, he places it in himself; that enters into him. Now when he obeys the orders of his Teacher, he thereby buys back that quarter which (resides) in the Teacher; hallowing it, he places it in himself; that enters into him. [Now when he recites the Veda, he thereby buys back the quarter which resides in the Soul. Hallowing it, he places it in himself; that enters into him.] Let him not go to beg, after he has bathed (on finishing his studentship). . . . If he does not find another woman whom he can ask for alms,, let him beg even from his own teacher's wife or from his own mother. The seventh (night) shall not pass without his asking for alms. [(He commits) sin if he does not go out to ask for alms and does not place fuel on the fire. If he neglects that during seven (days and) nights, he must perform the penance prescribed for one who has broken the vow of studentship.] All the Vedas come to him who knows that and acts thus.'

sanskrit_iast: yathā ha vā agniḥ samiddho rocata evaṃ ha vā eṣa snātvā rocate ya evaṃ vidvān brahmacaryaṃ caratīti brāhmaṇam | itibrāhmaṇam |
meaning: यथा ह वा अग्निः समिद्धो रोचत एवं ह वा एष स्नात्वा रोचते य एवं विद्वान् ब्रह्मचर्यं चरतीति ब्राह्मणम् । इतिब्राह्मणम् ।
text: 'As a blazing fire shines, even so shines he who, knowing this, thus fulfils the duties of studentship, after he has bathed (on leaving his teacher).' Thus speaks the Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: atha snātakasya |
meaning: अथ स्नातकस्य ।
text: Now (follow the duties) of a Snātaka.

sanskrit_iast: antarvāsa uttarīyam |
meaning: अन्तर्वास उत्तरीयम् ।
text: He shall wear a lower garment and upper garment.

sanskrit_iast: vaiṇavaṃ daṇḍaṃ dhārayet |
meaning: वैणवं दण्डं धारयेत् ।
text: Let him carry a staff made of bamboo,

sanskrit_iast: sodakaṃ ca kamaṇḍalum |
meaning: सोदकं च कमण्डलुम् ।
text: And a pot filled with water.

sanskrit_iast: dviyajñopavītī |
meaning: द्वियज्ञोपवीती ।
text: Let him wear two sacrificial threads.

sanskrit_iast: uṣṇīṣam ajinam uttarīyam upānahau chattraṃ copāsanaṃdarśapūrṇamāsau |
meaning: उष्णीषम् अजिनम् उत्तरीयम् उपानहौ छत्त्रं चोपासनंदर्शपूर्णमासौ ।
text: (He shall possess) a turban, an upper garment (consisting of) a skin, shoes, and a parasol. (He shall keep) a sacred fire and (offer) the new and full moon (Sthālīpākas).

sanskrit_iast: parvasu ca keśaśmaśrulomanakhavāpanam |
meaning: पर्वसु च केशश्मश्रुलोमनखवापनम् ।
text: He shall cause the hair of his head, of his beard, and of his body, and his nails to be cut on the Parva days.

sanskrit_iast: tasya vṛttiḥ |
meaning: तस्य वृत्तिः ।
text: His livelihood (he shall obtain in the following manner):

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇarājanyavaiśyarathakāreṣv āmaṃ lipseta |
meaning: ब्राह्मणराजन्यवैश्यरथकारेष्व् आमं लिप्सेत ।
text: Let him beg uncooked (food) from Brāhmaṇas, Kshatriyas, Vaiśyas, or carpenters,

sanskrit_iast: bhaikṣaṃ vā |
meaning: भैक्षं वा ।
text: Or (cooked) food (even from many).

sanskrit_iast: vāgyatas tiṣṭhet |
meaning: वाग्यतस् तिष्ठेत् ।
text: Let him remain silent (when he goes to beg).

sanskrit_iast: sarvāṇi cāsya devapitṛsaṃyuktāni pākayajñasaṃsthānibhūtikarmāni kurvīteti |
meaning: सर्वाणि चास्य देवपितृसंयुक्तानि पाकयज्ञसंस्थानिभूतिकर्मानि कुर्वीतेति ।
text: Let him perform with that all Pākaya g ñ as, offered to the gods and manes, and the rites, securing welfare.

sanskrit_iast: etena vidhinā prajāpateḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ paramarṣayaḥ paramāṃkāṣṭhāṃ gacchantīti baudhāyanaḥ |
meaning: एतेन विधिना प्रजापतेः परमेष्ठिनः परमर्षयः परमांकाष्ठां गच्छन्तीति बौधायनः ।
text: Baudhāyana declares that by (following) this rule the most excellent sages reach the highest abode of Pra g āpati Paramesh th in.

sanskrit_iast: atha kamaṇḍalucaryām upadiśanti |
meaning: अथ कमण्डलुचर्याम् उपदिशन्ति ।
text: Now (those who know the law) prescribe the carrying of a waterpot.

sanskrit_iast: chāgasya dakṣiṇe karṇe pāṇau viprasya dakṣiṇe | apsu caiva kuśastambe pāvakaḥ paripaṭhyate | tasmāc chaucaṃ kṛtvā pāṇinā parimṛjīta paryagnikaraṇaṃ hitat | uddīpyasva jātaveda iti punardāhād viśiṣyate |
meaning: छागस्य दक्षिणे कर्णे पाणौ विप्रस्य दक्षिणे । अप्सु चैव कुशस्तम्बे पावकः परिपठ्यते । तस्माच् छौचं कृत्वा पाणिना परिमृजीत पर्यग्निकरणं हितत् । उद्दीप्यस्व जातवेद इति पुनर्दाहाद् विशिष्यते ।
text: It is declared (in the Vedas) that fire (resides) in the right ear of a goat, in the right hand of a Brāhmaṇa, likewise in water (and) in a bundle of Kuśa grass. Therefore after personal purification let him wipe (his water-vessel) on all sides with his (right) hand, (reciting the mantra), 'Blaze up, O fire;' for that (is called) encircling it with fire and is preferable to heating (the pot on the fire).

sanskrit_iast: tatrāpi kiṃcit saṃspṛṣṭaṃ manasi manyeta kuśairvā tṛṇair vā prajvālya pradakṣiṇaṃ paridahanam |
meaning: तत्रापि किंचित् संस्पृष्टं मनसि मन्येत कुशैर्वा तृणैर् वा प्रज्वाल्य प्रदक्षिणं परिदहनम् ।
text: With reference to this matter they prescribe also (the following rules): 'If he thinks in his heart that (the pot) has been slightly defiled, let him light Kuśa or (other) grass and heat (the pot) on all sides, keeping his right hand turned towards it.'

sanskrit_iast: ata ūrdhvaṃ śvavāyasaprabhṛtyupahatānām agnivarṇa ity upadiśanti |
meaning: अत ऊर्ध्वं श्ववायसप्रभृत्युपहतानाम् अग्निवर्ण इत्य् उपदिशन्ति ।
text: 'If (pots) have been touched by crows, dogs, or other (unclean animals, they shall be heated, until they are of) the colour of fire, after the (paryagnikaraṇa has been performed).'

sanskrit_iast: mūtrapurīṣalohitaretaḥprabhṛtyupahatānāmutsargaḥ |
meaning: मूत्रपुरीषलोहितरेतःप्रभृत्युपहतानामुत्सर्गः ।
text: (Pots) which have been defiled by urine, ordure, blood, semen, and the like must be thrown away.

sanskrit_iast: bhagne kamaṇḍalau vyāhṛtibhiḥ śataṃ juhuyāj japed vā |
meaning: भग्ने कमण्डलौ व्याहृतिभिः शतं जुहुयाज् जपेद् वा ।
text: If his waterpot has been broken, let him offer one hundred (oblations) reciting the Vyāh ri tis, or mutter (the Vyāh ri tis as often).

sanskrit_iast: bhūmir bhūmim agān mātā mātaram apy agāt | bhūyāsmaputraiḥ paśubhir yo no dveṣṭi sa bhidyatām iti | kapālāni saṃhṛtyāpsu prakṣipya sāvitrīṃ daśāvarāṃ kṛtvā punar evānyaṃ gṛhṇīyāt |
meaning: भूमिर् भूमिम् अगान् माता मातरम् अप्य् अगात् । भूयास्मपुत्रैः पशुभिर् यो नो द्वेष्टि स भिद्यताम् इति । कपालानि संहृत्याप्सु प्रक्षिप्य सावित्रीं दशावरां कृत्वा पुनर् एवान्यं गृह्णीयात् ।
text: (Reciting the text), 'Earth went to earth, the mother joined the mother; may we have sons and cattle; may he who hates us be destroyed,' he shall collect the fragments, throw them into water, repeat the Gāyatrī at least ten times and take again another (pot).

sanskrit_iast: varuṇam āśritya | etat te varuṇa punar eva mām om iti | akṣaraṃ dhyāyet |
meaning: वरुणम् आश्रित्य । एतत् ते वरुण पुनर् एव माम् ओम् इति । अक्षरं ध्यायेत् ।
text: Taking refuge with Varuṇa, (he shall recite the mantra), 'That (belongs) to thee, Varuṇa; again to me, Om,' (and) meditate on the indestructible.

sanskrit_iast: śūdrād gṛhya śataṃ kuryād vaiśyād ardhaśataṃ smṛtam | kṣatriyāt pañcaviṃśat tu brāhmaṇād daśa kīrtitāḥ |
meaning: शूद्राद् गृह्य शतं कुर्याद् वैश्याद् अर्धशतं स्मृतम् । क्षत्रियात् पञ्चविंशत् तु ब्राह्मणाद् दश कीर्तिताः ।
text: 'If he has received (the new vessel) from a Śūdra, let him recite (the Gāyatrī) one hundred (times). (If he has received it) from a Vaiśya, fifty (repetitions of the Gāyatrī) are prescribed, but (on receiving it) from a Kshatriya twenty-five, (and on taking it) from a Brāhmaṇa ten.'

sanskrit_iast: astamita āditya udakaṃ gṛhṇīyān na gṛhṇīyād iti mīmāṃsante brahmavādinaḥ |
meaning: अस्तमित आदित्य उदकं गृह्णीयान् न गृह्णीयाद् इति मीमांसन्ते ब्रह्मवादिनः ।
text: Those who recite the Veda are doubtful whether he shall fetch water after the sun has, set or shall not fetch it.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhṇīyād ity etad aparam |
meaning: गृह्णीयाद् इत्य् एतद् अपरम् ।
text: The most excellent (opinion is) that he may fetch it.

sanskrit_iast: yāvad udakaṃ gṛhṇīyāt tāvat prāṇam āyacchet |
meaning: यावद् उदकं गृह्णीयात् तावत् प्राणम् आयच्छेत् ।
text: Let him restrain his breath, while he fetches water.

sanskrit_iast: agnir ha vai hy udakaṃ gṛhṇāti |
meaning: अग्निर् ह वै ह्य् उदकं गृह्णाति ।
text: Fire, forsooth, takes up water.

sanskrit_iast: kamaṇḍalūdakenābhiṣiktapāṇipādo yāvad ārdraṃ tāvadaśuciḥ pareṣām | ātmānam eva pūtam karoti | nānyat karma kurvīteti vijñāyate |
meaning: कमण्डलूदकेनाभिषिक्तपाणिपादो यावद् आर्द्रं तावदशुचिः परेषाम् । आत्मानम् एव पूतम् करोति । नान्यत् कर्म कुर्वीतेति विज्ञायते ।
text: It is declared (in the Veda), 'When he has washed his hands and feet with water from his water-vessel, he is impure for others, as long as the moisture (remains). He purifies himself only. Let him not perform other religious rites (with water from his pot).'

sanskrit_iast: api vā pratiśaucam ā maṇibandhāc chucir iti baudhāyanaḥ |
meaning: अपि वा प्रतिशौचम् आ मणिबन्धाच् छुचिर् इति बौधायनः ।
text: Baudhāyana (says), 'Or if on the occasion of each personal purification (he washes himself with other water) up to the wrist, (he will become) pure.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses):

sanskrit_iast: kamaṇḍalur dvijātīnāṃ śaucārthaṃ vihitaḥ purā | brahmaṇā munimukhyaiś ca tasmāt taṃ dhārayet sadā | tataḥ śaucaṃ tataḥ pānaṃ saṃdhyopāsanam eva ca | nirviśaṅkena kartavyaṃ yadīcchec chreya ātmanaḥ |
meaning: कमण्डलुर् द्विजातीनां शौचार्थं विहितः पुरा । ब्रह्मणा मुनिमुख्यैश् च तस्मात् तं धारयेत् सदा । ततः शौचं ततः पानं संध्योपासनम् एव च । निर्विशङ्केन कर्तव्यं यदीच्छेच् छ्रेय आत्मनः ।
text: 'Formerly (the use of) a waterpot has been prescribed by Brahman and the chief sages for the purification of twice-born men. Therefore he shall always carry one.' 'He who desires his own welfare, shall use it without hesitation, for purifying (his person), for drinking, and for performing his twilight devotions.'

sanskrit_iast: kuryāc chuddhena manasā na cittaṃ dūṣayed budhaḥ | sahakamaṇḍalunotpannaḥ svayaṃbhūs tasmāt kamaṇḍalunā caret |
meaning: कुर्याच् छुद्धेन मनसा न चित्तं दूषयेद् बुधः । सहकमण्डलुनोत्पन्नः स्वयंभूस् तस्मात् कमण्डलुना चरेत् ।
text: Let him do it with a believing heart; a wise man must not corrupt his mind. The self-existent [paragraph continues] (Brahman) came into existence with a water-vessel. Therefore let him perform (his rites) with a water-vessel.

sanskrit_iast: mūtrapurīṣe kurvan dakṣiṇe haste gṛhṇāti savya ācamanīyam | etat sidhyati sādhūnām |
meaning: मूत्रपुरीषे कुर्वन् दक्षिणे हस्ते गृह्णाति सव्य आचमनीयम् । एतत् सिध्यति साधूनाम् ।
text: Let him hold it in his right hand when he voids urine and excrements, in the left when he sips water. That is (a) settled (rule) for all good men.

sanskrit_iast: yathā hi somasaṃyogāc camaso medhya ucyate | apāṃ tathaiva saṃyogān nityo medhyaḥ kamaṇḍaluḥ |
meaning: यथा हि सोमसंयोगाच् चमसो मेध्य उच्यते । अपां तथैव संयोगान् नित्यो मेध्यः कमण्डलुः ।
text: For as the sacrificial cusp ( k amasa) is declared to be pure on account of its contact with the Soma-juice, even so the water-vessel is constantly pure through its contact with water.

sanskrit_iast: pitṛdevāgnikāryeṣu tasmāt taṃ parivarjayet |
meaning: पितृदेवाग्निकार्येषु तस्मात् तं परिवर्जयेत् ।
text: Therefore let him avoid (to use) it for the worship of the manes, the gods, and the fire.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād vinā kamaṇḍalunā nādhvānaṃ vrajen na sīmantaṃ nagṛhād gṛham |
meaning: तस्माद् विना कमण्डलुना नाध्वानं व्रजेन् न सीमन्तं नगृहाद् गृहम् ।
text: Therefore let him not go on a journey without a waterpot, nor to the boundary of the village, nor from one house to the other.

sanskrit_iast: padam api na gacched iṣumātrād ity eke |
meaning: पदम् अपि न गच्छेद् इषुमात्राद् इत्य् एके ।
text: Some (declare that he must not go without it) a step further than the length of an arrow.

sanskrit_iast: yad icched dharmasaṃtatim iti baudhāyanaḥ |
meaning: यद् इच्छेद् धर्मसंततिम् इति बौधायनः ।
text: Baudhāyana (says that he shall not go without it) if he wishes to fulfil his duties constantly.

sanskrit_iast: ṛgvidheneti vāg vadati | ṛgvidheneti vāg vadati |
meaning: ऋग्विधेनेति वाग् वदति । ऋग्विधेनेति वाग् वदति ।
text: (The divine) Word declares that (this is con-firmed) by a Ri k-shaped (passage).

sanskrit_iast: athātaḥ śaucādhiṣṭhānam |
meaning: अथातः शौचाधिष्ठानम् ।
text: Now (follows the description of) the means of purification.

sanskrit_iast: adbhiḥ śudhyanti gātrāṇi buddhir jñānena śudhyati | ahiṃsayā ca bhūtātmā manaḥ satyena śudhyati || iti |
meaning: अद्भिः शुध्यन्ति गात्राणि बुद्धिर् ज्ञानेन शुध्यति । अहिंसया च भूतात्मा मनः सत्येन शुध्यति ॥ इति ।
text: The body is purified by water, the understanding by knowledge, the soul by abstention from injuring living beings, the internal organ by truth.

sanskrit_iast: manaḥśuddhir antaḥśaucam |
meaning: मनःशुद्धिर् अन्तःशौचम् ।
text: Purifying the internal organ (is called) internal purification.

sanskrit_iast: bahiḥśaucaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ |
meaning: बहिःशौचं व्याख्यास्यामः ।
text: We will explain (the rules of) external purification.

sanskrit_iast: kauśaṃ sautraṃ vā tristrivṛd yajñopavītam |
meaning: कौशं सौत्रं वा त्रिस्त्रिवृद् यज्ञोपवीतम् ।
text: The sacrificial thread (shall be made) of Kuśa grass, or cotton, (and consist) of thrice three strings.

sanskrit_iast: ā nābheḥ |
meaning: आ नाभेः ।
text: (It shall hang down) to the navel.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇaṃ bāhum uddhṛtya savyam avadhāya śiro 'vadadhyāt |
meaning: दक्षिणं बाहुम् उद्धृत्य सव्यम् अवधाय शिरो ऽवदध्यात् ।
text: (In putting it on) he shall raise the right arm, lower the left, and lower the head.

sanskrit_iast: viparītaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ |
meaning: विपरीतं पितृभ्यः ।
text: The contrary (is done at sacrifices) to the manes.

sanskrit_iast: kaṇṭhe 'vasaktaṃ nivītam |
meaning: कण्ठे ऽवसक्तं निवीतम् ।
text: (If the thread is) suspended round the neck, (it is called) nivīta.

sanskrit_iast: adho 'vasaktaṃ adhovītam |
meaning: अधो ऽवसक्तं अधोवीतम् ।
text: (If it is) suspended below (the navel, it is called) adhopavīta.

sanskrit_iast: prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vāsīnaḥ śaucam ārabheta śucau deśedakṣiṇam bāhuṃ jānvantarā kṛtvā prakṣālya pādau pāṇī cāmaṇibandhāt |
meaning: प्राङ्मुख उदङ्मुखो वासीनः शौचम् आरभेत शुचौ देशेदक्षिणम् बाहुं जान्वन्तरा कृत्वा प्रक्षाल्य पादौ पाणी चामणिबन्धात् ।
text: Let him perform (the rite of personal) purification, facing the east or the north, (and) seated in a pure place; (let him) place his right arm between his knees and wash both hands up to the wrist and both feet (up to the ankles).

sanskrit_iast: pādaprakṣālanoccheṣaṇena nācāmet |
meaning: पादप्रक्षालनोच्छेषणेन नाचामेत् ।
text: Let him not use for sipping the remainder of the water with which he has washed his feet.

sanskrit_iast: yady ācāmed bhūmau srāvayitvācāmet |
meaning: यद्य् आचामेद् भूमौ स्रावयित्वाचामेत् ।
text: But if he uses (that) for sipping, let him do it, after pouring (a portion of it) on the ground.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmeṇa tīrthenācāmet |
meaning: ब्राह्मेण तीर्थेनाचामेत् ।
text: He shall sip out of the Tīrtha sacred to Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: aṅguṣṭhamūlaṃ brāhmaṃ tīrtham |
meaning: अङ्गुष्ठमूलं ब्राह्मं तीर्थम् ।
text: The part (of the hand) at the root of the thumb (is called) the Tīrtha sacred to Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: aṅguṣṭhāgraṃ pitryam aṅgulyagraṃ daivam aṅgulimūlam ārṣam |
meaning: अङ्गुष्ठाग्रं पित्र्यम् अङ्गुल्यग्रं दैवम् अङ्गुलिमूलम् आर्षम् ।
text: The part above the thumb (is called the Tīrtha) sacred to the manes, the part at the tips of the fingers that sacred to the gods, the part at the root of the fingers that sacred to the Ri shis.

sanskrit_iast: nāṅgulībhir na sabudbudābhir na saphenābhir noṣṇābhirna kṣārābhir na lavaṇābhir na kaluṣābhir na vivarṇābhir nadurgandharasābhiḥ |
meaning: नाङ्गुलीभिर् न सबुद्बुदाभिर् न सफेनाभिर् नोष्णाभिर्न क्षाराभिर् न लवणाभिर् न कलुषाभिर् न विवर्णाभिर् नदुर्गन्धरसाभिः ।
text: (Let him not use for sipping water that has trickled) from the fingers, nor (water) that is covered with bubbles or foam, nor (water that is) hot, or alkaline, or salt, or muddy, or discoloured, or has a bad smell or taste.

sanskrit_iast: na hasan na jalpan na tiṣṭhan na vilokayan na prahvo na praṇatona muktaśikho na prāvṛtakaṇṭho na veṣṭitaśirā na tvaramāṇonāyajñopavītī na prasāritapādo na baddhakakṣyo na bahirjānuḥśabdam akurvan |
meaning: न हसन् न जल्पन् न तिष्ठन् न विलोकयन् न प्रह्वो न प्रणतोन मुक्तशिखो न प्रावृतकण्ठो न वेष्टितशिरा न त्वरमाणोनायज्ञोपवीती न प्रसारितपादो न बद्धकक्ष्यो न बहिर्जानुःशब्दम् अकुर्वन् ।
text: (Let him not sip water) laughing, nor talking, nor standing, nor looking about, nor bending his head or his body forward, nor while the lock on his crown is untied, nor while his throat is wrapped up, nor while his head is covered, nor when he is in a hurry, nor without wearing the sacrificial thread, nor stretching his feet out, nor while his loins are girt (with a cloth), nor without holding his right arm between his knees, nor making a sound.

sanskrit_iast: trir apo hṛdayaṃgamāḥ pibet |
meaning: त्रिर् अपो हृदयंगमाः पिबेत् ।
text: Let him thrice drink water that reaches his heart.

sanskrit_iast: triḥ parimṛjet |
meaning: त्रिः परिमृजेत् ।
text: Let him wipe (his lips) thrice.

sanskrit_iast: dvir ity eke |
meaning: द्विर् इत्य् एके ।
text: Some (declare that he shall do it) twice.

sanskrit_iast: sakṛd ubhayaṃ śūdrasya striyāś ca |
meaning: सकृद् उभयं शूद्रस्य स्त्रियाश् च ।
text: A woman and a Śūdra (shall perform) both (acts) once (only).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | gatābhir hṛdayaṃ vipraḥ kaṇṭhyābhiḥ kṣatriyaḥ śuciḥ | vaiśyo 'dbhiḥ prāśitābhiḥ syāt strīśūdrau spṛśyacāntataḥ || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । गताभिर् हृदयं विप्रः कण्ठ्याभिः क्षत्रियः शुचिः । वैश्यो ऽद्भिः प्राशिताभिः स्यात् स्त्रीशूद्रौ स्पृश्यचान्ततः ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): A Brāhmaṇa is purified by water that reaches his heart, a Kshatriya by (water) reaching his throat, a Vaiśya by (water barely) taken into the mouth, a woman and a Śūdra by touching (it) with the extremity (of the lips).

sanskrit_iast: dantavad dantasakteṣu dantavat teṣu dhāraṇāt | srasteṣu teṣu nācāmet teṣāṃ saṃsrāvavac chuciḥ || iti |
meaning: दन्तवद् दन्तसक्तेषु दन्तवत् तेषु धारणात् । स्रस्तेषु तेषु नाचामेत् तेषां संस्राववच् छुचिः ॥ इति ।
text: 'If (drops) adhere to his teeth, (they must be considered pure) like the teeth, because they are fixed (in the mouth) like the teeth. Let him not sip water on their account in case they fall. If they flow out, he will be pure.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | dantavad dantalagneṣu yac cāpy antar mukhe bhavet | ācāntasyāvaśiṣṭaṃ syān nigirann eva tac chuciḥ || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । दन्तवद् दन्तलग्नेषु यच् चाप्य् अन्तर् मुखे भवेत् । आचान्तस्यावशिष्टं स्यान् निगिरन्न् एव तच् छुचिः ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): If anything adheres to the teeth, (it is pure) like the teeth; and if he swallows (it or) whatever else may be in the mouth (or) may remain after sipping water, (he will become) pure.'

sanskrit_iast: khāny adbhiḥ saṃspṛśya pādau nābhiṃ śiraḥ savyaṃ pāṇimantataḥ |
meaning: खान्य् अद्भिः संस्पृश्य पादौ नाभिं शिरः सव्यं पाणिमन्ततः ।
text: (After sipping) he shall touch the cavities (of the head) with water, the feet, the navel, the head, (and) lastly the left hand.

sanskrit_iast: taijasaṃ ced ādāyocchiṣṭī syāt tad udasyācamyādāsyann adbhiḥ prokṣet |
meaning: तैजसं चेद् आदायोच्छिष्टी स्यात् तद् उदस्याचम्यादास्यन्न् अद्भिः प्रोक्षेत् ।
text: If he becomes impure while holding (a vessel) made of metal, he shall put it down, sip water and sprinkle it, when he is going to take it up.

sanskrit_iast: atha ced annenocchiṣṭī syāt tad udasyācamyādāsyannadbhiḥ prokṣet |
meaning: अथ चेद् अन्नेनोच्छिष्टी स्यात् तद् उदस्याचम्यादास्यन्नद्भिः प्रोक्षेत् ।
text: Now if he becomes impure (while he is occupied) with food, he shall put it down, sip water and sprinkle it, when he is going to take it up.

sanskrit_iast: atha ced adbhir ucchiṣṭī syāt tad udasyācamyādāsyannadbhiḥ prokṣet |
meaning: अथ चेद् अद्भिर् उच्छिष्टी स्यात् तद् उदस्याचम्यादास्यन्नद्भिः प्रोक्षेत् ।
text: Now if he becomes impure (while occupied) with water, he shall put it down, sip water and sprinkle it, when he is going to take it up

sanskrit_iast: etad eva viparītam amatre |
meaning: एतद् एव विपरीतम् अमत्रे ।
text: That is contrary (to the rule) in (the case of an earthen) vessel.

sanskrit_iast: vānaspatye vikalpaḥ |
meaning: वानस्पत्ये विकल्पः ।
text: In (the case of a vessel) made of wood there is an option.

sanskrit_iast: taijasānām ucchiṣṭānāṃ gośakṛnmṛdbhasmabhiḥ parimārjanamanyatamena vā |
meaning: तैजसानाम् उच्छिष्टानां गोशकृन्मृद्भस्मभिः परिमार्जनमन्यतमेन वा ।
text: Defiled (objects) made of metal must be scoured with cowdung, earth, and ashes, or with one of these (three).

sanskrit_iast: tāmrarajatasuvarṇānām amlaiḥ |
meaning: ताम्ररजतसुवर्णानाम् अम्लैः ।
text: Copper, silver, and gold (must be cleaned) with acids.

sanskrit_iast: amatrāṇāṃ dahanam |
meaning: अमत्राणां दहनम् ।
text: Earthen vessels must be heated.

sanskrit_iast: dāravāṇāṃ takṣaṇam |
meaning: दारवाणां तक्षणम् ।
text: (Objects) made of wood must be planed.

sanskrit_iast: vaiṇavānāṃ gomayena |
meaning: वैणवानां गोमयेन ।
text: (Objects) made of bamboo (must be cleaned) with cowdung,

sanskrit_iast: phalamayānāṃ govālarajjvā |
meaning: फलमयानां गोवालरज्ज्वा ।
text: (Objects) made of fruits with a rope of cow-hair,

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇājinānāṃ bilvataṇḍulaiḥ |
meaning: कृष्णाजिनानां बिल्वतण्डुलैः ।
text: Skins of black deer with (ground) Bel nut and rice,

sanskrit_iast: kutapānām ariṣṭaiḥ |
meaning: कुतपानाम् अरिष्टैः ।
text: Blankets (of the hair of the mountain goat) with Areka nuts,

sanskrit_iast: aurṇānām ādityena |
meaning: और्णानाम् आदित्येन ।
text: (Cloth) made of (sheep's) wool by the (rays of the) sun,

sanskrit_iast: kṣaumāṇāṃ gaurasarṣapakalkena |
meaning: क्षौमाणां गौरसर्षपकल्केन ।
text: Linen (cloth) with a paste of yellow mustard,

sanskrit_iast: mṛdā celānām |
meaning: मृदा चेलानाम् ।
text: Cotton cloth with earth,

sanskrit_iast: celavac carmaṇām |
meaning: चेलवच् चर्मणाम् ।
text: Skins (other than deer-skins shall be treated) like cotton cloth,

sanskrit_iast: taijasavad upalamaṇīnām |
meaning: तैजसवद् उपलमणीनाम् ।
text: Stones and gems like (objects) made of metal,

sanskrit_iast: dāruvad asthnām |
meaning: दारुवद् अस्थ्नाम् ।
text: Bones like wood,

sanskrit_iast: kṣaumavac chaṅkhaśṛṅgaśuktidantānām |
meaning: क्षौमवच् छङ्खशृङ्गशुक्तिदन्तानाम् ।
text: Conch-shells, horn, pearl-shells, and ivory like linen cloth.

sanskrit_iast: payasā vā |
meaning: पयसा वा ।
text: Or (they may be cleaned) with milk.

sanskrit_iast: cakṣurghrāṇānukūlyād vāmūtrapurīṣāsṛjśukrakuṇapaspṛṣṭānāṃ pūrvoktānām anyatamenatriḥsaptakṛtvaḥ parimārjanam |
meaning: चक्षुर्घ्राणानुकूल्याद् वामूत्रपुरीषासृज्शुक्रकुणपस्पृष्टानां पूर्वोक्तानाम् अन्यतमेनत्रिःसप्तकृत्वः परिमार्जनम् ।
text: (Objects) which have been defiled by urine, ordure, blood, semen, or a dead body, (but) are agreeable to the eye and the nose, shall be rubbed seven times with one of the substances mentioned above.

sanskrit_iast: ataijasānām evaṃbhūtānām utsargaḥ |
meaning: अतैजसानाम् एवंभूतानाम् उत्सर्गः ।
text: (Objects) not made of metal which are in the same condition must be thrown away.

sanskrit_iast: vacanād yajñe camasapātrānām |
meaning: वचनाद् यज्ञे चमसपात्रानाम् ।
text: The cups and vessels (used) at a sacrifice (must be cleaned) according to the injunction (of the Veda).

sanskrit_iast: na somenocchiṣṭā bhavantīti śrutiḥ |
meaning: न सोमेनोच्छिष्टा भवन्तीति श्रुतिः ।
text: The Veda (declares), 'They do not become impure through Soma.'

sanskrit_iast: kālo 'gnir manasaḥ śuddhir udakādyupalepanam | avijñātaṃ ca bhūtāṇāṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ śaucam ucyate || iti |
meaning: कालो ऽग्निर् मनसः शुद्धिर् उदकाद्युपलेपनम् । अविज्ञातं च भूताणां षड्विधं शौचम् उच्यते ॥ इति ।
text: 'Time, fire, purity of mind, water and the like (fluids), smearing with cowdung and ignorance (of defilement) are declared to be the sixfold (means of) purification for created beings.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | kālaṃ deśaṃ tathātmānaṃ dravyaṃ dravyaprayojanam | upapattim avasthāṃ ca vijñāya śaucaṃ śaucajñaḥ kuśalo dharmepsuḥ samācaret |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । कालं देशं तथात्मानं द्रव्यं द्रव्यप्रयोजनम् । उपपत्तिम् अवस्थां च विज्ञाय शौचं शौचज्ञः कुशलो धर्मेप्सुः समाचरेत् ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): [paragraph continues] 'A clever man, who knows (the rules of) purification and is desirous of righteousness, shall perform (the rites of) purification, after having fully considered the time, and the place (of the defilement), likewise himself, (as well as) the object (to be cleaned) and the substance (to be employed), the purpose of the object, the cause (of the defilement), and the condition (of the thing or person defiled).'

sanskrit_iast: nityaṃ śuddhaḥ kāruhastaḥ paṇyaṃ yac ca prasāritam | brahmacārigataṃ bhaikṣaṃ nityaṃ medhyam iti śrutiḥ |
meaning: नित्यं शुद्धः कारुहस्तः पण्यं यच् च प्रसारितम् । ब्रह्मचारिगतं भैक्षं नित्यं मेध्यम् इति श्रुतिः ।
text: The Veda declares that the hand of an artisan is always pure, so is every vendible commodity exposed for sale and food obtained by begging, which a student holds in. his hand.

sanskrit_iast: vatsaḥ prasnavane medhyaḥ śakuniḥ phalaśātane | striyaś ca ratisaṃsarge śvā mṛgagrahaṇe śuciḥ |
meaning: वत्सः प्रस्नवने मेध्यः शकुनिः फलशातने । स्त्रियश् च रतिसंसर्गे श्वा मृगग्रहणे शुचिः ।
text: A calf is pure on the flowing (of the milk), a bird on the fall of the fruit, women at the time of dalliance, and a dog when he catches a deer.

sanskrit_iast: ākarāḥ śucayaḥ sarve varjayitvā surākaram | adūṣyāḥ saṃtatā dhārā vātodbhūtāś ca reṇavaḥ |
meaning: आकराः शुचयः सर्वे वर्जयित्वा सुराकरम् । अदूष्याः संतता धारा वातोद्भूताश् च रेणवः ।
text: All mines and places of manufacture are pure excepting distilleries of spirituous liquor; continuously flowing streams of water and dust raised by the wind cannot be contaminated.

sanskrit_iast: amedhyeṣu ca ye vṛkṣā uptāḥ puṣpaphalopagāḥ | teṣām api na duṣyanti puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca |
meaning: अमेध्येषु च ये वृक्षा उप्ताः पुष्पफलोपगाः । तेषाम् अपि न दुष्यन्ति पुष्पाणि च फलानि च ।
text: The flowers and fruit of flowering and fruit-bearing trees which grow in unclean places are likewise not impure.

sanskrit_iast: caityavṛkṣaṃ citiṃ yūpaṃ caṇḍālaṃ vedavikrayam | etāni brāhmaṇaḥ spṛṣṭvā sacelo jalam āviśet |
meaning: चैत्यवृक्षं चितिं यूपं चण्डालं वेदविक्रयम् । एतानि ब्राह्मणः स्पृष्ट्वा सचेलो जलम् आविशेत् ।
text: On touching a tree standing on a sacred spot, a funeral pile, a sacrificial post, a K aṇd āla or a person who sells the Veda, a Brāhmaṇa shall bathe dressed in his clothes.

sanskrit_iast: ātmaśayyāsanaṃ vastraṃ jāyāpatyaṃ kamaṇḍaluḥ | śucīny ātmana etāni pareṣām aśucīni tu |
meaning: आत्मशय्यासनं वस्त्रं जायापत्यं कमण्डलुः । शुचीन्य् आत्मन एतानि परेषाम् अशुचीनि तु ।
text: One's own couch, seat, clothes, wife, child, and waterpot are pure for oneself; but for strangers they are impure.

sanskrit_iast: āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ nāvaḥ pathi tṛṇāni ca | caṇḍālapatitaspṛṣṭaṃ mārutenaiva śudhyati |
meaning: आसनं शयनं यानं नावः पथि तृणानि च । चण्डालपतितस्पृष्टं मारुतेनैव शुध्यति ।
text: A seat, a couch, a vehicle, ships (and boats), the road and grass are purified by the wind, if they have been touched by K aṇd ālas or outcasts.

sanskrit_iast: khalakṣetreṣu yad dhānyaṃ kūpavāpīṣu yaj jalam | abhojyād api tad bhojyaṃ yac ca goṣṭhagataṃ payaḥ |
meaning: खलक्षेत्रेषु यद् धान्यं कूपवापीषु यज् जलम् । अभोज्याद् अपि तद् भोज्यं यच् च गोष्ठगतं पयः ।
text: Grain on the threshing-floor, water in wells and reservoirs, and milk in the cowpen are fit for use even (if they come) from a person whose food must not be eaten.

sanskrit_iast: trīṇi devāḥ pavitrāṇi brāhmaṇānām akalpayan | adṛṣṭam adbhir nirṇiktaṃ yac ca vācā praśasyate |
meaning: त्रीणि देवाः पवित्राणि ब्राह्मणानाम् अकल्पयन् । अदृष्टम् अद्भिर् निर्णिक्तं यच् च वाचा प्रशस्यते ।
text: The gods created for Brāhmaṇas three means of purification, (viz.) ignorance of defilement, sprinkling with water, and commending by word of mouth.

sanskrit_iast: āpaḥ pavitraṃ bhūmigatā gotṛptir yāsu jāyate | avyāptāś ced amedhyena gandhavarṇarasānvitāḥ |
meaning: आपः पवित्रं भूमिगता गोतृप्तिर् यासु जायते । अव्याप्ताश् चेद् अमेध्येन गन्धवर्णरसान्विताः ।
text: Water collected on the ground with which cows slake their thirst is a means of purification, provided it is not strongly mixed with unclean (substances), nor has a (bad) smell, nor is discoloured, nor has a (bad) taste.

sanskrit_iast: bhūmes tu saṃmārjanaprokṣaṇopalepanāvastaraṇollekhanairyathāsthānaṃ doṣaviśeṣāt prāyatyam |
meaning: भूमेस् तु संमार्जनप्रोक्षणोपलेपनावस्तरणोल्लेखनैर्यथास्थानं दोषविशेषात् प्रायत्यम् ।
text: But land becomes pure, according to the degree of the defilement, by sweeping the (defiled) spot, by sprinkling it with water, by smearing it with cowdung, by scattering (pure earth) on it, or by scraping it.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse):

sanskrit_iast: gocarmamātram abbindur bhūmeḥ śudhyati pātitaḥ | samūḍham asamūḍhaṃ vā yatrāmedhyaṃ na lakṣyate || iti |
meaning: गोचर्ममात्रम् अब्बिन्दुर् भूमेः शुध्यति पातितः । समूढम् असमूढं वा यत्रामेध्यं न लक्ष्यते ॥ इति ।
text: 'A drop of water which is allowed to fall (on the ground) purifies a bull's hide of land, whether (the land) has been (previously) swept or not, provided no impure substance is visible on it.'

sanskrit_iast: parokṣam adhiśritasyānnasyāvadyotyābhyukṣaṇam |
meaning: परोक्षम् अधिश्रितस्यान्नस्यावद्योत्याभ्युक्षणम् ।
text: Food which is cooked out of sight must be illuminated (with fire) and be sprinkled with water,

sanskrit_iast: tathāpaṇeyānāṃ ca bhakṣāṇām |
meaning: तथापणेयानां च भक्षाणाम् ।
text: Likewise eatables bought in the market.

sanskrit_iast: bībhatsavaḥ śucikāmā hi devā nāśraddadhānasya havir juṣanta iti |
meaning: बीभत्सवः शुचिकामा हि देवा नाश्रद्दधानस्य हविर् जुषन्त इति ।
text: For the Veda (declares), 'For the gods who are (easily) disgusted and desirous of purity do not enjoy the offerings made by a man destitute of faith.'

sanskrit_iast: śucer aśraddadhānasya śraddadhānasya cāśuceḥ | mīmāṃsitvobhayaṃ devāḥ samam annam akalpayan | prajāpatis tu tān āha na samaṃ viṣamaṃ hi tat | hatam aśraddadhānasya śraddhāpūtaṃ viśiṣyate || iti |
meaning: शुचेर् अश्रद्दधानस्य श्रद्दधानस्य चाशुचेः । मीमांसित्वोभयं देवाः समम् अन्नम् अकल्पयन् । प्रजापतिस् तु तान् आह न समं विषमं हि तत् । हतम् अश्रद्दधानस्य श्रद्धापूतं विशिष्यते ॥ इति ।
text: After reflecting (for a, long time on the respective value of) the (food) of a pure man destitute of faith and of an impure person who has faith, the gods declared both to be equal. But the Lord of created beings said to them, 'That is not equal, it is unequal. The food of a man destitute of faith is worthless, that which is purified by faith is preferable.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | aśraddhā paramaḥ pāpmā śraddhā hi paramaṃ tapaḥ | tasmād aśraddhayā dattaṃ havir nāśnanti devatāḥ |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अश्रद्धा परमः पाप्मा श्रद्धा हि परमं तपः । तस्माद् अश्रद्धया दत्तं हविर् नाश्नन्ति देवताः ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'Want of faith is the greatest sin; for faith is the highest austerity. Therefore the gods do not eat offerings given without faith.'

sanskrit_iast: iṣṭvā dattvāpi vā mūrkhaḥ svargaṃ nahi sa gacchati |
meaning: इष्ट्वा दत्त्वापि वा मूर्खः स्वर्गं नहि स गच्छति ।
text: 'A foolish man does not reach heaven, though he may offer (sacrifices) or give (gifts).'

sanskrit_iast: śaṅkāvihatacāritro yaḥ svābhiprāyam āśritaḥ | śāstrātigaḥ smṛto mūrkho dharmatantroparodhanāt || iti |
meaning: शङ्काविहतचारित्रो यः स्वाभिप्रायम् आश्रितः । शास्त्रातिगः स्मृतो मूर्खो धर्मतन्त्रोपरोधनात् ॥ इति ।
text: 'He is called a foolish man whose conduct is blemished by doubts, and who, clinging to his own fancies, transgresses (the rules of) the Śāstras, because he opposes the fulfilment of the sacred law.'

sanskrit_iast: śākapuṣpaphalamūlauṣadhīnāṃ tu prakṣālanam |
meaning: शाकपुष्पफलमूलौषधीनां तु प्रक्षालनम् ।
text: But pot-herbs, flowers, fruit, roots, and annual plants (must be) sprinkled (with water).

sanskrit_iast: śuṣkaṃ tṛṇam ayājñikaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ loṣṭaṃ vā tiraskṛtyāhorātrayor udagdakṣiṇāmukhaḥ pravṛtya śira uccared avamehed vā |
meaning: शुष्कं तृणम् अयाज्ञिकं काष्ठं लोष्टं वा तिरस्कृत्याहोरात्रयोर् उदग्दक्षिणामुखः प्रवृत्य शिर उच्चरेद् अवमेहेद् वा ।
text: Having placed dry grass, wood of trees unfit for sacrifices or a clod of earth (on the ground), let him void faeces or urine, turning his face during the day towards the north and at night towards the south and wrapping up his head.

sanskrit_iast: mūtre mṛdādbhiḥ prakṣālanam |
meaning: मूत्रे मृदाद्भिः प्रक्षालनम् ।
text: (After voiding) urine he shall clean (the organ once) with earth and water,

sanskrit_iast: triḥ pāṇeḥ |
text: The hand three times.

sanskrit_iast: tadvat purīṣe |
meaning: तद्वत् पुरीषे ।
text: In like manner (he shall clean himself with earth and water after voiding) faeces.

sanskrit_iast: paryāyāt tris triḥ pāyoḥ pāṇeś ca |
meaning: पर्यायात् त्रिस् त्रिः पायोः पाणेश् च ।
text: The number (of the applications of both is) thrice three for both feet and the hand.

sanskrit_iast: mūtravad retasa utsarge |
meaning: मूत्रवद् रेतस उत्सर्गे ।
text: After an effusion of semen (he shall purify himself) in the same manner as after voiding urine.

sanskrit_iast: nīvīṃ visrasya paridhāyāpa upaspṛśet |
meaning: नीवीं विस्रस्य परिधायाप उपस्पृशेत् ।
text: He shall wash himself, after he has untied or put on the cloth round his loins,

sanskrit_iast: ārdraṃ tṛṇaṃ gomayaṃ bhūmiṃ vā samupaspṛśet |
meaning: आर्द्रं तृणं गोमयं भूमिं वा समुपस्पृशेत् ।
text: Or he may touch moist grass, cowdung, or earth.

sanskrit_iast: nābher adhaḥ sparśanaṃ karmayukto varjayet |
meaning: नाभेर् अधः स्पर्शनं कर्मयुक्तो वर्जयेत् ।
text: While he is engaged in (the performance of) religious rites, he shall avoid to touch (the part of his body) below the navel.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvaṃ vai puruṣasya nābhyai medhyam avācīnam amedhyam itiśrutiḥ |
meaning: ऊर्ध्वं वै पुरुषस्य नाभ्यै मेध्यम् अवाचीनम् अमेध्यम् इतिश्रुतिः ।
text: The Veda (declares), 'A man's (body) is pure above the navel, it is impure below the navel.'

sanskrit_iast: śūdrāṇām āryādhiṣṭhitānām ardhamāsi māsi vā vapanamāryavadācamanakalpaḥ |
meaning: शूद्राणाम् आर्याधिष्ठितानाम् अर्धमासि मासि वा वपनमार्यवदाचमनकल्पः ।
text: Śūdras living in the service of Āryans shall trim (their hair and nails) every month; their mode of sipping water (shall be) the same as that of Āryans.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśyaḥ kusīdam upajīvet |
meaning: वैश्यः कुसीदम् उपजीवेत् ।
text: A Vaiśya may live by usury.

sanskrit_iast: pañcaviṃśatis tv eva pañcamāṣikī syāt |
meaning: पञ्चविंशतिस् त्व् एव पञ्चमाषिकी स्यात् ।
text: But (a sum of) twenty-five (kārshāpaṇas shall bear an interest) of five māshas (per mensem).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | yaḥ samargham ṛṇaṃ gṛhya mahārghaṃ saṃprayojayet | sa vai vārddhuṣiko nāma sarvadharmeṣu garhitaḥ | vṛddhiṃ ca bhrūṇahatyāṃ ca tulayā samatolayat | atiṣṭhad bhrūṇahā koṭyāṃ vārddhuṣiḥ samakampata || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । यः समर्घम् ऋणं गृह्य महार्घं संप्रयोजयेत् । स वै वार्द्धुषिको नाम सर्वधर्मेषु गर्हितः । वृद्धिं च भ्रूणहत्यां च तुलया समतोलयत् । अतिष्ठद् भ्रूणहा कोट्यां वार्द्धुषिः समकम्पत ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses) 'He who, acquiring property cheap, employs (it so that it yields) a higher price, is called a usurer, and blamed in all (treatises on) the sacred law.' '(Brahman) weighed in the scales the crime of killing a learned Brāhmaṇa against (the crime of) usury; the slayer of the Brāhmaṇa remained at the top, the usurer sank downwards.'

sanskrit_iast: gorakṣakān vāṇijakāṃs tathā kārukuśīlavān | preṣyān vārddhuṣikāṃś caiva viprāñ śūdravad ācaret |
meaning: गोरक्षकान् वाणिजकांस् तथा कारुकुशीलवान् । प्रेष्यान् वार्द्धुषिकांश् चैव विप्राञ् शूद्रवद् आचरेत् ।
text: 'Let him treat Brāhmaṇas who tend cattle, those who live by trade, (and) those who are artisans, actors (and bards), servants or usurers, like Śūdras.'

sanskrit_iast: kāmaṃ tu pariluptakṛtyāya kadaryāya nāstikāya pāpīyasepūrvau dadyātām |
meaning: कामं तु परिलुप्तकृत्याय कदर्याय नास्तिकाय पापीयसेपूर्वौ दद्याताम् ।
text: But men of the first two castes may, at their pleasure, lend (money at interest) to one who neglects his sacred duties, to a miser, to an atheist, or to a very wicked man.

sanskrit_iast: ayajñenāvivāhena vedasyotsādanena ca | kulāny akulatāṃ yānti brāhmaṇātikrameṇa ca |
meaning: अयज्ञेनाविवाहेन वेदस्योत्सादनेन च । कुलान्य् अकुलतां यान्ति ब्राह्मणातिक्रमेण च ।
text: Through the neglect of sacrifices, of (lawful) marriages, of the study of the Veda, and of (learned) Brāhmaṇas, (noble) families (even) are degraded.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇātikramo nāsti mūrkhe mantravivarjite | jvalantam agnim utsṛjya nahi bhasmani hūyate |
meaning: ब्राह्मणातिक्रमो नास्ति मूर्खे मन्त्रविवर्जिते । ज्वलन्तम् अग्निम् उत्सृज्य नहि भस्मनि हूयते ।
text: The offence of neglecting a Brāhmaṇa cannot be committed against a fool who is unacquainted with the Veda. For (in offering sacrifices) one does not pass by a brilliant fire and throw the oblations into ashes.

sanskrit_iast: gobhir aśvaiś ca yānaiś ca kṛṣyā rājopasevayā | kulāny akulatāṃ yānti yāni hīnāni mantrataḥ |
meaning: गोभिर् अश्वैश् च यानैश् च कृष्या राजोपसेवया । कुलान्य् अकुलतां यान्ति यानि हीनानि मन्त्रतः ।
text: Families which are deficient in (the knowledge of) the Veda, are degraded by (keeping) cows, horses and vehicles, by agriculture and by serving the king.

sanskrit_iast: mantratas tu samṛddhāni kulāny alpadhanāny api | kulasaṃkhyāṃ ca gacchanti karṣanti ca mahadyaśaḥ |
meaning: मन्त्रतस् तु समृद्धानि कुलान्य् अल्पधनान्य् अपि । कुलसंख्यां च गच्छन्ति कर्षन्ति च महद्यशः ।
text: But even poor families which are rich in (the knowledge of) the Veda obtain rank among the (noble) families and gain great fame.

sanskrit_iast: vedaḥ kṛṣivināśāya kṛṣir vedavināśinī | śaktimān ubhayaṃ kuryād aśaktas tu kṛṣiṃ tyajet |
meaning: वेदः कृषिविनाशाय कृषिर् वेदविनाशिनी । शक्तिमान् उभयं कुर्याद् अशक्तस् तु कृषिं त्यजेत् ।
text: The (study of) the Veda impedes (the pursuit of) agriculture, (the pursuit of) agriculture impedes (the study of) the Veda. He who is able (to do it), may attend to both; but he who is unable (to attend to both), shall give up agriculture.

sanskrit_iast: na vai devān pīvarosaṃyatātmā rorūyamāṇaḥ kakudī samaśnute | calattundī rabhasaḥ kamavādī kṛśāsa ity aṇavas tatra yānti |
meaning: न वै देवान् पीवरोसंयतात्मा रोरूयमाणः ककुदी समश्नुते । चलत्तुन्दी रभसः कमवादी कृशास इत्य् अणवस् तत्र यान्ति ।
text: A fat, bellowing, raging humped bull, who does not restrain himself, who hurts living creatures and speaks according to his pleasure, forsooth, does not reach the (abode of) the gods; (but) those who are small like atoms, (being) emaciated (by austerities and fasts), go thither.

sanskrit_iast: yad yauvane carati vibhrameṇa sad vāsad vā yādṛśaṃ vāyadā vā | uttare ced vayasi sādhuvṛttas tad evāsya bhavatinetarāṇi |
meaning: यद् यौवने चरति विभ्रमेण सद् वासद् वा यादृशं वायदा वा । उत्तरे चेद् वयसि साधुवृत्तस् तद् एवास्य भवतिनेतराणि ।
text: If, erring, in his youth he commits at any time good or evil acts of any kind, (they will all remain without result). (For) if in his later age he lives righteously, he will obtain (the reward of) that (virtuous conduct) alone, not (the punishments of his former) crimes.

sanskrit_iast: śoceta manasā nityaṃ duṣkṛtāny anucintayan | tapasvī cāpramādī ca tataḥ pāpāt pramucyate |
meaning: शोचेत मनसा नित्यं दुष्कृतान्य् अनुचिन्तयन् । तपस्वी चाप्रमादी च ततः पापात् प्रमुच्यते ।
text: Let him always be sorrowing in his heart, when he thinks of his sins, (let him) practise austerities and be careful; thus he will be freed from sin.

sanskrit_iast: spṛśanti bindavaḥ pādau ya ācāmayataḥ parān | na tair ucchiṣṭabhāvaḥ syāt tulyās te bhūmigaiḥ saha || iti |
meaning: स्पृशन्ति बिन्दवः पादौ य आचामयतः परान् । न तैर् उच्छिष्टभावः स्यात् तुल्यास् ते भूमिगैः सह ॥ इति ।
text: 'Where drops of water touch the feet of a man who offers water for sipping to others, no defilement is caused by them. They are equally (pure) as (water) collected on the ground.'

sanskrit_iast: sapiṇḍeṣv ā daśāham āśaucam iti jananamaraṇayor adhikṛtya vadanty ṛtvigdīkṣitabrahmacārivarjam |
meaning: सपिण्डेष्व् आ दशाहम् आशौचम् इति जननमरणयोर् अधिकृत्य वदन्त्य् ऋत्विग्दीक्षितब्रह्मचारिवर्जम् ।
text: Referring to deaths and births, they declare that the impurity of Sapiṇd as lasts ten days; excepting officiating priests, men who have performed the initiatory ceremony of a Soma-sacrifice, and students of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: sapiṇḍatā tv ā saptamāt sapiṇḍeṣu |
meaning: सपिण्डता त्व् आ सप्तमात् सपिण्डेषु ।
text: But amongst Sapiṇd as Sapiṇd a-relationship (extends) to the seventh person.

sanskrit_iast: ā saptamāsād ā dantajananād vodakopasparśanam |
meaning: आ सप्तमासाद् आ दन्तजननाद् वोदकोपस्पर्शनम् ।
text: (If children die) before the completion of the seventh month or before teething, (the relatives) shall bathe.

sanskrit_iast: piṇḍodakakriyā prete nātrivarṣe vidhīyate | ā dantajananād vāpi dahanaṃ ca na kārayet |
meaning: पिण्डोदकक्रिया प्रेते नात्रिवर्षे विधीयते । आ दन्तजननाद् वापि दहनं च न कारयेत् ।
text: In (the case of a child) that dies before the completion of its third year or before teething, offerings of funeral cakes and water are not prescribed, and one should not burn its (body);

sanskrit_iast: aprattāsu ca kanyāsu |
meaning: अप्रत्तासु च कन्यासु ।
text: Nor when unmarried maidens die.

sanskrit_iast: prattāsv eke ha kurvate |
meaning: प्रत्तास्व् एके ह कुर्वते ।
text: Some do it in the case of married daughters.

sanskrit_iast: lokasaṃgrahaṇārthaṃ hi tad amantrāḥ striyo matāḥ |
meaning: लोकसंग्रहणार्थं हि तद् अमन्त्राः स्त्रियो मताः ।
text: That (is done) in order to gain the good-will of the people. Women are considered to have no business with the sacred texts.

sanskrit_iast: strīṇām akṛtavivāhānāṃ tryahāc chudhyanti bāndhavāḥ | yathoktenaiva kalpena śudhyanti ca sanābhaya iti |
meaning: स्त्रीणाम् अकृतविवाहानां त्र्यहाच् छुध्यन्ति बान्धवाः । यथोक्तेनैव कल्पेन शुध्यन्ति च सनाभय इति ।
text: 'The relatives of unmarried women become pure after three days. But the uterine brothers become pure by (following) the rule mentioned before.'

sanskrit_iast: api ca prapitāmahaḥ pitāmahaḥ pitā svayaṃ sodaryā bhrātaraḥsavarṇāyāḥ putraḥ pautraḥ prapautras tatputravarjaṃ teṣāṃ caputrapautram avibhaktadāyam sapiṇḍān ācakṣate |
meaning: अपि च प्रपितामहः पितामहः पिता स्वयं सोदर्या भ्रातरःसवर्णायाः पुत्रः पौत्रः प्रपौत्रस् तत्पुत्रवर्जं तेषां चपुत्रपौत्रम् अविभक्तदायम् सपिण्डान् आचक्षते ।
text: Moreover, the great-grandfather, the grand-father, the father, oneself, the uterine brothers, the son by a wife of equal caste, the grandson, (and) the great-grandson--these they call Sapiṇd as, but not the (great-grandson's) son;--and amongst these a son and a son's son (together with their father are) sharers of an undivided oblation.

sanskrit_iast: vibhaktadāyān api sakulyān ācakṣate |
meaning: विभक्तदायान् अपि सकुल्यान् आचक्षते ।
text: The sharers of divided oblations they call Sakulyas.

sanskrit_iast: asatsv anyeṣu tadgāmī hy artho bhavati |
meaning: असत्स्व् अन्येषु तद्गामी ह्य् अर्थो भवति ।
text: If no other (relations) are living, the property (of a deceased male) descends to them (the Sapiṇd as).

sanskrit_iast: sapiṇḍābhāve sakulyaḥ |
meaning: सपिण्डाभावे सकुल्यः ।
text: On failure of Sapiṇd as, the Sakulyas (inherit).

sanskrit_iast: tadabhāve pitācāryo 'ntevāsy ṛtvig vā haret |
meaning: तदभावे पिताचार्यो ऽन्तेवास्य् ऋत्विग् वा हरेत् ।
text: On failure of them, the teacher who (holds the place of a spiritual) father, a pupil, or an officiating priest shall take it,

sanskrit_iast: tadabhāve rājā tatsvaṃ traividyavṛddhebhyaḥ saṃprayacchet |
meaning: तदभावे राजा तत्स्वं त्रैविद्यवृद्धेभ्यः संप्रयच्छेत् ।
text: On failure of them, the king. Let him give that property to persons well-versed in the three Vedas.

sanskrit_iast: na tv eva kadā cit svayaṃ rājā brāhmaṇasvam ādadīta |
meaning: न त्व् एव कदा चित् स्वयं राजा ब्राह्मणस्वम् आददीत ।
text: But the king should never take for himself the property of a Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | brahmasvaṃ putrapautraghnaṃ viṣam ekākinaṃ haret | na viṣaṃ viṣam ity āhur brahmasvaṃ viṣam ucyate | tasmād rājā brāhmaṇasvaṃ nādadīta | paramaṃ hy etadviṣaṃ yad brāhmaṇasvam iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । ब्रह्मस्वं पुत्रपौत्रघ्नं विषम् एकाकिनं हरेत् । न विषं विषम् इत्य् आहुर् ब्रह्मस्वं विषम् उच्यते । तस्माद् राजा ब्राह्मणस्वं नाददीत । परमं ह्य् एतद्विषं यद् ब्राह्मणस्वम् इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): The property of a Brāhmaṇa destroys (him who takes it), together with sons and grandsons; poison kills one man only. (Therefore) they do not declare poison to be (the worst) poison. The property of a Brāhmaṇa is called (the worst) poison.'

sanskrit_iast: jananamaraṇayoḥ saṃnipāte samāno daśarātraḥ |
meaning: जननमरणयोः संनिपाते समानो दशरात्रः ।
text: If a birth and a death occur together, one. and the same period of ten (days and) nights (shall serve for both).

sanskrit_iast: atha yadi daśarātrāḥ saṃnipateyur ādyaṃ daśarātramāśaucam ā navamād divasāt |
meaning: अथ यदि दशरात्राः संनिपतेयुर् आद्यं दशरात्रमाशौचम् आ नवमाद् दिवसात् ।
text: Now if (other deaths or births) happen before the completion of the ten (days and) nights (of impurity), the first period of ten (days and) nights (shall suffice, provided the new cause of impurity occurs) before the end of the ninth day.

sanskrit_iast: janane tāvan mātāpitror daśāham āśaucam |
meaning: जनने तावन् मातापित्रोर् दशाहम् आशौचम् ।
text: On a birth, indeed, the parents (alone) become impure during ten days.

sanskrit_iast: mātur ity eke tatpariharaṇāt |
meaning: मातुर् इत्य् एके तत्परिहरणात् ।
text: Some (declare that) the mother (alone becomes impure), because (people) avoid (lying-in women alone).

sanskrit_iast: pitur ity apare śukraprādhānyāt |
meaning: पितुर् इत्य् अपरे शुक्रप्राधान्यात् ।
text: Others (say that) the father (alone becomes impure) because the semen is the chief cause (of the generation).

sanskrit_iast: ayonijā hy api putrāḥ śrūyante |
meaning: अयोनिजा ह्य् अपि पुत्राः श्रूयन्ते ।
text: For sons who were born without mothers, are mentioned in the revealed texts.

sanskrit_iast: mātāpitror eva tu saṃsargasāmānyāt |
meaning: मातापित्रोर् एव तु संसर्गसामान्यात् ।
text: But (the correct opinion is that) both the parents (become impure) because they are equally connected (with the event).

sanskrit_iast: maraṇe tu yathābālaṃ puraskṛtya yajñopavītāny apasavyāni kṛtvā tīrtham avatīrya sakṛt sakṛt trir nimajjyonmajjyottīryācamya tatpratyayam udakam āsicyāta evottīryācamya gṛhadvāryaṅgāram udkam iti saṃspṛśyākṣāralavaṇāśino daśāhaṃ kaṭam āsīran |
meaning: मरणे तु यथाबालं पुरस्कृत्य यज्ञोपवीतान्य् अपसव्यानि कृत्वा तीर्थम् अवतीर्य सकृत् सकृत् त्रिर् निमज्ज्योन्मज्ज्योत्तीर्याचम्य तत्प्रत्ययम् उदकम् आसिच्यात एवोत्तीर्याचम्य गृहद्वार्यङ्गारम् उद्कम् इति संस्पृश्याक्षारलवणाशिनो दशाहं कटम् आसीरन् ।
text: But when a death (has happened, the relatives of the deceased), allowing the youngest to begin, shall pass their sacrificial threads over the right shoulder and under the left arm, descend into the water at a bathing-place, submerge (their bodies), emerge (out of the water), ascend the bank, sip water, pour out libations for the (deceased, repeating the last four acts) severally three times thereafter, ascend the bank, sip water, touch a coal, water or the like at the door of their house, and sit during ten days on mats, eating food that does not contain pungent condiments or salt.

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ vā śrāddhakarma |
meaning: एकादश्यां द्वादश्यां वा श्राद्धकर्म ।
text: (Let him perform) a funeral sacrifice on the eleventh or the twelfth (day).

sanskrit_iast: śeṣakriyāyāṃ loko 'nuroddhavyaḥ |
meaning: शेषक्रियायां लोको ऽनुरोद्धव्यः ।
text: In (performing) the remaining rites (one should) conform to (the customs of) the people.

sanskrit_iast: atrāpy asapiṇḍeṣu yathāsannaṃ trirātram ahorātramekāham iti kurvīta |
meaning: अत्राप्य् असपिण्डेषु यथासन्नं त्रिरात्रम् अहोरात्रमेकाहम् इति कुर्वीत ।
text: In case of a (death) let him also keep (a period of impurity) for (persons who are) not (his) Sapiṇd as, according to the degree of nearness, three (days and) nights, a day and a night, one day and so forth,

sanskrit_iast: ācāryopādhyāyatatputreṣu trirātram |
meaning: आचार्योपाध्यायतत्पुत्रेषु त्रिरात्रम् ।
text: For a teacher, a sub-teacher (upādhyāya), and their sons, three (days and) nights,

sanskrit_iast: ṛtvijāṃ ca |
meaning: ऋत्विजां च ।
text: Likewise for officiating priests,

sanskrit_iast: śiṣyasatīrthyasabrahmacāriṣu trirātram ahorātramekāham iti kurvīta |
meaning: शिष्यसतीर्थ्यसब्रह्मचारिषु त्रिरात्रम् अहोरात्रमेकाहम् इति कुर्वीत ।
text: Let hire keep. on account of a pupil, for one who has the same spiritual guide, for a fellow-student (sabrahma k ārin) three (days and) nights, one day and a night, one day and so forth (as periods of impurity).

sanskrit_iast: garbhasrāve garbhamāsasaṃmitā rātrayaḥ strīṇām |
meaning: गर्भस्रावे गर्भमाससंमिता रात्रयः स्त्रीणाम् ।
text: On a miscarriage females (remain impure) as many (days and) nights as months (elapsed after conception).

sanskrit_iast: paraśavopasparśane 'nabhisaṃdhipūrvaṃ sacelo 'paḥ spṛṣṭvā sadyaḥ śuddho bhavati |
meaning: परशवोपस्पर्शने ऽनभिसंधिपूर्वं सचेलो ऽपः स्पृष्ट्वा सद्यः शुद्धो भवति ।
text: If he unintentionally touches the corpse of a stranger, he becomes at once pure after bathing dressed in his clothes.

sanskrit_iast: abhisaṃdhipūrvaṃ trirātram |
meaning: अभिसंधिपूर्वं त्रिरात्रम् ।
text: (If he does it) intentionally, (he will remain impure) during three (days and) nights.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtumatyāṃ ca |
meaning: ऋतुमत्यां च ।
text: And (the same rules apply if he touches a woman) during her courses.

sanskrit_iast: yas tato jāyate so 'bhiśasta iti vyākhyātāny asyaivratāni |
meaning: यस् ततो जायते सो ऽभिशस्त इति व्याख्यातान्य् अस्यैव्रतानि ।
text: A son who is born from (intercourse with a temporarily unclean woman) becomes an Abhiśasta. Thereby the penances (to be performed) by him have been explained.

sanskrit_iast: vedavikrayiṇaṃ yūpaṃ patitaṃ citim eva ca | spṛṣṭvā samācaret snānaṃ śvānaṃ caṇḍālam eva ca |
meaning: वेदविक्रयिणं यूपं पतितं चितिम् एव च । स्पृष्ट्वा समाचरेत् स्नानं श्वानं चण्डालम् एव च ।
text: On touching one who sells the Veda, a sacrificial post, an outcast, a funeral pile, a dog, or a K aṇd āla he shall bathe.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇasya vraṇadvāre pūyaśoṇitasaṃbhave | kṛmir utpadyate tatra prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet |
meaning: ब्राह्मणस्य व्रणद्वारे पूयशोणितसंभवे । कृमिर् उत्पद्यते तत्र प्रायश्चित्तं कथं भवेत् ।
text: Now if a worm is produced in an open wound that is filled with pus and sanies, how shall, in that case, a penance be performed?

sanskrit_iast: gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam | tryahaṃ snātvā ca pītvā ca kṛmidaṣṭaḥ śucir bhavet |
meaning: गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकम् । त्र्यहं स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च कृमिदष्टः शुचिर् भवेत् ।
text: He who is bitten by a worm will become pure on bathing (daily) during three days and drinking (a mixture of) cow's urine, cowdung, milk, sour milk, butter, and water boiled with Kuśa grass.

sanskrit_iast: śunopahataḥ sacelo 'vagāheta |
meaning: शुनोपहतः सचेलो ऽवगाहेत ।
text: He who has been touched by a dog shall bathe dressed in his clothes;

sanskrit_iast: prakṣālya vā taṃ deśam agninā saṃspṛśya punaḥ prakṣālyapādau cācamya prayato bhavati |
meaning: प्रक्षाल्य वा तं देशम् अग्निना संस्पृश्य पुनः प्रक्षाल्यपादौ चाचम्य प्रयतो भवति ।
text: Or he becomes pure by washing that spot (where he has been touched), by touching it with fire, by (afterwards) again washing it and his feet, and by sipping water.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | śunā daṣṭas tu yo vipro nadīṃ gatvā samudragām | prāṇāyāmaśataṃ kṛtvā ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśudhyati | suvarṇarajatābhyāṃ vā gavāṃ śṛṅgodakena vā | navaiś ca kalaśaiḥ snātvā sadya eva śucir bhavet || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । शुना दष्टस् तु यो विप्रो नदीं गत्वा समुद्रगाम् । प्राणायामशतं कृत्वा घृतं प्राश्य विशुध्यति । सुवर्णरजताभ्यां वा गवां शृङ्गोदकेन वा । नवैश् च कलशैः स्नात्वा सद्य एव शुचिर् भवेत् ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'But a Brāhmaṇa who has been bitten by a dog, is purified if he goes to a river that flows into the ocean, (bathes there and) suppresses his breath one hundred times and (afterwards) eats clarified butter. He will (also) become pure at, once on bathing (in water brought) in golden or silver (vessels), or in a cow's horn, or in new (earthen pots).'

sanskrit_iast: abhakṣyāḥ paśavo grāmyāḥ |
meaning: अभक्ष्याः पशवो ग्राम्याः ।
text: Tame animals must not be eaten,

sanskrit_iast: kravyādāḥ śakunayaś ca |
meaning: क्रव्यादाः शकुनयश् च ।
text: Nor carnivorous and (tame) birds,

sanskrit_iast: tathā kukkuṭasūkaram |
meaning: तथा कुक्कुटसूकरम् ।
text: Nor (tame) cocks and pigs;

sanskrit_iast: anyatrājāvibhyaḥ |
meaning: अन्यत्राजाविभ्यः ।
text: Goats and sheep (are) excepted (from the above prohibition).
