sanskrit_iast: bhakṣyāḥ śvāvidgodhāśaśaśalyakakacchapakhaṅgāḥkhaṅgavarjāḥ pañca pañcanakhāḥ |
meaning: भक्ष्याः श्वाविद्गोधाशशशल्यककच्छपखङ्गाःखङ्गवर्जाः पञ्च पञ्चनखाः ।
text: Five five-toed animals may be eaten, (viz.) the porcupine, the iguana, the hare, the hedgehog, the tortoise and the rhinoceros, excepting the rhinoceros,

sanskrit_iast: tatharśyahariṇapṛṣatamahiṣavarāhakuluṅgāḥkuluṅgavarjāḥ pañca dvikhuriṇaḥ |
meaning: तथर्श्यहरिणपृषतमहिषवराहकुलुङ्गाःकुलुङ्गवर्जाः पञ्च द्विखुरिणः ।
text: Likewise five animals with cloven hoofs, (viz.) the white-footed antelope (Nīl-gāi), the (common ravine) deer, the spotted deer, the buffalo, the (wild) boar and the black antelope, excepting the black antelope,

sanskrit_iast: pakṣiṇastittirikapotakapiñjalavārdhrāṇasamayūravāraṇāvāraṇavarjāḥ pañca viṣkirāḥ |
meaning: पक्षिणस्तित्तिरिकपोतकपिञ्जलवार्ध्राणसमयूरवारणावारणवर्जाः पञ्च विष्किराः ।
text: (Likewise) five (kinds of) birds that feed scratching with their feet, (viz.) the partridge, the blue rock-pigeon, the francoline partridge, the (crane called) Vārdhrāṇasa, the peacock and the Vāraṇa, excepting the Vāraṇa,

sanskrit_iast: matsyāḥ sahasradaṃṣṭraś cilicimovarmibṛhacchiromaśakarirohitarājīvāḥ |
meaning: मत्स्याः सहस्रदंष्ट्रश् चिलिचिमोवर्मिबृहच्छिरोमशकरिरोहितराजीवाः ।
text: (And the following) fishes, (viz.) the Silurus Pelorius (Sahasradaṃshṭrin), the K ili k ima, the Varmi, the B ri ha k kh iras, the Maśakari(?), the Cyprinus Rohita, and the Rā g i.

sanskrit_iast: anirdaśāhasaṃdhinīkṣīram apeyam |
meaning: अनिर्दशाहसंधिनीक्षीरम् अपेयम् ।
text: The milk of a (female animal) whose offspring is not ten days old, and of one that gives milk while big with a young one, must not be drunk,

sanskrit_iast: vivatsānyavatsayoś ca |
meaning: विवत्सान्यवत्सयोश् च ।
text: Nor that of a (cow) that has no calf or that (suckles) a strange calf.

sanskrit_iast: āvikam auṣṭrikam aikaśapham apeyam |
meaning: आविकम् औष्ट्रिकम् ऐकशफम् अपेयम् ।
text: (The milk) of sheep, camels, and one-hoofed animals must not be drunk.

sanskrit_iast: apeyapayaḥpāne kṛcchro 'nyatra gavyāt |
meaning: अपेयपयःपाने कृच्छ्रो ऽन्यत्र गव्यात् ।
text: If (he has) drunk (milk) which ought not to be drunk, excepting cow's milk, (he must perform) a K ri k kh ra (penance).

sanskrit_iast: gavye tu trirātram upavāsaḥ |
meaning: गव्ये तु त्रिरात्रम् उपवासः ।
text: But if (he has drunk) cow's milk (that is unfit for use, he shall) fast during three (days and) nights.

sanskrit_iast: paryuṣitaṃśākayūṣamāṃsasarpiḥśṛtadhānāguḍadadhimadhusaktuvarjam |
meaning: पर्युषितंशाकयूषमांससर्पिःशृतधानागुडदधिमधुसक्तुवर्जम् ।
text: Stale (food must not be eaten or drunk) excepting pot-herbs, broths, meat, clarified butter, cooked grain, molasses, sour milk, and barley-meal,

sanskrit_iast: śuktāni tathājāto guḍaḥ |
meaning: शुक्तानि तथाजातो गुडः ।
text: Nor (substances) which have turned sour, nor molasses which have come into that state.

sanskrit_iast: śrāvaṇyāṃ paurṇamāsyām āṣāḍhyāṃ vopākṛtya taiṣyāṃmāghyāṃ votsṛjeyuḥ | utsṛjeyuḥ |
meaning: श्रावण्यां पौर्णमास्याम् आषाढ्यां वोपाकृत्य तैष्यांमाघ्यां वोत्सृजेयुः । उत्सृजेयुः ।
text: After performing the ceremony preparatory to the beginning of the Veda-study (upākarman) on the (full moon of the month) of Śrāvaṇa or of Ashā dh a, they shall close the term on the full moon of Taisha or Māgha.

sanskrit_iast: śucim adhvaraṃ devā juṣante |
meaning: शुचिम् अध्वरं देवा जुषन्ते ।
text: The gods enjoy a pure sacrifice (only);

sanskrit_iast: śucikāmā hi devāḥ śucayaś ca |
meaning: शुचिकामा हि देवाः शुचयश् च ।
text: For the gods are desirous of purity and (themselves) pure.

sanskrit_iast: tad eśābhivadati | śucī vo havyā marutaḥ śucīnāṃ śuciṃ hinomy adhvaraṃśucibhyaḥ | ṛtena satyam ṛtasāpa āyañ śucijanmānaḥ śucayaḥpāvakāḥ || iti |
meaning: तद् एशाभिवदति । शुची वो हव्या मरुतः शुचीनां शुचिं हिनोम्य् अध्वरंशुचिभ्यः । ऋतेन सत्यम् ऋतसाप आयञ् शुचिजन्मानः शुचयःपावकाः ॥ इति ।
text: The following ( Ri k ) declares that, 'To you, O Maruts, the pure ones, pure viands; to you, the pure ones, I offer a pure sacrifice. They who love the pious rites, who are of pure origin, (themselves) pure and purifiers (of others), came duly to the truthful (worshipper).'

sanskrit_iast: ahataṃ vāsasāṃ śuci | tasmād yat kiṃ cejyāsaṃyuktaṃ syāt sarvaṃ tad ahatairvāsobhiḥ kuryāt |
meaning: अहतं वाससां शुचि । तस्माद् यत् किं चेज्यासंयुक्तं स्यात् सर्वं तद् अहतैर्वासोभिः कुर्यात् ।
text: (He will be) pure (if there is) no blemish on his clothes, therefore let him perform all (acts) that are connected with sacrificing, (dressed) in unblemished clothes.

sanskrit_iast: prakṣālitopavātāny akliṣṭāni vāsāṃsi patnīyajamānāvṛtvijaś ca paridadhīran |
meaning: प्रक्षालितोपवातान्य् अक्लिष्टानि वासांसि पत्नीयजमानावृत्विजश् च परिदधीरन् ।
text: The sacrificer and his wife as well as the officiating priests shall put on dresses which have been washed, and dried by the wind, and which are not in a bad condition.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ prakramād ūrdhvam |
meaning: एवं प्रक्रमाद् ऊर्ध्वम् ।
text: (It shall be) thus from the (beginning of the) Prakrama,

sanskrit_iast: dīrghasomeṣu sattreṣu caivam |
meaning: दीर्घसोमेषु सत्त्रेषु चैवम् ।
text: And thus at the long Soma-sacrifices and the Sattras;

sanskrit_iast: yathāsamāmnātaṃ ca |
meaning: यथासमाम्नातं च ।
text: And (on other occasions other dresses must be used) in accordance with the injunction (of the Veda),

sanskrit_iast: yathaitad abhicaraṇīyeṣv iṣṭipaśusomeṣu lohitoṣṇīṣālohitavāsasaś cartvijaḥ pracareyuś citravāsasaś citrāsaṅgāvṛṣākapāv iti ca |
meaning: यथैतद् अभिचरणीयेष्व् इष्टिपशुसोमेषु लोहितोष्णीषालोहितवाससश् चर्त्विजः प्रचरेयुश् चित्रवाससश् चित्रासङ्गावृषाकपाव् इति च ।
text: Thus at (all) Ishṭis, animal sacrifices, and Soma-sacrifices which may be used as spells (against enemies), the priests shall perform (the sacred rites), wearing red turbans and red dresses; (when reciting the hymn seen by) V ri shākapi (he shall) wear a dress and a mantle of many colours and so forth.

sanskrit_iast: agnyādhāne kṣaumāṇi vāsāṃsi teṣām alābhe kārpāsikānyaurṇāni vā bhavanti |
meaning: अग्न्याधाने क्षौमाणि वासांसि तेषाम् अलाभे कार्पासिकान्यौर्णानि वा भवन्ति ।
text: At the Agnyādhāna (sacrifice) the clothes (shall be made) of flax; on failure of such, (dresses) made of cotton or of wool are used.

sanskrit_iast: mūtrapurīṣalohitaretaḥprabhṛtyupahatānāṃ mṛdādbhiriti prakṣālanam |
meaning: मूत्रपुरीषलोहितरेतःप्रभृत्युपहतानां मृदाद्भिरिति प्रक्षालनम् ।
text: Clothes defiled by urine, ordure, blood, semen and the like (shall be) cleaned with earth, water and the like.

sanskrit_iast: vāsovat tārpyavalkalānām |
meaning: वासोवत् तार्प्यवल्कलानाम् ।
text: (Dresses) made of T ri pa-bark and v ri kala (shall be treated) like cotton-cloth,

sanskrit_iast: valkalavat kṛṣṇājinānām |
meaning: वल्कलवत् कृष्णाजिनानाम् ।
text: Deer-skins like (dresses) made of bark.

sanskrit_iast: na parihitam adhirūḍham aprakṣālitaṃ prāvaraṇam |
meaning: न परिहितम् अधिरूढम् अप्रक्षालितं प्रावरणम् ।

sanskrit_iast: nāpalpūlitaṃ manuṣyasaṃyuktaṃ devatrā yuñjyāt |
meaning: नापल्पूलितं मनुष्यसंयुक्तं देवत्रा युञ्ज्यात् ।

sanskrit_iast: ghanāyā bhūmer upaghāta upalepanam |
meaning: घनाया भूमेर् उपघात उपलेपनम् ।
text: If solid earth is defiled, (it must be) smeared with cowdung.

sanskrit_iast: suṣirāyāḥ karṣaṇam |
meaning: सुषिरायाः कर्षणम् ।
text: Loose (earth must be cleansed by) ploughing,

sanskrit_iast: klinnāyā medhyam āhṛtya pracchādanam |
meaning: क्लिन्नाया मेध्यम् आहृत्य प्रच्छादनम् ।
text: Moist (earth) by bringing pure (earth) and covering (it with that).

sanskrit_iast: caturbhiḥ śudhyate bhūmir gobhir ākramaṇāt khananāddahanād abhivarṣaṇāt |
meaning: चतुर्भिः शुध्यते भूमिर् गोभिर् आक्रमणात् खननाद्दहनाद् अभिवर्षणात् ।
text: Land is purified in four (ways), by being trod on by cows, by digging, by lighting a fire on it, by rain falling on it,

sanskrit_iast: pañcamāc copalepanāt ṣaṣṭhāt kālāt |
meaning: पञ्चमाच् चोपलेपनात् षष्ठात् कालात् ।
text: Fifthly by smearing it with cowdung, and sixthly through (the lapse of) time.

sanskrit_iast: asaṃskṛtāyāṃ bhūmau nyastānāṃ tṛṇānāṃ prakṣālanam |
meaning: असंस्कृतायां भूमौ न्यस्तानां तृणानां प्रक्षालनम् ।
text: Grass placed on unconsecrated ground (must be) washed.

sanskrit_iast: parokṣopahatānām abhyukṣaṇam |
meaning: परोक्षोपहतानाम् अभ्युक्षणम् ।
text: (Grass) defiled out of one's sight, (shall be) sprinkled (with water).

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ kṣudrasamidhām |
meaning: एवं क्षुद्रसमिधाम् ।
text: Small pieces of sacred fuel (shall be purified) in the same manner.

sanskrit_iast: mahatāṃ kāṣṭhānām upaghāte prakṣālyāvaśoṣaṇam |
meaning: महतां काष्ठानाम् उपघाते प्रक्षाल्यावशोषणम् ।
text: Large pieces of wood (must be) washed and dried.

sanskrit_iast: bahūnāṃ tu prokṣaṇam |
meaning: बहूनां तु प्रोक्षणम् ।
text: But a great quantity (of wood shall be) sprinkled (with water).

sanskrit_iast: dārumayāṇāṃ pātrāṇām ucchiṣṭasamanvārabdhānāmavalekhanam |
meaning: दारुमयाणां पात्राणाम् उच्छिष्टसमन्वारब्धानामवलेखनम् ।
text: Wooden vessels which have been touched by impure men (shall be) scraped;

sanskrit_iast: ucchiṣṭalepopahatānām avatakṣaṇam ||
meaning: उच्छिष्टलेपोपहतानाम् अवतक्षणम् ॥
text: (And) those which are defiled by stains of remnants (shall be) planed.

sanskrit_iast: mūtrapurīṣalohitaretaḥprabhṛtyupahatānām utsargaḥ |
meaning: मूत्रपुरीषलोहितरेतःप्रभृत्युपहतानाम् उत्सर्गः ।
text: (Wooden vessels) defiled by urine, ordure, blood, semen, and the like (very impure substances shall be) thrown away.

sanskrit_iast: tad etad anyatra nirdeśāt |
meaning: तद् एतद् अन्यत्र निर्देशात् ।
text: These (rules must be followed) except in case a (special) injunction (is given);

sanskrit_iast: yathaitad agnihotre gharmocchiṣṭe ca dadhigharme cakuṇḍapāyinām ayane cotsargiṇām ayane ca dākṣāyaṇayajñeceḍādadhe ceḍādadhe ca catuścakre ca brahmaudaneṣu cateṣu sarveṣu darbhair adbhiḥ prakṣālanam |
meaning: यथैतद् अग्निहोत्रे घर्मोच्छिष्टे च दधिघर्मे चकुण्डपायिनाम् अयने चोत्सर्गिणाम् अयने च दाक्षायणयज्ञेचेडादधे चेडादधे च चतुश्चक्रे च ब्रह्मौदनेषु चतेषु सर्वेषु दर्भैर् अद्भिः प्रक्षालनम् ।
text: Thus, for instance, (purification by) washing with Kuśa grass and water (is prescribed) on all the following (occasions, viz.) at the Agnihotra, the Gharmo k kh ishṭa, the Dadhigharma, the Kuṇd apāyinām Ayana, the Utsargiṇām Ayana, the Dākshāyaṇa sacrifice, the Ardhodaya, the K atuśk akra, and the Brahmaudanas,

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣv eva somabhakṣeṣv adbhir eva mārjālīye prakṣālanam |
meaning: सर्वेष्व् एव सोमभक्षेष्व् अद्भिर् एव मार्जालीये प्रक्षालनम् ।
text: (Again) at all Soma-sacrifices (the cups must be) cleaned with water only on (the heap of earth called) the Mār g āliya;

sanskrit_iast: mūtrapurīṣalohitaretaḥprabhṛtyupahatānām utsargaḥ |
meaning: मूत्रपुरीषलोहितरेतःप्रभृत्युपहतानाम् उत्सर्गः ।
text: If these same (cups are defiled) by urine, ordure, blood, semen, and the like (they must be) thrown away.

sanskrit_iast: mṛnmayānāṃ pātrāṇām ucchiṣṭasamanvārabdhānām avakūlanam |
meaning: मृन्मयानां पात्राणाम् उच्छिष्टसमन्वारब्धानाम् अवकूलनम् ।
text: Earthen vessels that have been touched by impure persons (must be) exposed to (the flame of) a fire of Kuśa grass.

sanskrit_iast: ucchiṣṭalepopahatānāṃ punardahanam |
meaning: उच्छिष्टलेपोपहतानां पुनर्दहनम् ।
text: Those which have been defiled by stains of remnants (of food must be) exposed to another burning.

sanskrit_iast: mūtrapurīṣalohitaretaḥprabhṛtyupahatānām utsargaḥ |
meaning: मूत्रपुरीषलोहितरेतःप्रभृत्युपहतानाम् उत्सर्गः ।
text: Those which have been defiled by urine, ordure, blood, semen, and the like (must be) thrown away.

sanskrit_iast: taijasānāṃ pātrāṇāṃ pūrvavat parimṛṣṭānāṃ prakṣālanam |
meaning: तैजसानां पात्राणां पूर्ववत् परिमृष्टानां प्रक्षालनम् ।
text: (Vessels) made of metal (must be) washed, after having been scrubbed as (directed) above.

sanskrit_iast: parimārjanadravyāṇi gośakṛnmṛdbhasmeti |
meaning: परिमार्जनद्रव्याणि गोशकृन्मृद्भस्मेति ।
text: The materials (to be used) for scrubbing (are) cowdung, earth, ashes, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast: mūtrapurīṣalohitaretaḥprabhṛtyupahatānāṃ punaḥkaraṇam |
meaning: मूत्रपुरीषलोहितरेतःप्रभृत्युपहतानां पुनःकरणम् ।
text: Those which have been defiled by urine, ordure, blood, semen, and the like (must be) recast,

sanskrit_iast: gomūtre vā saptarātraṃ pariśāyanaṃ mahānadyāṃ vā |
meaning: गोमूत्रे वा सप्तरात्रं परिशायनं महानद्यां वा ।
text: Or (they must) be kept during seven (days and) nights completely immersed in cow's urine,

sanskrit_iast: evam aśmamayānām |
meaning: एवम् अश्ममयानाम् ।
text: Or in a great river for as long (a period).

sanskrit_iast: alābubilvavināḍānāṃ govālaiḥ parimārjanam |
meaning: अलाबुबिल्वविनाडानां गोवालैः परिमार्जनम् ।
text: (Vessels) made of stone or of fruits, (i.e.) gourds, Bel-fruit, and Vināḷas, (shall be) brushed with (a brush of) cow's hair.

sanskrit_iast: naḍaveṇuśarakuśavyūtānāṃ gomayenādbhir iti prakṣālanam |
meaning: नडवेणुशरकुशव्यूतानां गोमयेनाद्भिर् इति प्रक्षालनम् ।
text: (Sacrificial implements made of) plaited Naḷa-reeds, bamboo, or Śara-reeds (shall be) washed with cowdung, water, and the like.

sanskrit_iast: vrīhīṇām upaghāte prakṣālyāvaśoṣaṇam |
meaning: व्रीहीणाम् उपघाते प्रक्षाल्यावशोषणम् ।
text: If unhusked rice has been defiled, (it must be) washed (and afterwards be) dried.

sanskrit_iast: bahūnāṃ tu prokṣaṇam |
meaning: बहूनां तु प्रोक्षणम् ।
text: But a great quantity (of unhusked rice must be) sprinkled.

sanskrit_iast: taṇḍulānām utsargaḥ |
meaning: तण्डुलानाम् उत्सर्गः ।
text: Husked rice (which has been defiled must be) thrown away.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ siddhahaviṣām |
meaning: एवं सिद्धहविषाम् ।
text: The same (rule applies) to cooked sacrificial viands.

sanskrit_iast: mahatāṃ śvavāyasaprabhṛtyupahatānāṃ taṃ deśaṃpuruṣānnam uddhṛtya | pavamānaḥ suvarjana iti | etenānuvākenābhyukṣaṇam |
meaning: महतां श्ववायसप्रभृत्युपहतानां तं देशंपुरुषान्नम् उद्धृत्य । पवमानः सुवर्जन इति । एतेनानुवाकेनाभ्युक्षणम् ।
text: But if a great quantity has been defiled by (the touch of) dogs, crows, and the like (unclean beings), one must throw away that portion (as) food for men, and sprinkle (the rest with water), reciting the Anuvāka, 'Pavamānaḥsuvar g ana h .'

sanskrit_iast: madhūdake payovikāre ca pātrāt pātrāntarānayaneśaucam |
meaning: मधूदके पयोविकारे च पात्रात् पात्रान्तरानयनेशौचम् ।
text: Hydromel and preparations of milk (are) purified by pouring them from one vessel into another.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ tailasarpiṣī ucchiṣṭasamanvārabdheudake 'vadhāyopayojayet |
meaning: एवं तैलसर्पिषी उच्छिष्टसमन्वारब्धेउदके ऽवधायोपयोजयेत् ।
text: In like manner let him pour oil and clarified butter which have been touched by an impure (person) into water, and (afterwards) use them.

sanskrit_iast: amedhyābhyādhāne samāropyāgniṃ mathitvā pavamāneṣṭiḥ |
meaning: अमेध्याभ्याधाने समारोप्याग्निं मथित्वा पवमानेष्टिः ।
text: If (any) impure (substance) is thrown (into the sacrificial fire) let him place (the two Araṇis one) on (the other), produce fire by friction, (and offer) a Pavamāneshṭi.

sanskrit_iast: śaucadeśamantrāvṛdarthadravyasaṃskārakālabhedeṣupūrvapūrvaprādhānyam | pūrvapūrvaprādhānyam |
meaning: शौचदेशमन्त्रावृदर्थद्रव्यसंस्कारकालभेदेषुपूर्वपूर्वप्राधान्यम् । पूर्वपूर्वप्राधान्यम् ।
text: If (the rules regarding) purity, the proper place, the mantras, the series of actions, the object, the materials, (their) consecration, and the proper time are conflicting, each earlier-named (point) is more important (than the following ones).

sanskrit_iast: uttarata upacāro vihāraḥ |
meaning: उत्तरत उपचारो विहारः ।
text: The sacred fires (shall be) approached from the north,

sanskrit_iast: tathāpavargaḥ |
meaning: तथापवर्गः ।
text: (And be) left in the same manner.

sanskrit_iast: viparītaṃ pitryeṣu |
meaning: विपरीतं पित्र्येषु ।
text: The contrary (proceeding should be adopted at sacrifices offered) to the manes.

sanskrit_iast: pādopahataṃ prakṣālayet |
meaning: पादोपहतं प्रक्षालयेत् ।
text: Let him wash that which has been touched with (his) foot.

sanskrit_iast: aṅgam upaspṛśya sicaṃ vāpa upaspṛśet |
meaning: अङ्गम् उपस्पृश्य सिचं वाप उपस्पृशेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: evaṃchedanabhedanakhanananirasanapitryarākṣasanairṛtaraudrābhicaraṇīyeṣu |
meaning: एवंछेदनभेदनखनननिरसनपित्र्यराक्षसनैरृतरौद्राभिचरणीयेषु ।

sanskrit_iast: na mantravatā yajñāṅgenātmānam abhipariharet |
meaning: न मन्त्रवता यज्ञाङ्गेनात्मानम् अभिपरिहरेत् ।
text: Let him not turn round himself a sacrificial implement (the use of) which is accompanied by the recitation of mantras.

sanskrit_iast: abhyantarāṇi yajñāṅgāni |
meaning: अभ्यन्तराणि यज्ञाङ्गानि ।
text: (For) the sacrificial implements (are) more nearly (connected with the sacrifice),

sanskrit_iast: bāhyā ṛtvijaḥ |
meaning: बाह्या ऋत्विजः ।
text: The priests, more remotely.

sanskrit_iast: patnīyajamānāv ṛtvigbhyo 'ntaratamau |
meaning: पत्नीयजमानाव् ऋत्विग्भ्यो ऽन्तरतमौ ।
text: The sacrificer and his wife are even nearer than the priests.

sanskrit_iast: yajñāngebhya ājyam ājyād havīṃṣi havirbhyaḥ paśuḥ paśoḥsomaḥ somād agnayaḥ |
meaning: यज्ञान्गेभ्य आज्यम् आज्याद् हवींषि हविर्भ्यः पशुः पशोःसोमः सोमाद् अग्नयः ।
text: After the sacrificial implements (follows) the clarified butter, after the clarified butter the sacrificial viands, after the sacrificial viands the animal to be slain, after the animal the Soma, after the Soma the sacred fires.

sanskrit_iast: yathākarmartvijo na vihārād abhiparyāvarteran |
meaning: यथाकर्मर्त्विजो न विहाराद् अभिपर्यावर्तेरन् ।
text: If there is work for them, the priests shall not turn away from the sacred fires.

sanskrit_iast: prāṅmukhaś ced dakṣiṇam aṃsam abhiparyāvarteta |
meaning: प्राङ्मुखश् चेद् दक्षिणम् अंसम् अभिपर्यावर्तेत ।
text: If he faces the east, let him turn towards his right shoulder,

sanskrit_iast: pratyaṅmukhaḥ savyam |
meaning: प्रत्यङ्मुखः सव्यम् ।
text: If he faces the west, towards the left.

sanskrit_iast: antareṇa cātvālotkarau yajñasya tīrtham |
meaning: अन्तरेण चात्वालोत्करौ यज्ञस्य तीर्थम् ।
text: The entrance to the sacrificial (enclosure lies) between the K ātvāla and the Utkara,

sanskrit_iast: acātvāla āhavanīyotkarau |
meaning: अचात्वाल आहवनीयोत्करौ ।
text: (When one comes) from the K ātvāla, (it lies between) the Āhavanīya fire and the Utkara.

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ kartāro yajamānaḥ patnī ca prapadyeran |
meaning: ततः कर्तारो यजमानः पत्नी च प्रपद्येरन् ।
text: The officiating (priests), the sacrificer, and his wife shall enter by that (road),

sanskrit_iast: visaṃsthite |
meaning: विसंस्थिते ।
text: As long as the sacrificial rite is not completed.

sanskrit_iast: saṃsthite ca saṃcaro 'nutkaradeśāt |
meaning: संस्थिते च संचरो ऽनुत्करदेशात् ।
text: When it has been finished (they shall) pass to and fro on the side where there is no Utkara (i.e. on the western side of the enclosure).

sanskrit_iast: nāprokṣitam aprapannaṃ klinnaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ samidhaṃvābhyādadhyāt |
meaning: नाप्रोक्षितम् अप्रपन्नं क्लिन्नं काष्ठं समिधंवाभ्यादध्यात् ।
text: Let him not put on the fire logs or Samidhs which have not been sprinkled (with water),

sanskrit_iast: agreṇāhavanīyaṃ brahmayajamānau prapadyete |
meaning: अग्रेणाहवनीयं ब्रह्मयजमानौ प्रपद्येते ।
text: The Brahman (priest) and the sacrificer shall enter in front of the Āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: jaghanenāhavanīyam ity eke |
meaning: जघनेनाहवनीयम् इत्य् एके ।
text: Some (declare that they shall enter) behind the Āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇenāhavanīyaṃ brahmāyatanaṃ tadapareṇa yajamānasya |
meaning: दक्षिणेनाहवनीयं ब्रह्मायतनं तदपरेण यजमानस्य ।
text: The seat of the Brahman (priest is situated) to the south of the Āhavanīya fire, (that) of the sacrificer to the west of him.

sanskrit_iast: uttarāṃ śroṇim uttareṇa hotuḥ |
meaning: उत्तरां श्रोणिम् उत्तरेण होतुः ।
text: (The seat) of the Hot ri (priest is situated) to the north of the northern Sroṇi (of the Vedi),

sanskrit_iast: utkara āgnīdhrasya |
meaning: उत्कर आग्नीध्रस्य ।
text: (That) of the Āgnīdhra priest near the Utkara,

sanskrit_iast: jaghanena gārhapatyaṃ patnyāḥ |
meaning: जघनेन गार्हपत्यं पत्न्याः ।
text: (That) of the (sacrificer's) wife behind the Gārhapatya fire.

sanskrit_iast: teṣu kālekāla eva darbhān saṃstṛṇāti |
meaning: तेषु कालेकाल एव दर्भान् संस्तृणाति ।
text: He scatters Darbha grass on these (seats) as often as (they are used).

sanskrit_iast: ekaikasya codakamaṇḍalur upāttaḥ syād ācamanārthaḥ |
meaning: एकैकस्य चोदकमण्डलुर् उपात्तः स्याद् आचमनार्थः ।

sanskrit_iast: vratopeto dīkṣitaḥ syāt |
meaning: व्रतोपेतो दीक्षितः स्यात् ।

sanskrit_iast: na parapāpaṃ vaden na krudhyen na roden mūtrapurīṣenāvekṣeta |
meaning: न परपापं वदेन् न क्रुध्येन् न रोदेन् मूत्रपुरीषेनावेक्षेत ।

sanskrit_iast: amedhyaṃ dṛṣṭvā japati | abaddhaṃ mano daridraṃ cakṣuḥsūryo jyotiṣāṃ śreṣṭho dīkṣe mā mā hāsīr iti |
meaning: अमेध्यं दृष्ट्वा जपति । अबद्धं मनो दरिद्रं चक्षुःसूर्यो ज्योतिषां श्रेष्ठो दीक्षे मा मा हासीर् इति ।

sanskrit_iast: atha yady enam abhivarṣati | undatīr balaṃ dhattaujo dhattabalaṃ dhatta mā me dīkṣāṃ mā tapo nirvadhiṣṭeti |
meaning: अथ यद्य् एनम् अभिवर्षति । उन्दतीर् बलं धत्तौजो धत्तबलं धत्त मा मे दीक्षां मा तपो निर्वधिष्टेति ।

sanskrit_iast: catvāro varṇā brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviṭśūdrāḥ |
meaning: चत्वारो वर्णा ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविट्शूद्राः ।
text: There are four castes (varṇa, viz.) Brāhmaṇas, Kshatriyas, Vaiśyas, and Śūdras.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ varṇānupūrvyeṇa catasro bhāryā brāhmaṇasya |
meaning: तेषां वर्णानुपूर्व्येण चतस्रो भार्या ब्राह्मणस्य ।
text: (Males) belonging to them (may take) wives according to the order of the castes, (viz.) a Brāhmaṇa four,

sanskrit_iast: tisro rājanyasya |
meaning: तिस्रो राजन्यस्य ।
text: A Kshatriya three,

sanskrit_iast: dve vaiśyasya |
meaning: द्वे वैश्यस्य ।
text: A Vaiśya two,

sanskrit_iast: ekā śūdrasya |
meaning: एका शूद्रस्य ।
text: A Śūdra one.

sanskrit_iast: tāsu putrāḥ savarṇānantarāsu savarṇāḥ |
meaning: तासु पुत्राः सवर्णानन्तरासु सवर्णाः ।

sanskrit_iast: ekāntaradvyantarāsv |
meaning: एकान्तरद्व्यन्तरास्व् ।

sanskrit_iast: pratilomāsv āyogavamāgadhavaiṇakṣattṛpulkasakukkuṭavaidehakacaṇḍālaḥ |
meaning: प्रतिलोमास्व् आयोगवमागधवैणक्षत्तृपुल्कसकुक्कुटवैदेहकचण्डालः ।

sanskrit_iast: ambaṣṭhāt prathamāyāṃ śvapākaḥ |
meaning: अम्बष्ठात् प्रथमायां श्वपाकः ।

sanskrit_iast: ugrād dvitīyāyāṃ vaiṇaḥ |
meaning: उग्राद् द्वितीयायां वैणः ।

sanskrit_iast: niṣādāt tṛtīyāyāṃ pulkasaḥ |
meaning: निषादात् तृतीयायां पुल्कसः ।

sanskrit_iast: viparyaye kukkuṭaḥ |
meaning: विपर्यये कुक्कुटः ।

sanskrit_iast: niṣādena niṣādyām ā pañcamāj jāto 'pahanti śūdratām |
meaning: निषादेन निषाद्याम् आ पञ्चमाज् जातो ऽपहन्ति शूद्रताम् ।

sanskrit_iast: tam upanayet ṣaṣṭhaṃ yājayet |
meaning: तम् उपनयेत् षष्ठं याजयेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: saptamo 'vikṛtabījaḥ samabījaḥ sama ity eṣāṃ saṃjñāḥkrameṇa nipatanti |
meaning: सप्तमो ऽविकृतबीजः समबीजः सम इत्य् एषां संज्ञाःक्रमेण निपतन्ति ।

sanskrit_iast: triṣu varṇeṣu sādṛśyād avrato janayet tu yān | tān sāvitrīparibhraṣṭān vrātyān āhur manīṣiṇaḥ | vrātyān āhur manīṣiṇa iti || | rathakārāmbaṣṭhasūtogramāgadhāyogavavaiṇakṣattṛpulkasakukkuṭavaidehakacaṇḍālaśvapākaprabhṛtayaḥ |
meaning: त्रिषु वर्णेषु सादृश्याद् अव्रतो जनयेत् तु यान् । तान् सावित्रीपरिभ्रष्टान् व्रात्यान् आहुर् मनीषिणः । व्रात्यान् आहुर् मनीषिण इति ॥ । रथकाराम्बष्ठसूतोग्रमागधायोगववैणक्षत्तृपुल्कसकुक्कुटवैदेहकचण्डालश्वपाकप्रभृतयः ।

sanskrit_iast: tatra savarṇāsu savarṇāḥ |
meaning: तत्र सवर्णासु सवर्णाः ।
text: Among these, sons of equal caste (spring) from women of equal caste.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇāt kṣatriyāyāṃ brāhmaṇo vaiśyāyām ambaṣṭhaḥśūdrāyāṃ niṣādaḥ |
meaning: ब्राह्मणात् क्षत्रियायां ब्राह्मणो वैश्यायाम् अम्बष्ठःशूद्रायां निषादः ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa (begets) on a female of the Kshatriya caste a Brāhmaṇa, on a female of the Vaiśya caste an Ambash th a, on a female of the Śūdra caste a Nishāda,

sanskrit_iast: pāraśava ity eke |
meaning: पारशव इत्य् एके ।
text: (According to) some a Pāraśava.

sanskrit_iast: kṣatriyād vaiśyāyāṃ kṣatriyaḥ śūdrāyām ugraḥ |
meaning: क्षत्रियाद् वैश्यायां क्षत्रियः शूद्रायाम् उग्रः ।
text: A Kshatriya (begets) on a female of the Vaiśya caste a Kshatriya, on a female of the Śūdra caste an Ugra.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśyāc chūdrāyāṃ rathakāraḥ |
meaning: वैश्याच् छूद्रायां रथकारः ।
text: A Vaiśya (begets) on a female of the Śūdra caste a Rathakāra.

sanskrit_iast: śūdrād vaiśyāyāṃ māgadhaḥ kṣatriyāyāṃ kṣattābrāhmaṇyāṃ caṇḍālaḥ |
meaning: शूद्राद् वैश्यायां मागधः क्षत्रियायां क्षत्ताब्राह्मण्यां चण्डालः ।
text: A Śūdra begets on a female of the Vaiśya caste a Māgadha, on a female of the Kshatriya caste a Kshatt ri , but on a female of the Brāhmaṇa caste a K aṇd āla.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśyāt kṣatriyāyām āyogavo brāhmaṇyāṃ vaidehakaḥ | kṣatriyād brāhmaṇyāṃ sūtaḥ |
meaning: वैश्यात् क्षत्रियायाम् आयोगवो ब्राह्मण्यां वैदेहकः । क्षत्रियाद् ब्राह्मण्यां सूतः ।
text: A Vaiśya begets on a female of the Kshatriya caste an Āyogava, on a female of the Brāhmaṇa caste a Sūta.

sanskrit_iast: tatrāmbaṣṭhograyoḥ saṃyoge bhavaty anulomaḥ |
meaning: तत्राम्बष्ठोग्रयोः संयोगे भवत्य् अनुलोमः ।
text: If among these an Ambash th a (male) and an Ugra (female) unite, (their son) will be born in the direct order of the castes (Anuloma).

sanskrit_iast: kṣattṛvaidehakayoḥ pratilomaḥ |
meaning: क्षत्तृवैदेहकयोः प्रतिलोमः ।
text: If a Kshatt ri (male) and a Vaidehaka (female) unite, (their son will be) born against the order of the castes (Pratiloma).

sanskrit_iast: ugrāj jātaḥ kṣattryāṃ śvapākaḥ |
meaning: उग्राज् जातः क्षत्त्र्यां श्वपाकः ।
text: An Ugra (begets) on a female of the Kshatt ri caste a Śvapāka,

sanskrit_iast: vaidehakād ambaṣṭhāyāṃ vaiṇaḥ |
meaning: वैदेहकाद् अम्बष्ठायां वैणः ।
text: A Vaidehaka on a female of the Ambash th a caste a Vaiṇa,

sanskrit_iast: niṣadāc chūdrāyāṃ pulkasaḥ |
meaning: निषदाच् छूद्रायां पुल्कसः ।
text: A Nishāda on a female of the Śūdra caste a Pulkasa,

sanskrit_iast: śūdrān niṣādyāṃ kukkuṭaḥ |
meaning: शूद्रान् निषाद्यां कुक्कुटः ।
text: A Śūdra on a female of the Nishāda caste a Kukkuṭaka.

sanskrit_iast: varṇasaṃkarād utpannān vrātyān āhur manīṣiṇaḥ | vrātyān āhur manīṣiṇa iti |
meaning: वर्णसंकराद् उत्पन्नान् व्रात्यान् आहुर् मनीषिणः । व्रात्यान् आहुर् मनीषिण इति ।
text: The wise declare those sprung from an inter-mixture of the castes to be Vrātyas.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍbhāgabhṛto rājā rakṣet prajāḥ |
meaning: षड्भागभृतो राजा रक्षेत् प्रजाः ।
text: Let the king protect (his) subjects, receiving as his pay a sixth part (of their incomes or spiritual merit).

sanskrit_iast: brahma vai svaṃ mahimānaṃ brāhmaṇeṣv adadhādadhyayanādhyāpanayajanayājanadānapratigrahasaṃyuktaṃ vedānāṃguptyai |
meaning: ब्रह्म वै स्वं महिमानं ब्राह्मणेष्व् अदधादध्ययनाध्यापनयजनयाजनदानप्रतिग्रहसंयुक्तं वेदानांगुप्त्यै ।
text: Brahman, forsooth, placed its majesty in the Brāhmaṇas, together with (the duties and privileges of) studying, teaching, sacrificing for themselves, sacrificing for others, liberality, and accepting (gifts), for the protection of the Vedas;

sanskrit_iast: kṣatre balamadhyayanayajanadānaśastrakośabhūtarakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kṣatrasyavṛddhyai |
meaning: क्षत्रे बलमध्ययनयजनदानशस्त्रकोशभूतरक्षणसंयुक्तं क्षत्रस्यवृद्ध्यै ।
text: In the Kshatriyas (it placed) strength, together with (the duties and privileges of) studying, sacrificing, liberality, (using) weapons, and protecting the treasure (and the life of) created beings, for the growth of (good) government;

sanskrit_iast: viṭsvadhyayanayajanadānakṛṣivāṇijyapaśupālanasaṃyuktaṃ karmaṇāṃvṛddhyai |
meaning: विट्स्वध्ययनयजनदानकृषिवाणिज्यपशुपालनसंयुक्तं कर्मणांवृद्ध्यै ।
text: In the Vaiśyas (it placed the power of work), together with (the duties of) studying, sacrificing, liberality, cultivating (the soil), trading, and tending cattle, for the growth of (productive) labour.

sanskrit_iast: śūdreṣu pūrveṣāṃ paricaryām |
meaning: शूद्रेषु पूर्वेषां परिचर्याम् ।
text: On the Śūdras (it imposed the duty of) serving the three higher (castes).

sanskrit_iast: patto hy aṣṛjyanteti |
meaning: पत्तो ह्य् अषृज्यन्तेति ।
text: For (the Veda states), 'they were created from the feet (of Brahman).'

sanskrit_iast: sarvatodhuraṃ purohitaṃ vṛṇuyāt |
meaning: सर्वतोधुरं पुरोहितं वृणुयात् ।
text: Let (the king) choose a domestic priest (who shall be) foremost in all (transactions).

sanskrit_iast: tasya śāsane varteta |
meaning: तस्य शासने वर्तेत ।
text: Let him act according to his instructions.

sanskrit_iast: saṃgrāme na nivarteta |
meaning: संग्रामे न निवर्तेत ।
text: Let him not turn back in battle.

sanskrit_iast: na karṇibhir na digdhaiḥ praharet || | bhītamattonmattapramattavisaṃnāhastrībālavṛddhabrāhmaṇair na yudhyeta |
meaning: न कर्णिभिर् न दिग्धैः प्रहरेत् ॥ । भीतमत्तोन्मत्तप्रमत्तविसंनाहस्त्रीबालवृद्धब्राह्मणैर् न युध्येत ।

sanskrit_iast: anyatrātatāyinaḥ |
meaning: अन्यत्राततायिनः ।
text: Excepting assassins (ātatāyin).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | adhyāpakaṃ kule jātaṃ yo hanyād ātatāyinam | na tena bhrūṇahā bhavati manyus tan manyum ṛcchati || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अध्यापकं कुले जातं यो हन्याद् आततायिनम् । न तेन भ्रूणहा भवति मन्युस् तन् मन्युम् ऋच्छति ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'He who slays an assassin, able to teach (the Veda) and born in a (noble) family, does not (incur) by that (act the guilt of) the murderer of a learned Brāhmaṇa; (in) that (case) fury recoils upon fury.'

sanskrit_iast: sāmudraśulko varaṃ rūpam uddhṛtya daśapaṇaṃ śatam |
meaning: सामुद्रशुल्को वरं रूपम् उद्धृत्य दशपणं शतम् ।
text: The duty on goods imported by sea is, after deducting a choice article, ten Paṇas in the hundred.

sanskrit_iast: anyeṣām api sārānurūpyeṇānupahatya dharmyaṃ prakalpayet |
meaning: अन्येषाम् अपि सारानुरूप्येणानुपहत्य धर्म्यं प्रकल्पयेत् ।
text: Let him also lay just (duties) on other (marketable goods) according to their intrinsic value without oppressing (the traders).

sanskrit_iast: abrāhmaṇasya pranaṣṭasvāmikaṃ rikthaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ paripālya rājā haret |
meaning: अब्राह्मणस्य प्रनष्टस्वामिकं रिक्थं संवत्सरं परिपाल्य राजा हरेत् ।
text: Let the king guard the property of men belonging to a non-Brāhmanical caste, the owner of which has disappeared, during a year, and afterwards take it (for himself).

sanskrit_iast: avadhyo vai brāhmaṇaḥ sarvāparādheṣu |
meaning: अवध्यो वै ब्राह्मणः सर्वापराधेषु ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa, forsooth, shall not suffer corporal punishment for any offence.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇasyabrahmahatyāgurutalpagamanasuvarṇasteyasurāpāneṣu kusindhabhagasṛgālasurādhvajāṃs taptenāyasā lalāṭe 'ṅkayitvā viṣayān nirdhamanam |
meaning: ब्राह्मणस्यब्रह्महत्यागुरुतल्पगमनसुवर्णस्तेयसुरापानेषु कुसिन्धभगसृगालसुराध्वजांस् तप्तेनायसा ललाटे ऽङ्कयित्वा विषयान् निर्धमनम् ।
text: In case (a Brāhmaṇa) has slain a Brāhmaṇa, has violated his Guru's bed, has stolen the gold (of a Brāhmaṇa), or has drunk (the spirituous liquor called) Surā, (the king) shall cause to be impressed with a heated iron the mark of a headless trunk, a female part, a jackal, (or) the sign of a tavern on the forehead (of the offender) and banish him from his realm.

sanskrit_iast: kṣatriyādīnāṃ brāhmaṇavadhe vadhaḥ sarvasvaharaṇam ca |
meaning: क्षत्रियादीनां ब्राह्मणवधे वधः सर्वस्वहरणम् च ।
text: If a Kshatriya or (a man of any) other (lower caste) has murdered a Brāhmaṇa, death and the confiscation of all his property (shall be his punishment).

sanskrit_iast: teṣām eva tulyāpakṛṣṭavadhe yathābalam anurūpāndaṇḍān prakalpayet |
meaning: तेषाम् एव तुल्यापकृष्टवधे यथाबलम् अनुरूपान्दण्डान् प्रकल्पयेत् ।
text: If those same (persons) slay men of equal or lower castes, (the king) shall fix suitable punishments in accordance with their ability.

sanskrit_iast: kṣatriyavadhe gosahasram ṛṣabhādhikaṃ rājña utsṛjedvairaniryātanārtham |
meaning: क्षत्रियवधे गोसहस्रम् ऋषभाधिकं राज्ञ उत्सृजेद्वैरनिर्यातनार्थम् ।
text: For slaying a Kshatriya (the offender) shall give to the king one thousand cows and besides a bull in expiation of his sin,

sanskrit_iast: śataṃ vaiśye daśa śūdra ṛṣabhaś cātrādhikaḥ |
meaning: शतं वैश्ये दश शूद्र ऋषभश् चात्राधिकः ।
text: For (slaying) a Vaiśya one hundred cows, for (slaying) a Śūdra ten; and a bull (must be) added (in each case).

sanskrit_iast: śūdravadhena strīvadho govadhaś cavyākhyāto 'nyatrātreyyā vadhād dhenvanaḍuhoś ca |
meaning: शूद्रवधेन स्त्रीवधो गोवधश् चव्याख्यातो ऽन्यत्रात्रेय्या वधाद् धेन्वनडुहोश् च ।
text: (The punishment for) the murder of a woman--excepting a (Brāhmaṇī) who had bathed after temporary uncleanness--and for the destruction of a cow have been explained by the (rule regarding the) murder of a Śūdra.

sanskrit_iast: vadhe dhenvanaḍuhor ante cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret |
meaning: वधे धेन्वनडुहोर् अन्ते चान्द्रायणं चरेत् ।
text: If he has slain a milch-cow or a draught-ox, he shall perform a K āndrāyaṇa (lunar penance) after (paying the prescribed fine).

sanskrit_iast: ātreyyā vadhaḥ kṣatriyavadhena vyākhyātaḥ || | haṃsabhāsabarhiṇacakravākapracalākakākolūkamaṇḍūkaḍiḍḍikaḍerikāśvababhrunakulādīnāṃvadhe śūdravat |
meaning: आत्रेय्या वधः क्षत्रियवधेन व्याख्यातः ॥ । हंसभासबर्हिणचक्रवाकप्रचलाककाकोलूकमण्डूकडिड्डिकडेरिकाश्वबभ्रुनकुलादीनांवधे शूद्रवत् ।

sanskrit_iast: lokasaṃgrahaṇārthaṃ yathā dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ vā sākṣīsākṣyaṃ brūyāt |
meaning: लोकसंग्रहणार्थं यथा दृष्टं श्रुतं वा साक्षीसाक्ष्यं ब्रूयात् ।
text: In order to gain the good opinion of men, a witness shall give evidence in accordance with what he has seen or heard.

sanskrit_iast: pādo 'dharmasya kartāraṃ pādo gacchati sākṣiṇam | pādaḥ sabhāsadaḥ sarvān pādo rājānam ṛcchati | rājā bhavaty anenāś ca mucyante ca sabhāsadaḥ | eno gacchati kartāraṃ yatra nindyo ha nindyate |
meaning: पादो ऽधर्मस्य कर्तारं पादो गच्छति साक्षिणम् । पादः सभासदः सर्वान् पादो राजानम् ऋच्छति । राजा भवत्य् अनेनाश् च मुच्यन्ते च सभासदः । एनो गच्छति कर्तारं यत्र निन्द्यो ह निन्द्यते ।
text: Of injustice (in decisions) one quarter falls on the party in the cause, one quarter on his witnesses, one quarter on all the judges, and one quarter on the king. But where he who deserves condemnation is condemned, the king is guiltless and the judges free from blame; the guilt falls on the offender (alone).

sanskrit_iast: sākṣiṇaṃ caivam uddiṣṭaṃ yatnāt pṛcched vicakṣaṇaḥ |
meaning: साक्षिणं चैवम् उद्दिष्टं यत्नात् पृच्छेद् विचक्षणः ।
text: (Therefore) a wise man should ask an appointed witness in the following manner:

sanskrit_iast: yāṃ rātrim ajaniṣṭhās tvaṃ yāṃ ca rātriṃ mariṣyasi | etayor antarā yat te sukṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ bhavet | tat sarvaṃ rājagāmi syād anṛtaṃ bruvatas tava |
meaning: यां रात्रिम् अजनिष्ठास् त्वं यां च रात्रिं मरिष्यसि । एतयोर् अन्तरा यत् ते सुकृतं सुकृतं भवेत् । तत् सर्वं राजगामि स्याद् अनृतं ब्रुवतस् तव ।
text: 'The merit which thou hast acquired in the interval between the night in which thou wast born and that in which thou wilt die, all that will go to the king, if thou speakest an untruth.'

sanskrit_iast: trīn eva ca pitqn hanti trīn eva ca pitāmahān | sapta jātān ajātāṃś ca sākṣī sākṣyaṃ mṛṣā vadan |
meaning: त्रीन् एव च पित्qन् हन्ति त्रीन् एव च पितामहान् । सप्त जातान् अजातांश् च साक्षी साक्ष्यं मृषा वदन् ।
text: 'A witness who speaks falsely, slays three fathers and three grandfathers and seven (descendants), both the born and the unborn.'

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyārthe anṛte hanti trīn eva ca pitāmahān | pañca paśvanṛte hanti daśa hanti gavānṛte | śatam aśvānṛte hanti sahasraṃ puruṣānṛte | sarvaṃ bhūmyanṛte hanti sākṣī sākṣyaṃ mṛṣā vadan |
meaning: हिरण्यार्थे अनृते हन्ति त्रीन् एव च पितामहान् । पञ्च पश्वनृते हन्ति दश हन्ति गवानृते । शतम् अश्वानृते हन्ति सहस्रं पुरुषानृते । सर्वं भूम्यनृते हन्ति साक्षी साक्ष्यं मृषा वदन् ।
text: 'By false testimony concerning gold he kills three ancestors; by false testimony regarding (small) cattle he kills five; by false testimony concerning kine he kills ten.' 'He kills a hundred by false evidence regarding horses, (and) a thousand by false evidence concerning a man. A witness Who speaks falsely, destroys the whole (world) by false evidence concerning land.'

sanskrit_iast: catvāro varṇāḥ putriṇaḥ sākṣiṇaḥ syur anyatraśrotriyarājanyapravrajitamānuṣyahīnebhyaḥ |
meaning: चत्वारो वर्णाः पुत्रिणः साक्षिणः स्युर् अन्यत्रश्रोत्रियराजन्यप्रव्रजितमानुष्यहीनेभ्यः ।
text: (Men of) the four castes (varṇa) who have sons may be witnesses excepting Śrotriyas, the king, ascetics, and those who are destitute of human (intellect).

sanskrit_iast: smṛtau pradhānataḥ pratipattiḥ |
meaning: स्मृतौ प्रधानतः प्रतिपत्तिः ।
text: If (the witness rightly) recollects (the facts of) the case (he will receive) commendation from the most eminent men.

sanskrit_iast: ato 'nyathā kartapatyam |
meaning: अतो ऽन्यथा कर्तपत्यम् ।
text: In the contrary case (he will) fall into hell.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśarātraṃ taptaṃ payaḥ pibet kūśmāṇḍair vā juhuyād iti | kūśmāṇḍair vā juhuyād iti |
meaning: द्वादशरात्रं तप्तं पयः पिबेत् कूश्माण्डैर् वा जुहुयाद् इति । कूश्माण्डैर् वा जुहुयाद् इति ।
text: Let him (who has given false evidence), drink hot milk during twelve (days and) nights or offer burnt oblations (reciting) the Kūshmāṇd a (texts).

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭau vivāhāḥ |
meaning: अष्टौ विवाहाः ।
text: (There are) eight marriage-rites.

sanskrit_iast: śrutaśīle vijñāya brahmacāriṇe 'rthine dīyate sa brāhmaḥ |
meaning: श्रुतशीले विज्ञाय ब्रह्मचारिणे ऽर्थिने दीयते स ब्राह्मः ।
text: If (the father) gives (his daughter) to a student (who has not broken his vow of chastity and) who asks for her, after fully enquiring into his learning and character, that (is) the rite .of Brahman (brāhma).

sanskrit_iast: ācchādyālaṃkṛtya | eṣā saha dharmaś caryatām iti | prājāptyaḥ |
meaning: आच्छाद्यालंकृत्य । एषा सह धर्मश् चर्यताम् इति । प्राजाप्त्यः ।
text: If (the father gives his daughter away) after clothing her and decking her with ornaments, (saying) 'That (is thy wife), fulfil the law (with her),' that (is) the rite of Pra g āpati (prā g āpatya).

sanskrit_iast: pūrvāṃ lājāhutiṃ hutvā gobhyāṃ sahārṣaḥ |
meaning: पूर्वां लाजाहुतिं हुत्वा गोभ्यां सहार्षः ।
text: If (the bridegroom) after offering the first burnt oblation of parched grain (receives the maiden) for a bull and a cow, that is the rite of the Ri shis (ārsha).

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāsu nīyamānāsv antarvedy ṛtvije sa daivaḥ |
meaning: दक्षिणासु नीयमानास्व् अन्तर्वेद्य् ऋत्विजे स दैवः ।

sanskrit_iast: dhanenopatoṣyāsuraḥ |
meaning: धनेनोपतोष्यासुरः ।

sanskrit_iast: sakāmena sakāmāyā mithaḥ saṃyogo gāndharvaḥ |
meaning: सकामेन सकामाया मिथः संयोगो गान्धर्वः ।

sanskrit_iast: prasahya haraṇād rākṣasaḥ |
meaning: प्रसह्य हरणाद् राक्षसः ।

sanskrit_iast: suptāṃ mattāṃ pramattāṃ vopagacched iti paiśācaḥ |
meaning: सुप्तां मत्तां प्रमत्तां वोपगच्छेद् इति पैशाचः ।

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ catvāraḥ pūrve brāhmaṇasya teṣv api pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥśreyān |
meaning: तेषां चत्वारः पूर्वे ब्राह्मणस्य तेष्व् अपि पूर्वः पूर्वःश्रेयान् ।

sanskrit_iast: uttareṣām uttara uttaraḥ pāpīyān |
meaning: उत्तरेषाम् उत्तर उत्तरः पापीयान् ।

sanskrit_iast: atrāpi ṣaṣṭhasaptamau kṣatradharmānugatautatpratyayatvāt kṣatrasya |
meaning: अत्रापि षष्ठसप्तमौ क्षत्रधर्मानुगतौतत्प्रत्ययत्वात् क्षत्रस्य ।

sanskrit_iast: pañcamāṣṭamau vaiśyaśūdrāṇām |
meaning: पञ्चमाष्टमौ वैश्यशूद्राणाम् ।
text: The fifth and the eighth (are lawful) for Vaiśyas and Śūdras.

sanskrit_iast: ayantritakalatrā hi vaiśyaśūdrā bhavanti |
meaning: अयन्त्रितकलत्रा हि वैश्यशूद्रा भवन्ति ।
text: For Vaiśyas and Śūdras are not particular about their wives,

sanskrit_iast: karṣaṇaśuśrūṣādhikṛtatvāt |
meaning: कर्षणशुश्रूषाधिकृतत्वात् ।
text: Because they are allowed (to subsist by such low occupations as) husbandry and service.

sanskrit_iast: gāndharvam apy eke praśaṃsanti sarveṣāṃ snehānugatatvāt |
meaning: गान्धर्वम् अप्य् एके प्रशंसन्ति सर्वेषां स्नेहानुगतत्वात् ।
text: Some recommend the Gāndharva rite for all (castes), because it is based on (mutual) affection.

sanskrit_iast: yathā yukto vivāhas tathā yuktā prajā bhavatītivijñāyate |
meaning: यथा युक्तो विवाहस् तथा युक्ता प्रजा भवतीतिविज्ञायते ।
text: The Veda declares, The quality of the offspring depends on the quality of the marriage rite.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | krītā dravyeṇa yā nārī sā na patnī vidhīyate | sā na daive na sā pitrye dāsīṃ tāṃ kāśyapo 'bravīt |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । क्रीता द्रव्येण या नारी सा न पत्नी विधीयते । सा न दैवे न सा पित्र्ये दासीं तां काश्यपो ऽब्रवीत् ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'It is declared that a female who has been purchased for money is not a wife. She cannot (assist) at sacrifices offered to the gods or the manes. Kāśyapa has stated that she is a slave.'

sanskrit_iast: śulkena ye prayacchanti svasutāṃ lobhamohitāḥ | ātmavikrayiṇaḥ pāpā mahākilbiṣakārakāḥ | patanti narake ghore ghnanti cā saptamaṃ kulam | gamanāgamanaṃ caiva sarvaṃ śulke vidhīyate || | paurṇamasyaṣṭakāmāvāsyāgnyutpātabhūmikampaśmaśānadeśapatiśrotriyaikatīrthaprayāṇeṣv ahorātram anadhyāyaḥ |
meaning: शुल्केन ये प्रयच्छन्ति स्वसुतां लोभमोहिताः । आत्मविक्रयिणः पापा महाकिल्बिषकारकाः । पतन्ति नरके घोरे घ्नन्ति चा सप्तमं कुलम् । गमनागमनं चैव सर्वं शुल्के विधीयते ॥ । पौर्णमस्यष्टकामावास्याग्न्युत्पातभूमिकम्पश्मशानदेशपतिश्रोत्रियैकतीर्थप्रयाणेष्व् अहोरात्रम् अनध्यायः ।

sanskrit_iast: vāte pūtigandhe nīhāre canṛttagītavāditraruditasāmaśabdeṣu tāvantaṃ kālam |
meaning: वाते पूतिगन्धे नीहारे चनृत्तगीतवादित्ररुदितसामशब्देषु तावन्तं कालम् ।
text: (The study of the Veda must be interrupted) while (a strong) wind (blows), a foul smell (is perceptible), or hoar-frost (lies on the ground), when dancing (is going on), and while the sounds of singing, musical instruments, weeping, or of the Sāman (melodies are audible).

sanskrit_iast: stanayitnuvarṣavidyutsaṃnipāte tryaham anadhyāyo 'nyatravarṣākālāt |
meaning: स्तनयित्नुवर्षविद्युत्संनिपाते त्र्यहम् अनध्यायो ऽन्यत्रवर्षाकालात् ।
text: When thunder, lightning, and rain come together, (the interruption shall last) three days except in the rainy season.

sanskrit_iast: varṣākāle 'pi varṣavarjam ahorātrayoś ca tatkālam |
meaning: वर्षाकाले ऽपि वर्षवर्जम् अहोरात्रयोश् च तत्कालम् ।
text: In the rainy season, too, (the reading must be interrupted) until the same hour of the (next) day or night, (if thunder and lightning come together), not on account of rain.

sanskrit_iast: pitryapratigrahabhojanayoś ca taddivasaśeṣam |
meaning: पित्र्यप्रतिग्रहभोजनयोश् च तद्दिवसशेषम् ।
text: If (he has) received anything or dined on the occasion of a sacrifice in honour of the manes, (he shall not read) during the remainder of the day,

sanskrit_iast: bhojaneṣv ā jaraṇam |
meaning: भोजनेष्व् आ जरणम् ।
text: (Nor) after meals until (the food) has been digested.

sanskrit_iast: pāṇimukho hi brāhmaṇaḥ |
meaning: पाणिमुखो हि ब्राह्मणः ।
text: For the hand of a Brāhmaṇa is his mouth.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | bhuktaṃ pratigṛhītaṃ ca nirviśeṣam iti śrutiḥ |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । भुक्तं प्रतिगृहीतं च निर्विशेषम् इति श्रुतिः ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): According to the revealed texts there is no difference whether one has eaten or received (a present at a Śrāddha).'

sanskrit_iast: pitary uparate trirātram |
meaning: पितर्य् उपरते त्रिरात्रम् ।
text: (A student shall discontinue the study of the Veda) during three days in case his father has died.

sanskrit_iast: dvayam u ha vai suśravaso 'nūcānasya retobrāhmaṇasyordhvaṃ nābher adhastād anyat | sa yad ūrdhvaṃ nābhestena haitat prajāyate yad brāhmaṇān upanayati yad adhyāpayati yad yājayati yat sādhu karoti | sarvāsyaiṣā prajā bhavati | atha yadavācīṇaṃ nābhes tena hāsyaurasī prajā bhavati | tasmāc chrotriyamanūcānam aprajo 'sīti na vadanti |
meaning: द्वयम् उ ह वै सुश्रवसो ऽनूचानस्य रेतोब्राह्मणस्योर्ध्वं नाभेर् अधस्ताद् अन्यत् । स यद् ऊर्ध्वं नाभेस्तेन हैतत् प्रजायते यद् ब्राह्मणान् उपनयति यद् अध्यापयति यद् याजयति यत् साधु करोति । सर्वास्यैषा प्रजा भवति । अथ यदवाचीणं नाभेस् तेन हास्यौरसी प्रजा भवति । तस्माच् छ्रोत्रियमनूचानम् अप्रजो ऽसीति न वदन्ति ।
text: 'Of two kinds, forsooth, is the virile energy of a famous Brāhmaṇa who is learned in the Vedas, (that which resides) above the navel and the other (that resides) below the' navel. Through that which (resides) above the navel, his offspring is produced when he initiates Brāhmaṇas, when he teaches them, when he causes them to offer sacrifices, when he makes them holy. All these are his children. But through that which resides below the navel the children of his body are produced. Therefore they never say to a Śrotriya who is versed in the Vedas, 'Thou art destitute of offspring.'

sanskrit_iast: tasmād dvināmā dvimukho vipro dviretā dvijanmā ceti |
meaning: तस्माद् द्विनामा द्विमुखो विप्रो द्विरेता द्विजन्मा चेति ।
text: 'Therefore a Brāhmaṇa has two names, two mouths, two kinds of virile energy, and two births.'

sanskrit_iast: śūdrāpapātraśravaṇasaṃdarśanayoś ca tāvantaṃ kālam |
meaning: शूद्रापपात्रश्रवणसंदर्शनयोश् च तावन्तं कालम् ।
text: (Let him discontinue the recitation of the Veda) as long as he is within hearing or sight of Śūdras and Apapātras.

sanskrit_iast: naktaṃ śivāvirāve nādhīyīta svapnāntam |
meaning: नक्तं शिवाविरावे नाधीयीत स्वप्नान्तम् ।
text: When at night the howl of a solitary jackal is heard, he shall not study until he has slept.

sanskrit_iast: ahorātrayoś ca saṃdhyayoḥ parvasu ca nādhīyīta |
meaning: अहोरात्रयोश् च संध्ययोः पर्वसु च नाधीयीत ।
text: Let him not study in the evening and morning twilights nor on the Parva-days.

sanskrit_iast: na māṃsam aśnīyān na striyam upeyāt |
meaning: न मांसम् अश्नीयान् न स्त्रियम् उपेयात् ।
text: He shall not eat meat nor approach his wife (on those days).

sanskrit_iast: parvasu hi rakṣaḥpiśācā vyabhicāravanto bhavantītivijñāyate |
meaning: पर्वसु हि रक्षःपिशाचा व्यभिचारवन्तो भवन्तीतिविज्ञायते ।
text: It is declared in the Veda, 'For on the Parva-days the Rākshasas and the Piśā k as roam about (in order to injure men).'

sanskrit_iast: anyeṣu cādbhutotpāteṣv ahorātram anadhyāyo 'nyatramānasāt |
meaning: अन्येषु चाद्भुतोत्पातेष्व् अहोरात्रम् अनध्यायो ऽन्यत्रमानसात् ।
text: And on (the appearance of) other omens and portents (he shall not repeat the Veda), except mentally, during a day and a night.

sanskrit_iast: mānase 'pi jananamaraṇayor anadhyāyaḥ |
meaning: मानसे ऽपि जननमरणयोर् अनध्यायः ।
text: The mental recitation of the Veda must also be interrupted on births and deaths (occurring in the family).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | hanty aṣṭamī hy upādhyāyaṃ hanti śiṣyaṃ caturdaśī | hanti pañcadaśī vidyāṃ tasmāt parvaṇi varjayet | tasmāt parvaṇi varjayed iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । हन्त्य् अष्टमी ह्य् उपाध्यायं हन्ति शिष्यं चतुर्दशी । हन्ति पञ्चदशी विद्यां तस्मात् पर्वणि वर्जयेत् । तस्मात् पर्वणि वर्जयेद् इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'The eighth day destroys the teacher, the fourteenth destroys the pupil, the fifteenth destroys learning; therefore let him avoid (studying the Veda) on the Parva-days.'

sanskrit_iast: athātaḥ prāyaścittāni |
meaning: अथातः प्रायश्चित्तानि ।
text: Now, therefore, the penances (will be described).

sanskrit_iast: bhrūṇahā dvādaśa samāḥ |
meaning: भ्रूणहा द्वादश समाः ।
text: The murderer of a learned Brāhmaṇa (shall practise the following vow) during twelve years:

sanskrit_iast: kapālī khaṭvāṅgī gardabhacarmavāsā araṇyaniketanaḥśmaśāne dhvajaṃ śavaśiraḥ kṛtvā kuṭīṃ kārayet | tām āvaset | saptāgārāṇi bhaikṣaṃ caran svakarmācakṣāṇas tena prāṇān dhārayet | alabdhvopavāsaḥ |
meaning: कपाली खट्वाङ्गी गर्दभचर्मवासा अरण्यनिकेतनःश्मशाने ध्वजं शवशिरः कृत्वा कुटीं कारयेत् । ताम् आवसेत् । सप्तागाराणि भैक्षं चरन् स्वकर्माचक्षाणस् तेन प्राणान् धारयेत् । अलब्ध्वोपवासः ।
text: Carrying a skull (instead of a dish) and the foot of a bedstead (instead of a staff), dressed in the hide of an ass, staying in the forest, making a dead man's skull his flag, he shall cause a hut to be built in a burial-ground and reside there; going to seven houses in order to beg food, while proclaiming his deed, he shall support life with what (he gets there), and shall fast if he obtains nothing;

sanskrit_iast: aśvamedhena gosavenāgniṣṭutā vā yajeta |
meaning: अश्वमेधेन गोसवेनाग्निष्टुता वा यजेत ।
text: Or he may offer a horse-sacrifice, a Gosava, or an Agnishṭut

sanskrit_iast: aśvamedhāvabhṛthe vātmānaṃ pāvayet |
meaning: अश्वमेधावभृथे वात्मानं पावयेत् ।
text: Or he may bathe (with the priests) on the completion of a horse-sacrifice (offered by somebody else).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | amatyā brāhmaṇaṃ hatvā duṣṭo bhavati dharmataḥ | ṛṣayo niṣkṛtiṃ tasya vadanty amatipūrvake | matipūrvaṃ ghnatas tasya niṣkṛtir nopalabhyate |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अमत्या ब्राह्मणं हत्वा दुष्टो भवति धर्मतः । ऋषयो निष्कृतिं तस्य वदन्त्य् अमतिपूर्वके । मतिपूर्वं घ्नतस् तस्य निष्कृतिर् नोपलभ्यते ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'He who unintentionally slays a Brāhmaṇa becomes sinful according to the sacred law. The sages declare that he may be purified (if he did it) unintentionally. But no expiation is found for a wilful murderer.'

sanskrit_iast: apagūrya caret kṛcchram atikṛcchraṃ nipātane | kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caiva lohitasya pravartane | tasmān naivāpagureta na ca kurvīta śoṇitam || iti |
meaning: अपगूर्य चरेत् कृच्छ्रम् अतिकृच्छ्रं निपातने । कृच्छ्रं चान्द्रायणं चैव लोहितस्य प्रवर्तने । तस्मान् नैवापगुरेत न च कुर्वीत शोणितम् ॥ इति ।
text: He who has raised his hand (against a Brāhmaṇa), shall perform a K ri k kh ra penance, an Atik ri k kh ra penance if he strikes, a K ri k kh ra and a K āndrāyaṇa if blood flows. Therefore let him neither raise his hand nor cause blood to flow.'

sanskrit_iast: nava samā rājanyasya |
meaning: नव समा राजन्यस्य ।
text: (For killing) a Kshatriya (he shall keep the normal vow of continence) during nine years,

sanskrit_iast: tisro vaiśyasya |
meaning: तिस्रो वैश्यस्य ।
text: (For killing) a Vaiśya during three (years),

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaraṃ śūdrasya |
meaning: संवत्सरं शूद्रस्य ।
text: (For killing) a Śūdra during one year,

sanskrit_iast: striyāś ca |
meaning: स्त्रियाश् च ।
text: Likewise for killing a woman.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇavad ātreyyāḥ |
meaning: ब्राह्मणवद् आत्रेय्याः ।
text: (The penance for killing) a woman who has bathed after temporary uncleanness (is) the same (as that) for (the murder of) a Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: gurutalpagas tapte lohaśayane śayīta |
meaning: गुरुतल्पगस् तप्ते लोहशयने शयीत ।
text: He who has defiled the bed of a Guru shall place himself on a heated iron bed,

sanskrit_iast: sūrmiṃ vā jvalantīṃ śliṣyet |
meaning: सूर्मिं वा ज्वलन्तीं श्लिष्येत् ।
text: Or embrace a red hot image (of a woman),

sanskrit_iast: liṅgaṃ vā savṛṣaṇaṃ parivāsyāñjalāv ādhāyadakṣiṇāpratīcyor diśor antareṇa gacched ā nipatanāt |
meaning: लिङ्गं वा सवृषणं परिवास्याञ्जलाव् आधायदक्षिणाप्रतीच्योर् दिशोर् अन्तरेण गच्छेद् आ निपतनात् ।
text: Or cutting off his organ together with the testicles and holding them in his joined hands, he shall walk towards the south-west until he falls down (dead).

sanskrit_iast: stenaḥ prakīrya keśān saidhrakam musalam ādāya skandhenarājānaṃ gacched anena māṃ jahīti | tenainaṃ hanyāt |
meaning: स्तेनः प्रकीर्य केशान् सैध्रकम् मुसलम् आदाय स्कन्धेनराजानं गच्छेद् अनेन मां जहीति । तेनैनं हन्यात् ।
text: A thief shall go to the king with flying hair, carrying on his shoulder a club of Sindhraka wood (and say), 'Strike me with that.' (Then the king) shall strike him.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | skandhenādāya musalaṃ steno rājānam anviyāt | anena śādhi māṃ rājan kṣatradharmam anusmaran | śāsane vā visarge vā steno mucyeta kilbiṣāt | aśāsanāt tu tad rājā stenād āpnoti kilbiṣam || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । स्कन्धेनादाय मुसलं स्तेनो राजानम् अन्वियात् । अनेन शाधि मां राजन् क्षत्रधर्मम् अनुस्मरन् । शासने वा विसर्गे वा स्तेनो मुच्येत किल्बिषात् । अशासनात् तु तद् राजा स्तेनाद् आप्नोति किल्बिषम् ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'A thief shall go to the king carrying a club on his shoulder (and say to him), 'Punish me with that, O king, remembering the duty of Kshatriyas.' 'Whether he be punished or be pardoned, the thief is freed from his guilt. But if the king does not punish him, that guilt of the thief falls on him.'

sanskrit_iast: surāṃ pītvoṣṇayā kāyaṃ dahet |
meaning: सुरां पीत्वोष्णया कायं दहेत् ।
text: If he has drunk (the spirituous liquor called) Surā, he shall scald himself to death with hot (liquor of the) same (kind).

sanskrit_iast: amatyā pāne kṛcchrābdapādaṃ caret punarupanayanaṃ ca |
meaning: अमत्या पाने कृच्छ्राब्दपादं चरेत् पुनरुपनयनं च ।
text: For unintentionally drinking (Surā), he shall perform K ri k kh ra penances during three months and be initiated again,

sanskrit_iast: vapanavrataniyamalopaś ca pūrvānuṣṭhitatvāt |
meaning: वपनव्रतनियमलोपश् च पूर्वानुष्ठितत्वात् ।
text: And (on this second initiation) the cutting (of the hair and nails), the vows, and (the observance of the) restrictive rules may be omitted.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | amatyā vāruṇīṃ pītvā prāśya mūtrapurīṣayoḥ | brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ punaḥsaṃskāram arhati |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अमत्या वारुणीं पीत्वा प्राश्य मूत्रपुरीषयोः । ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः पुनःसंस्कारम् अर्हति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'A Brāhmaṇa, Kshatriya, or Vaiśya who has unintentionally drunk (the spirituous liquor called) Vāruṇī or has swallowed urine or faeces must be initiated a second time.'

sanskrit_iast: surādhāne tu yo bhāṇḍe apaḥ paryuṣitāḥ pibet | śaṅkhapuṣpīvipakvena ṣaḍahaṃ kṣīreṇa vartayet |
meaning: सुराधाने तु यो भाण्डे अपः पर्युषिताः पिबेत् । शङ्खपुष्पीविपक्वेन षडहं क्षीरेण वर्तयेत् ।
text: 'But he who drinks water which has stood in a vessel, used for keeping Surā, shall live six days on milk in which (leaves of) the Śaṅkhapushpī plant have been boiled.'

sanskrit_iast: guruprayuktaś cen mriyeta gurus trīn kṛcchrāṃś caret |
meaning: गुरुप्रयुक्तश् चेन् म्रियेत गुरुस् त्रीन् कृच्छ्रांश् चरेत् ।
text: If (a pupil) who is employed by his teacher (on some errand) meets with his death, (the teacher) shall perform three K ri k kh ra penances.

sanskrit_iast: etad evāsaṃskṛte |
meaning: एतद् एवासंस्कृते ।
text: The same (penance) is prescribed for not finishing (the education of the pupil).

sanskrit_iast: brahmacāriṇaḥ śavakarmaṇā vratāvṛttir anyatramātāpitror ācāryāc ca |
meaning: ब्रह्मचारिणः शवकर्मणा व्रतावृत्तिर् अन्यत्रमातापित्रोर् आचार्याच् च ।
text: If a student assists at the burial of anybody except (at that of his) mother, of his father, or of his teacher, he must begin his vow afresh.

sanskrit_iast: sa ced vyādhīyīta kāmaṃ guror ucchiṣṭaṃ bhaiṣajyārthesarvaṃ prāśnīyāt |
meaning: स चेद् व्याधीयीत कामं गुरोर् उच्छिष्टं भैषज्यार्थेसर्वं प्राश्नीयात् ।
text: If a (student) is sick, he may, at his pleasure, eat all the fragments of his teacher's meal as medicine.

sanskrit_iast: yenecchet tena cikitset |
meaning: येनेच्छेत् तेन चिकित्सेत् ।
text: He may physic himself with any (medicine) which he may desire.

sanskrit_iast: sa yadā gadī syāt tad utthāyādityam upatiṣṭheta | haṃsaḥ śuciṣad iti | etayā |
meaning: स यदा गदी स्यात् तद् उत्थायादित्यम् उपतिष्ठेत । हंसः शुचिषद् इति । एतया ।
text: When he is unable to move, he may worship the sun, after he has risen, reciting this ( Ri k verse): A swan, dwelling in purity.'

sanskrit_iast: divā retaḥ siktvā trir apo hṛdayaṃgamāḥ pibed retasyābhiḥ |
meaning: दिवा रेतः सिक्त्वा त्रिर् अपो हृदयंगमाः पिबेद् रेतस्याभिः ।
text: When he has spent his manly strength in the day-time, let him thrice drink water that reaches his heart, reciting the verses which contain the word retas.

sanskrit_iast: yo brahmacārī striyam upeyāt so 'vakīrṇī |
meaning: यो ब्रह्मचारी स्त्रियम् उपेयात् सो ऽवकीर्णी ।
text: A student who approaches a woman (is called) an Avakīrṇin,

sanskrit_iast: sa gardabhaṃ paśum ālabheta |
meaning: स गर्दभं पशुम् आलभेत ।
text: Let him offer an ass (in the place of) a sacrificial animal.

sanskrit_iast: nairṛtaḥ paśuḥ puroḍāśaś ca rakṣodevato yamadevato vā |
meaning: नैरृतः पशुः पुरोडाशश् च रक्षोदेवतो यमदेवतो वा ।
text: The sacrificial meat-cake (puroḍāsa shall be offered) to Nir ri ti, or to the Rākshasas, or to Yama.

sanskrit_iast: śiśnāt prāśitram apsv avadānaiś carantīti vijñāyate |
meaning: शिश्नात् प्राशित्रम् अप्स्व् अवदानैश् चरन्तीति विज्ञायते ।
text: It is declared in the Veda, 'The piece to be eaten by the sacrificer (prāśitra, shall be taken) from the organ (of the animal); and the (other) portions shall be offered in water.'

sanskrit_iast: api vāmāvāsyāyāṃ niśy agnim upasamādhāyadārvihomikīṃ pariceṣṭāṃ kṛtvā dve ājyāhutī juhoti | kāmāvakīrṇo 'smy avakīrṇo 'smi kāma kāmāya svāhā | kāmābhidrugdho 'smy abhidrugdho 'smi kāma kāmāya svāheti |
meaning: अपि वामावास्यायां निश्य् अग्निम् उपसमाधायदार्विहोमिकीं परिचेष्टां कृत्वा द्वे आज्याहुती जुहोति । कामावकीर्णो ऽस्म्य् अवकीर्णो ऽस्मि काम कामाय स्वाहा । कामाभिद्रुग्धो ऽस्म्य् अभिद्रुग्धो ऽस्मि काम कामाय स्वाहेति ।
text: 'Or he may also heap (fuel) on the fire in the night of the new moon, perform the preparatory rites required for the Darvīhoma, and offer two oblations of clarified butter (reciting these two sacred texts): "O Lust, I have broken my vow; my vow have I broken, O Lust; to Lust Svāhā;" "O Lust, I have done evil; evil have I done, O Lust; to Lust Svāhā."'

sanskrit_iast: hutvā prayatāñjaliḥ kavātiryaṅṅ agnim abhimantrayeta | saṃ mā siñcantu marutaḥ sam indraḥ saṃ bṛhaspatiḥ | saṃmāyam agniḥ siñcatv āyuṣā ca balena cāyuṣmantaṃ karota meti |
meaning: हुत्वा प्रयताञ्जलिः कवातिर्यङ्ङ् अग्निम् अभिमन्त्रयेत । सं मा सिञ्चन्तु मरुतः सम् इन्द्रः सं बृहस्पतिः । संमायम् अग्निः सिञ्चत्व् आयुषा च बलेन चायुष्मन्तं करोत मेति ।
text: 'After he has made the offering, he shall address the fire, closely joining his hands, turning sideways (with the following texts): "May the Maruts grant me, may Indra, may B ri haspati, may this fire grant me long life and strength, may it make me long-lived! "'

sanskrit_iast: athāsya jñātayaḥ pariṣady udapātraṃ ninayeyur asāv aham itthaṃbhūta iti | caritvāpaḥ payo ghṛtaṃ madhulavaṇam ity ārabdhavantaṃ brāhmaṇā brūyuś caritaṃ tvayeti | omitītaraḥ pratyāha | caritanirveśaṃ savanīyaṃ kuryuḥ |
meaning: अथास्य ज्ञातयः परिषद्य् उदपात्रं निनयेयुर् असाव् अहम् इत्थंभूत इति । चरित्वापः पयो घृतं मधुलवणम् इत्य् आरब्धवन्तं ब्राह्मणा ब्रूयुश् चरितं त्वयेति । ओमितीतरः प्रत्याह । चरितनिर्वेशं सवनीयं कुर्युः ।
text: Now the relatives shall empty (the water-pot) of a (grievous offender) at a (solemn) meeting (and he shall confess), 'I N. N. am (the perpetrator of) such and such (a deed).' After (the outcast) has performed (his penance) the Brāhmaṇas shall ask him who has touched water, milk, clarified butter, honey, and salt, 'Hast thou performed (thy penance)?' The other (person) shall answer, 'Om' (yes)! They shall admit him who has performed (a penance) to all sacrificial rites, making no difference (between him and others).

sanskrit_iast: sagotrāṃ ced amatyopagacchen mātṛvad enāṃ bibhṛyāt |
meaning: सगोत्रां चेद् अमत्योपगच्छेन् मातृवद् एनां बिभृयात् ।
text: If he unintentionally marries a female who belongs to his own family (gotra), he shall support her, (treating her) like his mother.

sanskrit_iast: prajātā cet kṛcchrābdapādaṃ caritvā | yan maātmano mindābhūt | punar agniś cakṣur adād iti | etābhyāṃ juhuyāt |
meaning: प्रजाता चेत् कृच्छ्राब्दपादं चरित्वा । यन् मआत्मनो मिन्दाभूत् । पुनर् अग्निश् चक्षुर् अदाद् इति । एताभ्यां जुहुयात् ।
text: If (such a woman) has borne a child; he shall perform K ri k kh ra penances during three months and offer (two burnt oblations reciting) the two (Mantras), 'That which is the blemish of my soul' (and) 'Fire restored my sight.'

sanskrit_iast: parivittaḥ parivettā yā cainaṃ parivindati | sarve te narakaṃ yānti dātṛyājakapañcamāḥ |
meaning: परिवित्तः परिवेत्ता या चैनं परिविन्दति । सर्वे ते नरकं यान्ति दातृयाजकपञ्चमाः ।
text: 'An elder brother whose younger brother marries first, the younger brother who marries first, the damsel wedded (by the latter), he who gives her away, and fifthly, he who sacrifices for them (at the wedding), all sink to a region of torment.'

sanskrit_iast: parivittaḥ parivettā dātā yaś cāpi yājakaḥ | kṛcchradvādaśarātreṇa strī trirātreṇa śudhyati || iti |
meaning: परिवित्तः परिवेत्ता दाता यश् चापि याजकः । कृच्छ्रद्वादशरात्रेण स्त्री त्रिरात्रेण शुध्यति ॥ इति ।
text: The unmarried elder brother and the married younger brother, the giver (of the maiden) and the performer of the sacrifices become pure by undergoing a K ri k kh ra penance of twelve days, the female (who has been wedded to the younger brother) by (fasting during) three days.'

sanskrit_iast: atha patanīyāni |
meaning: अथ पतनीयानि ।
text: Now (follow the offences) causing loss of caste (patanīya),

sanskrit_iast: samudrasaṃyānam |
meaning: समुद्रसंयानम् ।
text: (Viz.) making voyages by sea,

sanskrit_iast: brahmasvanyāsāpaharaṇam |
meaning: ब्रह्मस्वन्यासापहरणम् ।
text: Stealing the property of a Brāhmaṇa or a deposit,

sanskrit_iast: bhūmyanṛtam |
meaning: भूम्यनृतम् ।
text: Giving false evidence regarding land,

sanskrit_iast: sarvapaṇyair vyavaharaṇam |
meaning: सर्वपण्यैर् व्यवहरणम् ।
text: Trading with merchandise of any description (whether forbidden or not),

sanskrit_iast: śūdrasevanam |
meaning: शूद्रसेवनम् ।
text: Serving Śūdras,

sanskrit_iast: śūdrābhijananam |
meaning: शूद्राभिजननम् ।
text: Begetting a son on a female of the Śūdra caste,

sanskrit_iast: tadapatyatvaṃ ca |
meaning: तदपत्यत्वं च ।
text: And becoming thereby her son.

sanskrit_iast: eteṣām anyatamaṃ kṛtvā |
meaning: एतेषाम् अन्यतमं कृत्वा ।
text: (For those who have) committed one of these (offences the following penance is prescribed);

sanskrit_iast: caturthakālā mitabhojinaḥ syur apo 'bhyaveyuḥ savanānukalpam | sthānāsanābhyāṃ viharanta ete tribhir varṣais tad apaghnanti pāpam |
meaning: चतुर्थकाला मितभोजिनः स्युर् अपो ऽभ्यवेयुः सवनानुकल्पम् । स्थानासनाभ्यां विहरन्त एते त्रिभिर् वर्षैस् तद् अपघ्नन्ति पापम् ।
text: 'They shall eat every fourth meal-time a little food, bathe at the time of the three libations (morning, noon, and evening), passing (the day) standing and (the night) sitting. After the lapse of three years they throw off their guilt.'

sanskrit_iast: yad ekarātreṇa karoti pāpaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ varṇaṃ brāhmaṇaḥsevamānaḥ | caturthakāla udakābhyavāyī tribhir varṣais tad apahantipāpam || iti |
meaning: यद् एकरात्रेण करोति पापं कृष्णं वर्णं ब्राह्मणःसेवमानः । चतुर्थकाल उदकाभ्यवायी त्रिभिर् वर्षैस् तद् अपहन्तिपापम् ॥ इति ।
text: 'A Brāhmaṇa removes the sin which he committed by serving the black race during one day and one night, if he bathes during three years at every fourth meal-time.'

sanskrit_iast: athopapātakāni |
meaning: अथोपपातकानि ।
text: Now (follow) the minor offences, entailing loss of caste (upapātaka),

sanskrit_iast: agamyāgamanaṃ gurvīsakhīṃ gurusakhīm apapātrāṃ patitāṃca gatvā bheṣajakaraṇaṃ grāmayājanaṃ raṅgopajīvanaṃnāṭyācāryatā gomahiṣīrakṣaṇaṃ yac cānyad apy evaṃyuktaṃkanyādūṣaṇam iti |
meaning: अगम्यागमनं गुर्वीसखीं गुरुसखीम् अपपात्रां पतितांच गत्वा भेषजकरणं ग्रामयाजनं रङ्गोपजीवनंनाट्याचार्यता गोमहिषीरक्षणं यच् चान्यद् अप्य् एवंयुक्तंकन्यादूषणम् इति ।
text: (Viz.) intercourse with females who must not be approached (agamyā, e.g.) cohabitation with the female friend of a female Guru, with the female friend of a male Guru, with an Apapātra woman, and a female outcast, following the profession of medicine, sacrificing for many, living by (performances on) the stage, following the profession of a teacher of dancing, singing and acting, tending cows and buffalos, and similar (low occupations, as well as) fornication.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tu nirveśaḥ patitavṛttir dvau saṃvatsarau |
meaning: तेषां तु निर्वेशः पतितवृत्तिर् द्वौ संवत्सरौ ।
text: The expiation (prescribed) for these (offences is) to live as an outcast during two years.

sanskrit_iast: athāśucikarāṇi |
meaning: अथाशुचिकराणि ।
text: Now (follow the offences) which make men impure (asu k ikara),

sanskrit_iast: dyūtam abhicāro 'nāhitāgner uñchavṛttitā samāvṛttasyabhaikṣacaryā tasya caiva gurukule vāsa ūrdhvaṃ caturbhyo māsebhyastasya cādhyāpanaṃ nakṣatranirdeśaś ceti |
meaning: द्यूतम् अभिचारो ऽनाहिताग्नेर् उञ्छवृत्तिता समावृत्तस्यभैक्षचर्या तस्य चैव गुरुकुले वास ऊर्ध्वं चतुर्भ्यो मासेभ्यस्तस्य चाध्यापनं नक्षत्रनिर्देशश् चेति ।
text: (Viz.) gambling, performing incantations, subsisting by gleaning corn though one does not perform an Agnihotra, subsisting by alms after one has finished one's studentship, living, after that has been finished, longer than four months in the house of one's teacher, and teaching such a (person who has finished his studentship), gaining one's livelihood by astrology and so forth.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tu nirveśo dvādaśa māsān dvādaśa ardhamāsāndvādaśa dvādaśāhān dvādaśa ṣaḍahān dvādaśa tryahān dvādaśāhaṃṣaḍahaṃ tryaham ahorātram ekāham iti yathā karmābhyāsaḥ |
meaning: तेषां तु निर्वेशो द्वादश मासान् द्वादश अर्धमासान्द्वादश द्वादशाहान् द्वादश षडहान् द्वादश त्र्यहान् द्वादशाहंषडहं त्र्यहम् अहोरात्रम् एकाहम् इति यथा कर्माभ्यासः ।
text: But the expiation of these (offences is to perform penances) during twelve months, during twelve fortnights, during twelve times ten days, during twelve se’nnights, during twelve times three days, during twelve days, during six days, during three days, during a day and a night, during one day, in proportion to the offence committed.

sanskrit_iast: atha patitāḥ samavasāya dharmāṃś careyur itaretarayājakāitaretarādhyāpakā mitho vivahamānāḥ | putrān saṃniṣpādya brūyur vipravrajatāsmat ta evam āryān saṃpratipatsyatheti |
meaning: अथ पतिताः समवसाय धर्मांश् चरेयुर् इतरेतरयाजकाइतरेतराध्यापका मिथो विवहमानाः । पुत्रान् संनिष्पाद्य ब्रूयुर् विप्रव्रजतास्मत् त एवम् आर्यान् संप्रतिपत्स्यथेति ।
text: Now outcasts shall live together and (together) fulfil their duties, sacrificing for each other, teaching each other, and marrying amongst each other. If they have begot sons, they shall say to them, 'Depart from among us; thus you will again reach the Āryas.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpi na sendriyaḥ patati |
meaning: अथापि न सेन्द्रियः पतति ।
text: For the organs do not become impure together with the man.

sanskrit_iast: tad etena veditavyam | aṅgahīno 'pi sāṅgaṃ janayet |
meaning: तद् एतेन वेदितव्यम् । अङ्गहीनो ऽपि साङ्गं जनयेत् ।
text: (The truth of) that may be learned from this (parallel case); a man deficient in limbs begets a son who has the full number of limbs.

sanskrit_iast: mithyaitad iti hārītaḥ |
meaning: मिथ्यैतद् इति हारीतः ।
text: Hārīta declares that this is wrong.

sanskrit_iast: dadhidhānīsadharmāḥ striyaḥ syuḥ | yo hi dadhidhānyāmaprayataṃ paya ātacya manthati na tac chiṣṭā dharmakṛtyeṣūpayojayanti |
meaning: दधिधानीसधर्माः स्त्रियः स्युः । यो हि दधिधान्यामप्रयतं पय आतच्य मन्थति न तच् छिष्टा धर्मकृत्येषूपयोजयन्ति ।
text: For wives may be (considered) similar to the vessel which contains the curds (for the sacrifice). If one makes impure milk curdle in a milk-vessel and stirs it, the Śishṭas do not use the (curds thus produced) for sacred rites.

sanskrit_iast: evam aśuci śukraṃ yan nirvartate na tena saha saṃprayogo vidyate |
meaning: एवम् अशुचि शुक्रं यन् निर्वर्तते न तेन सह संप्रयोगो विद्यते ।
text: In like manner no intercourse can be held with that (offspring) which is produced from impure seed.

sanskrit_iast: aśuciśukrotpannānāṃ teṣām icchatāṃ prāyaścittiḥ |
meaning: अशुचिशुक्रोत्पन्नानां तेषाम् इच्छतां प्रायश्चित्तिः ।
text: If they desire it, (they may perform) a penance,

sanskrit_iast: patanīyānāṃ tṛtīyo 'ṃśaḥ strīṇām aṃśas tṛtīyaḥ |
meaning: पतनीयानां तृतीयो ऽंशः स्त्रीणाम् अंशस् तृतीयः ।
text: (Viz. in the case of males) the third part (of the penance prescribed) for crimes causing loss of caste (patanīya); for females the third part (of that).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | bhojanābhyañjanād dānād yad anyat kurute tilaiḥ | śvaviṣṭhāyāṃ kṛmir bhūtvā pitṛbhiḥ saha majjati || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । भोजनाभ्यञ्जनाद् दानाद् यद् अन्यत् कुरुते तिलैः । श्वविष्ठायां कृमिर् भूत्वा पितृभिः सह मज्जति ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'If he applies sesamum to any other purpose, but food, anointing, and charitable gifts, he will be born again as a worm and, together with his ancestors, be plunged into the ordure of dogs.'

sanskrit_iast: pitqn vā eṣa vikrīṇīte yas tilān vikrīṇīte | prāṇānvā eṣa vikrīṇīte yas taṇḍulān vikrīṇīte | sukṛtāṃśān vā eṣa vikrīṇīte yaḥ paṇamāno duhitaraṃ dadāti |
meaning: पित्qन् वा एष विक्रीणीते यस् तिलान् विक्रीणीते । प्राणान्वा एष विक्रीणीते यस् तण्डुलान् विक्रीणीते । सुकृतांशान् वा एष विक्रीणीते यः पणमानो दुहितरं ददाति ।
text: He who sells sesamum, forsooth, sells his ancestors; he who sells rice, forsooth, sells his life; he who gives away his daughter, making a bargain, forsooth, sells portions of his spiritual merit.

sanskrit_iast: tṛṇakāṣṭham avikṛtaṃ vikreyam |
meaning: तृणकाष्ठम् अविकृतं विक्रेयम् ।
text: Grass and wood, in its natural state, may be sold.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | paśavaś caikatodantā aśmā ca lavaṇoddhṛtaḥ | etad brāhmaṇa te paṇyaṃ tantuś cārajanīkṛtaḥ || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । पशवश् चैकतोदन्ता अश्मा च लवणोद्धृतः । एतद् ब्राह्मण ते पण्यं तन्तुश् चारजनीकृतः ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'Animals that have teeth in one jaw only, as well as minerals excepting salt, and undyed thread, these, O Brāhmaṇa, are the goods which thou art permitted to sell.'

sanskrit_iast: pātakavarjaṃ vā babhruṃ piṅgalāṃ gāṃ romaśāṃsarpiṣāvasicya kṛṣṇais tilair avakīryānūcānāya dadyāt |
meaning: पातकवर्जं वा बभ्रुं पिङ्गलां गां रोमशांसर्पिषावसिच्य कृष्णैस् तिलैर् अवकीर्यानूचानाय दद्यात् ।
text: (If he has committed) any offence excepting a mortal sin (pātaka) he may either give to a learned Brāhmaṇa (anū k āna) a hairy cow of brown or red-dish colour, after sprinkling her with clarified butter and scattering black sesamum seeds over her;

sanskrit_iast: kūśmāṇḍair vā dvādaśāham |
meaning: कूश्माण्डैर् वा द्वादशाहम् ।
text: Or (he may offer burnt oblations), reciting the Kūshmāṇd as, during twelve days,

sanskrit_iast: yad arvācīnam eno bhrūṇahatyāyās tasmān mucyata iti |
meaning: यद् अर्वाचीनम् एनो भ्रूणहत्यायास् तस्मान् मुच्यत इति ।
text: '(Thus) he will be freed. from the guilt (of any crime that is) less (heinous) than the murder of a learned Brāhmaṇa.'

sanskrit_iast: pātakābhiśaṃsane kṛcchraḥ |
meaning: पातकाभिशंसने कृच्छ्रः ।
text: If one is accused of a mortal sin (pātaka), a K ri k kh ra (penance must be performed by the accused).

sanskrit_iast: tadabdo 'bhiśaṃsituḥ |
meaning: तदब्दो ऽभिशंसितुः ।
text: The accuser (shall perform) that (K ri k kh ra penance during) a year.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsareṇa patati patitena samācaran | yājanādhyāpanādyaunān na tu yānāsanāśanād iti |
meaning: संवत्सरेण पतति पतितेन समाचरन् । याजनाध्यापनाद्यौनान् न तु यानासनाशनाद् इति ।
text: 'He who during a year associates with an outcast, becomes (likewise) an outcast; not by sacrificing forḥim, by teaching him or by (forming) a matrimonial (alliance with him), but by using the same carriage or seat.'

sanskrit_iast: amedhyaprāśane prāyaścittir naiṣpurīṣyam | tat saptarātreṇāvāpyate |
meaning: अमेध्यप्राशने प्रायश्चित्तिर् नैष्पुरीष्यम् । तत् सप्तरात्रेणावाप्यते ।
text: The penance for eating impure substances is to fast until the entrails are empty. That is attained in seven (days and) nights.

sanskrit_iast: apaḥ payo ghṛtaṃ parāka iti pratitryaham uṣṇāni sataptakṛcchraḥ |
meaning: अपः पयो घृतं पराक इति प्रतित्र्यहम् उष्णानि सतप्तकृच्छ्रः ।
text: (Subsisting on) water, milk, clarified butter, (and) fasting,--each for three days,--(and taking the three fluids) hot, that is a Taptak ri k kh ra penance.

sanskrit_iast: tryahaṃ prātas tathā sāyam ayācitaṃ parāka iti kṛcchraḥ |
meaning: त्र्यहं प्रातस् तथा सायम् अयाचितं पराक इति कृच्छ्रः ।
text: (Eating) during three days in the morning only, during the (next) three days in the evening only, (subsisting) during (another) three days (on) food given unasked, and fasting during three days, (that is) a K ri k kh ra penance.

sanskrit_iast: prātaḥ sāyam ayācitaṃ parāka iti trayaś catūrātrāḥ sa eṣastrībālavṛddhānāṃ kṛcchraḥ |
meaning: प्रातः सायम् अयाचितं पराक इति त्रयश् चतूरात्राः स एषस्त्रीबालवृद्धानां कृच्छ्रः ।
text: (If the period of twelve days is divided into) three (periods of) four days, that is the K ri k kh ra penance of, women, children, and aged men.

sanskrit_iast: yāvat sakṛd ādadīta tāvad aśnīyāt pūrvavat so 'tikṛcchraḥ |
meaning: यावत् सकृद् आददीत तावद् अश्नीयात् पूर्ववत् सो ऽतिकृच्छ्रः ।
text: If (observing the rule given) above one eats (at each meal) so much only as one can take at one (mouthful), that is an Atik ri k kh ra penance.

sanskrit_iast: abbhakṣas tṛtīyaḥ sa kṛcchrātikṛcchraḥ |
meaning: अब्भक्षस् तृतीयः स कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रः ।
text: (If one) subsists on water only, that is a K ri k kh rātik ri k kh ra, the third (in the order of the K ri k kh ra penances).

sanskrit_iast: kṛcchre triṣavaṇam udakopasparśanam |
meaning: कृच्छ्रे त्रिषवणम् उदकोपस्पर्शनम् ।
text: During a K ri k kh ra penance (the following rules must be followed, viz.) to bathe at morn, noon, and evening,

sanskrit_iast: adhaḥśayanam |
meaning: अधःशयनम् ।
text: To sleep on the ground,

sanskrit_iast: ekavastratā keśaśmaśrulomanakhavāpanam |
meaning: एकवस्त्रता केशश्मश्रुलोमनखवापनम् ।
text: To wear one garment only, to shave the hair of the head, of the beard, and of the body, and to clip the nails.

sanskrit_iast: etad eva striyāḥ keśavapanavarjam | keśavapanavarjam |
meaning: एतद् एव स्त्रियाः केशवपनवर्जम् । केशवपनवर्जम् ।
text: The same (rules apply) to women except (that referring to) shaving the head.

sanskrit_iast: nityodakī nityayajñopavītī nityasvādhyāyīvṛṣalānnavarjī | ṛtau ca gacchan vidhivac ca juhvan na brāhmaṇaś cyavatebrahmalokāt |
meaning: नित्योदकी नित्ययज्ञोपवीती नित्यस्वाध्यायीवृषलान्नवर्जी । ऋतौ च गच्छन् विधिवच् च जुह्वन् न ब्राह्मणश् च्यवतेब्रह्मलोकात् ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa who always carries water (in his pot), who always wears the sacred thread, who daily recites the Veda, who avoids the food of Śūdras, who approaches (his wife) in the proper season, and offers sacrifices in accordance with the rules (of the Veda, after death) never falls from Brahman's heaven.

sanskrit_iast: manuḥ putrebhyo dāyaṃ vyabhajad iti śrutiḥ |
meaning: मनुः पुत्रेभ्यो दायं व्यभजद् इति श्रुतिः ।
text: The Veda (says), 'Manu divided his estate among his sons.'

sanskrit_iast: samaśaḥ sarveṣām aviśeṣāt |
meaning: समशः सर्वेषाम् अविशेषात् ।
text: (A father may, therefore, divide his property) equally among all, without (making any) difference;

sanskrit_iast: varaṃ vā rūpam uddharej jyeṣṭhaḥ |
meaning: वरं वा रूपम् उद्धरेज् ज्येष्ठः ।
text: Or the eldest may receive the most excellent chattel.

sanskrit_iast: tasmāj jyeṣṭhaṃ putraṃ dhanena niravasāyayantīti śrutiḥ |
meaning: तस्माज् ज्येष्ठं पुत्रं धनेन निरवसाययन्तीति श्रुतिः ।
text: (For) the Veda says, 'Therefore, they distinguish the eldest by (an additional share of the) property.

sanskrit_iast: daśānāṃ vaikam uddharej jyeṣṭhaḥ |
meaning: दशानां वैकम् उद्धरेज् ज्येष्ठः ।
text: Or the eldest may receive (in excess) one part out of ten;

sanskrit_iast: samam itare vibhajeran |
meaning: समम् इतरे विभजेरन् ।
text: (And) the other (sons) shall receive equal shares.

sanskrit_iast: pitur anumatyā dāyavibhāgaḥ sati pitari |
meaning: पितुर् अनुमत्या दायविभागः सति पितरि ।
text: While the father lives, the division of the estate takes place (only) with the permission of the father.

sanskrit_iast: caturṇāṃ varṇānāṃ go 'śvājāvayo jyeṣṭhāṃśaḥ |
meaning: चतुर्णां वर्णानां गो ऽश्वाजावयो ज्येष्ठांशः ।
text: The (additional) share of the eldest is, (according to the order) of the four castes, a cow, a horse, a goat, and a sheep.

sanskrit_iast: nānāvarṇastrīputrasamavāye dāyaṃ daśāṃśān kṛtvācaturas trīn dvāv ekam iti yathākramaṃ vibhajeran |
meaning: नानावर्णस्त्रीपुत्रसमवाये दायं दशांशान् कृत्वाचतुरस् त्रीन् द्वाव् एकम् इति यथाक्रमं विभजेरन् ।
text: If there are sons born of wives of different castes (varṇa), they should make ten portions of the ancestral property and take four (shares), three, two, (and) one, according to the order (of the castes).

sanskrit_iast: aurase tūtpanne savarṇās tṛtīyāṃśaharāḥ |
meaning: औरसे तूत्पन्ने सवर्णास् तृतीयांशहराः ।
text: But if a legitimate son of the body (aurasa) is born, the (other) sons of equal caste shall obtain one third share (of the estate).

sanskrit_iast: savarṇāputrānantarāputrayor anantarāputraś ced guṇavānsa jyeṣṭhāṃśaṃ haret |
meaning: सवर्णापुत्रानन्तरापुत्रयोर् अनन्तरापुत्रश् चेद् गुणवान्स ज्येष्ठांशं हरेत् ।
text: If there is a son of equal caste and a son of a wife of the next lower caste, the son born of the wife of the next lower caste may take the share of the eldest, provided he be endowed with good qualities.

sanskrit_iast: guṇavān hi śeṣāṇāṃ bhartā bhavati |
meaning: गुणवान् हि शेषाणां भर्ता भवति ।
text: (A son) who possesses good qualities becomes the protector of the rest.

sanskrit_iast: savarṇāyāṃ saṃskṛtāyāṃ svayamutpāditam aurasaṃ putraṃ vidyāt | athāpy udāharanti | aṅgād aṅgāt saṃbhavasi hṛdayād adhi jāyase | ātmā vai putranāmāsi sa jīva śaradaḥ śatam || iti |
meaning: सवर्णायां संस्कृतायां स्वयमुत्पादितम् औरसं पुत्रं विद्यात् । अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अङ्गाद् अङ्गात् संभवसि हृदयाद् अधि जायसे । आत्मा वै पुत्रनामासि स जीव शरदः शतम् ॥ इति ।
text: One must know a son begotten by (the husband) himself on a wedded wife of equal caste (to be) a legitimate son of the body (aurasa). Now they quote also (the following verse): 'From the several limbs (of my body) art thou produced, from my heart art thou born; thou art "self" called a son; mayest thou live a hundred autumns.'

sanskrit_iast: abhyupagamya duhitari jātaṃ putrikāputram anyaṃ dauhitram |
meaning: अभ्युपगम्य दुहितरि जातं पुत्रिकापुत्रम् अन्यं दौहित्रम् ।
text: The (male child) born of a daughter, after an agreement has been made, (one must know to be) the son of an appointed daughter (putrikāputra); any other (male offspring of a daughter they call) a daughter's son (dauhitra).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | ādiśet prathame piṇḍe mātaraṃ putrikāsutaḥ | dvitīye pitaraṃ tasyās tṛtīye ca pitāmaham || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । आदिशेत् प्रथमे पिण्डे मातरं पुत्रिकासुतः । द्वितीये पितरं तस्यास् तृतीये च पितामहम् ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'The son of an appointed daughter should offer the first funeral cake to his mother, the second to her father, and the third to his father's father.'

sanskrit_iast: mṛtasya prasūto yaḥ klībavyādhitayor vānyenānumate sve kṣetre sa kṣetrajaḥ |
meaning: मृतस्य प्रसूतो यः क्लीबव्याधितयोर् वान्येनानुमते स्वे क्षेत्रे स क्षेत्रजः ।
text: He who is begotten, by another man, on the wife of a deceased man, of a eunuch, or of one (incurably) diseased, after permission (has been given), is called the son begotten on a wife (kshetra g a).

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa dvipitā dvigotraś ca dvayor api svadhārikthabhāg bhavati |
meaning: स एष द्विपिता द्विगोत्रश् च द्वयोर् अपि स्वधारिक्थभाग् भवति ।
text: Such a (son begotten on a wife) has two fathers and belongs to two families; he has a right to perform the funeral oblations, and to inherit the property of (his) two (fathers).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | dvipituḥ piṇḍadānaṃ syāt piṇḍepiṇḍe ca nāmanī | trayaś ca piṇḍāḥ ṣaṇṇāṃ syur evaṃ kurvan na muhyati || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । द्विपितुः पिण्डदानं स्यात् पिण्डेपिण्डे च नामनी । त्रयश् च पिण्डाः षण्णां स्युर् एवं कुर्वन् न मुह्यति ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): The son of two fathers shall give the funeral cakes (to his two fathers, and pronounce) two names with each oblation, and three cakes shall serve for six persons; he who acts thus will not err.'

sanskrit_iast: mātāpitṛbhyāṃ datto 'nyatareṇa vā yo 'patyārthe parigṛhyate sa dattaḥ |
meaning: मातापितृभ्यां दत्तो ऽन्यतरेण वा यो ऽपत्यार्थे परिगृह्यते स दत्तः ।
text: He (is called) an adopted son (datta) who, being given by his father and his mother, or by either of the two, is received in the place of a child.

sanskrit_iast: sadṛśaṃ yaṃ sakāmaṃ svayaṃ kuryāt sa kṛtrimaḥ |
meaning: सदृशं यं सकामं स्वयं कुर्यात् स कृत्रिमः ।
text: He (is called) a son made (k ri trima) whom (a mail) himself makes (his son), with the (adoptee's) consent (only), and who belongs to the same caste (as the adopter).
