sanskrit_iast: gṛhe gūḍhotpanno 'nte jñāto gūḍhajaḥ |
meaning: गृहे गूढोत्पन्नो ऽन्ते ज्ञातो गूढजः ।
text: He is called a son born secretly (gū dh agga) who is secretly born in the house and whose (origin is) afterwards (only) recognised.

sanskrit_iast: mātāpitṛbhyām utsṛṣṭo 'nyatareṇa vā yo 'patyārthe parigṛhyate so 'paviddhaḥ |
meaning: मातापितृभ्याम् उत्सृष्टो ऽन्यतरेण वा यो ऽपत्यार्थे परिगृह्यते सो ऽपविद्धः ।
text: He is called a son cast off (apaviddha) who, being, cast off by his father and his mother, or by either (of them), is received in the place of a child.

sanskrit_iast: asaṃskṛtām anatisṛṣṭāṃ yām upagacchet tasyāṃ yo jātaḥ sa kānīnaḥ |
meaning: असंस्कृताम् अनतिसृष्टां याम् उपगच्छेत् तस्यां यो जातः स कानीनः ।
text: If anybody approaches an unmarried girl without the permission (of her father or guardian), the son born by such (a woman is called) the son of an unmarried damsel (kānīna).

sanskrit_iast: yā garbhiṇī saṃskriyate vijñātā vāvijñātā vā tasyāṃyo jātaḥ sa sahoḍhaḥ |
meaning: या गर्भिणी संस्क्रियते विज्ञाता वाविज्ञाता वा तस्यांयो जातः स सहोढः ।
text: If one marries either knowingly or unknowingly a pregnant bride, the child which is born of her is called (a son) taken with the bride (saho dh a).

sanskrit_iast: mātāpitror hastāt krīto 'nyatareṇa vā yo 'patyārthe parigṛhyate sa krītaḥ |
meaning: मातापित्रोर् हस्तात् क्रीतो ऽन्यतरेण वा यो ऽपत्यार्थे परिगृह्यते स क्रीतः ।
text: He (is called a son) bought (krīta) who, being purchased from his father and his mother, or from either of them, is received in the place of a child.

sanskrit_iast: klībaṃ tyaktvā patitaṃ vā yānyaṃ patiṃ vindet tasyāṃpunarbhvāṃ yo jātaḥ sa paunarbhavaḥ |
meaning: क्लीबं त्यक्त्वा पतितं वा यान्यं पतिं विन्देत् तस्यांपुनर्भ्वां यो जातः स पौनर्भवः ।
text: He (is called the son) of a twice-married woman (paunarbhava) who is born of a re-married female, (i.e.) of one who, having left an impotent man, has taken a second husband.

sanskrit_iast: mātāpitṛvihīno yaḥ svayam ātmānaṃ dadyāt sa svayaṃdattaḥ |
meaning: मातापितृविहीनो यः स्वयम् आत्मानं दद्यात् स स्वयंदत्तः ।
text: He (is called) a self-given (son, svayaṃdatta) who, abandoned by his father and his mother, gives himself (to a stranger).

sanskrit_iast: dvijātipravarāc chūdrāyāṃ jāto niṣādaḥ |
meaning: द्विजातिप्रवराच् छूद्रायां जातो निषादः ।
text: He who is begotten by (a man of) the first twice-born (caste) on a female of the Śūdra caste (is called) a Nishāda.

sanskrit_iast: kāmāt pāraśava iti putrāḥ |
meaning: कामात् पारशव इति पुत्राः ।
text: (He who was begotten by the same parents) through lust (is called) a Pāraśava. Thus (the various kinds of) sons (have been enumerated).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | aurasaṃ putrikāputraṃ kṣetrajaṃ dattakṛtrimau | gūḍhajaṃ cāpaviddhaṃ ca rikthabhājaḥ pracakṣate |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । औरसं पुत्रिकापुत्रं क्षेत्रजं दत्तकृत्रिमौ । गूढजं चापविद्धं च रिक्थभाजः प्रचक्षते ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'They declare the legitimate son, the son of an appointed daughter, the son begotten on a wife, the adopted son and the son made, the son born secretly and the son cast off, (to be entitled) to share the inheritance.'

sanskrit_iast: kānīnaṃ ca sahoḍhaṃ ca krītaṃ paunarbhavaṃ tathā | svayaṃdattaṃ niṣādaṃ ca gotrabhājaḥ pracakṣate |
meaning: कानीनं च सहोढं च क्रीतं पौनर्भवं तथा । स्वयंदत्तं निषादं च गोत्रभाजः प्रचक्षते ।
text: 'They declare the son of an unmarried damsel and the son received with the bride, the son bought, likewise the son of a twice-married female, the son self-given and the Nishāda, to be members of the family.'

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ prathama evety āhaupajaṅghaniḥ |
meaning: तेषां प्रथम एवेत्य् आहौपजङ्घनिः ।
text: Aupa g andhani (declares that) the first among them alone (is entitled to inherit, and a member of his father's family).

sanskrit_iast: idānīm aham īrṣyāmi strīṇāṃ janaka no purā | yato yamasya sadane janayituḥ putram abruvan | retodhāḥ putraṃ nayati paretya yamasādane | tasmāt svabhāryāṃ rakṣantu bibhyataḥ pararetasaḥ |
meaning: इदानीम् अहम् ईर्ष्यामि स्त्रीणां जनक नो पुरा । यतो यमस्य सदने जनयितुः पुत्रम् अब्रुवन् । रेतोधाः पुत्रं नयति परेत्य यमसादने । तस्मात् स्वभार्यां रक्षन्तु बिभ्यतः पररेतसः ।
text: 'Now, O G anaka, I jealously watch my wives, (though I did) not (do it) formerly; for they have declared in Yama's court that the son belongs to the begetter. The giver of the seed carries off the son, after death, in Yama's hall, Therefore they carefully protect their wives, fearing the seed of strangers.'

sanskrit_iast: apramattā rakṣata tantum etaṃ mā vaḥ kṣetreparabījāni vāpsuḥ | janayituḥ putro bhavati sāṃparāye moghaṃvettā kurute tantum etam || iti |
meaning: अप्रमत्ता रक्षत तन्तुम् एतं मा वः क्षेत्रेपरबीजानि वाप्सुः । जनयितुः पुत्रो भवति सांपराये मोघंवेत्ता कुरुते तन्तुम् एतम् ॥ इति ।
text: 'Carefully watch (the procreation of your) offspring, lest strange seed fall on your soil. After death the son belongs to the begetter; through carelessness a husband makes (the procreation of) a son useless.'

sanskrit_iast: teṣām aprāptavyavahārāṇām aṃśān sopacayān suniguptān nidadhyur ā vyavahāraprāpaṇāt |
meaning: तेषाम् अप्राप्तव्यवहाराणाम् अंशान् सोपचयान् सुनिगुप्तान् निदध्युर् आ व्यवहारप्रापणात् ।
text: Let them carefully protect the shares of those who are minors, as well as the increments (thereon).

sanskrit_iast: atītavyavahārān grāsācchādanair bibhṛyuḥ |
meaning: अतीतव्यवहारान् ग्रासाच्छादनैर् बिभृयुः ।
text: Granting food, clothes, (and shelter), they shall support those who are incapable of transacting legal business,

sanskrit_iast: andhajaḍaklībavyasanivyādhitādīṃś ca |
meaning: अन्धजडक्लीबव्यसनिव्याधितादींश् च ।
text: (Viz.) the blind, idiots, those immersed in vice, the incurably diseased, and so forth,

sanskrit_iast: akarmiṇaḥ |
meaning: अकर्मिणः ।
text: Those who neglect their duties and occupations;

sanskrit_iast: patitatajjātavarjam |
meaning: पतिततज्जातवर्जम् ।
text: But not the outcast nor his offspring.

sanskrit_iast: na patitaiḥ saṃvyavahāro vidyate |
meaning: न पतितैः संव्यवहारो विद्यते ।
text: Intercourse with outcasts shall not take place.

sanskrit_iast: patitām api tu mātaraṃ bibhṛyād anabhibhāṣamāṇaḥ |
meaning: पतिताम् अपि तु मातरं बिभृयाद् अनभिभाषमाणः ।
text: But he shall support an outcast mother, without speaking to her.

sanskrit_iast: mātur alaṃkāraṃ duhitaraḥ sāṃpradāyikaṃ labherann anyad vā |
meaning: मातुर् अलंकारं दुहितरः सांप्रदायिकं लभेरन्न् अन्यद् वा ।
text: The daughters shall obtain the ornaments of their mother, (as many as are) presented according to the custom (of the caste), or anything else (that may be given according to custom).

sanskrit_iast: na striyāḥ svātantryaṃ vidyate |
meaning: न स्त्रियाः स्वातन्त्र्यं विद्यते ।
text: Women do not possess independence.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | pitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane | putras tu sthavirībhāve na strīsvātantryam arhati || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । पिता रक्षति कौमारे भर्ता रक्षति यौवने । पुत्रस् तु स्थविरीभावे न स्त्रीस्वातन्त्र्यम् अर्हति ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): Their father protects (them) in childhood, their husband protects (them) in youth, and their sons protect (them) in old age a woman is never fit for independence.'

sanskrit_iast: nirindriyā hy adāyāś ca striyo matā iti śrutiḥ |
meaning: निरिन्द्रिया ह्य् अदायाश् च स्त्रियो मता इति श्रुतिः ।
text: The Veda declares, 'Therefore women are considered to be destitute of strength and of a portion.'

sanskrit_iast: bhartṛhite yatamānāḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ jayeran |
meaning: भर्तृहिते यतमानाः स्वर्गं लोकं जयेरन् ।
text: Those (women) who strive (to do what is) agreeable to their husbands will gain heaven.

sanskrit_iast: vyatikrame kṛcchraḥ |
meaning: व्यतिक्रमे कृच्छ्रः ।
text: But for a violation (of their duty towards the husband) a K ri k kh ra penance (must be performed).

sanskrit_iast: śūdre cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret |
meaning: शूद्रे चान्द्रायणं चरेत् ।
text: (For violating it) with a Śūdra (a woman) shall perform a lunar penance ( k āndrāyaṇa);

sanskrit_iast: vaiśyādiṣu pratilomaṃ kṛcchrātikṛcchrādīṃś caret |
meaning: वैश्यादिषु प्रतिलोमं कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रादींश् चरेत् ।
text: (For violating it) against the order of the castes with a Vaiśya and so forth, she shall perform a K ri k kh ra or an (Atik ri k kh ra) penance.

sanskrit_iast: puṃsāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ saṃvatsaraṃ brahmacaryam |
meaning: पुंसां ब्राह्मणादीनां संवत्सरं ब्रह्मचर्यम् ।
text: For male (offenders, i.e.) Brāhmaṇas and so forth, a year's chastity (is prescribed).

sanskrit_iast: śūdraṃ kaṭāgninā dahet |
meaning: शूद्रं कटाग्निना दहेत् ।
text: Let him burn a Śūdra (who commits adultery with an Āryan) in a straw-fire.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses):

sanskrit_iast: abrāhmaṇasya śārīro daṇḍaḥ saṃgrahaṇe bhavet |
meaning: अब्राह्मणस्य शारीरो दण्डः संग्रहणे भवेत् ।
text: 'Anybody but a Brāhmaṇa shall suffer corporal punishment for adultery.'

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣām eva varṇānāṃ dārā rakṣyatamā dhanāt |
meaning: सर्वेषाम् एव वर्णानां दारा रक्ष्यतमा धनात् ।
text: 'The wives (of men) of all castes must be guarded more carefully than wealth.'

sanskrit_iast: na tu cāraṇadāreṣu na raṅgāvatare vadhaḥ | saṃsarjayanti tā hy etān niguptāṃś cālayanty api |
meaning: न तु चारणदारेषु न रङ्गावतरे वधः । संसर्जयन्ति ता ह्य् एतान् निगुप्तांश् चालयन्त्य् अपि ।
text: 'But corporal punishment (shall) not (be inflicted) for (adultery with) the wives of minstrels and with those who appear on the stage. For (the husbands) carry them (to other men), or, lying concealed (at home), permit them to hold culpable intercourse.'

sanskrit_iast: striyaḥ pavitram atulaṃ naitā duṣyanti karhicit | māsimāsi rajo hy āsāṃ duritāny apakarṣati |
meaning: स्त्रियः पवित्रम् अतुलं नैता दुष्यन्ति कर्हिचित् । मासिमासि रजो ह्य् आसां दुरितान्य् अपकर्षति ।
text: 'Women (possess) an unrivalled means of purification; they never become (entirely) foul. For month by month their temporary uncleanness removes their sins.'

sanskrit_iast: somaḥ śaucaṃ dadau tāsāṃ gandharvaḥ śikṣitāṃ giram | agniś ca sarvabhakṣatvaṃ tasmānniṣkalmaṣāḥ striyaḥ |
meaning: सोमः शौचं ददौ तासां गन्धर्वः शिक्षितां गिरम् । अग्निश् च सर्वभक्षत्वं तस्मान्निष्कल्मषाः स्त्रियः ।
text: 'Soma gave them cleanliness, the Gandharva their melodious voice, and Fire purity of all (limbs); therefore women are free from stains.'

sanskrit_iast: aprajāṃ daśame varṣe strīprajāṃ dvādaśe tyajet | mṛtaprajāṃ pañcadaśe sadyas tv apriyavādinīm |
meaning: अप्रजां दशमे वर्षे स्त्रीप्रजां द्वादशे त्यजेत् । मृतप्रजां पञ्चदशे सद्यस् त्व् अप्रियवादिनीम् ।
text: 'Let him abandon a barren (wife) in the tenth year, one who bears daughters (only) in the twelfth, one whose children (all) die in the fifteenth, but her who is quarrelsome without delay.'

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaraṃ pretapatnī madhumāṃsamadyalavaṇāni varjayedadhaḥ śayīta |
meaning: संवत्सरं प्रेतपत्नी मधुमांसमद्यलवणानि वर्जयेदधः शयीत ।
text: A widow shall avoid during a year (the use of) honey, meat, spirituous liquor, and salt, and sleep on the ground.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṇmāsān iti maudgalyaḥ |
meaning: षण्मासान् इति मौद्गल्यः ।
text: Maudgalya (declares that she shall do so) during six months.

sanskrit_iast: ata ūrdhvaṃ gurubhir anumatā devarāj janayet putram aputrā |
meaning: अत ऊर्ध्वं गुरुभिर् अनुमता देवराज् जनयेत् पुत्रम् अपुत्रा ।
text: After (the expiration of) that (time) she may, with the permission of her Gurus, bear a son to her brother-in-law, in case she has no son.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | vaśā cotpannaputrā ca nīrajaskā gataprajā | nākāmā saṃniyojyā syāt phalaṃ yasyāṃ na vidyate || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । वशा चोत्पन्नपुत्रा च नीरजस्का गतप्रजा । नाकामा संनियोज्या स्यात् फलं यस्यां न विद्यते ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): One whose appointment can have no result, (viz.) a barren woman, one who has borne sons, one who is past child-bearing, one whose children are (all) dead, and one who is unwilling must not be appointed.'

sanskrit_iast: mātulapitṛsvasā bhaginī bhāgineyī snuṣā mātulānīsakhivadhūr ity agamyāḥ |
meaning: मातुलपितृस्वसा भगिनी भागिनेयी स्नुषा मातुलानीसखिवधूर् इत्य् अगम्याः ।
text: The sister of a maternal uncle and of the father, a sister, a sister's daughter, a daughter-in-law, a maternal uncle's wife, and the wife of a friend are females who must never be approached (agamyā).

sanskrit_iast: agamyānāṃ gamane kṛcchrātikṛcchrau cāndrāyaṇam itiprāyaścittiḥ |
meaning: अगम्यानां गमने कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रौ चान्द्रायणम् इतिप्रायश्चित्तिः ।
text: For intercourse with females who must not be approached (agamyā), a K ri k kh ra and an Atik ri k kh ra (and) a K āndrāyaṇa are the penances prescribed for all.

sanskrit_iast: etena caṇḍālīvyavāyo vyākhyātaḥ |
meaning: एतेन चण्डालीव्यवायो व्याख्यातः ।
text: Thereby (the rule regarding) intercourse with a female of the K aṇd āla caste has been declared.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | caṇḍālīṃ brāhmaṇo gatvā bhuktvā ca pratigṛhya ca | ajñānāt patito vipro jñānāt tu samatāṃ vrajet |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । चण्डालीं ब्राह्मणो गत्वा भुक्त्वा च प्रतिगृह्य च । अज्ञानात् पतितो विप्रो ज्ञानात् तु समतां व्रजेत् ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): A Brāhmaṇa who unintentionally approaches a female of the K aṇd āla caste, eats (food given by a K aṇd āla) or receives (presents from him), becomes an outcast; but (if he does it) intentionally, he becomes equal (to a K aṇd āla).

sanskrit_iast: pitur guror narendrasya bhāryāṃ gatvā pramādataḥ | gurutalpī bhavet tena pūrvoktas tasya niṣkrayaḥ || iti |
meaning: पितुर् गुरोर् नरेन्द्रस्य भार्यां गत्वा प्रमादतः । गुरुतल्पी भवेत् तेन पूर्वोक्तस् तस्य निष्क्रयः ॥ इति ।
text: 'He who approaches his father's, his teacher's, or a king's wife, is guilty of the crime of violating a Guru's bed; the penance ordained for him has been declared above.'

sanskrit_iast: adhyāpanayājanapratigrahair aśaktaḥ kṣatradharmeṇa jīvetpratyanantaratvāt |
meaning: अध्यापनयाजनप्रतिग्रहैर् अशक्तः क्षत्रधर्मेण जीवेत्प्रत्यनन्तरत्वात् ।
text: (A Brāhmaṇa) who is unable (to subsist) by teaching, sacrificing for others, or the acceptance of gifts, shall maintain himself by following the duties of Kshatriyas, because that is the next following (caste).

sanskrit_iast: neti gautamaḥ | atyugro hi kṣatradharmo brāhmaṇasya |
meaning: नेति गौतमः । अत्युग्रो हि क्षत्रधर्मो ब्राह्मणस्य ।
text: Gautama (declares that one shall) not (act thus). For the duties of Kshatriyas are too cruel for a Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe vā varṇānāṃ vāpi saṃkare | gṛhṇīyātāṃ vipraviśau śastraṃ dharmavyapekṣayā |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । गवार्थे ब्राह्मणार्थे वा वर्णानां वापि संकरे । गृह्णीयातां विप्रविशौ शस्त्रं धर्मव्यपेक्षया ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'Out of regard for the sacred law a Brāhmaṇa and a Vaiśya may take up arms for (the protection of) cows or Brāhmaṇas, or when a confusion of the castes (threatens to take place).

sanskrit_iast: vaiśyavṛttir anuṣṭheyā pratyanantaratvāt |
meaning: वैश्यवृत्तिर् अनुष्ठेया प्रत्यनन्तरत्वात् ।
text: (Or) the livelihood of a Vaiśya should be adopted, because that is the one following (next):

sanskrit_iast: prāk prātarāśāt karṣī syāt |
meaning: प्राक् प्रातराशात् कर्षी स्यात् ।
text: (If he lives by agriculture) he shall plough before breakfast,

sanskrit_iast: asyūtanāsikābhyāṃ samuṣkābhyām atudann ārayāmuhurmuhur abhyucchandayan |
meaning: अस्यूतनासिकाभ्यां समुष्काभ्याम् अतुदन्न् आरयामुहुर्मुहुर् अभ्युच्छन्दयन् ।
text: With two bulls whose noses have not been pierced, not striking them with the goad, (but) frequently coaxing them.

sanskrit_iast: bhāryādir agniḥ | tasmin karmakaraṇaṃ prāg agnyādheyāt |
meaning: भार्यादिर् अग्निः । तस्मिन् कर्मकरणं प्राग् अग्न्याधेयात् ।
text: The (sacred domestic) fire (shall be kindled) at the wedding; the religious ceremonies up to the Agnyādheya (shall be) performed in that.

sanskrit_iast: agnyādheyaprabhṛty athemāny ajasrāṇi bhavanti yathaitadagnyādheyam agnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsāv āgrayaṇamudagayanadakṣiṇāyanayoḥ paśuś cāturmāsyāny ṛtumukhe ṣaḍḍhotā vasantejyotiṣtoma ity evaṃ kṣemaprāpaṇam |
meaning: अग्न्याधेयप्रभृत्य् अथेमान्य् अजस्राणि भवन्ति यथैतदग्न्याधेयम् अग्निहोत्रं दर्शपूर्णमासाव् आग्रयणमुदगयनदक्षिणायनयोः पशुश् चातुर्मास्यान्य् ऋतुमुखे षड्ढोता वसन्तेज्योतिष्तोम इत्य् एवं क्षेमप्रापणम् ।
text: Now, beginning with the Agnyādheya, follow these (rites in an) uninterrupted (series), as, for instance, the Agnyādheya, the Agnihotra, the new and full moon sacrifices, the Āgraya.a at the winter and summer solstices, the animal sacrifice, the K āturmāsyas at the beginning of each season, the Shaḍdh ot ri in spring, the Agnishṭoma. Thus the attainment of bliss (is secured).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | na divāsvapnaśīlena na ca sarvānnabhojinā | kāmaṃ śakyaṃ nabho gantum ārūḍhapatitena vā |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । न दिवास्वप्नशीलेन न च सर्वान्नभोजिना । कामं शक्यं नभो गन्तुम् आरूढपतितेन वा ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'Neither he who is accustomed to sleep in the day-time, nor he who eats the food of anybody, nor he who falls from a height to which he has climbed, can reach heaven as he desires.'

sanskrit_iast: dainyaṃ śāṭhyaṃ jaihmyaṃ ca varjayet |
meaning: दैन्यं शाठ्यं जैह्म्यं च वर्जयेत् ।
text: Let him avoid meanness, hard-heartedness, and crookedness.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy atrośanasaś ca vṛṣaparvaṇaś ca duhitroḥ saṃvādegāthām udāharanti | stuvato duhitā tvaṃ vai yācataḥ pratigṛhṇataḥ | athāhaṃ stūyamānasya dadato 'pratigṛhṇataḥ | dadato 'pratigṛhṇata iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् अत्रोशनसश् च वृषपर्वणश् च दुहित्रोः संवादेगाथाम् उदाहरन्ति । स्तुवतो दुहिता त्वं वै याचतः प्रतिगृह्णतः । अथाहं स्तूयमानस्य ददतो ऽप्रतिगृह्णतः । ददतो ऽप्रतिगृह्णत इति ।
text: Now they quote also with reference to this (subject the following) verse in the dialogue between the daughters of Uśanas and V ri shaparvan: 'Thou, forsooth, art the daughter of one who praises (others), who begs and accepts (gifts); but I am the child of one who is praised, who gives gifts and does not accept them.'

sanskrit_iast: tapasyam apovagāhanam |
meaning: तपस्यम् अपोवगाहनम् ।
text: Bathing is suitable for (the practice of) austerity.

sanskrit_iast: devatās tarpayitvā pitṛtarpaṇam |
meaning: देवतास् तर्पयित्वा पितृतर्पणम् ।
text: The libation to the manes (is offered) after the gods have been satisfied (with water),

sanskrit_iast: anutīrtham apa utsiñcati | ūrjaṃ vahantīr iti |
meaning: अनुतीर्थम् अप उत्सिञ्चति । ऊर्जं वहन्तीर् इति ।
text: They pour out water which gives strength, from one Tīrtha after the other.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | sravantīṣv aniruddhāsu trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ | prātarutthāya kurvīrandevarṣipitṛtarpaṇam |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । स्रवन्तीष्व् अनिरुद्धासु त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयः । प्रातरुत्थाय कुर्वीरन्देवर्षिपितृतर्पणम् ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'With flowing, unconfined water twice-born men of the three castes shall satisfy the gods, Ri shis, and manes, when they have risen in the morning.'

sanskrit_iast: niruddhāsu na kurvīrann aṃśabhāk tatra setukṛt |
meaning: निरुद्धासु न कुर्वीरन्न् अंशभाक् तत्र सेतुकृत् ।
text: 'They shall not offer (libations of water) con-fined (in tanks and wells), (If they do it), he who made the embankment; will obtain a share (of the merit of their devotion).'

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt parakṛtān setūn kūpāṃś ca parivarjayed iti |
meaning: तस्मात् परकृतान् सेतून् कूपांश् च परिवर्जयेद् इति ।
text: 'Therefore let him avoid embankments (around tanks) and wells made by others.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | uddhṛtya vāpi trīn piṇḍān kuryād āpatsu no sadā | niruddhāsu tu mṛtpiṇḍān kūpāt trīn abghaṭāṃs tathā || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । उद्धृत्य वापि त्रीन् पिण्डान् कुर्याद् आपत्सु नो सदा । निरुद्धासु तु मृत्पिण्डान् कूपात् त्रीन् अब्घटांस् तथा ॥ इति ।
text: Nov they quote also (the following verse): 'Or, in times of distress--not as a rule--he may bathe in (water) confined (in tanks), after taking out three lumps (of earth); from a well (let him take three) lumps of clay and three jars of water.'

sanskrit_iast: bahupratigrāhyasyāpratigrāhyasya vā pratigṛhyāyājyaṃ vā yājayitvānāśyānnasya vānnam aśitvā taratsamandīyaṃ japed iti |
meaning: बहुप्रतिग्राह्यस्याप्रतिग्राह्यस्य वा प्रतिगृह्यायाज्यं वा याजयित्वानाश्यान्नस्य वान्नम् अशित्वा तरत्समन्दीयं जपेद् इति ।
text: If he has accepted presents from one who is able to give presents to many, or from one whose presents ought not to be accepted, or if he has sacrificed for one for whom he ought not to have sacrificed, or if he has eaten food (given by a person) whose food must not be eaten, he shall mutter the Taratsamandīya.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | gurusaṃkariṇaś caiva śiṣyasaṃkariṇaś ca ye | āhāramantrasaṃkīrṇā dīrghaṃ tama upāsate || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । गुरुसंकरिणश् चैव शिष्यसंकरिणश् च ये । आहारमन्त्रसंकीर्णा दीर्घं तम उपासते ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): Those who improperly associate with (an outcast) teacher, those who improperly associate with (outcast) pupils, and those who improperly associate (with outcasts) by (accepting their) food or by (reciting) Mantras (for them), enter into deep darkness.'

sanskrit_iast: atha snātakavratāni |
meaning: अथ स्नातकव्रतानि ।
text: Now (follow) the duties of a Snātaka.

sanskrit_iast: sāyaṃ prātar yad aśanīyaṃ syāt tenānnena vaiśvadevaṃbalim upahṛtya brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviṭśūdrān abhyāgatān yathāśakti pūjayet |
meaning: सायं प्रातर् यद् अशनीयं स्यात् तेनान्नेन वैश्वदेवंबलिम् उपहृत्य ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविट्शूद्रान् अभ्यागतान् यथाशक्ति पूजयेत् ।
text: After offering at the morning and at the evening (meals) with (a portion of) the food which he may have, the Vaiśvadeva and the Bali-offerings, he shall honour, according to his ability, Brāhmaṇas, Kshatriyas, Vaiśyas, and Śūdras (who may come to his house as) guests.

sanskrit_iast: yadi bahūnāṃ na śaknuyād ekasmai guṇavate dadyāt |
meaning: यदि बहूनां न शक्नुयाद् एकस्मै गुणवते दद्यात् ।
text: If he cannot (afford to give food) to many, let him give (something) to one who possesses good qualities,

sanskrit_iast: yo vā prathamam upagataḥ syāt |
meaning: यो वा प्रथमम् उपगतः स्यात् ।

sanskrit_iast: śūdraś ced āgatas taṃ karmaṇi niyuñjyāt |
meaning: शूद्रश् चेद् आगतस् तं कर्मणि नियुञ्ज्यात् ।

sanskrit_iast: śrotriyāya vāgraṃ dadyāt |
meaning: श्रोत्रियाय वाग्रं दद्यात् ।
text: Or (if he cannot spare much), he may give a first portion (agrya) to a Śrotriya.

sanskrit_iast: ye nityā bhāktikāḥ syus teṣāmanuparodhena saṃvibhāgo vihitaḥ |
meaning: ये नित्या भाक्तिकाः स्युस् तेषामनुपरोधेन संविभागो विहितः ।
text: It is prescribed that the division (of the food) shall be made without detriment to (the interests of) those who daily receive a portion.

sanskrit_iast: na tv eva kadācid adattvā bhuñjīta |
meaning: न त्व् एव कदाचिद् अदत्त्वा भुञ्जीत ।
text: But he shall never eat without having given away (some small portion of the food).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy atrānnagītau ślokāv udāharanti | yo mām adattvā pitṛdevatābhyobhṛtyātithīnāṃ ca suhṛjjanasya | saṃpannam aśnan viṣam atti mohāt tam admy ahaṃ tasya camṛtyur asmi | hutāgnihotraḥ kṛtavaiśvadevaḥ pūjyātithīn bhṛtyajanāvaśiṣṭam | tuṣṭaḥ śuciḥ śraddadhad atti yo māṃ tasyāmṛtaṃ syāṃsa ca māṃ bhunakti |
meaning: अथाप्य् अत्रान्नगीतौ श्लोकाव् उदाहरन्ति । यो माम् अदत्त्वा पितृदेवताभ्योभृत्यातिथीनां च सुहृज्जनस्य । संपन्नम् अश्नन् विषम् अत्ति मोहात् तम् अद्म्य् अहं तस्य चमृत्युर् अस्मि । हुताग्निहोत्रः कृतवैश्वदेवः पूज्यातिथीन् भृत्यजनावशिष्टम् । तुष्टः शुचिः श्रद्दधद् अत्ति यो मां तस्यामृतं स्यांस च मां भुनक्ति ।
text: Now they quote also two verses which have been proclaimed by (the goddess of) food: 'Him who, without giving me to the gods, the manes, his servants, his guests and friends, consumes what has been prepared and (thus), in his exceeding folly, swallows poison, I consume, and I am his death. But for him who, offering the Agnihotra, performing the Vaiśvadeva, and honouring guests, eats, full of contentment, purity, and faith, what remains after feeding those whom he must support, I become ambrosia, and he (really) enjoys me.'

sanskrit_iast: subrāhmaṇaśrotriyavedapāragebhyogurvarthaniveśauṣadhārthavṛttikṣīṇayakṣyamāṇādhyayanādhvasaṃyogavaiśvajiteṣu dravyasaṃvibhāgo yathāśakti kāryo bahirvedibhikṣamāṇeṣu |
meaning: सुब्राह्मणश्रोत्रियवेदपारगेभ्योगुर्वर्थनिवेशौषधार्थवृत्तिक्षीणयक्ष्यमाणाध्ययनाध्वसंयोगवैश्वजितेषु द्रव्यसंविभागो यथाशक्ति कार्यो बहिर्वेदिभिक्षमाणेषु ।
text: Presents of money must be given, according to one's ability, to good Brāhmaṇas, Śrotriyas, and Vedapāragas, when they beg outside the Vedi, for the sake of Gurus, in order to defray (the expenses of) their marriages, or of medicine, or when they are distressed for a livelihood, or desirous to offer a sacrifice, or engaged in studying, or on a journey, or have performed a Viśva g it sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: kṛtānnam itareṣu |
meaning: कृतान्नम् इतरेषु ।
text: Cooked food (must be given) to other (beggars).

sanskrit_iast: suprakṣālitapādapāṇir ācāntaḥ śucau saṃvṛte deśe 'nnamupahṛtam upasaṃgṛhya kāmakrodhadrohalobhamohān apahatya sarvābhiraṅgulībhiḥ śabdam akurvan prāśnīyāt |
meaning: सुप्रक्षालितपादपाणिर् आचान्तः शुचौ संवृते देशे ऽन्नमुपहृतम् उपसंगृह्य कामक्रोधद्रोहलोभमोहान् अपहत्य सर्वाभिरङ्गुलीभिः शब्दम् अकुर्वन् प्राश्नीयात् ।
text: Let him eat (seated) in a pure, enclosed place, after having well washed his hands and feet and after having sipped water, respectfully receiving the food which is brought to him, keeping himself free from lust, anger, hatred, greed, and perplexity, (conveying the food into his mouth) with all his fingers and making no noise (during mastication).

sanskrit_iast: na piṇḍaśeṣaṃ pātryām utsṛjet |
meaning: न पिण्डशेषं पात्र्याम् उत्सृजेत् ।
text: Let him not put back into the dish a remnant of food.

sanskrit_iast: māṃsamatsyatilasaṃsṛṣṭaprāśane 'pa upaspṛśyāgnim abhimṛśet |
meaning: मांसमत्स्यतिलसंसृष्टप्राशने ऽप उपस्पृश्याग्निम् अभिमृशेत् ।
text: If he eats (food), containing meat, fish, or sesamum, he shall (afterwards) wash and touch fire,

sanskrit_iast: astamite ca snānam |
meaning: अस्तमिते च स्नानम् ।
text: And bathe after sunset.

sanskrit_iast: pālāśam āsanaṃ pāduke dantadhāvanam iti varjayet |
meaning: पालाशम् आसनं पादुके दन्तधावनम् इति वर्जयेत् ।
text: Let him avoid a seat, clogs, sticks for cleaning the teeth, and other (implements) made of Palāśa wood.

sanskrit_iast: notsaṅge 'nnaṃ bhakṣayet |
meaning: नोत्सङ्गे ऽन्नं भक्षयेत् ।
text: Let him not eat (food placed) in his lap,

sanskrit_iast: āsandyāṃ na bhuñjīta |
meaning: आसन्द्यां न भुञ्जीत ।
text: Nor on a chair,

sanskrit_iast: vaiṇavaṃ daṇḍaṃ dhārayed rukmakuṇḍale ca |
meaning: वैणवं दण्डं धारयेद् रुक्मकुण्डले च ।
text: He shall carry a staff, made of bamboo, and golden earrings.

sanskrit_iast: padā pādasya prakṣālanam adhiṣṭhānaṃ ca varjayet |
meaning: पदा पादस्य प्रक्षालनम् अधिष्ठानं च वर्जयेत् ।
text: Let him not rub one foot with the other while bathing, nor place the one on the other while standing,

sanskrit_iast: na bahirmālāṃ dhārayet |
meaning: न बहिर्मालां धारयेत् ।
text: Let him not wear a visible garland.

sanskrit_iast: sūryam udayāstamaye na nirīkṣeta |
meaning: सूर्यम् उदयास्तमये न निरीक्षेत ।
text: Let him not look at the sun when he rises or sets.

sanskrit_iast: nendradhanur iti parasmai prabrūyāt |
meaning: नेन्द्रधनुर् इति परस्मै प्रब्रूयात् ।
text: Let him not announce (the appearance of a rainbow) to another (man, saying), 'There is Indra's bow.'

sanskrit_iast: yadi brūyān maṇidhanur ity eva brūyāt |
meaning: यदि ब्रूयान् मणिधनुर् इत्य् एव ब्रूयात् ।
text: If he points it out, he shall call it 'the jewelled bow.'

sanskrit_iast: puradvārīndrakīlaparighāv antareṇa nātīyāt |
meaning: पुरद्वारीन्द्रकीलपरिघाव् अन्तरेण नातीयात् ।
text: Let him not pass between the prakīlaka and the beam, at the town gate,

sanskrit_iast: pleṅkhayor antareṇa na gacchet |
meaning: प्लेङ्खयोर् अन्तरेण न गच्छेत् ।
text: Nor let him pass between the two posts of a swing.

sanskrit_iast: vatsatantīṃ ca nopari gacchet |
meaning: वत्सतन्तीं च नोपरि गच्छेत् ।
text: Let him not step over a rope to which a calf is tied.

sanskrit_iast: bhasmāsthiromatuṣakapālāpasnānāni nādhitiṣṭhet |
meaning: भस्मास्थिरोमतुषकपालापस्नानानि नाधितिष्ठेत् ।
text: Let him not step on ashes, bones, hair, chaff, potsherds, nor on a bathing-place (moist with) water.

sanskrit_iast: gāṃ dhayantīṃ na parasmai prabrūyāt |
meaning: गां धयन्तीं न परस्मै प्रब्रूयात् ।
text: Let him not announce it to another (man if) a cow suckles (her calf).

sanskrit_iast: nādhenum adhenur iti brūyāt |
meaning: नाधेनुम् अधेनुर् इति ब्रूयात् ।
text: Let him not say of (a cow which is) not a milch-cow, 'She is not a milch-cow.'

sanskrit_iast: yadi brūyād dhenuṃ bhavyety eva brūyāt |
meaning: यदि ब्रूयाद् धेनुं भव्येत्य् एव ब्रूयात् ।
text: If he speaks (of such a one), let him say, 'It is one which will become a milch-cow.'

sanskrit_iast: śuktā rūkṣāḥ paruṣā vāco na brūyāt |
meaning: शुक्ता रूक्षाः परुषा वाचो न ब्रूयात् ।
text: Let him not make empty, ill-sounding, or harsh speeches.

sanskrit_iast: naiko 'dhvānaṃ vrajet |
meaning: नैको ऽध्वानं व्रजेत् ।
text: Let him not go alone on a. journey,

sanskrit_iast: na patitair na striyā na śūdreṇa |
meaning: न पतितैर् न स्त्रिया न शूद्रेण ।
text: Nor with outcasts, nor with a woman, nor with a Śūdra.

sanskrit_iast: na pratisāyaṃ vrajet |
meaning: न प्रतिसायं व्रजेत् ।
text: Let him not set out (on a journey) towards evening.

sanskrit_iast: na nagnaḥ snāyāt |
meaning: न नग्नः स्नायात् ।
text: Let him not bathe (entirely) naked.

sanskrit_iast: na naktaṃ snāyāt |
meaning: न नक्तं स्नायात् ।
text: Let him not bathe at night.

sanskrit_iast: na nadīṃ bāhukas taret |
meaning: न नदीं बाहुकस् तरेत् ।
text: Let him not cross a river swimming.

sanskrit_iast: na kūpam avekṣeta |
meaning: न कूपम् अवेक्षेत ।
text: Let him not look down into a well.

sanskrit_iast: na gartam avekṣeta |
meaning: न गर्तम् अवेक्षेत ।
text: Let him not look down into a pit.

sanskrit_iast: na tatropaviśed yata enam anya utthāpayet |
meaning: न तत्रोपविशेद् यत एनम् अन्य उत्थापयेत् ।
text: Let him not sit down there, where another person may order him to rise.

sanskrit_iast: panthā deyo brāhmaṇāya gave rājñe hy acakṣuṣe | vṛddhāya bhārataptāya garbhiṇyai durbalāya ca |
meaning: पन्था देयो ब्राह्मणाय गवे राज्ञे ह्य् अचक्षुषे । वृद्धाय भारतप्ताय गर्भिण्यै दुर्बलाय च ।
text: Way must be made for a Brāhmaṇa, a cow, a king, a blind man, an aged man, one who is suffering under a burden, a pregnant woman, and a weak man.

sanskrit_iast: prabhūtaidhodakayavasasamitkuśamālyopaniṣkramaṇamāḍhyajanākulam analasasamṛddham āryajanabhūyiṣṭhamadasyupraveśyaṃ grāmam āvasituṃ yateta dhārmikaḥ |
meaning: प्रभूतैधोदकयवससमित्कुशमाल्योपनिष्क्रमणमाढ्यजनाकुलम् अनलससमृद्धम् आर्यजनभूयिष्ठमदस्युप्रवेश्यं ग्रामम् आवसितुं यतेत धार्मिकः ।
text: A righteous man shall seek to dwell in a village where fuel, water, fodder, sacred fuel, Kuśa grass, and garlands are plentiful, access to which is easy, where many rich people dwell, which abounds in industrious people, where Āryans form the majority, and which is not easily entered by robbers.

sanskrit_iast: udapānodake grāme brāhmaṇo vṛṣalīpatiḥ | uṣitvā dvādaśa samāḥ śūdrasādharmyam ṛcchati |
meaning: उदपानोदके ग्रामे ब्राह्मणो वृषलीपतिः । उषित्वा द्वादश समाः शूद्रसाधर्म्यम् ऋच्छति ।
text: 'A Brāhmaṇa who, having wedded a wife of the Śūdra caste and dwells during twelve years in a village where water (is obtainable) from wells only, becomes equal to a Śūdra.'

sanskrit_iast: purareṇukuṇṭhitaśarīras tatparipurṇanetravadanaś ca | nagare vasan suniyatātmā siddhim avāpsyatīti na tad asti |
meaning: पुररेणुकुण्ठितशरीरस् तत्परिपुर्णनेत्रवदनश् च । नगरे वसन् सुनियतात्मा सिद्धिम् अवाप्स्यतीति न तद् अस्ति ।
text: (If you say that) he who lives in a town and whose body is covered with the dust, (raised) by others, and whose eyes and mouth are filled with it, will obtain salvation, if he restrains himself, (I declare that) that is impossible.

sanskrit_iast: rathāśvagajadhānyānāṃ gavāṃ caiva rajaḥ śubham | apraśastaṃ samūhanyāḥ śvājāvikharavāsasām |
meaning: रथाश्वगजधान्यानां गवां चैव रजः शुभम् । अप्रशस्तं समूहन्याः श्वाजाविखरवाससाम् ।
text: 'The dust raised by carriages, horses, elephants, and cows, and (that which comes) from grain is pure, blamed is (that raised) by a broom, goats, sheep, donkeys, and garments.'

sanskrit_iast: pūjyān pūjayet |
meaning: पूज्यान् पूजयेत् ।
text: Let him honour those who are worthy of honour.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣividvannṛpavaramātulaśvaśurartvijaḥ | ete 'rghyāḥ śāstravihitāḥ smṛtāḥ kālavibhāgaśaḥ |
meaning: ऋषिविद्वन्नृपवरमातुलश्वशुरर्त्विजः । एते ऽर्घ्याः शास्त्रविहिताः स्मृताः कालविभागशः ।
text: 'A Ri shi, a learned man, a king, a bride-groom, a maternal uncle, a father-in-law, and an officiating priest are mentioned in the Sm ri ti as worthy of the honey-mixture at certain times and occasions.'

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣividvannṛpāḥ prāptāḥ kriyārambhe varartvijau | mātulaśvaśurau pūjyau saṃvatsaragatāgatau || iti |
meaning: ऋषिविद्वन्नृपाः प्राप्ताः क्रियारम्भे वरर्त्विजौ । मातुलश्वशुरौ पूज्यौ संवत्सरगतागतौ ॥ इति ।
text: 'A Ri shi, a learned man, and a king must be honoured whenever they come, a bridegroom and a priest at the beginning of the religious rites, a maternal uncle and a father-in-law when a year has elapsed since their last visit.'

sanskrit_iast: agnyagāre gavāṃ madhye brāhmaṇānāṃ ca saṃnidhau | svādhyāye bhojane caiva dakṣiṇaṃ bāhum uddharet |
meaning: अग्न्यगारे गवां मध्ये ब्राह्मणानां च संनिधौ । स्वाध्याये भोजने चैव दक्षिणं बाहुम् उद्धरेत् ।
text: 'Let him raise his right arm on (entering) the place where the sacred fire is kept, in the midst of a herd of cows, in the presence of Brāhmaṇas, at the daily recitation of the Veda, and at dinner.'

sanskrit_iast: uttaraṃ vāsaḥ kartavyaṃ pañcasv eteṣu karmasu | svādhyāyotsargadāneṣu bhojanācāmayos tathā |
meaning: उत्तरं वासः कर्तव्यं पञ्चस्व् एतेषु कर्मसु । स्वाध्यायोत्सर्गदानेषु भोजनाचामयोस् तथा ।
text: 'An upper garment must be worn on the following five occasions: during the daily study, during the evacuation (of excrements), when one bestows gifts, at dinner, and while one sips water.'

sanskrit_iast: havanaṃ bhojanaṃ dānam upahāraḥ pratigrahaḥ | bahirjānu na kāryāṇi tadvad ācamanaṃ smṛtam |
meaning: हवनं भोजनं दानम् उपहारः प्रतिग्रहः । बहिर्जानु न कार्याणि तद्वद् आचमनं स्मृतम् ।
text: 'While one offers oblations in the fire, while one dines, bestows gifts, offers (food to deities or Gurus), and accepts presents, (the right hand) must be placed between the knees.'

sanskrit_iast: anne śritāni bhūtāni annaṃ prāṇam iti śrutiḥ | tasmād annaṃ pradātavyam annaṃ hi paramaṃ haviḥ |
meaning: अन्ने श्रितानि भूतानि अन्नं प्राणम् इति श्रुतिः । तस्माद् अन्नं प्रदातव्यम् अन्नं हि परमं हविः ।
text: 'The revealed texts declare, that the creatures depend on food, food is life; therefore gifts of food must be made. Food is the most excellent of sacrificial viands.'

sanskrit_iast: hutena śāmyate pāpaṃ hutam annena śāmyati | annaṃ dakṣiṇayā śāntim upayātīti na śrutiḥ | upayātīti naḥ śrutir iti |
meaning: हुतेन शाम्यते पापं हुतम् अन्नेन शाम्यति । अन्नं दक्षिणया शान्तिम् उपयातीति न श्रुतिः । उपयातीति नः श्रुतिर् इति ।
text: 'Sin is removed by burnt offerings, burnt oblations are surpassed by (gifts of) food, and gifts of food by kind speeches. That (is declared) to us in the revealed texts.'

sanskrit_iast: athātaḥ saṃdhyopāsanavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ |
meaning: अथातः संध्योपासनविधिं व्याख्यास्यामः ।
text: Now, therefore, we will declare the rule for (performing) the twilight devotions.

sanskrit_iast: tīrthaṃ gatvāprayato 'bhiṣiktaḥ prayato vānabhiṣiktaḥprakṣālitapādapāṇir apa ācamya surabhimatyābliṅgābhirvāruṇībhir hiraṇyavarṇābhiḥ pāvamānībhir vyāhṛtibhir anyaiś capavitrair ātmānaṃ prokṣya prayato bhavati |
meaning: तीर्थं गत्वाप्रयतो ऽभिषिक्तः प्रयतो वानभिषिक्तःप्रक्षालितपादपाणिर् अप आचम्य सुरभिमत्याब्लिङ्गाभिर्वारुणीभिर् हिरण्यवर्णाभिः पावमानीभिर् व्याहृतिभिर् अन्यैश् चपवित्रैर् आत्मानं प्रोक्ष्य प्रयतो भवति ।
text: Going to a (sacred) bathing-place, he shall bathe, in case he is impure; in case he is pure, he may, optionally, omit the bath. (But in either case) he shall wash his feet and hands. Sipping water and sprinkling himself, while he recites the (Rik-verses) containing the word Surabhi, the Abliṅgas, those addressed to Varuṇa, the Hiraṇyavarṇas, the Pāvamānīs, the (sacred syllables called) Vyāh ri tis, and other purificatory (texts), he becomes pure (and fit to perform the twilight devotions).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | apovagāhanaṃ apo 'vagāhanaṃ snānaṃ vihitaṃ sārvavarṇikam | mantravatprokṣaṇaṃ cāpi dvijātīnāṃ viśiṣyate || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अपोवगाहनं अपो ऽवगाहनं स्नानं विहितं सार्ववर्णिकम् । मन्त्रवत्प्रोक्षणं चापि द्विजातीनां विशिष्यते ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'Submersion in water (and) bathing are prescribed for all the (four) castes. But sprinkling (water over the body), while Mantras (are being recited), is the particular (duty) of the twice-born.'

sanskrit_iast: sarvakarmaṇāṃ caivārambheṣu prāk saṃdhyopāsanakālāccaitenaiva pavitrasamūhenātmānaṃ prokṣya prayato bhavati |
meaning: सर्वकर्मणां चैवारम्भेषु प्राक् संध्योपासनकालाच्चैतेनैव पवित्रसमूहेनात्मानं प्रोक्ष्य प्रयतो भवति ।
text: He who sprinkles himself (with water) at the beginning of any sacred rite,--before the time of the twilight devotions,--while reciting that same collection of purificatory (texts), becomes pure.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | darbheṣv āsīno darbhān dhārayamāṇaḥsodakena pāṇinā pratyaṅmukhaḥ sāvitrīṃ sahasrakṛtva āvartayet |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । दर्भेष्व् आसीनो दर्भान् धारयमाणःसोदकेन पाणिना प्रत्यङ्मुखः सावित्रीं सहस्रकृत्व आवर्तयेत् ।
text: Now they quote also (the following rules): Seated, with his face to the west, on Darbha grass and holding Darbha blades in his (right) hand, which is filled with water, he shall repeat the Sāvitrī one thousand times;

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāyāmaśo vā śatakṛtvaḥ |
meaning: प्राणायामशो वा शतकृत्वः ।
text: Or (he may recite the verse) one hundred times, suppressing his breath;

sanskrit_iast: ubhayataḥpraṇavāṃ sasaptavyāhṛtikāṃ manasā vā daśakṛtvaḥ |
meaning: उभयतःप्रणवां ससप्तव्याहृतिकां मनसा वा दशकृत्वः ।
text: Or mentally ten times, adding the syllable Om at the beginning and at the end and the seven Vyāh ri tis.

sanskrit_iast: tribhiś ca prāṇāyāmais tānto brahmahṛdayena |
meaning: त्रिभिश् च प्राणायामैस् तान्तो ब्रह्महृदयेन ।
text: And if he is tired by three suppressions of his breath (performed) with (the recitation of) the (Anuvāka called) Brahmah ri daya (the heart of Brahman, then let him repeat the Sāvitrī).

sanskrit_iast: vāruṇībhyāṃ rātrim upatiṣṭhate | imaṃ me varuṇa | tat tvā yāmīti | dvābhyām |
meaning: वारुणीभ्यां रात्रिम् उपतिष्ठते । इमं मे वरुण । तत् त्वा यामीति । द्वाभ्याम् ।
text: In the evening he worships (the sun) with the two (verses) addressed to Varuṇa, 'Hear this my call, O Varuṇa,' and 'Therefore I go to thee.'

sanskrit_iast: evam eva prātaḥ prāṅmukhas tiṣṭhan |
meaning: एवम् एव प्रातः प्राङ्मुखस् तिष्ठन् ।
text: The same (rules apply to the twilight devotion) in the morning, (but the worshipper) shall face the east and stand upright.

sanskrit_iast: maitrībhyām ahar upatiṣṭhate | mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛtaḥ | mitrojanān yātayatīti | dvābhyām |
meaning: मैत्रीभ्याम् अहर् उपतिष्ठते । मित्रस्य चर्षणीधृतः । मित्रोजनान् यातयतीति । द्वाभ्याम् ।
text: In the day-time he worships (the sun) with the two (verses) addressed to Mitra, 'The glory of Mitra, who supports men,' and 'Mitra causes men to join.'

sanskrit_iast: supūrvām api pūrvām upakramyodita āditye samāpnuyāt |
meaning: सुपूर्वाम् अपि पूर्वाम् उपक्रम्योदित आदित्ये समाप्नुयात् ।
text: Let him begin (the twilight devotion) in the morning very early, and finish it when the sun has risen.

sanskrit_iast: anastamita upakramya supaścād api paścimām |
meaning: अनस्तमित उपक्रम्य सुपश्चाद् अपि पश्चिमाम् ।
text: Let him begin (the twilight devotion) in the evening, when (the sun) has set, (and finish it) very soon after (the appearance of the stars);

sanskrit_iast: saṃdhyayoś ca saṃpattāv ahorātrayoś ca saṃtatyai |
meaning: संध्ययोश् च संपत्ताव् अहोरात्रयोश् च संतत्यै ।
text: And the complete observance of the twilight devotions (produces as its reward) an uninterrupted succession of days and nights.

sanskrit_iast: api cātra prajāpatigītau ślokau bhavataḥ | anāgatāṃ tu ye pūrvām anatītāṃ tu paścimām | saṃdhyāṃ nopāsate viprāḥ kathaṃ te brāhmaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ | sāyaṃ prātaḥ sadā saṃdhyāṃ ye viprā no upāsate | kāmaṃ tān dhārmiko rājā śūdrakarmasu yojayed || iti |
meaning: अपि चात्र प्रजापतिगीतौ श्लोकौ भवतः । अनागतां तु ये पूर्वाम् अनतीतां तु पश्चिमाम् । संध्यां नोपासते विप्राः कथं ते ब्राह्मणाः स्मृताः । सायं प्रातः सदा संध्यां ये विप्रा नो उपासते । कामं तान् धार्मिको राजा शूद्रकर्मसु योजयेद् ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote with reference to this (subject) also the following two verses, which have been proclaimed by the Lord of created beings (Pra g āpati) 'How can those twice-born men be called Brāhmaṇas who do not perform their twilight devotions, in the morning and in the evening at the proper time? At his pleasure a righteous king may appoint those Brāhmaṇas who neglect to daily perform the twilight devotions, both at morn and at eve, to do the work of Śūdras.'

sanskrit_iast: tatra sāyamatikrame rātryupavāsaḥprātaratikrame 'harupavāsaḥ |
meaning: तत्र सायमतिक्रमे रात्र्युपवासःप्रातरतिक्रमे ऽहरुपवासः ।
text: If the time for the (twilight devotion) is allowed to pass in the evening, (the offender shall) fast during the night; and if it is neglected in the morning, he shall fast during the (next) day.

sanskrit_iast: sthānāsanaphalam avāpnoti |
meaning: स्थानासनफलम् अवाप्नोति ।
text: He obtains (thereby) the (same) reward as if he had remained standing and sitting (in the twilight).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | yad upasthakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ padbhyāṃ vā yat kṛtaṃ bhavet | bāhubhyāṃ manasā vāpi vācā vā yat kṛtaṃ bhavet | sāyaṃ saṃdhyām upasthāya tena tasmāt pramucyate |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । यद् उपस्थकृतं पापं पद्भ्यां वा यत् कृतं भवेत् । बाहुभ्यां मनसा वापि वाचा वा यत् कृतं भवेत् । सायं संध्याम् उपस्थाय तेन तस्मात् प्रमुच्यते ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'Whatever sin (a man) may have committed with his organ, with his feet, with his arms, by thoughts or by speech, from (all) that he is freed by performing the twilight devotion in the evening.'

sanskrit_iast: rātryā cāpi saṃdhīyate na cainaṃ varuṇo gṛhṇāti |
meaning: रात्र्या चापि संधीयते न चैनं वरुणो गृह्णाति ।
text: (The worshipper) becomes also connected (thereby) with the (next) night, and Varuṇa will not seize him.

sanskrit_iast: evam eva prātar upasthāya rātrikṛtāt pāpāt pramucyate |
meaning: एवम् एव प्रातर् उपस्थाय रात्रिकृतात् पापात् प्रमुच्यते ।
text: In like manner he becomes free from the sin committed during the night by worshipping in the morning.

sanskrit_iast: ahnā cāpi saṃdhīyate mitraś cainaṃ gopāyaty ādityaścainaṃ svargaṃ lokam unnayati |
meaning: अह्ना चापि संधीयते मित्रश् चैनं गोपायत्य् आदित्यश्चैनं स्वर्गं लोकम् उन्नयति ।
text: He is also connected with the (next) day, Mitra protects him and Āditya leads him up to heaven.

sanskrit_iast: sa evam evāharahar ahorātrayoḥ saṃdhiṣūpatiṣṭhamānobrahmapūto brahmabhūto brāhmaṇaḥ śāstram anuvartamāno brahmalokam abhijayatīti vijñāyate | brahmalokam abhijayatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: स एवम् एवाहरहर् अहोरात्रयोः संधिषूपतिष्ठमानोब्रह्मपूतो ब्रह्मभूतो ब्राह्मणः शास्त्रम् अनुवर्तमानो ब्रह्मलोकम् अभिजयतीति विज्ञायते । ब्रह्मलोकम् अभिजयतीति विज्ञायते ।
text: It is declared in the Veda, 'A Brāhmaṇa who in this same manner daily worships in the twilight, both at morn and at eve and, being sanctified by the Brahman, becoming one with the Brahman, and resplendent through the Brahman, follows the rules of the Śāstra, gains the heaven of Brahman.'

sanskrit_iast: atha hastau prakṣālya kamaṇḍaluṃ mṛtpiṇḍaṃ ca saṃgṛhya tīrthaṃ gatvā triḥ pādau prakṣālayate trir ātmānaṃ |
meaning: अथ हस्तौ प्रक्षाल्य कमण्डलुं मृत्पिण्डं च संगृह्य तीर्थं गत्वा त्रिः पादौ प्रक्षालयते त्रिर् आत्मानं ।
text: Now, after washing his hands, he shall take his waterpot and a clod of earth, go to a (sacred) bathing-place and thrice clean his feet (with earth and water) and thrice his body.

sanskrit_iast: atha haike bruvate | śmaśānam āpo devagṛhaṃ goṣṭhaṃ yatra cabrāhmaṇā aprakṣālya pādau tan na praveṣṭavyam iti |
meaning: अथ हैके ब्रुवते । श्मशानम् आपो देवगृहं गोष्ठं यत्र चब्राह्मणा अप्रक्षाल्य पादौ तन् न प्रवेष्टव्यम् इति ।
text: Now some say, 'One must not enter a burial-ground, water, a temple, a cowpen, nor a place where Brāhmaṇas (sit) without having cleaned one's feet.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpo 'bhiprapadyate | hiraṇyaśṛṅgaṃ varuṇaṃ prapadye tīrthaṃ me dehi yācitaḥ | yan mayā bhuktam asādhūnāṃ pāpebhyaś ca pratigrahaḥ | yan me manasā vācā karmaṇā vā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam | tan na indro varuṇo bṛhaspatiḥ savitā ca punantupunaḥpunaḥ || iti |
meaning: अथापो ऽभिप्रपद्यते । हिरण्यशृङ्गं वरुणं प्रपद्ये तीर्थं मे देहि याचितः । यन् मया भुक्तम् असाधूनां पापेभ्यश् च प्रतिग्रहः । यन् मे मनसा वाचा कर्मणा वा दुष्कृतं कृतम् । तन् न इन्द्रो वरुणो बृहस्पतिः सविता च पुनन्तुपुनःपुनः ॥ इति ।
text: Then he enters the water, (reciting the following verse): 'I take refuge with gold-horned Varuṇa, give me at my request (O Varuṇa) a purifying bathing-place. May Indra, Varuṇa, B ri haspati, and Savit ri again and again cleanse me from all sin which I have committed by eating the food of unholy men, by receiving gifts from the wicked, and from all evil which I have done by thoughts, speeches, or deeds.'

sanskrit_iast: athāñjalināpa upahanti | sumitrā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ santv iti |
meaning: अथाञ्जलिनाप उपहन्ति । सुमित्रा न आप ओषधयः सन्त्व् इति ।
text: Then he takes up water in his joined hands, (saying), 'May the waters and the herbs be propitious to us.'

sanskrit_iast: tāṃ diśaṃ nirukṣati yasyām asya diśi dveṣyo bhavati | durmitrās tasmai bhūyāsur yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣma iti |
meaning: तां दिशं निरुक्षति यस्याम् अस्य दिशि द्वेष्यो भवति । दुर्मित्रास् तस्मै भूयासुर् यो ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्म इति ।
text: (Next) he pours (the water) out in that direction in which an enemy of his dwells, (saying), 'May they work woe to him who hates us and whom we hate.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpa upaspṛśya triḥ pradakṣiṇam udakam āvartayati | yadapāṃ kruraṃ yad amedhyaṃ yad aśāntaṃ tad apagacchatād iti |
meaning: अथाप उपस्पृश्य त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम् उदकम् आवर्तयति । यदपां क्रुरं यद् अमेध्यं यद् अशान्तं तद् अपगच्छताद् इति ।
text: Then he sips water, and thrice makes the water eddy around himself turning from the left to the right (and saying), 'May that which is hurtful, which is impure, and which is inauspicious in the water be removed.'

sanskrit_iast: apsu nimajjyonmajjya |
meaning: अप्सु निमज्ज्योन्मज्ज्य ।
text: After having submerged himself and having emerged from the water,

sanskrit_iast: nāpsu sataḥ prayamaṇaṃ vidyate na vāsaḥpalpūlanaṃnopasparśanam |
meaning: नाप्सु सतः प्रयमणं विद्यते न वासःपल्पूलनंनोपस्पर्शनम् ।
text: (Acts of) personal purification, washing the clothes by beating them on a stone and sipping water are not (permitted to the worshipper) as long as he is in the water.

sanskrit_iast: yady uparuddhāḥ syur etenopatiṣṭhate | namo 'gnaye 'psumatenama indrāya namo varuṇāya namo vāruṇyai namo 'dbhya iti |
meaning: यद्य् उपरुद्धाः स्युर् एतेनोपतिष्ठते । नमो ऽग्नये ऽप्सुमतेनम इन्द्राय नमो वरुणाय नमो वारुण्यै नमो ऽद्भ्य इति ।
text: If (the water used for bathing) has been (taken from a) confined (place, such as a well), he worships it with the following (Mantra): 'Adoration to Agni, the lord of the waters; adoration to Indra; adoration to Varuṇa; adoration to Vāruṇī; adoration to the waters.'

sanskrit_iast: uttīryācamyācāntaḥ punar ācāmet | āpaḥ punantu pṛthivīṃ pṛthivī pūtā punātu mām | punantu brahmaṇaspatir brahma pūtā punātu mām | yad ucchiṣṭam abhojyaṃ yad vā duścaritaṃ mama | sarvaṃ punantu mām āpo 'satāṃ ca pratigrahaṃ svāheti |
meaning: उत्तीर्याचम्याचान्तः पुनर् आचामेत् । आपः पुनन्तु पृथिवीं पृथिवी पूता पुनातु माम् । पुनन्तु ब्रह्मणस्पतिर् ब्रह्म पूता पुनातु माम् । यद् उच्छिष्टम् अभोज्यं यद् वा दुश्चरितं मम । सर्वं पुनन्तु माम् आपो ऽसतां च प्रतिग्रहं स्वाहेति ।
text: After having ascended the bank and having sipped water, let him again sip water, though he has done so before, (and recite the following Mantras) 'May water purify the earth, may the purified earth purify me, may Brahmaṇaspati (and) Brahman purify, may the purified (earth) purify me. May water purify me, (taking away) all (the guilt which I incurred by eating) remnants of food, and forbidden food, (by committing) evil deeds, (by) receiving gifts from wicked men, Svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: pavitre kṛtvādbhir mārjayati | āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuva ititisṛbhiḥ | hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā iti catasṛbhiḥ | pavamānaḥsuvarjana iti | etenānuvākena mārjayitvāntarjalagato 'ghamarṣaṇena trīn prāṇāyāmān dhārayitvottīrya vāsaḥ pīḍayitvā prakṣālitopavātānyakliṣṭāni vāsāṃsi paridhāyāpa ācamya darbheṣv āsīno darbhāndhārayamāṇaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ sāvitrīṃ sahasrakṛtva āvartayec chatakṛtvo 'parimitakṛtvo vā daśāvaram |
meaning: पवित्रे कृत्वाद्भिर् मार्जयति । आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुव इतितिसृभिः । हिरण्यवर्णाः शुचयः पावका इति चतसृभिः । पवमानःसुवर्जन इति । एतेनानुवाकेन मार्जयित्वान्तर्जलगतो ऽघमर्षणेन त्रीन् प्राणायामान् धारयित्वोत्तीर्य वासः पीडयित्वा प्रक्षालितोपवातान्यक्लिष्टानि वासांसि परिधायाप आचम्य दर्भेष्व् आसीनो दर्भान्धारयमाणः प्राङ्मुखः सावित्रीं सहस्रकृत्व आवर्तयेच् छतकृत्वो ऽपरिमितकृत्वो वा दशावरम् ।
text: Making two Pavitras he rubs (his body) with water. Having rubbed himself, (reciting the) three (verses), 'Ye waters are,' &c., the four (verses), 'The golden-coloured, pure, purifying,' &c., (and) the Anuvāka, 'He who purifies,' &c., he performs, stepping back into the water, three Prāṇāyāmas with the Aghamarshaṇa (hymn); then he ascends the bank, squeezes (the water) out of his dress, puts on garments which have been washed and dried in the air and which are not the worse for wear, sips water, sits down on Darbha grass, and, holding Darbha grass (in his hands), recites, facing the east, the Gāyatrī one thousand times, (or) one hundred times, or any number of times, or at least twelve times.

sanskrit_iast: athādityam upatiṣṭhate | ud vayaṃ tamasas pari | ud u tyam | citram | tac cakṣur devahitam | ya udagād iti |
meaning: अथादित्यम् उपतिष्ठते । उद् वयं तमसस् परि । उद् उ त्यम् । चित्रम् । तच् चक्षुर् देवहितम् । य उदगाद् इति ।
text: Then he worships the sun (reciting the following Mantras): 'Out of darkness we,' &c., 'Up that bright,' &c., That eye which is beneficial to the gods,' &c., (and) 'He who rose,' &c.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | praṇavo vyāhṛtayaḥ sāvitrī cety etepañca brahmayajñā aharahar brāhmaṇaṃ kilbiṣāt pāvayanti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । प्रणवो व्याहृतयः सावित्री चेत्य् एतेपञ्च ब्रह्मयज्ञा अहरहर् ब्राह्मणं किल्बिषात् पावयन्ति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following maxim): 'The syllable Om,, the Vyāh ri tis, and the Sāvitrī, these five Veda-offerings daily cleanse the Brāhmaṇa from guilt.'

sanskrit_iast: pūtaḥ pañcabhir brahmayajñair athottaraṃ devatās tarpayati |
meaning: पूतः पञ्चभिर् ब्रह्मयज्ञैर् अथोत्तरं देवतास् तर्पयति ।
text: Being purified by the five Veda-offerings, he next satiates the gods (with water, saying),

sanskrit_iast: om agniḥ prajāpatiḥ somo rudro 'ditir bṛhaspatiḥsarpā ity etāni prāgdvārāṇi daivatāni sanakṣatrāṇi sagrahāṇisāhorātrāṇi samuhūrtāni tarpayāmi | oṃ vasūṃś ca tarpayāmi |
meaning: ओम् अग्निः प्रजापतिः सोमो रुद्रो ऽदितिर् बृहस्पतिःसर्पा इत्य् एतानि प्राग्द्वाराणि दैवतानि सनक्षत्राणि सग्रहाणिसाहोरात्राणि समुहूर्तानि तर्पयामि । ओं वसूंश् च तर्पयामि ।
text: 'I satiate the deities of the eastern gate, Agni, Pra g āpati, Soma, Rudra, Aditi, B ri haspati, together with the lunar mansions, with the planets, with the days and nights, and with the Muhūrtas; Om, I also satiate the Vasus;

sanskrit_iast: oṃ pitaro 'ryamā bhagaḥ savitā tvaṣṭā vāyurindrāgnī ity etāni dakṣiṇadvārāṇi daivatāni sanakṣatrāṇisagrahāṇi sāhorātrāṇi samuhūrtāni tarpayāmi | oṃ rudrāṃś ca tarpayāmi |
meaning: ओं पितरो ऽर्यमा भगः सविता त्वष्टा वायुरिन्द्राग्नी इत्य् एतानि दक्षिणद्वाराणि दैवतानि सनक्षत्राणिसग्रहाणि साहोरात्राणि समुहूर्तानि तर्पयामि । ओं रुद्रांश् च तर्पयामि ।
text: 'Om, I satiate the deities of the southern gate, the Pit ri s, Yama, Bhaga, Savit ri , Tvashṭri , Vāyu, Indrāgnī, together with the lunar mansions, with the planets, with the days and nights, and with the Muhūrtas; Om, I also satiate the Rudras.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ mitra indro mahāpitara āpo viśve devā brahmāviṣṇur ity etāni pratyagdvārāṇi daivatāni sanakṣatrāṇi sagrahāṇisāhorātrāṇi samuhūrtāni tarpayāmi | om ādityāṃś ca tarpayāmi |
meaning: ओं मित्र इन्द्रो महापितर आपो विश्वे देवा ब्रह्माविष्णुर् इत्य् एतानि प्रत्यग्द्वाराणि दैवतानि सनक्षत्राणि सग्रहाणिसाहोरात्राणि समुहूर्तानि तर्पयामि । ओम् आदित्यांश् च तर्पयामि ।
text: 'Om, I satiate the deities of the western gate, Mitra, Indra, the Mahāpit ri s, the Waters, all the gods, Brahman, Vishṇu, together with the lunar mansions, with the planets, with the days and nights, and with the Muhūrtas; Om, I also satiate the Ādityas.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ vasavo varuṇo 'ja ekapād ahirbudhnyaḥpūṣāśvinau yama ity etāny udagdvārāṇi daivatāni sanakṣatrāṇisagrahāṇi sāhorātrāṇi samuhūrtāni tarpayāmi | oṃ viśvāndevāṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ sādhyāṃś ca tarpayāmi |
meaning: ओं वसवो वरुणो ऽज एकपाद् अहिर्बुध्न्यःपूषाश्विनौ यम इत्य् एतान्य् उदग्द्वाराणि दैवतानि सनक्षत्राणिसग्रहाणि साहोरात्राणि समुहूर्तानि तर्पयामि । ओं विश्वान्देवांस् तर्पयामि । ओं साध्यांश् च तर्पयामि ।
text: 'Om, I satiate the deities of the northern gate, the Vasus, Varuṇa, A g a-ekapād, Ahibudhnya, Ushas, the two Aśvins, Yama, together with . . . . . .

sanskrit_iast: oṃ brahmāṇaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ prajāpatiṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ caturmukhaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ parameṣṭhinaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ hiraṇyagarbhaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ svayaṃbhuvaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ brahmapārṣadāṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ brahmapārṣadīś ca tarpayāmi | om agniṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ vāyuṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ varuṇaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ sūryaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ candramasaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ nakṣatrāṇi tarpayāmi | oṃ sadyojātaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ bhūḥ puruṣaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ bhuvaḥ puruṣaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ suvaḥ puruṣaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ suvaḥ puruṣaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ bhūs tarpayāmi | oṃ bhuvas tarpayāmi | oṃ suvas tarpayāmi | oṃ mahas tarpayāmi | oṃ janas tarpayāmi | oṃ tapas tarpayāmi | oṃ satyaṃ tarpayāmi |
meaning: ओं ब्रह्माणं तर्पयामि । ओं प्रजापतिं तर्पयामि । ओं चतुर्मुखं तर्पयामि । ओं परमेष्ठिनं तर्पयामि । ओं हिरण्यगर्भं तर्पयामि । ओं स्वयंभुवं तर्पयामि । ओं ब्रह्मपार्षदांस् तर्पयामि । ओं ब्रह्मपार्षदीश् च तर्पयामि । ओम् अग्निं तर्पयामि । ओं वायुं तर्पयामि । ओं वरुणं तर्पयामि । ओं सूर्यं तर्पयामि । ओं चन्द्रमसं तर्पयामि । ओं नक्षत्राणि तर्पयामि । ओं सद्योजातं तर्पयामि । ओं भूः पुरुषं तर्पयामि । ओं भुवः पुरुषं तर्पयामि । ओं सुवः पुरुषं तर्पयामि । ओं भूर् भुवः सुवः पुरुषं तर्पयामि । ओं भूस् तर्पयामि । ओं भुवस् तर्पयामि । ओं सुवस् तर्पयामि । ओं महस् तर्पयामि । ओं जनस् तर्पयामि । ओं तपस् तर्पयामि । ओं सत्यं तर्पयामि ।

sanskrit_iast: oṃ bhavaṃ devaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ śarvaṃ devam tarpayāmi | omīśānaṃ devaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ paśupatiṃ devaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ rudraṃdevaṃ tarpayāmi | om ugraṃ devaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ bhīmaṃ devaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ mahāntaṃ devaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ bhavasya devasya patnīṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ śarvasya devasyapatnīṃ tarpayāmi | om īśānasya devasya patnīṃ tarpayāmi | oṃpaśupater devasya patnīṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ rudrasya devasya patnīṃ tarpayāmi | om ugrasya devasya patnīṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ bhīmasya devasyapatnīṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ mahato devasya patnīṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ bhavasya devasya sutaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ śarvasya devasyasutaṃ tarpayāmi | om īśānasya devasya sutaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ paśupaterdevasya sutaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ rudrasya devasya sutaṃ tarpayāmi | omugrasya devasya sutaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ bhīmasya devasya sutaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ mahato devasya sutaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ rudrāṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ rudrapārṣadāṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ rudrapārṣadīśca tarpayāmi |
meaning: ओं भवं देवं तर्पयामि । ओं शर्वं देवम् तर्पयामि । ओमीशानं देवं तर्पयामि । ओं पशुपतिं देवं तर्पयामि । ओं रुद्रंदेवं तर्पयामि । ओम् उग्रं देवं तर्पयामि । ओं भीमं देवं तर्पयामि । ओं महान्तं देवं तर्पयामि । ओं भवस्य देवस्य पत्नीं तर्पयामि । ओं शर्वस्य देवस्यपत्नीं तर्पयामि । ओम् ईशानस्य देवस्य पत्नीं तर्पयामि । ओंपशुपतेर् देवस्य पत्नीं तर्पयामि । ओं रुद्रस्य देवस्य पत्नीं तर्पयामि । ओम् उग्रस्य देवस्य पत्नीं तर्पयामि । ओं भीमस्य देवस्यपत्नीं तर्पयामि । ओं महतो देवस्य पत्नीं तर्पयामि । ओं भवस्य देवस्य सुतं तर्पयामि । ओं शर्वस्य देवस्यसुतं तर्पयामि । ओम् ईशानस्य देवस्य सुतं तर्पयामि । ओं पशुपतेर्देवस्य सुतं तर्पयामि । ओं रुद्रस्य देवस्य सुतं तर्पयामि । ओमुग्रस्य देवस्य सुतं तर्पयामि । ओं भीमस्य देवस्य सुतं तर्पयामि । ओं महतो देवस्य सुतं तर्पयामि । ओं रुद्रांस् तर्पयामि । ओं रुद्रपार्षदांस् तर्पयामि । ओं रुद्रपार्षदीश्च तर्पयामि ।

sanskrit_iast: oṃ vighnaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ vināyakaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ vīraṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ sthūlaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ varadaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ hastimukhaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ tarpayāmi | om ekadantaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ lambodaraṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ vighnapārṣadāṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ vighnapārṣadīś ca tarpayāmi |
meaning: ओं विघ्नं तर्पयामि । ओं विनायकं तर्पयामि । ओं वीरं तर्पयामि । ओं स्थूलं तर्पयामि । ओं वरदं तर्पयामि । ओं हस्तिमुखं तर्पयामि । ओं वक्रतुण्डं तर्पयामि । ओम् एकदन्तं तर्पयामि । ओं लम्बोदरं तर्पयामि । ओं विघ्नपार्षदांस् तर्पयामि । ओं विघ्नपार्षदीश् च तर्पयामि ।

sanskrit_iast: oṃ sanatkumāraṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ skandaṃ tarpayāmi | om indraṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ jayantaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ viśākhaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ mahāsenaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃsubrahmaṇyaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ skandapārṣadāṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ skandapārṣadīś ca tarpayāmi |
meaning: ओं सनत्कुमारं तर्पयामि । ओं स्कन्दं तर्पयामि । ओम् इन्द्रं तर्पयामि । ओं षष्ठीं तर्पयामि । ओं षण्मुखं तर्पयामि । ओं जयन्तं तर्पयामि । ओं विशाखं तर्पयामि । ओं महासेनं तर्पयामि । ओंसुब्रह्मण्यं तर्पयामि । ओं स्कन्दपार्षदांस् तर्पयामि । ओं स्कन्दपार्षदीश् च तर्पयामि ।

sanskrit_iast: om ādityaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ somaṃ tarpayāmi | om aṅgārakaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ budhaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ bṛhaspatiṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ śukraṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ śanaiścaraṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ rāhuṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ ketuṃ tarpayāmi |
meaning: ओम् आदित्यं तर्पयामि । ओं सोमं तर्पयामि । ओम् अङ्गारकं तर्पयामि । ओं बुधं तर्पयामि । ओं बृहस्पतिं तर्पयामि । ओं शुक्रं तर्पयामि । ओं शनैश्चरं तर्पयामि । ओं राहुं तर्पयामि । ओं केतुं तर्पयामि ।

sanskrit_iast: oṃ keśavaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ mādhavaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ govindaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ viṣṇuṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ madhusūdanaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ trivikramaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ vāmanaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ śrīdharaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ padmanābhaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ dāmodaraṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ śriyaṃ devīṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ sarasvatīṃ devīṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ puṣṭiṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ tuṣṭiṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ garutmantaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ viṣṇupārṣadāṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ viṣṇupārṣadīś ca tarpayāmi |
meaning: ओं केशवं तर्पयामि । ओं नारायणं तर्पयामि । ओं माधवं तर्पयामि । ओं गोविन्दं तर्पयामि । ओं विष्णुं तर्पयामि । ओं मधुसूदनं तर्पयामि । ओं त्रिविक्रमं तर्पयामि । ओं वामनं तर्पयामि । ओं श्रीधरं तर्पयामि । ओं हृषीकेशं तर्पयामि । ओं पद्मनाभं तर्पयामि । ओं दामोदरं तर्पयामि । ओं श्रियं देवीं तर्पयामि । ओं सरस्वतीं देवीं तर्पयामि । ओं पुष्टिं तर्पयामि । ओं तुष्टिं तर्पयामि । ओं गरुत्मन्तं तर्पयामि । ओं विष्णुपार्षदांस् तर्पयामि । ओं विष्णुपार्षदीश् च तर्पयामि ।

sanskrit_iast: oṃ yamaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ yamarājaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ dharmaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ dharmarājaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ kālaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ nīlaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ mṛtyuṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ vaivasvataṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ citraṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ citraguptaṃ tarpayāmi | om audumbaraṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ vaivasvatapārṣadāṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ vaivasvatapārṣadīśca tarpayāmi |
meaning: ओं यमं तर्पयामि । ओं यमराजं तर्पयामि । ओं धर्मं तर्पयामि । ओं धर्मराजं तर्पयामि । ओं कालं तर्पयामि । ओं नीलं तर्पयामि । ओं मृत्युं तर्पयामि । ओं वैवस्वतं तर्पयामि । ओं चित्रं तर्पयामि । ओं चित्रगुप्तं तर्पयामि । ओम् औदुम्बरं तर्पयामि । ओं वैवस्वतपार्षदांस् तर्पयामि । ओं वैवस्वतपार्षदीश्च तर्पयामि ।

sanskrit_iast: oṃ bhūmidevāṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ kāśyapam tarpayāmi | om antarikṣaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ vidyāṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ dhanvantariṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ dhanvantaripārṣadāṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ dhanvantaripārṣadīś ca tarpayāmīti |
meaning: ओं भूमिदेवांस् तर्पयामि । ओं काश्यपम् तर्पयामि । ओम् अन्तरिक्षं तर्पयामि । ओं विद्यां तर्पयामि । ओं धन्वन्तरिं तर्पयामि । ओं धन्वन्तरिपार्षदांस् तर्पयामि । ओं धन्वन्तरिपार्षदीश् च तर्पयामीति ।

sanskrit_iast: atha nivītī |
meaning: अथ निवीती ।
text: Next, passing the sacrificial thread round the neck, (he offers the following libations):

sanskrit_iast: om ṛṣīṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ maharṣīṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ paramarṣīṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ brahmarṣīṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ devarṣīṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ rājarṣīṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ śrutarṣīṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ janarṛṣīṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ taparṛṣīṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ satyarṣīṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ saptarṣīṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ kāṇḍarṣīṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ ṛṣikāṃs tarpayāmi | om ṛṣipatnīs tarpayāmi | om ṛṣiputrāṃs tarpayāmi | om ṛṣipautrāṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ kāṇvaṃ baudhāyanaṃ tarpayāmi | om āpastambaṃ sūtrakāraṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ satyāṣāḍhaṃhiraṇyakeśinaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ vājasaneyinaṃ yājñavalkyam tarpayāmi | om āśvalāyanaṃ śaunakaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ vyāsaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ praṇavaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ vyāhṛtīs tarpayāmi | oṃ sāvitrīṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ gāyatrīṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ chandāṃsi tarpayāmi | om ṛgvedaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ yajurvedaṃ tarpayāmi | oṃ sāmavedaṃ tarpayāmi | om atharvavedaṃ tarpayāmi | om atharvāṅgirasas tarpayāmi | om itihāsapurāṇāni tarpayāmi | oṃ sarvavedāṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ sarvadevajanāṃs tarpayāmi | oṃ sarvabhūtāni tarpayāmīti |
meaning: ओम् ऋषींस् तर्पयामि । ओं महर्षींस् तर्पयामि । ओं परमर्षींस् तर्पयामि । ओं ब्रह्मर्षींस् तर्पयामि । ओं देवर्षींस् तर्पयामि । ओं राजर्षींस् तर्पयामि । ओं श्रुतर्षींस् तर्पयामि । ओं जनरृषींस् तर्पयामि । ओं तपरृषींस् तर्पयामि । ओं सत्यर्षींस् तर्पयामि । ओं सप्तर्षींस् तर्पयामि । ओं काण्डर्षींस् तर्पयामि । ओं ऋषिकांस् तर्पयामि । ओम् ऋषिपत्नीस् तर्पयामि । ओम् ऋषिपुत्रांस् तर्पयामि । ओम् ऋषिपौत्रांस् तर्पयामि । ओं काण्वं बौधायनं तर्पयामि । ओम् आपस्तम्बं सूत्रकारं तर्पयामि । ओं सत्याषाढंहिरण्यकेशिनं तर्पयामि । ओं वाजसनेयिनं याज्ञवल्क्यम् तर्पयामि । ओम् आश्वलायनं शौनकं तर्पयामि । ओं व्यासं तर्पयामि । ओं वसिष्ठं तर्पयामि । ओं प्रणवं तर्पयामि । ओं व्याहृतीस् तर्पयामि । ओं सावित्रीं तर्पयामि । ओं गायत्रीं तर्पयामि । ओं छन्दांसि तर्पयामि । ओम् ऋग्वेदं तर्पयामि । ओं यजुर्वेदं तर्पयामि । ओं सामवेदं तर्पयामि । ओम् अथर्ववेदं तर्पयामि । ओम् अथर्वाङ्गिरसस् तर्पयामि । ओम् इतिहासपुराणानि तर्पयामि । ओं सर्ववेदांस् तर्पयामि । ओं सर्वदेवजनांस् तर्पयामि । ओं सर्वभूतानि तर्पयामीति ।

sanskrit_iast: atha prācīnāvīti | oṃ pitqn svadhā namas tarpayāmi | oṃ pitāmahān svadhā namas tarpayāmi | oṃ prapitāmahān svadhā namas tarpayāmi | oṃ mātqḥ svadhānamas tarpayāmi | oṃ pitāmahīḥ svadhā namas tarpayāmi | oṃ prapitāmahīḥ svadhā namas tarpayāmi | oṃ mātāmahān svadhā namas tarpayāmi | oṃ mātuḥ pitāmahānsvadhā namas tarpayāmi | oṃ mātuḥ prapitāmahān svadhānamas tarpayāmi | oṃ mātāmahīḥ svadhā namas tarpayāmi | oṃ mātuḥ pitāmahīḥ svadhā namas tarpayāmi | oṃ mātuḥ prapitāmahīḥ svadhā namas tarpayāmi |
meaning: अथ प्राचीनावीति । ओं पित्qन् स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओं पितामहान् स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओं प्रपितामहान् स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओं मात्qः स्वधानमस् तर्पयामि । ओं पितामहीः स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओं प्रपितामहीः स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओं मातामहान् स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओं मातुः पितामहान्स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओं मातुः प्रपितामहान् स्वधानमस् तर्पयामि । ओं मातामहीः स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओं मातुः पितामहीः स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओं मातुः प्रपितामहीः स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि ।

sanskrit_iast: om ācāryān svadhā namas tarpayāmi | om ācāryapatnīḥ svadhā namas tarpayāmi | oṃ gurūn svadhānamas tarpayāmi | oṃ gurupatnīḥ svadhā namas tarpayāmi | oṃ sakhīn svadhā namas tarpayāmi | oṃ sakhipatnīḥ svadhā namas tarpayāmi | oṃ jñātīn svadhānamas tarpayāmi | oṃ jñātipatnīḥ svadhā namas tarpayāmi | om amātyān svadhā namas tarpayāmi | om amātyapatnīḥ svadhā namas tarpayāmi | oṃ sarvān svadhā namas tarpayāmi | oṃ sarvāḥ svadhā namas tarpayāmīti |
meaning: ओम् आचार्यान् स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओम् आचार्यपत्नीः स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओं गुरून् स्वधानमस् तर्पयामि । ओं गुरुपत्नीः स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओं सखीन् स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओं सखिपत्नीः स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओं ज्ञातीन् स्वधानमस् तर्पयामि । ओं ज्ञातिपत्नीः स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओम् अमात्यान् स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओम् अमात्यपत्नीः स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओं सर्वान् स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामि । ओं सर्वाः स्वधा नमस् तर्पयामीति ।

sanskrit_iast: anutīrtham apa utsiñcati |
meaning: अनुतीर्थम् अप उत्सिञ्चति ।
text: He pours the water out from the several Tīrthas (of the hand sacred to the several deities).

sanskrit_iast: ūrjaṃ vahantīr amṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ payaḥ kīlālaṃ parisrutam | svadhā stha tarpayata me pitqn | tṛpyata tṛpyata tṛpyateti |
meaning: ऊर्जं वहन्तीर् अमृतं घृतं पयः कीलालं परिस्रुतम् । स्वधा स्थ तर्पयत मे पित्qन् । तृप्यत तृप्यत तृप्यतेति ।
text: (He recites at the end of the rite the following [paragraph continues] Mantra): '(Ye waters), who bring food, ambrosia, clarified butter, milk, and barley-gruel, are food for the manes; satiate my ancestors! May you be satiated, may you be satiated!'

sanskrit_iast: naikavastro nārdravāsā daivāni karmāṇy anusaṃcaret |
meaning: नैकवस्त्रो नार्द्रवासा दैवानि कर्माण्य् अनुसंचरेत् ।
text: Let him not perform ceremonies in honour of the gods while his clothes are wet, or while he is dressed in one garment only,.

sanskrit_iast: pitṛsaṃyuktāni cety ekeṣām | pitṛsaṃyuktāni cety ekeṣām |
meaning: पितृसंयुक्तानि चेत्य् एकेषाम् । पितृसंयुक्तानि चेत्य् एकेषाम् ।
text: Nor those connected with the manes. That is the opinion) of some (teachers).

sanskrit_iast: atheme pañca mahāyajñāḥ | tāny eva mahāsattrāṇi | devayajñaḥ pitṛyajño bhūtayajño manuṣyayajño brahmayajña iti |
meaning: अथेमे पञ्च महायज्ञाः । तान्य् एव महासत्त्राणि । देवयज्ञः पितृयज्ञो भूतयज्ञो मनुष्ययज्ञो ब्रह्मयज्ञ इति ।
text: Now these five great sacrifices, which are also called the great sacrificial sessions, are the sacrifice to be offered to the gods, the sacrifice to be offered to the manes, the sacrifice to be offered to all beings, the sacrifice to be offered to men, (and) the sacrifice to be offered to Brahman,

sanskrit_iast: aharahaḥ svāhākuryād ā kāṣṭhāt | tathaitaṃdevayajñaṃ samāpnoti |
meaning: अहरहः स्वाहाकुर्याद् आ काष्ठात् । तथैतंदेवयज्ञं समाप्नोति ।
text: Let him daily offer (something to the gods with the exclamation) Svāhā, be it only a piece of fuel. Thereby he performs that sacrifice to the gods.

sanskrit_iast: aharahaḥ svadhākuryād odapātrāt | tathaitaṃpitṛyajñaṃ samāpnoti |
meaning: अहरहः स्वधाकुर्याद् ओदपात्रात् । तथैतंपितृयज्ञं समाप्नोति ।
text: Let him daily offer (something to the manes with the exclamation) Svadhā, be it only a vessel filled with water. Thereby he performs that sacrifice to the manes.

sanskrit_iast: aharahar namaḥkuryād ā puṣpebhyaḥ | tathaitambhūtayajñaṃ samāpnoti |
meaning: अहरहर् नमःकुर्याद् आ पुष्पेभ्यः । तथैतम्भूतयज्ञं समाप्नोति ।
text: Let him daily pay reverence to (all beings) endowed with life. Thereby he performs that sacrifice to the beings.

sanskrit_iast: aharahar brāhmaṇebhyo 'nnaṃ dadyād ā mūlaphalaśākebhyaḥ | tathaitaṃ manuṣyayajñaṃ samāpnoti |
meaning: अहरहर् ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ऽन्नं दद्याद् आ मूलफलशाकेभ्यः । तथैतं मनुष्ययज्ञं समाप्नोति ।
text: Let him daily give food to Brāhmaṇas, be it only roots, fruit, or vegetables. Thereby he performs that sacrifice to men.

sanskrit_iast: aharahaḥ svādhyāyaṃ kuryād ā praṇavāt | tathaitaṃbrahmayajñaṃ samāpnoti |
meaning: अहरहः स्वाध्यायं कुर्याद् आ प्रणवात् । तथैतंब्रह्मयज्ञं समाप्नोति ।
text: Let him daily recite the Veda privately, be it only the syllable Om or the Vyāh ri tis. Thereby he performs that sacrifice to be offered to Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: svādhyāyo vai brahmayajñaḥ | tasya ha vā etasyabrahmayajñasya vāg eva juhūr mana upabhṛc cakṣur dhruvā medhā sruvaḥsatyam avabhṛthaḥ svargo loka udayanam | yāvantaṃ ha vā imāṃ vittasyapūrṇāṃ dadat svargaṃ lokaṃ jayati tāvantaṃ lokaṃ jayati bhūyāṃsaṃ cākṣayyaṃ cāpa punarmṛtyuṃ jayatiya evaṃ vidvān svādhyāyam adhīte | tasmāt svādhyāyo 'dhyetavya itihi brāhmaṇam |
meaning: स्वाध्यायो वै ब्रह्मयज्ञः । तस्य ह वा एतस्यब्रह्मयज्ञस्य वाग् एव जुहूर् मन उपभृच् चक्षुर् ध्रुवा मेधा स्रुवःसत्यम् अवभृथः स्वर्गो लोक उदयनम् । यावन्तं ह वा इमां वित्तस्यपूर्णां ददत् स्वर्गं लोकं जयति तावन्तं लोकं जयति भूयांसं चाक्षय्यं चाप पुनर्मृत्युं जयतिय एवं विद्वान् स्वाध्यायम् अधीते । तस्मात् स्वाध्यायो ऽध्येतव्य इतिहि ब्राह्मणम् ।
text: 'The private recitation of the Veda is, indeed, the sacrifice to Brahman. At that sacrifice to Brahman speech, forsooth, (takes the place of) the G uhū, the internal organ (that of) the Upabh ri t, the eye (that of) the Dhruvā, the understanding (that of) the Sruva, truth (that of) the final bath, heaven (is) the conclusion of the sacrifice. He who, knowing this, daily recites the Veda to himself, gains as much heavenly bliss as, and more than, he who gives away this whole earth that is filled with wealth, and imperishable (beatitude), and conquers death. Therefore the Veda should be recited in private. Thus speaks the Brāhmaṇa.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | svabhyaktaḥ suhitaḥ sukhe śayaneśayāno yaṃ yaṃ kratum adhīte tena tenāsyeṣṭaṃ bhavatīti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । स्वभ्यक्तः सुहितः सुखे शयनेशयानो यं यं क्रतुम् अधीते तेन तेनास्येष्टं भवतीति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following passage): 'If, well anointed, well fed, and lying on a comfortable couch, one recites (the portion of the Veda referring to) any sacrifice, one has offered it thereby.'

sanskrit_iast: tasya ha vā etasya dharmasya caturdhā bhedam eka āhuḥ | adṛṣṭatvāt | ye catvāra iti | karmavādaḥ |
meaning: तस्य ह वा एतस्य धर्मस्य चतुर्धा भेदम् एक आहुः । अदृष्टत्वात् । ये चत्वार इति । कर्मवादः ।
text: Some (teachers) declare (that there is a text) which teaches a fourfold division of these sacred duties. (But) as no (other meaning is) perceptible, (the text) 'Four paths,' &c., refers to sacrificial rites.

sanskrit_iast: aiṣṭikapāśukasaumikadārvihomāṇām |
meaning: ऐष्टिकपाशुकसौमिकदार्विहोमाणाम् ।
text: (Viz.) to Ishṭis, animal sacrifices, Soma sacrifices, and Darvīhomas.

sanskrit_iast: tad eṣābhivadati | ye catvāraḥ pathayo devayānā antarā dyāvāpṛthivī viyanti | teṣāṃ yo ajyānim ajītim āvahāt tasmai no devāḥ pari datteha sarve || iti |
meaning: तद् एषाभिवदति । ये चत्वारः पथयो देवयाना अन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी वियन्ति । तेषां यो अज्यानिम् अजीतिम् आवहात् तस्मै नो देवाः परि दत्तेह सर्वे ॥ इति ।
text: The following (Rik) declares that, 'Four paths, leading to the world of. the gods, go severally from the earth to heaven. All ye gods, place us on that among them which will gain us undecaying prosperity.'

sanskrit_iast: brahmacārī gṛhastho vānaprasthaḥ parivrājaka iti |
meaning: ब्रह्मचारी गृहस्थो वानप्रस्थः परिव्राजक इति ।
text: The student, the householder, the hermit in the woods, the ascetic (constitute the four orders).

sanskrit_iast: brahmacārī guruśuśrūṣy ā maraṇāt |
meaning: ब्रह्मचारी गुरुशुश्रूष्य् आ मरणात् ।
text: A student (shall) obey his teacher until death.

sanskrit_iast: vānaprastho vaikhānasaśāstrasamudācāraḥ |
meaning: वानप्रस्थो वैखानसशास्त्रसमुदाचारः ।
text: A hermit is he who regulates his conduct entirely according to the Institutes proclaimed by Vikhanas.

sanskrit_iast: vaikhānaso vane mūlaphalāśī tapaḥśīlaḥ savaneṣūdakamupaspṛśañ śrāmaṇakenāgnim ādhāyāgrāmyabhojīdevapitṛbhūtamanuṣyarṣipūjakaḥ sarvātithiḥ pratiṣiddhavarjaṃbaiṣkam apy upayuñjīta | na phālakṛṣṭam adhitiṣṭhed grāmaṃ ca na praviśet | jaṭilaś cīrājinavāsā nātisāṃvatsaraṃ bhuñjīta |
meaning: वैखानसो वने मूलफलाशी तपःशीलः सवनेषूदकमुपस्पृशञ् श्रामणकेनाग्निम् आधायाग्राम्यभोजीदेवपितृभूतमनुष्यर्षिपूजकः सर्वातिथिः प्रतिषिद्धवर्जंबैष्कम् अप्य् उपयुञ्जीत । न फालकृष्टम् अधितिष्ठेद् ग्रामं च न प्रविशेत् । जटिलश् चीराजिनवासा नातिसांवत्सरं भुञ्जीत ।
text: A Vaikhānasa (shall live) in the forest, subsisting on roots and fruit, practising austerities and bathing at morn, noon, and eve; he shall kindle a fire according to the Śrāmaṇaka (rule); he shall eat wild-growing (vegetables and grain) only; he shall worship gods, manes, Bhūtas, men, and Ri shis; he shall receive hospitably (men of) all (castes) except those (with whom intercourse is) forbidden; he may even use the flesh of animals killed by carnivorous beasts; he shall not step on ploughed (land); and he shall not enter a village; he shall wear his hair in braids, and dress in (garments made of) bark or skins; he shall not eat anything that has been hoarded for more than a year.

sanskrit_iast: parivrājakaḥ parityajya bandhūn aparigrahaḥ pravrajed yathāvidhi |
meaning: परिव्राजकः परित्यज्य बन्धून् अपरिग्रहः प्रव्रजेद् यथाविधि ।
text: An ascetic shall leave his relatives and, not attended by any one nor procuring any property, depart (from his house performing the customary ceremony) according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast: araṇyaṃ gatvā |
meaning: अरण्यं गत्वा ।
text: He shall go into the forest (and live there).

sanskrit_iast: śikhāmuṇḍaḥ |
meaning: शिखामुण्डः ।
text: He shall shave his hair excepting the top-lock.

sanskrit_iast: kaupīnācchādanaḥ |
meaning: कौपीनाच्छादनः ।
text: He shall wear a cloth to cover his nakedness.

sanskrit_iast: varṣāsv ekasthaḥ |
meaning: वर्षास्व् एकस्थः ।
text: He shall reside in one place during the rainy season.

sanskrit_iast: kāṣāyavāsāḥ |
meaning: काषायवासाः ।
text: He shall wear a dress dyed yellowish-red.

sanskrit_iast: sannamusale vyaṅgāre nivṛttaśarāvasaṃpāte bhikṣeta |
meaning: सन्नमुसले व्यङ्गारे निवृत्तशरावसंपाते भिक्षेत ।
text: He shall go to beg when the pestle lies motionless, when the embers have been extinguished, and when the cleaning of the dishes has been finished.

sanskrit_iast: vāṅmanaḥkarmadaṇḍair bhūtānām adrohī |
meaning: वाङ्मनःकर्मदण्डैर् भूतानाम् अद्रोही ।
text: With the three means of punishment, (viz.) words, thoughts, and acts, he shall not injure created beings.

sanskrit_iast: pavitraṃ bibhrac chaucārtham |
meaning: पवित्रं बिभ्रच् छौचार्थम् ।
text: He shall carry a cloth for straining water for the sake of purification.

sanskrit_iast: uddhṛtaparipūtābhir adbhir apkāryaṃ kurvāṇaḥ |
meaning: उद्धृतपरिपूताभिर् अद्भिर् अप्कार्यं कुर्वाणः ।
text: He shall perform the necessary purifications with water which has been taken out (of a well or tank) and has been strained.

sanskrit_iast: apavidhya vaidikāni karmāṇy ubhayataḥ paricchinnā madhyamaṃpadaṃ saṃśliṣyāmaha iti vadantaḥ |
meaning: अपविध्य वैदिकानि कर्माण्य् उभयतः परिच्छिन्ना मध्यमंपदं संश्लिष्यामह इति वदन्तः ।
text: (Ascetics shall) say, 'Renouncing the works taught in the Veda, cut off from both (worlds), we attach ourselves to the central sphere (Brahman).'

sanskrit_iast: aikāśramyaṃ tv ācāryā aprajanatvād itareṣām |
meaning: ऐकाश्रम्यं त्व् आचार्या अप्रजनत्वाद् इतरेषाम् ।
text: But the venerable teacher (declares) that there is one order only, because the others do not beget offspring.

sanskrit_iast: tatrodāharanti | prāhlādir ha vai kapilo nāmāsura āsa | sa etān bhedāṃś cakāra devaiḥ spardhamānaḥ | tān manīṣī nādriyeta |
meaning: तत्रोदाहरन्ति । प्राह्लादिर् ह वै कपिलो नामासुर आस । स एतान् भेदांश् चकार देवैः स्पर्धमानः । तान् मनीषी नाद्रियेत ।
text: With reference to this matter they quote also (the following passage): 'There was, forsooth, an Āsura, Kapila by name, the son of Prahlāda. Striving with the gods, he made these divisions. A wise man should not take heed of them.'

sanskrit_iast: adṛṣṭatvāt | ye catvāra iti | karmavādaaiṣṭikapāśukasaumikadārvihomāṇām |
meaning: अदृष्टत्वात् । ये चत्वार इति । कर्मवादऐष्टिकपाशुकसौमिकदार्विहोमाणाम् ।
text: Because no (other meaning is) perceptible, (the text) 'Four paths,' &c., refers to sacrificial rites, (viz.) to Ishṭis, animal sacrifices, Soma sacrifices, Darvīhomas.

sanskrit_iast: tad eṣābhyanūcyate | eṣa nityo mahimā brāhmaṇasya na karmaṇā vardhate nokanīyān | tasyaivātmā padavit taṃ viditvā na karmaṇā lipyatepāpakena || iti |
meaning: तद् एषाभ्यनूच्यते । एष नित्यो महिमा ब्राह्मणस्य न कर्मणा वर्धते नोकनीयान् । तस्यैवात्मा पदवित् तं विदित्वा न कर्मणा लिप्यतेपापकेन ॥ इति ।
text: With respect to this (question the following verse also) is quoted: 'That eternal greatness of the Brāhmaṇa is neither increased by works, nor diminished. The soul knows the nature of that (greatness); knowing that, he is not stained by evil deeds.'

sanskrit_iast: sa brūyāt | yena sūryas tapati tejaseddhaḥ pitā putreṇa pitṛmānyoniyonau | nāvedavin manute taṃ bṛhantaṃ sarvānubhūm ātmānaṃ saṃparāye || iti |
meaning: स ब्रूयात् । येन सूर्यस् तपति तेजसेद्धः पिता पुत्रेण पितृमान्योनियोनौ । नावेदविन् मनुते तं बृहन्तं सर्वानुभूम् आत्मानं संपराये ॥ इति ।
text: If he says that, (let him reflect on the following verse): 'He who knows not the Veda, does not at death think of that great, all-perceiving soul, through which the sun, resplendent with brilliancy, gives warmth, and the father has a father through the son at his birth from the womb.'

sanskrit_iast: ime ye nārvāṅ na paraś caranti na brāhmaṇāso nasutekarāsaḥ | ta ete vācam abhipadya pāpayā sirīs tantraṃ tanvateaprajajñaye || iti |
meaning: इमे ये नार्वाङ् न परश् चरन्ति न ब्राह्मणासो नसुतेकरासः । त एते वाचम् अभिपद्य पापया सिरीस् तन्त्रं तन्वतेअप्रजज्ञये ॥ इति ।
text: (Moreover), 'Those who, being neither true Brāhmaṇas nor performers of Soma sacrifices, work not for that which is near, nor for that which is far, take hold of the word and with sinful (speech) ignorantly perform the rites.'

sanskrit_iast: prajābhir agne amṛtatvam aśyām | jāyamāno vai brāhmaṇastribhir ṛṇavā jāyate brahmacaryeṇarṣibhyo yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayāpitṛbhya iti | evam ṛṇasaṃyogavādinyo 'saṃkhyeyā bhavanti |
meaning: प्रजाभिर् अग्ने अमृतत्वम् अश्याम् । जायमानो वै ब्राह्मणस्त्रिभिर् ऋणवा जायते ब्रह्मचर्येणर्षिभ्यो यज्ञेन देवेभ्यः प्रजयापितृभ्य इति । एवम् ऋणसंयोगवादिन्यो ऽसंख्येया भवन्ति ।
text: There are innumerable (passages in the Veda) which refer to the debts (to be paid by a Brāhmaṇa), such as, 'May I obtain, O Agni, immortality through offspring;' 'A Brāhmaṇa on being born, (owes) a son to his ancestors,' &c.

sanskrit_iast: trayīṃ vidyāṃ brahmacaryaṃ prajātiṃ śraddhāṃ tapoyajñam anupradānam | ya etāni kurvate tair it saha smo rajo bhūtvā dhvaṃsate 'nyat praśaṃsan || iti | dhvaṃsate 'nyat praśaṃsann iti |
meaning: त्रयीं विद्यां ब्रह्मचर्यं प्रजातिं श्रद्धां तपोयज्ञम् अनुप्रदानम् । य एतानि कुर्वते तैर् इत् सह स्मो रजो भूत्वा ध्वंसते ऽन्यत् प्रशंसन् ॥ इति । ध्वंसते ऽन्यत् प्रशंसन्न् इति ।
text: 'Those dwell with us, who fulfil the following (duties), the study of the three Vedas, the studentship, the procreation of offspring, faith, austerity, sacrificing, and giving gifts; he who praises other (duties) becomes dust and perishes.'

sanskrit_iast: atha śālīnayāyāvarāṇām ātmayājināṃ prāṇāhutīr vyākhyāsyāmaḥ |
meaning: अथ शालीनयायावराणाम् आत्मयाजिनां प्राणाहुतीर् व्याख्यास्यामः ।
text: Now we will explain the oblations (offered) to the vital air (prāṇa) by Śālīnas (householders) and Yāyāvaras (vagrants), who sacrifice to the soul.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāvaśyakāvasāne saṃmṛṣṭopalipte deśe prāṅmukha upaviśya tad bhūtam āhriyamāṇam | bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar om iti | upasthāya vācaṃ yacchet |
meaning: सर्वावश्यकावसाने संमृष्टोपलिप्ते देशे प्राङ्मुख उपविश्य तद् भूतम् आह्रियमाणम् । भूर् भुवः सुवर् ओम् इति । उपस्थाय वाचं यच्छेत् ।
text: At the end of all the necessary (daily rites), let him sit down, facing the east, in a place that has been well cleaned and smeared with cowdung; next let him worship that prepared (food) which is being brought. (saying), 'Bhū h , Bhuva h , Sva h , Om,' (and then) remain silent.
