sanskrit_iast: nyastam annaṃ mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ pradakṣiṇam udakaṃ pariṣicyasavyena pāṇināvimuñcan | amṛtopastaraṇam asīti | purastād apaḥ pītvā pañcānnena prāṇāhutīr juhoti | prāṇe niviṣṭo 'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śivo mā viśāpradāhāya | prāṇāya svāhā | apāneniviṣṭo 'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śivo mā viśāpradāhāya | apānāya svāhā | vyāne niviṣṭo 'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śivo mā viśāpradāhāya | vyānāyasvāhā | udāne niviṣṭo 'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śivo mā viśāpradāhāya | udānāya svāhā | samāne niviṣṭo 'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śivo mā viśāpradāhāya | samānāya svāheti |
meaning: न्यस्तम् अन्नं महाव्याहृतिभिः प्रदक्षिणम् उदकं परिषिच्यसव्येन पाणिनाविमुञ्चन् । अमृतोपस्तरणम् असीति । पुरस्ताद् अपः पीत्वा पञ्चान्नेन प्राणाहुतीर् जुहोति । प्राणे निविष्टो ऽमृतं जुहोमि । शिवो मा विशाप्रदाहाय । प्राणाय स्वाहा । अपानेनिविष्टो ऽमृतं जुहोमि । शिवो मा विशाप्रदाहाय । अपानाय स्वाहा । व्याने निविष्टो ऽमृतं जुहोमि । शिवो मा विशाप्रदाहाय । व्यानायस्वाहा । उदाने निविष्टो ऽमृतं जुहोमि । शिवो मा विशाप्रदाहाय । उदानाय स्वाहा । समाने निविष्टो ऽमृतं जुहोमि । शिवो मा विशाप्रदाहाय । समानाय स्वाहेति ।
text: (Next) he pours water round the food which has been placed (before him), turning his right hand towards it, and reciting the Mahāvyāh ri tis; (afterwards), continuing to hold (the dish) with his left hand, he first drinks water, (saying), 'Thou art a substratum for ambrosia,' and (finally) offers five oblations of food to the vital airs, (reciting the texts), 'Full of reverence, I offer ambrosia to Prāṇa; mayest thou propitiously enter me, not in order to burn me. To Prāṇa, Svāhā!' &c.

sanskrit_iast: pañcānnena prāṇāhutīr hutvā tūṣṇīṃ bhūyo vratayetprajāpatiṃ manasā dhyāyan | nāntarā vācaṃ visṛjet |
meaning: पञ्चान्नेन प्राणाहुतीर् हुत्वा तूष्णीं भूयो व्रतयेत्प्रजापतिं मनसा ध्यायन् । नान्तरा वाचं विसृजेत् ।
text: After offering the five oblations of food to the vital airs, let him finish his meal silently. Meditating in his heart on the lord of created beings, let him not emit speech while (eating),

sanskrit_iast: yady antarā vācaṃ visṛjet | bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar omiti | japitvā punar eva bhuñjīta |
meaning: यद्य् अन्तरा वाचं विसृजेत् । भूर् भुवः सुवर् ओमिति । जपित्वा पुनर् एव भुञ्जीत ।
text: If he emits speech, he shall mutter 'Bhū h , Bhuva h , Sva h , Om,' and afterwards continue to eat.

sanskrit_iast: tvakkeśanakhakīṭākhupurīṣāṇi dṛṣṭvā taṃ deśaṃ piṇḍam uddhṛtyādbhir abhyukṣya bhasmāvakīrya punar adbhiḥ prokṣya vācāca praśastam upayuñjīta |
meaning: त्वक्केशनखकीटाखुपुरीषाणि दृष्ट्वा तं देशं पिण्डम् उद्धृत्याद्भिर् अभ्युक्ष्य भस्मावकीर्य पुनर् अद्भिः प्रोक्ष्य वाचाच प्रशस्तम् उपयुञ्जीत ।
text: Now they quote also (the following rule): 'If he sees (bits of) skin, hair, nail-(parings), insects, or the dung of rats (in his food), 'he shall take out a lump, sprinkle that spot with water, scatter ashes on it, again sprinkle it with water, and use (the remainder of the food), after it has been declared fit (for use).'

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | āsīnaḥ prāṅmukho 'śnīyād vāgyato 'nnam akutsayan | askandayaṃs tanmanāś ca bhuktvā cāgnim upaspṛśed || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । आसीनः प्राङ्मुखो ऽश्नीयाद् वाग्यतो ऽन्नम् अकुत्सयन् । अस्कन्दयंस् तन्मनाश् च भुक्त्वा चाग्निम् उपस्पृशेद् ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'He shall eat, seated with his face towards the east, silent, not despising his food, not scattering (fragments on the ground), and solely attend (to his dinner); and, after he has eaten, he shall touch fire.'

sanskrit_iast: sarvabhakṣyāpūpakandamūlaphalamāṃsāni dantair nāvadyet |
meaning: सर्वभक्ष्यापूपकन्दमूलफलमांसानि दन्तैर् नावद्येत् ।
text: He shall not cut off with his teeth (pieces from) eatables (that must be swallowed) entire, (such as) cakes, bulbs, roots, fruit, and flesh.

sanskrit_iast: nātisuhitaḥ |
meaning: नातिसुहितः ।
text: (Let him) not (eat) to repletion.

sanskrit_iast: amṛtāpidhānam asīti | upariṣṭād apaḥ pītvācāntohṛdayadeśam abhimṛśati | prāṇānāṃ granthir asi rudro mā viśāntakaḥ | tenānnenāpyāyasveti |
meaning: अमृतापिधानम् असीति । उपरिष्टाद् अपः पीत्वाचान्तोहृदयदेशम् अभिमृशति । प्राणानां ग्रन्थिर् असि रुद्रो मा विशान्तकः । तेनान्नेनाप्यायस्वेति ।
text: After (dinner) he shall drink water, (reciting the text), 'Thou art 'a covering for ambrosia,' and stroke (the region of) the heart, (saying), 'Thou art the bond that connects the vital airs; (thou art) [paragraph continues] Rudra and Death; enter me; mayest thou grow through this food.'

sanskrit_iast: punar ācamya dakṣiṇe pādāṅguṣṭhe pāṇī nisrāvayati | aṅguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣo 'ṅguṣṭhaṃ ca samāśritaḥ | īśaḥ sarvasya jagataḥ prabhuḥ prīṇāti viśvabhuk || iti |
meaning: पुनर् आचम्य दक्षिणे पादाङ्गुष्ठे पाणी निस्रावयति । अङ्गुष्ठमात्रः पुरुषो ऽङ्गुष्ठं च समाश्रितः । ईशः सर्वस्य जगतः प्रभुः प्रीणाति विश्वभुक् ॥ इति ।
text: After sipping water a second time, he allows (the drops from) the hand to flow on the big toe of his right foot (and recites the following text): 'May the male be pleased, he who is of the size of a thumb, who occupies (a space of the size of) a thumb, who is the lord of the whole world, masterful, and the enjoyer of the universe.'

sanskrit_iast: hutānumantraṇam ūrdhvahastaḥ samācaret | śraddhāyāṃprāṇe niviśyāmṛtaṃ hutam | prāṇam annenāpyāyasva | śraddhāyāmapāne niviśyāmṛtaṃ hutam | prāṇam annenāpyāyasva | śraddhāyāṃvyāne niviśyāmṛtaṃ hutam | prāṇam annenāpyāyasva | śraddhāyāmudāne niviśyāmṛtaṃ hutam | prāṇam annenāpyāyasva | śraddhāyāṃsamāne niviśyāmṛtaṃ hutam | prāṇam annenāpyāyasveti | pañcabhiḥ |
meaning: हुतानुमन्त्रणम् ऊर्ध्वहस्तः समाचरेत् । श्रद्धायांप्राणे निविश्यामृतं हुतम् । प्राणम् अन्नेनाप्यायस्व । श्रद्धायामपाने निविश्यामृतं हुतम् । प्राणम् अन्नेनाप्यायस्व । श्रद्धायांव्याने निविश्यामृतं हुतम् । प्राणम् अन्नेनाप्यायस्व । श्रद्धायामुदाने निविश्यामृतं हुतम् । प्राणम् अन्नेनाप्यायस्व । श्रद्धायांसमाने निविश्यामृतं हुतम् । प्राणम् अन्नेनाप्यायस्वेति । पञ्चभिः ।
text: Let him perform the subsequent consecration (anumantraṇa) of the (food which has been) offered, with raised arms, (and let him recite) the five (texts beginning), 'With faith, worshipping Prāṇa, (I have) offered ambrosia; mayest thou increase Prāṇa through this food,'

sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇi ma ātmāmṛtatvāyeti |
meaning: ब्रह्मणि म आत्मामृतत्वायेति ।

sanskrit_iast: akṣareṇa cātmānaṃ yojayet |
meaning: अक्षरेण चात्मानं योजयेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: sarvakratuyājinām ātmayājī viśiṣyate |
meaning: सर्वक्रतुयाजिनाम् आत्मयाजी विशिष्यते ।

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति ।

sanskrit_iast: yathā hi tūlam aiṣīkam agnau protaṃ pradīpyate | tadvat sarvāṇi pāpāni dahyante hy ātmayājinaḥ |
meaning: यथा हि तूलम् ऐषीकम् अग्नौ प्रोतं प्रदीप्यते । तद्वत् सर्वाणि पापानि दह्यन्ते ह्य् आत्मयाजिनः ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'As cotton and reeds, thrown into a fire, blaze up, even so all the guilt of him who sacrifices to the soul is consumed;'

sanskrit_iast: kevalāgho bhavati kevalādī | mogham annaṃ vindateapracetā iti |
meaning: केवलाघो भवति केवलादी । मोघम् अन्नं विन्दतेअप्रचेता इति ।
text: (Moreover), 'He who eats merely (in order to satisfy his own hunger) reaps only guilt. In vain (the fool) takes food.'

sanskrit_iast: sa evam evāharahaḥ sāyaṃ prātar juhuyāt |
meaning: स एवम् एवाहरहः सायं प्रातर् जुहुयात् ।

sanskrit_iast: adbhir vā sāyam |
meaning: अद्भिर् वा सायम् ।

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | agre bhojayed atithīn antarvatnīr anantaram | bālavṛddhāṃs tathā dīnān vyādhitāṃś ca viśeṣataḥ | adattvā tu ya etebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ bhuṅkte yathāvidhi | bhujyamāno na jānāti na sa bhuṅkte sa bhujyate |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अग्रे भोजयेद् अतिथीन् अन्तर्वत्नीर् अनन्तरम् । बालवृद्धांस् तथा दीनान् व्याधितांश् च विशेषतः । अदत्त्वा तु य एतेभ्यः पूर्वं भुङ्क्ते यथाविधि । भुज्यमानो न जानाति न स भुङ्क्ते स भुज्यते ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): Let him first feed his guests, next the pregnant women, then the infants and the aged, thereafter the distressed and particularly the diseased. But he who eats first, without having given (food) to those (persons) according to the rule, does not know that he is being eaten. He does not eat, (but) he is eaten.'

sanskrit_iast: pitṛdaivatabhṛtyānāṃ mātāpitror guros tathā | vāgyato vighasam aśnīyād evaṃ dharmo vidhīyate || iti |
meaning: पितृदैवतभृत्यानां मातापित्रोर् गुरोस् तथा । वाग्यतो विघसम् अश्नीयाद् एवं धर्मो विधीयते ॥ इति ।
text: 'Let him eat silently what remains, (after he has given their portions) to the manes, the gods, the servants, his parents, and his Gurus; that is declared to be the rule of the sacred law.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | aṣṭau grāsā muner bhakṣyāḥ ṣoḍaśāraṇyavāsinaḥ | dvātriṃśat tu gṛhasthasya amitaṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अष्टौ ग्रासा मुनेर् भक्ष्याः षोडशारण्यवासिनः । द्वात्रिंशत् तु गृहस्थस्य अमितं ब्रह्मचारिणः ।
text: Nov they quote also (the following verses): Eight mouthfuls are the meal of an ascetic, sixteen that of a hermit in the woods, thirty-two that of a householder, and an unlimited (quantity) that of a student.'

sanskrit_iast: āhitāgnir anaḍvāṃś ca brahmacārī ca te trayaḥ | aśnanta eva sidhyanti naiṣāṃ siddhir anaśnatām || iti |
meaning: आहिताग्निर् अनड्वांश् च ब्रह्मचारी च ते त्रयः । अश्नन्त एव सिध्यन्ति नैषां सिद्धिर् अनश्नताम् ॥ इति ।
text: 'An Agnihotrin, a draught-ox, and, a student, those three can do their work only if they eat (much); without eating (much) they cannot do it.'

sanskrit_iast: gṛhastho brahmacārī vā yo 'naśnaṃs tu tapaś caret | prāṇāgnihotralopena avakīrṇī bhavet tu saḥ |
meaning: गृहस्थो ब्रह्मचारी वा यो ऽनश्नंस् तु तपश् चरेत् । प्राणाग्निहोत्रलोपेन अवकीर्णी भवेत् तु सः ।
text: 'A householder, or a student who practises austerity by fasting, becomes an Avakīrṇin through the omission of the sacrifice to the vital airs;'

sanskrit_iast: anyatra prāyaścittāt | prāyaścitte tad eva vidhānam |
meaning: अन्यत्र प्रायश्चित्तात् । प्रायश्चित्ते तद् एव विधानम् ।
text: Except when he performs a penance. In the case of a penance that (fasting) is the rule.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | antarā prātarāśaṃ ca sāyamāśaṃ tathaiva ca | sadopavāsī bhavati yo na bhuṅkte kadācana |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अन्तरा प्रातराशं च सायमाशं तथैव च । सदोपवासी भवति यो न भुङ्क्ते कदाचन ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'He who never eats between the morning and the evening meals, (obtains the same reward as he who) constantly fasts.'

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāgnihotramantrāṃs tu niruddhe bhojane japet | tretāgnihotramantrāṃs tu dravyālābhe yathā japet || iti |
meaning: प्राणाग्निहोत्रमन्त्रांस् तु निरुद्धे भोजने जपेत् । त्रेताग्निहोत्रमन्त्रांस् तु द्रव्यालाभे यथा जपेत् ॥ इति ।
text: 'As in case one obtains no materials (for the sacrifice), one must mutter the sacred texts to be recited at the Agnihotra, offered in the three fires, even so one should mutter the texts to be recited at the Prāṇāgnihotra, when one is prevented from dining.'

sanskrit_iast: evam ācaran brahmabhūyāya kalpate | brahmabhūyāya kalpata iti |
meaning: एवम् आचरन् ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते । ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पत इति ।
text: 'He who acts thus, will become one with Brahman.' Thus spake Pra g āpati (the lord of created beings).

sanskrit_iast: pitryam āyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ yaśasyaṃ puṣṭikarma ca |
meaning: पित्र्यम् आयुष्यं स्वर्ग्यं यशस्यं पुष्टिकर्म च ।
text: The offering to the manes secures long life and heaven, is worthy of praise and a rite ensuring prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: trimadhus triṇāciketas trisuparṇaḥ pañcāgniḥṣaḍaṅgavic chīrṣako jyeṣṭhasāmakaḥ snātaka iti paṅktipāvanāḥ |
meaning: त्रिमधुस् त्रिणाचिकेतस् त्रिसुपर्णः पञ्चाग्निःषडङ्गविच् छीर्षको ज्येष्ठसामकः स्नातक इति पङ्क्तिपावनाः ।
text: Persons who sanctify the company are, a Trimadhu, a Triṇā k iketa, a Trisuparṇa, one who keeps five fires, and one who knows the six Aṅgas, one who performs the vow called Śiras, one who knows the Gyesh th asāman, (and) a Snātaka;

sanskrit_iast: tadabhāve rahasyavit |
meaning: तदभावे रहस्यवित् ।
text: On failure of these, one who knows the (texts called) Rahasya.

sanskrit_iast: ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmānīti śrāddhasya mahimā | tasmādevaṃvidaṃ sapiṇḍam apy āśayet |
meaning: ऋचो यजूंषि सामानीति श्राद्धस्य महिमा । तस्मादेवंविदं सपिण्डम् अप्य् आशयेत् ।
text: The Ri k-verses, the Ya g us-formulas, and the Sāmans (give) lustre to a funeral offering. Therefore he may feed (on that occasion) even a Sapiṇd a relation who (knows) those (texts).

sanskrit_iast: rākṣoghnāni ca sāmāni svadhāvanti yajūṃṣi ca | madhvṛco 'tha pavitrāṇi śrāvayed āśayañ śanaiḥ |
meaning: राक्षोघ्नानि च सामानि स्वधावन्ति यजूंषि च । मध्वृचो ऽथ पवित्राणि श्रावयेद् आशयञ् शनैः ।
text: Let him who feeds (Brāhmaṇas at a funeral sacrifice) cause them to hear successively the Rakshoghna Sāmans, the Ya g us-formulas (called) Svadhāvat, the Ri k-verses (called) Madhu, and the (texts called) Pavitras.

sanskrit_iast: caraṇavato 'nūcānān yonigotramantrāsaṃbaddhāñ śucīn mantravatas tryavarān ayujaḥ pūrvedyuḥ prātar evavā nimantrya sadarbhopakḷpteṣv āsaneṣu prāṅmukhān upaveśayatyudaṅmukhān vā |
meaning: चरणवतो ऽनूचानान् योनिगोत्रमन्त्रासंबद्धाञ् शुचीन् मन्त्रवतस् त्र्यवरान् अयुजः पूर्वेद्युः प्रातर् एववा निमन्त्र्य सदर्भोपकॢप्तेष्व् आसनेषु प्राङ्मुखान् उपवेशयत्युदङ्मुखान् वा ।
text: Having invited on the day before (the Śrāddha), or just in the morning, virtuous, pure (men), such as Trimadhus, who know the Vedāṅgas and the sacred texts, who are not related by marriage, nor members of the same family, nor connected through the Veda, at least three, (but always) an odd number, the (sacrificer) makes them sit down on prepared seats, covered with Darbha grass, facing the east or the north.

sanskrit_iast: athaināṃs tilamiśrā apaḥ pratigrāhya gandhair mālyaiścālaṃkṛtya | agnau kariṣyāmīti | anujñāto gnim upasamādhāya saṃparistīryāgnimukhāt kṛtvānnasyaiva tisra āhutīr juhoti | somāya pitṛpītāya svadhā namaḥ svāhā | yamāyāṅgirasvate pitṛmate svadhā namaḥ svāhā | agnayekavyavāhanāya sviṣṭakṛte svadhā namaḥ svāheti |
meaning: अथैनांस् तिलमिश्रा अपः प्रतिग्राह्य गन्धैर् माल्यैश्चालंकृत्य । अग्नौ करिष्यामीति । अनुज्ञातो ग्निम् उपसमाधाय संपरिस्तीर्याग्निमुखात् कृत्वान्नस्यैव तिस्र आहुतीर् जुहोति । सोमाय पितृपीताय स्वधा नमः स्वाहा । यमायाङ्गिरस्वते पितृमते स्वधा नमः स्वाहा । अग्नयेकव्यवाहनाय स्विष्टकृते स्वधा नमः स्वाहेति ।
text: Then he offers to them water mixed with sesamum seed, adorns them with scents and garlands (and says), 'I wish to offer oblations in the fire.' [paragraph continues] When he has received permission (to do so), he heaps fuel on the sacred fire, scatters Kuśa grass around it, performs (all the ceremonies) up to the end of the Agnimukha, and offers three burnt oblations of food only, (reciting the following texts): 'To Soma, accompanied by the manes, Svāhā!' 'To Yama, accompanied by the Aṅgiras and by the manes, Svāhā!' 'To Agni, who carries the offerings to the manes, who causes sacrifices to be well performed, Svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: taccheṣeṇānnam abhighāryānnasyaitā eva tisro juhuyāt |
meaning: तच्छेषेणान्नम् अभिघार्यान्नस्यैता एव तिस्रो जुहुयात् ।
text: He shall make these three oblations with food only which has been sprinkled with the remainder of the (clarified butter).

sanskrit_iast: vayasāṃ piṇḍaṃ dadyāt |
meaning: वयसां पिण्डं दद्यात् ।
text: Let him give a cake of food to the birds.

sanskrit_iast: vayasāṃ hi pitaraḥ pratimayā carantīti vijñāyate |
meaning: वयसां हि पितरः प्रतिमया चरन्तीति विज्ञायते ।
text: For it is declared in the Veda, 'The manes roam about in the shape of birds.'

sanskrit_iast: athetarat sāṅguṣṭhena pāṇinābhimṛśati |
meaning: अथेतरत् साङ्गुष्ठेन पाणिनाभिमृशति ।
text: Next he touches the (other food) with his hand and with the thumb,

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivīsamantasya te 'gnir upadraṣṭarcas te mahimā dattasyāpramādāya pṛthivī te pātraṃ dyaurapidhānaṃ brahmaṇas tvā mukhe juhomi brāhmaṇānāṃ tvā vidyāvatāṃprāṇāpānayor juhomy akṣitam asi mā pitqṇāṃ kṣeṣṭhā amutrāmuṣmiṃloka iti | antarikṣasamantasya te vāyur upaśrotā yajūṃṣi te mahimā dattasyāpramādāya pṛthivī te pātraṃdyaur apidhānaṃ brahmaṇas tvā mukhe juhomi brāhmaṇānāṃ tvāvidyāvatāṃ prāṇāpānayor juhomy akṣitam asi mā pitāmahānāṃ kṣeṣṭhā amutrāmuṣmiṃ loka iti | dyusamantasya ta ādityo 'nukhyātāsāmāni te mahimā dattasya apramādāya pṛthivī te pātraṃ dyaurapidhānaṃ brahmaṇas tvā mukhe juhomi brāhmaṇānāṃ tvā vidyāvatāṃprāṇāpānayor juhomy akṣitam asi mā prapitāmahānāṃ kṣeṣṭhāamutrāmuṣmiṃ loka iti |
meaning: पृथिवीसमन्तस्य ते ऽग्निर् उपद्रष्टर्चस् ते महिमा दत्तस्याप्रमादाय पृथिवी ते पात्रं द्यौरपिधानं ब्रह्मणस् त्वा मुखे जुहोमि ब्राह्मणानां त्वा विद्यावतांप्राणापानयोर् जुहोम्य् अक्षितम् असि मा पित्qणां क्षेष्ठा अमुत्रामुष्मिंलोक इति । अन्तरिक्षसमन्तस्य ते वायुर् उपश्रोता यजूंषि ते महिमा दत्तस्याप्रमादाय पृथिवी ते पात्रंद्यौर् अपिधानं ब्रह्मणस् त्वा मुखे जुहोमि ब्राह्मणानां त्वाविद्यावतां प्राणापानयोर् जुहोम्य् अक्षितम् असि मा पितामहानां क्षेष्ठा अमुत्रामुष्मिं लोक इति । द्युसमन्तस्य त आदित्यो ऽनुख्यातासामानि ते महिमा दत्तस्य अप्रमादाय पृथिवी ते पात्रं द्यौरपिधानं ब्रह्मणस् त्वा मुखे जुहोमि ब्राह्मणानां त्वा विद्यावतांप्राणापानयोर् जुहोम्य् अक्षितम् असि मा प्रपितामहानां क्षेष्ठाअमुत्रामुष्मिं लोक इति ।
text: (And recites the following texts): 'Fire sees thee, who art co-extensive with the earth, the Ri k-verses are thy greatness, lest the gift be in vain; the earth is the vessel for thee, the sky the cover; I offer thee in the mouth of Brahman, I offer thee in the Prāṇa and the Apāna of learned Brāhmaṇas; thou art imperishable, mayest thou never fail to (the manes of our) fathers yonder, in the other world.' 'Air hears thee, who art co-extensive with the middle sphere, the Ya g us-formulas are thy greatness, lest the gift be in vain; the earth is the vessel for thee, the sky the cover; . . . mayest thou never fail to the (manes of our) grandfathers yonder, in the other world.' 'The sun reveals thee, who art co-extensive with the sky, the Sāmans are thy greatness, lest the gift be in vain; . . . . mayest thou never fail to the (manes of our) great-grandfathers yonder, in the other world.'

sanskrit_iast: atha vai bhavati |
meaning: अथ वै भवति ।
text: Now indeed (that) happens (also which the following verses teach):

sanskrit_iast: agnau karaṇaśeṣeṇa tad annam abhighārayet | niraṅguṣṭhaṃ tu yad dattaṃ na tat prīṇāti vai pitqn |
meaning: अग्नौ करणशेषेण तद् अन्नम् अभिघारयेत् । निरङ्गुष्ठं तु यद् दत्तं न तत् प्रीणाति वै पित्qन् ।
text: 'Let him sprinkle that food with the remainder of the burnt oblations. But what is given without (touching it with) the thumb does not gladden the manes.'

sanskrit_iast: ubhayoḥ śākhayor muktaṃ pitṛbhyo 'nnaṃ niveditam | tad antaram upāsante asurā duṣṭacetasaḥ |
meaning: उभयोः शाखयोर् मुक्तं पितृभ्यो ऽन्नं निवेदितम् । तद् अन्तरम् उपासन्ते असुरा दुष्टचेतसः ।
text: 'The malevolent Asuras seek an opportunity (to snatch away) that food intended for the manes, which is not supported with both hands.'

sanskrit_iast: yātudhānāḥ piśācāś ca pratilumpanti tad haviḥ | tiladāne hy adāyāś ca tathā krodhavaśe 'surāḥ |
meaning: यातुधानाः पिशाचाश् च प्रतिलुम्पन्ति तद् हविः । तिलदाने ह्य् अदायाश् च तथा क्रोधवशे ऽसुराः ।
text: 'The Yātudhānas and Piśā k as, who receive no share, steal the food if sesamum grains are not scattered (on the seats of the guests), and the Asuras (take it) if (the host) is under the sway of anger.'

sanskrit_iast: kāṣāyavāsā yān kurute japahomapratigrahān | na tad devaṃgamaṃ bhavati havyakavyeṣuyad haviḥ |
meaning: काषायवासा यान् कुरुते जपहोमप्रतिग्रहान् । न तद् देवंगमं भवति हव्यकव्येषुयद् हविः ।
text: 'If a person dressed in reddish clothes mutters prayers, offers burnt oblations, or receives gifts, the sacrificial viands, offered at sacrifices to the gods or to the manes, do not reach the deities.'

sanskrit_iast: yac ca dattam anaṅguṣṭhaṃ yac caiva pratigṛhyate | ācāmati ca yas tiṣṭhan na sa tena samṛdhyate || iti |
meaning: यच् च दत्तम् अनङ्गुष्ठं यच् चैव प्रतिगृह्यते । आचामति च यस् तिष्ठन् न स तेन समृध्यते ॥ इति ।
text: 'If gifts are given or received without (touching them with) the thumb and, if one sips water standing, (the performer of the act) is not benefited thereby.'

sanskrit_iast: ādyantayor apāṃ pradānaṃ sarvatra |
meaning: आद्यन्तयोर् अपां प्रदानं सर्वत्र ।
text: At the beginning and at the end (of a Śrāddha) water must be giver. (to the guests).

sanskrit_iast: jayaprabhṛti yathāvidhānam |
meaning: जयप्रभृति यथाविधानम् ।
text: In every case the muttering (of sacred texts) and the other (necessary acts must be performed) according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣam uktam aṣṭakāhome |
meaning: शेषम् उक्तम् अष्टकाहोमे ।
text: The remaining (rules) have been prescribed (in the section) on the burnt oblations on Ashṭakā (days).

sanskrit_iast: dvau daive pitṛkārye trīn ekaikam ubhayatra vā | bhojayet susamṛddho 'pi na prasajyeta vistare |
meaning: द्वौ दैवे पितृकार्ये त्रीन् एकैकम् उभयत्र वा । भोजयेत् सुसमृद्धो ऽपि न प्रसज्येत विस्तरे ।
text: 'He shall feed two (Brāhmaṇas) at the offering to the gods and three at the offering to the manes, or a single man on either occasion. Even a very wealthy man shall not be anxious (to entertain) a large company.'

sanskrit_iast: satkriyāṃ deśakālau ca śaucaṃ brāhmaṇasaṃpadam | pañcaitān vistaro hanti tasmāt taṃ parivarjayet |
meaning: सत्क्रियां देशकालौ च शौचं ब्राह्मणसंपदम् । पञ्चैतान् विस्तरो हन्ति तस्मात् तं परिवर्जयेत् ।
text: 'A large company destroys these five (advantages), the respectful treatment (of the invited guests, the propriety of) time and place, purity and (the selection of) virtuous Brāhmaṇa (guests); therefore he shall not invite (a large number).'

sanskrit_iast: urastaḥ pitaras tasya vāmataś ca pitāmahāḥ | dakṣiṇataḥ prapitāmahāḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ piṇḍatarkakāḥ || iti |
meaning: उरस्तः पितरस् तस्य वामतश् च पितामहाः । दक्षिणतः प्रपितामहाः पृष्ठतः पिण्डतर्ककाः ॥ इति ।
text: 'In front (feed) the fathers of the (sacrificer), to the left the grandfathers, to the right the great-grandfathers, and at the back those who pare off (portions) from the cakes.'

sanskrit_iast: prajākāmasyopadeśaḥ |
meaning: प्रजाकामस्योपदेशः ।
text: (Now follows some) advice for him who is desirous of offspring.

sanskrit_iast: prajanananimittā samākhyety aśvināv ūcatuḥ |
meaning: प्रजनननिमित्ता समाख्येत्य् अश्विनाव् ऊचतुः ।
text: The two Aśvins have declared, that fame is gained by the procreation (of sons);

sanskrit_iast: āyuṣā tapasā yuktaḥ svādhyāyejyāparāyaṇaḥ | prajām utpādayed yuktaḥ svesve varṇe jitendriyaḥ |
meaning: आयुषा तपसा युक्तः स्वाध्यायेज्यापरायणः । प्रजाम् उत्पादयेद् युक्तः स्वेस्वे वर्णे जितेन्द्रियः ।
text: 'Performing acts which tend to prolong life and austerities, intent on the performance of the private recitation and of sacrifices, and keeping his organs in subjection, let him carefully beget offspring in his own caste.'

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇasyarṇasaṃyogas tribhir bhavati janmataḥ | tāni mucyātmavān bhavati vimukto dharmasaṃśayāt |
meaning: ब्राह्मणस्यर्णसंयोगस् त्रिभिर् भवति जन्मतः । तानि मुच्यात्मवान् भवति विमुक्तो धर्मसंशयात् ।
text: 'From his birth a Brāhmaṇa is loaded with three debts; these let him pay. A prudent man is free from doubts regarding the sacred law.'

sanskrit_iast: svādhyāyena ṛṣīn pūjya somena ca puraṃdaram | prajayā ca pitqn pūrvān anṛṇo divi modate |
meaning: स्वाध्यायेन ऋषीन् पूज्य सोमेन च पुरंदरम् । प्रजया च पित्qन् पूर्वान् अनृणो दिवि मोदते ।
text: 'If he worships the sages through the study of the Veda, Indra with Soma sacrifices, and the manes of his ancestors through (the procreation of) children, he will rejoice in heaven, free from debt.'

sanskrit_iast: putreṇa lokāñ jayati pautreṇānantyam aśnute | atha putrasya pautreṇa nākam evādhirohati || iti |
meaning: पुत्रेण लोकाञ् जयति पौत्रेणानन्त्यम् अश्नुते । अथ पुत्रस्य पौत्रेण नाकम् एवाधिरोहति ॥ इति ।
text: 'Through a son he conquers the worlds, through a grandson he obtains immortality, but through his son's grandson he ascends to the (highest) heaven.' (All that) has been declared in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyate ca | jāyamāno vai brāhmaṇas tribhir ṛṇavā jāyate brahmacaryeṇarṣibhyo yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayā pitṛbhya iti | evam ṛṇasaṃyogaṃ vedo darśayati |
meaning: विज्ञायते च । जायमानो वै ब्राह्मणस् त्रिभिर् ऋणवा जायते ब्रह्मचर्येणर्षिभ्यो यज्ञेन देवेभ्यः प्रजया पितृभ्य इति । एवम् ऋणसंयोगं वेदो दर्शयति ।
text: The Veda shows the existence of the three debts in the following (passage): 'A Brāhmaṇa is born loaded with three debts; (he owes) the studentship to the sages, sacrifices to the gods, and a son to the manes;'

sanskrit_iast: satputram utpādyātmānaṃ tārayati |
meaning: सत्पुत्रम् उत्पाद्यात्मानं तारयति ।
text: Through the procreation of a virtuous son he saves himself.

sanskrit_iast: saptāvarān sapta pūrvān ṣaḍ anyān ātmasaptamān | satputram adhigacchānas tārayaty enaso bhayāt |
meaning: सप्तावरान् सप्त पूर्वान् षड् अन्यान् आत्मसप्तमान् । सत्पुत्रम् अधिगच्छानस् तारयत्य् एनसो भयात् ।
text: He who obtains a virtuous son saves from the fear of sin seven in the descending line and seven in the ascending line, (viz.) six others (in each), himself being the seventh.

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt prajāsaṃtānam utpādya phalam avāpnoti |
meaning: तस्मात् प्रजासंतानम् उत्पाद्य फलम् अवाप्नोति ।
text: Therefore he obtains a reward if he begets issue.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād yatnavān prajām utpādayet |
meaning: तस्माद् यत्नवान् प्रजाम् उत्पादयेत् ।
text: Therefore he should sedulously beget offspring,

sanskrit_iast: auṣadhamantrasaṃyogena |
meaning: औषधमन्त्रसंयोगेन ।
text: Through the application of medicines and sacred texts.

sanskrit_iast: tasyopadeśaḥ śrutisāmānyenopadiśyate |
meaning: तस्योपदेशः श्रुतिसामान्येनोपदिश्यते ।
text: The advice to him (who is intent on the procreation of children) is given in agreement with the revealed texts.

sanskrit_iast: sarvavarṇebhyaḥ phalavattvād iti | phalavattvād iti |
meaning: सर्ववर्णेभ्यः फलवत्त्वाद् इति । फलवत्त्वाद् इति ।
text: For it produces results in the case of all the castes.

sanskrit_iast: athātaḥ saṃnyāsavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ |
meaning: अथातः संन्यासविधिं व्याख्यास्यामः ।
text: Now we will explain the rule for entering the order of ascetics (saṃnyāsa).

sanskrit_iast: so 'ta eva brahmacaryavān pravrajatīty ekeṣām |
meaning: सो ऽत एव ब्रह्मचर्यवान् प्रव्रजतीत्य् एकेषाम् ।
text: Some (teachers say), 'He who has finished his studentship may become an ascetic immediately on (the completion of) that.'

sanskrit_iast: atha śālīnayāyāvarāṇām anapatyānām |
meaning: अथ शालीनयायावराणाम् अनपत्यानाम् ।
text: But (according to others, asceticism is befitting) for Sālīnas and Yāyāvaras who are childless;

sanskrit_iast: vidhuro vā prajāḥ svadharme pratiṣṭhāpya vā |
meaning: विधुरो वा प्रजाः स्वधर्मे प्रतिष्ठाप्य वा ।
text: Or a widower (may become an ascetic).

sanskrit_iast: saptatyā ūrdhvaṃ saṃnyāsam upadiśanti |
meaning: सप्तत्या ऊर्ध्वं संन्यासम् उपदिशन्ति ।
text: (In general) they prescribe the profession of asceticism after the completion of the seventieth year and after the children have been firmly settled in (the performance of) their sacred duties.

sanskrit_iast: vānaprasthasya vā karmavirāme |
meaning: वानप्रस्थस्य वा कर्मविरामे ।
text: Or a hermit in the woods (may become an ascetic) on finishing the (special) ceremonies (prescribed for him).

sanskrit_iast: eṣa nityo mahimā brāhmaṇasya na karmaṇā vardhate nokanīyān | tasyaivātmā padavit taṃ viditvā na karmaṇā lipyatepāpakena || iti |
meaning: एष नित्यो महिमा ब्राह्मणस्य न कर्मणा वर्धते नोकनीयान् । तस्यैवात्मा पदवित् तं विदित्वा न कर्मणा लिप्यतेपापकेन ॥ इति ।
text: 'That eternal greatness of the Brāhmaṇa is neither increased nor diminished by works. The soul knows the nature of that (greatness). He who knows that, is not stained by evil deeds.'

sanskrit_iast: apunarbhavaṃ nayatīti nityaḥ |
meaning: अपुनर्भवं नयतीति नित्यः ।
text: 'It leads to the cessation of births.'

sanskrit_iast: mahad enaṃ gamayatīti mahimā |
meaning: महद् एनं गमयतीति महिमा ।
text: 'The eternal one leads (him) to glory.' The greatness (of asceticism is declared by these passages).

sanskrit_iast: keśaśmaśrulomanakhāni vāpayitvopakalpayate |
meaning: केशश्मश्रुलोमनखानि वापयित्वोपकल्पयते ।
text: After having caused the hair of his head, his beard, the hair on his body, and his nails to be cut, he prepares

sanskrit_iast: yaṣṭayaḥ śikyaṃ jalapavitraṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ pātram iti |
meaning: यष्टयः शिक्यं जलपवित्रं कमण्डलुं पात्रम् इति ।
text: Sticks, a rope, a cloth for straining water, a water vessel, and an alms-bowl.

sanskrit_iast: etat samādāya grāmānte grāmasīmānte 'gnyagārevājyaṃ payo dadhīti trivṛt prāśyopavaset |
meaning: एतत् समादाय ग्रामान्ते ग्रामसीमान्ते ऽग्न्यगारेवाज्यं पयो दधीति त्रिवृत् प्राश्योपवसेत् ।
text: Taking these (implements, let him go) to the extremity of the village, or to- the extremity of the boundary (of the village), or to the house where the sacred fires are kept, partake of a threefold (mixture of) clarified butter, milk, (and) sour milk, and (afterwards) fast;

sanskrit_iast: apo vā |
meaning: अपो वा ।
text: Or (he may partake of) water.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ bhūḥ sāvitrīṃ praviśāmi tat savitur vareṇyam | oṃbhuvaḥ sāvitrīṃ praviśāmi bhargo devasya dhīmahi | oṃ suvaḥ sāvitrīṃ praviśāmi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayād iti | paccho padśo 'rdharcaśastataḥ samastayā ca vyastayā ca |
meaning: ओं भूः सावित्रीं प्रविशामि तत् सवितुर् वरेण्यम् । ओंभुवः सावित्रीं प्रविशामि भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि । ओं सुवः सावित्रीं प्रविशामि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयाद् इति । पच्छो पद्शो ऽर्धर्चशस्ततः समस्तया च व्यस्तया च ।
text: (Saying), 'Om, Bhū h , I enter the Sāvitrī, tat savitur vareṇyam; Om, Bhuva h , I enter the Sāvitrī, bhargo devasya dhīmahi; Om, I enter the Sāvitrī, dhiyo yo naḥpr.akodayāt;' (he shall recite the Sāvitrī) foot by foot, half-verse by half-verse, (and finish by repeating) the whole or the parts (of the verse).

sanskrit_iast: ātmānam ātmana āśramādāśramam upanīya brahmapūto bhavatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: आत्मानम् आत्मन आश्रमादाश्रमम् उपनीय ब्रह्मपूतो भवतीति विज्ञायते ।
text: It is declared in the Veda, 'Entering order after order, (man) becomes (one with) Brahman.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | āśramād āśramaṃ gatvā hutahomo jitendriyaḥ | bhikṣābalipariśrāntaḥ paścād bhavati bhikṣukaḥ || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । आश्रमाद् आश्रमं गत्वा हुतहोमो जितेन्द्रियः । भिक्षाबलिपरिश्रान्तः पश्चाद् भवति भिक्षुकः ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse) 'He who has passed from order to order, has offered burnt oblations and kept his organs in subjection, becomes afterwards, tired with (giving) alms and (making) offerings, an ascetic.'

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa bhikṣur ānantyāya |
meaning: स एष भिक्षुर् आनन्त्याय ।
text: Such an ascetic (becomes one with) the infinite (Brahman).

sanskrit_iast: purādityasyāstamayād gārhapatyam upasamādhāyānvāhāryapacanam āhṛtya jvalantam āhavanīyam uddhṛtya gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā samidvaty āhavanīye pūrṇāhutiṃ juhoti | oṃ svāheti |
meaning: पुरादित्यस्यास्तमयाद् गार्हपत्यम् उपसमाधायान्वाहार्यपचनम् आहृत्य ज्वलन्तम् आहवनीयम् उद्धृत्य गार्हपत्य आज्यं विलाप्योत्पूय स्रुचि चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वा समिद्वत्य् आहवनीये पूर्णाहुतिं जुहोति । ओं स्वाहेति ।
text: Before the sun sets, he heaps fuel on the Gārhapatya fire, brings the Anvāhāryapa k ana fire (to the spot), takes the flaming Āhavanīya. fire out (of the Gārhapatya), melts butter on the Gārhapatya fire, cleanses it (with Kuśa grass), takes four times (portions of it) in the sacrificial spoon (called Sru k ), and offers in the Āhavanīya fire on which sacred fuel has been heaped, (four times) a full oblation, (saying), 'Om, Svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: etad brahmānvādhānam iti vijñāyate |
meaning: एतद् ब्रह्मान्वाधानम् इति विज्ञायते ।
text: It is declared in the Veda that this (offering is) the Brahmānvādhāna (putting fuel on the sacred fires for the sake of the universal soul).

sanskrit_iast: atha sāyaṃ hute 'gnihotra uttareṇa gārhapatyaṃ tṛṇāni saṃstīrya teṣu dvaṃdvaṃ nyañci pātrāṇi sādayitvādakṣiṇenāhavanīyaṃ brahmāyatane darbhān saṃstīrya teṣukṛṣṇājinaṃ cāntardhāyaitāṃ rātriṃ jāgarti |
meaning: अथ सायं हुते ऽग्निहोत्र उत्तरेण गार्हपत्यं तृणानि संस्तीर्य तेषु द्वंद्वं न्यञ्चि पात्राणि सादयित्वादक्षिणेनाहवनीयं ब्रह्मायतने दर्भान् संस्तीर्य तेषुकृष्णाजिनं चान्तर्धायैतां रात्रिं जागर्ति ।
text: Now in the evening, after the Agnihotra has been offered, he scatters grass to the north of the Gārhapatya fire, places the sacrificial vessels in pairs, the upper part turned downwards, on it, strews Darbha grass to the south of the Āhavanīya fire on the seat destined for the Brahman priest, covers it with the skin of a black antelope, and remains awake during that night.

sanskrit_iast: ya evaṃ vidvān brahmarātrim upoṣya brāhmaṇo 'gnīn samāropya pramīyate sarvaṃ pāpmānaṃ tarati taratibrahmahatyām |
meaning: य एवं विद्वान् ब्रह्मरात्रिम् उपोष्य ब्राह्मणो ऽग्नीन् समारोप्य प्रमीयते सर्वं पाप्मानं तरति तरतिब्रह्महत्याम् ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa who, knowing this, dies after fasting during the night of Brahman and repositing within himself the sacred fires, conquers all guilt, even (that of) killing a Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: atha brāhme muhūrta utthāya kāla eva prātaragnihotraṃ juhoti |
meaning: अथ ब्राह्मे मुहूर्त उत्थाय काल एव प्रातरग्निहोत्रं जुहोति ।
text: Then he rises in the muhūrta sacred to Brahman, and offers the early Agnihotra just at the (appointed) time.

sanskrit_iast: atha pṛṣṭhyāṃ stīrtvāpaḥ praṇīya vaiśvānaraṃdvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati | sā prasiddheṣṭiḥ saṃtiṣṭhate |
meaning: अथ पृष्ठ्यां स्तीर्त्वापः प्रणीय वैश्वानरंद्वादशकपालं निर्वपति । सा प्रसिद्धेष्टिः संतिष्ठते ।
text: Next, after covering the (part of the altar called) P ri sh th yā and bringing water, he prepares (an offering) to (Agni) Vaiśvānara (which is cooked) in twelve potsherds. That (well-)known Ishṭi is the last (which he performs).

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīye 'gnihotrapātrāṇi prakṣipaty amṛnmayānyanaśmamayāni |
meaning: आहवनीये ऽग्निहोत्रपात्राणि प्रक्षिपत्य् अमृन्मयान्यनश्ममयानि ।
text: Afterwards he throws the sacrificial vessels, which are neither made of earth nor of stone, into the Āhavanīya fire,

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatye 'raṇī | bhavataṃ naḥ samanasāv iti |
meaning: गार्हपत्ये ऽरणी । भवतं नः समनसाव् इति ।
text: (And) throwing the two Araṇis into the Gārhapatya fire (with the words), 'May ye be of one mind with us,' he reposits the sacred fires in himself.

sanskrit_iast: ātmany agnīn samāropayate | yā te agneyajñiyā tanūr iti tris trir ekaikaṃ samājighrati |
meaning: आत्मन्य् अग्नीन् समारोपयते । या ते अग्नेयज्ञिया तनूर् इति त्रिस् त्रिर् एकैकं समाजिघ्रति ।
text: (Reciting the sacred text), 'O Fire, that body of thine, which is fit for the sacrifice,' he inhales the smell of (the smoke of) each fire thrice three times.

sanskrit_iast: athāntarvedi tiṣṭhan | oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ suvaḥ saṃnyastaṃmayā saṃnyastaṃ mayā saṃnyastaṃ mayeti | trir upāṃśūktvā triruccaiḥ |
meaning: अथान्तर्वेदि तिष्ठन् । ओं भूर् भुवः सुवः संन्यस्तंमया संन्यस्तं मया संन्यस्तं मयेति । त्रिर् उपांशूक्त्वा त्रिरुच्चैः ।
text: Then, standing within the sacrificial enclosure, (he says) thrice in a low voice and thrice aloud, 'Om, Bhū h , Bhuva h , Sva h , I have entered the order of ascetics, I have entered the order of ascetics, I have entered the order of ascetics,'

sanskrit_iast: triṣatyā hi devā iti vijñāyate |
meaning: त्रिषत्या हि देवा इति विज्ञायते ।
text: It is declared in the Veda, 'The gods are trebly true.'

sanskrit_iast: abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo matta iti cāpāṃ pūrṇam añjaliṃ ninayati |
meaning: अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो मत्त इति चापां पूर्णम् अञ्जलिं निनयति ।
text: (Finally) he pours out as much water as will fill his joined hands, (saying), 'I promise not to injure any living being.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo dattvā yaś carate muniḥ | na tasya sarvabhūtebhyo bhayaṃ cāpīha jāyate || iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो दत्त्वा यश् चरते मुनिः । न तस्य सर्वभूतेभ्यो भयं चापीह जायते ॥ इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse) An ascetic who roams about after having given a promise of safety to all living beings, is not threatened with danger by any creature.'

sanskrit_iast: sa vācaṃyamo bhavati |
meaning: स वाचंयमो भवति ।
text: (Henceforth) he must restrain his speech.

sanskrit_iast: sakhā mā gopāyeti daṇḍam ādatte |
meaning: सखा मा गोपायेति दण्डम् आदत्ते ।
text: He grasps his staff, (saying), '(Thou art my) friend, protect me.'

sanskrit_iast: yad asya pāre rajasa iti śikyaṃ gṛhṇāti |
meaning: यद् अस्य पारे रजस इति शिक्यं गृह्णाति ।
text: He takes the rope, (reciting the verse), 'The brilliant light,' &c.

sanskrit_iast: yena devāḥ pavitreṇeti jalapavitraṃ gṛhṇāti |
meaning: येन देवाः पवित्रेणेति जलपवित्रं गृह्णाति ।
text: He takes the cloth for straining water, (reciting the text), 'With which means of purification the gods,' &c.

sanskrit_iast: yena devā jyotiṣordhvā udāyann iti kamaṇḍaluṃ gṛhṇāti |
meaning: येन देवा ज्योतिषोर्ध्वा उदायन्न् इति कमण्डलुं गृह्णाति ।
text: He takes the waterpot, (reciting the verse), Through that light, by which the gods rose on high,' &c.

sanskrit_iast: saptavyāhṛtibhiḥ pātraṃ gṛhṇāti |
meaning: सप्तव्याहृतिभिः पात्रं गृह्णाति ।
text: He takes the alms-bowl, (reciting the Vyāh ri tis).

sanskrit_iast: yaṣṭayaḥ śikyaṃ jalapavitraṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ pātram ity etat samādāya yatrāpas tatra gatvā snātvāpa ācamyasurabhimatyābliṅgābhir vāruṇībhir hiraṇyavarṇābhiḥ pāvamānībhiriti mārjayitvāntarjalagato 'ghamarṣaṇena ṣoḍaśa prāṇāyāmān dhārayitvottīrya vāsaḥ pīḍayitvānyat prayataṃ vāsaḥ paridhāyāpa ācamya | oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar iti | jalapavitram ādāya tarpayati | oṃ bhūs tarpayāmi | oṃ bhuvas tarpayāmi | oṃsuvas tarpayāmi | oṃ mahas tarpayāmi | oṃ janas tarpayāmi | oṃ tapas tarpayāmi | oṃ satyaṃ tarpayāmīti |
meaning: यष्टयः शिक्यं जलपवित्रं कमण्डलुं पात्रम् इत्य् एतत् समादाय यत्रापस् तत्र गत्वा स्नात्वाप आचम्यसुरभिमत्याब्लिङ्गाभिर् वारुणीभिर् हिरण्यवर्णाभिः पावमानीभिरिति मार्जयित्वान्तर्जलगतो ऽघमर्षणेन षोडश प्राणायामान् धारयित्वोत्तीर्य वासः पीडयित्वान्यत् प्रयतं वासः परिधायाप आचम्य । ओं भूर् भुवः सुवर् इति । जलपवित्रम् आदाय तर्पयति । ओं भूस् तर्पयामि । ओं भुवस् तर्पयामि । ओंसुवस् तर्पयामि । ओं महस् तर्पयामि । ओं जनस् तर्पयामि । ओं तपस् तर्पयामि । ओं सत्यं तर्पयामीति ।
text: Taking with him the staves, the rope, the cloth for straining water, the waterpot, (and) the alms-bowl, he goes where water (is to be obtained), bathes, sips water, (and) washes himself, (reciting the verses called) Surabhimatī, Abliṅgās, Vāruṇīs, Hiraṇyavarṇās, and Pāvamānīs. Entering the water, he performs sixteen suppressions of the breath, (mentally repeating) the Aghamarshaṇa hymn, ascends the bank, wrings out his dress, puts on another pure dress, sips water, takes the cloth for straining, (saying), 'Om, Bhū h , Bhuva h , Sva h ,' and performs the Tarpaṇa (with the following texts), 'Om, Bhū h , I satiate,' 'Om, Bhuva h --, Om, Sva h --, Om, Maha h --, Om, Gana h --, Om, Tapa h --, Om, Satyam --.'

sanskrit_iast: devavat pitṛbhyo 'ñjalim ādāya | oṃ bhūḥ svadhā | oṃ bhuvaḥ svadhā | oṃ suvaḥ svadhā | oṃbhūr bhuvaḥ suvar mahar nama iti |
meaning: देववत् पितृभ्यो ऽञ्जलिम् आदाय । ओं भूः स्वधा । ओं भुवः स्वधा । ओं सुवः स्वधा । ओंभूर् भुवः सुवर् महर् नम इति ।
text: He takes up as much water as his joined hands will hold for the manes, (and satiates them with it) exactly in the same manner as the gods, (saying), 'Om, Bhū h Svadhā, Om, Bhuva h Svadhā,' &c.

sanskrit_iast: atha | ud u tyam | citram iti | dvābhyām ādityam upatiṣṭhate |
meaning: अथ । उद् उ त्यम् । चित्रम् इति । द्वाभ्याम् आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठते ।
text: Then he worships the sun, (reciting) the two verses (which begin), 'Ud u tyaṃk itram,' &c.

sanskrit_iast: om iti brahma brahma vā eṣa jyotir ya eṣa tapaty eṣa vedo ya eṣa tapati vedyam evaitad ya eṣa tapati | evam evaiṣa ātmānaṃ tarpayati | ātmane namaḥkaroti | ātmābrahmātmā jyotiḥ |
meaning: ओम् इति ब्रह्म ब्रह्म वा एष ज्योतिर् य एष तपत्य् एष वेदो य एष तपति वेद्यम् एवैतद् य एष तपति । एवम् एवैष आत्मानं तर्पयति । आत्मने नमःकरोति । आत्माब्रह्मात्मा ज्योतिः ।
text: (Saying), 'Om, this (syllable Om), forsooth, is Brahman; this (syllable) which sheds warmth is light; this which gives warmth is the Veda; this must be known as that which sheds warmth;' he thus satiates the soul (and afterwards) worships the soul (with these texts), 'The soul (is) Brahman, (is) light.'

sanskrit_iast: sāvitrīṃ sahasrakṛtva āvartayec chatakṛtvo 'parimitakṛtvo vā |
meaning: सावित्रीं सहस्रकृत्व आवर्तयेच् छतकृत्वो ऽपरिमितकृत्वो वा ।
text: Let him repeat the Sāvitrī one thousand times, or one hundred times, or an unlimited number of times.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar iti jalapavitram ādāyāpo gṛhṇāti |
meaning: ओं भूर् भुवः सुवर् इति जलपवित्रम् आदायापो गृह्णाति ।
text: (Saying), 'Bhū h , Bhuva h , Suva h ,' he takes up the cloth for straining, (and) fetches water.

sanskrit_iast: nāta ūrdhvam anuddhṛtābhir adbhiraparisrutābhir aparipūtābhir vācāmet |
meaning: नात ऊर्ध्वम् अनुद्धृताभिर् अद्भिरपरिस्रुताभिर् अपरिपूताभिर् वाचामेत् ।
text: Let him not, (at any period) after that (moment), sip water which has not been drawn up (from a well and the like), which has not been strained, and which has not been completely cleansed.

sanskrit_iast: na cāta ūrdhvaṃ śuklaṃ vāso dhārayet |
meaning: न चात ऊर्ध्वं शुक्लं वासो धारयेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: ekadaṇḍī tridaṇḍī vā |
meaning: एकदण्डी त्रिदण्डी वा ।
text: Now the following vows are (to be kept by an ascetic):

sanskrit_iast: athemāni vratāni bhavanti | ahiṃsā satyam astainyaṃmaithunasya ca varjanam | tyāga ity eva |
meaning: अथेमानि व्रतानि भवन्ति । अहिंसा सत्यम् अस्तैन्यंमैथुनस्य च वर्जनम् । त्याग इत्य् एव ।
text: Abstention from injuring living beings, truthfulness, abstention from appropriating the property of others, continence, (and) liberality.

sanskrit_iast: pañcaivopavratāni bhavanti | akrodhoguruśuśrūṣāpramādaḥ śaucam āhāraśuddhiś ceti |
meaning: पञ्चैवोपव्रतानि भवन्ति । अक्रोधोगुरुशुश्रूषाप्रमादः शौचम् आहारशुद्धिश् चेति ।
text: There are five minor vows, (viz.) abstention from anger, obedience towards the Guru, avoidance of rashness, cleanliness and purity in eating.

sanskrit_iast: atha bhaikṣacaryā | brāhmaṇānāṃ śālīnayāyāvarāṇāmapavṛtte vaiśvadeve bhikṣāṃ lipseta |
meaning: अथ भैक्षचर्या । ब्राह्मणानां शालीनयायावराणामपवृत्ते वैश्वदेवे भिक्षां लिप्सेत ।
text: Now (follows the rule for) begging. Let him ask Brāhmaṇas, both those who have houses ( s ālīna) and those who lead a wandering life (yāyāvara), for alms, when the Vaiśvadeva offering has been finished.

sanskrit_iast: bhavatpūrvāṃ pracodayet |
meaning: भवत्पूर्वां प्रचोदयेत् ।
text: Let him ask (for it), prefacing (his request with the word) Bhavat.

sanskrit_iast: godohamātram ākāṅkṣet |
meaning: गोदोहमात्रम् आकाङ्क्षेत् ।
text: Let him stand begging no longer than the time required for milking a cow.

sanskrit_iast: atha bhaikṣacaryād upāvṛtya śucau deśe nyasya hastapādān prakṣālyādityasyāgraṃ nivedayet | ud u tyam | citram iti | brahmaṇe nivedayate | brahma jajñānam iti |
meaning: अथ भैक्षचर्याद् उपावृत्य शुचौ देशे न्यस्य हस्तपादान् प्रक्षाल्यादित्यस्याग्रं निवेदयेत् । उद् उ त्यम् । चित्रम् इति । ब्रह्मणे निवेदयते । ब्रह्म जज्ञानम् इति ।
text: When he returns from begging, he lays (the alms) down in a pure place, washes his hands and feet, and announces (what he obtained) to the sun, (reciting the text), 'Ud u tyaṃk itram,' &c. He (also) announces it to Brahman (with the text), 'The first-born Brahman,' &c.

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyate | ādhānaprabhṛti yajamāna evāgnayo bhavanti | tasya prāṇo gārhapatyo 'pāno 'nvāhāryapacano vyāna āhavanīyaudānasamānau sabhyāvasathyau | pañca vā ete 'gnaya ātmasthāḥ | ātmany eva juhoti |
meaning: विज्ञायते । आधानप्रभृति यजमान एवाग्नयो भवन्ति । तस्य प्राणो गार्हपत्यो ऽपानो ऽन्वाहार्यपचनो व्यान आहवनीयौदानसमानौ सभ्यावसथ्यौ । पञ्च वा एते ऽग्नय आत्मस्थाः । आत्मन्य् एव जुहोति ।
text: It is declared in the Veda, 'After the Brahmādhāna the sacrificer himself (contains) the sacrificial fires. His respiration (prāṇa, represents) the Gārhapatya fire, the air that goes downwards (apāna, represents) the Anvāhāryapa k ana (or Dakshiṇa) fire, the circulation in the body (vyāna, represents) the Āhavanīya fire, the cerebral circulation (udāna) and the abdominal circulation (samāna, represent) the Sabhya and Āvasathya fires. These five fires are abiding in 'the soul. He (therefore) offers (the oblations) in the soul alone.'

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa ātmayajña ātmaniṣṭha ātmapratiṣṭha ātmānaṃkṣemaṃ nayatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: स एष आत्मयज्ञ आत्मनिष्ठ आत्मप्रतिष्ठ आत्मानंक्षेमं नयतीति विज्ञायते ।
text: 'This sacrifice, offered in the soul, which is located in and based on the soul, leads the soul to happiness.'

sanskrit_iast: bhūtebhyo dayāpūrvaṃ saṃvibhajya śeṣam adbhiḥ saṃspṛśyauṣadhavat prāśnīyāt |
meaning: भूतेभ्यो दयापूर्वं संविभज्य शेषम् अद्भिः संस्पृश्यौषधवत् प्राश्नीयात् ।
text: Giving, compassionately, portions (of his food) to the living beings, and sprinkling the remainder with water, he shall eat it as if it were a medicine.

sanskrit_iast: prāśyāpa ācamya jyotiṣmatyādityam upatiṣṭhate | udvayaṃ tamasas parīti | vāṅ ma āsan nasoḥ prāṇa iti japitvā |
meaning: प्राश्याप आचम्य ज्योतिष्मत्यादित्यम् उपतिष्ठते । उद्वयं तमसस् परीति । वाङ् म आसन् नसोः प्राण इति जपित्वा ।
text: After he has eaten and sipped water, he mutters (the texts), 'Out of darkness we,' &c., (and), My speech resides in the mouth,' &c., and worships the sun with the (verse called) G yotishmatī.

sanskrit_iast: ayācitam asaṃkḷptam upapannaṃ yadṛcchayā | āhāramātraṃ bhuñjīta kevalaṃ prāṇayātrikam || iti |
meaning: अयाचितम् असंकॢप्तम् उपपन्नं यदृच्छया । आहारमात्रं भुञ्जीत केवलं प्राणयात्रिकम् ॥ इति ।
text: Let him eat food, given without asking, regarding which nothing has been settled before-hand and which has reached him accidentally, so much only as is sufficient to sustain life.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | aṣṭau grāsā muner bhakṣyāḥ ṣoḍaśāraṇyavāsinaḥ | dvātriṃśat tu gṛhasthasya amitaṃbrahmacāriṇaḥ |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अष्टौ ग्रासा मुनेर् भक्ष्याः षोडशारण्यवासिनः । द्वात्रिंशत् तु गृहस्थस्य अमितंब्रह्मचारिणः ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'Eight mouthfuls (make) the meal of an ascetic, sixteen (that) of a hermit in the woods, thirty-two (that) of a householder, an unlimited (quantity that) of a student.'

sanskrit_iast: bhaikṣaṃ vā sarvavarṇebhya ekānnaṃ vā dvijātiṣu | api vā sarvavarṇebhyo na caikānnaṃ dvijātiṣu || iti |
meaning: भैक्षं वा सर्ववर्णेभ्य एकान्नं वा द्विजातिषु । अपि वा सर्ववर्णेभ्यो न चैकान्नं द्विजातिषु ॥ इति ।
text: 'Alms (may) either (be obtained) from (men of) the three castes, or the food (given) by a single Brāhmaṇa (may be eaten); or (he may obtain food) from (men of) all castes, and not (eat) that given by a single Brāhmaṇa.'

sanskrit_iast: atha yatropaniṣadam ācāryā bruvate tatrodāharanti || sthānamaunavīrāsanasavanopasparśanacaturthaṣaṣṭhāṣṭamakālavratayuktasya kaṇapiṇyākayāvakadadhipayovratatvaṃ ceti |
meaning: अथ यत्रोपनिषदम् आचार्या ब्रुवते तत्रोदाहरन्ति ॥ स्थानमौनवीरासनसवनोपस्पर्शनचतुर्थषष्ठाष्टमकालव्रतयुक्तस्य कणपिण्याकयावकदधिपयोव्रतत्वं चेति ।
text: Now they quote (the following special rules) for the case that the teachers explain (the doctrine) of the Upanishads: 'Diligently standing (in the day-time), keeping silence, sitting (at night) with crossed legs, bathing three times a day, and eating at the fourth, sixth, or eighth (meal-time only), he shall subsist entirely on (rice) grains, oil-cake, food prepared from barley, sour milk, (and) milk.'

sanskrit_iast: tatra maune yuktas traividyavṛddhair ācāryair munibhiranyair vāśramibhir bahuśrutair dantair dantānsaṃdhāyāntarmukha eva yāvadarthasaṃbhāṣī na strībhir na yatra lopo bhavatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: तत्र मौने युक्तस् त्रैविद्यवृद्धैर् आचार्यैर् मुनिभिरन्यैर् वाश्रमिभिर् बहुश्रुतैर् दन्तैर् दन्तान्संधायान्तर्मुख एव यावदर्थसंभाषी न स्त्रीभिर् न यत्र लोपो भवतीति विज्ञायते ।
text: It is declared in the Veda, On that (occasion) he shall rigidly keep silence; pressing the teeth together he may converse, without opening his mouth, as much as is necessary with teachers deeply versed in the three Vedas (and) with ascetics possessing a great knowledge of the scriptures, not with women, nor when he would break (his vow).'

sanskrit_iast: sthānamaunavīrāsanānām anyatamena saṃprayogaḥ | natrayaṃ saṃnipātayet |
meaning: स्थानमौनवीरासनानाम् अन्यतमेन संप्रयोगः । नत्रयं संनिपातयेत् ।
text: (Let him keep) only one of (the rules which enjoin) standing (in the day-time), rigid silence, and sitting (at night) with crossed legs; let him not keep all three together.

sanskrit_iast: yatra gataś ca yāvanmātram anuvratayed āpatsu na yatralopo bhavatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: यत्र गतश् च यावन्मात्रम् अनुव्रतयेद् आपत्सु न यत्रलोपो भवतीति विज्ञायते ।
text: It is declared in the Veda, And he who has gone there may eat, in times of distress, a small quantity of the food prescribed by his vow after (having partaken of other dishes), provided he does not break (his vow).'

sanskrit_iast: sthānamaunavīrāsanasavanopasparśanacaturthaṣaṣṭhāṣṭamakālavratayuktasya | aṣṭau tāny avrataghnāni āpo mūlaṃ ghṛtaṃ payaḥ | havir brāhmaṇakāmyā ca guror vacanamauṣadham iti |
meaning: स्थानमौनवीरासनसवनोपस्पर्शनचतुर्थषष्ठाष्टमकालव्रतयुक्तस्य । अष्टौ तान्य् अव्रतघ्नानि आपो मूलं घृतं पयः । हविर् ब्राह्मणकाम्या च गुरोर् वचनमौषधम् इति ।
text: 'Eight (things) do not cause him who is intent on standing (in the day-time), keeping rigid silence, sitting (at night) with crossed legs, bathing three times a day, and (eating) at the fourth, sixth, or eighth meal-time only, to break his vow, (viz.) water, roots, clarified butter, milk, sacrificial food, the wish of a Brāhmaṇa, an order of his teacher, and medicine.'

sanskrit_iast: sāyaṃprātaragnihotramantrāñ japet |
meaning: सायंप्रातरग्निहोत्रमन्त्राञ् जपेत् ।
text: Let him mutter the (Mantras which must be recited at the) Agnihotra, in the evening and in the morning,

sanskrit_iast: vāruṇībhiḥ sāyaṃ saṃdhyām upasthāya maitrībhiḥ prātaḥ |
meaning: वारुणीभिः सायं संध्याम् उपस्थाय मैत्रीभिः प्रातः ।
text: After performing his evening devotions by (reciting the verses called) Vāruṇīs, and his morning devotions by (reciting the verses called) Maitrīs.

sanskrit_iast: anagnir aniketaḥ syād aśarmāśaraṇo muniḥ | bhaikṣārthī grāmam anvicchet svādhyāye vācam utsṛjed || iti |
meaning: अनग्निर् अनिकेतः स्याद् अशर्माशरणो मुनिः । भैक्षार्थी ग्रामम् अन्विच्छेत् स्वाध्याये वाचम् उत्सृजेद् ॥ इति ।
text: An ascetic shall keep no fire, have no house, no home, and no protector. He may enter a village in order to collect alms, and emit speech at the private recitation of the Veda.'

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyate ca | parimitā vā ṛcaḥ parimitāni sāmāniparimitāni yajūṃṣi | athaitasyaivānto nāsti yad brahma | tatpratigṛṇata ācakṣīta | sa pratigara iti |
meaning: विज्ञायते च । परिमिता वा ऋचः परिमितानि सामानिपरिमितानि यजूंषि । अथैतस्यैवान्तो नास्ति यद् ब्रह्म । तत्प्रतिगृणत आचक्षीत । स प्रतिगर इति ।
text: It is declared in the Veda,' Limited in number are the Ri k-verses, limited in number are the Sāmans, limited is the answer (of the Adhvaryu priest):

sanskrit_iast: evam evaiṣa ā śarīravimokṣaṇād vṛkṣamūlikovedasaṃnyāsī |
meaning: एवम् एवैष आ शरीरविमोक्षणाद् वृक्षमूलिकोवेदसंन्यासी ।
text: 'Thus (an ascetic) shall not give up the Veda, (but live), until he is liberated from the body, at the root of the tree.'

sanskrit_iast: vedo vṛkṣaḥ | tasya mūlaṃ praṇavaḥ | praṇavātmako vedaḥ |
meaning: वेदो वृक्षः । तस्य मूलं प्रणवः । प्रणवात्मको वेदः ।
text: 'The tree (is) the Veda; the syllable Om is its root; the syllable Om is the essence of the Veda.'

sanskrit_iast: praṇavaṃ dhyāyan sapraṇavo brahmabhūyāya kalpata iti hovāca prajāpatiḥ |
meaning: प्रणवं ध्यायन् सप्रणवो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पत इति होवाच प्रजापतिः ।
text: 'Meditating on the syllable Om, he becomes fit (to be united with) Brahman.' Thus spake the lord of created beings.

sanskrit_iast: saptavyāhṛtibhir brahmabhājanaṃ prakṣālayed iti | prakṣālayed iti |
meaning: सप्तव्याहृतिभिर् ब्रह्मभाजनं प्रक्षालयेद् इति । प्रक्षालयेद् इति ।
text: Let him cleanse the vessel of Brahman with the seven Vyāh ri tis.

sanskrit_iast: atha śālīnayāyāvaracakracaradharmakāṅkṣiṇāṃ navabhirvṛttibhir vartamānānām |
meaning: अथ शालीनयायावरचक्रचरधर्मकाङ्क्षिणां नवभिर्वृत्तिभिर् वर्तमानानाम् ।

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tadvartanād vṛttir ity ucyate |
meaning: तेषां तद्वर्तनाद् वृत्तिर् इत्य् उच्यते ।

sanskrit_iast: śālāśrayatvāc chālīnatvam |
meaning: शालाश्रयत्वाच् छालीनत्वम् ।

sanskrit_iast: vṛttyā varayā yātīti yāyāvaratvam |
meaning: वृत्त्या वरया यातीति यायावरत्वम् ।

sanskrit_iast: anukrameṇa caraṇāc cakracaratvam |
meaning: अनुक्रमेण चरणाच् चक्रचरत्वम् ।
text: The term K akra k ara is derived from going by turns (to the houses of rich men).

sanskrit_iast: tā anuvyākhyāsyāmaḥ |
meaning: ता अनुव्याख्यास्यामः ।
text: We will explain those (above-mentioned means of livelihood) in their proper order.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṇṇivartanī kauddālī dhruvā saṃprakṣālanīsamūhā phālanī śiloñchā kāpotāsiddheccheti navaitāḥ |
meaning: षण्णिवर्तनी कौद्दाली ध्रुवा संप्रक्षालनीसमूहा फालनी शिलोञ्छा कापोतासिद्धेच्छेति नवैताः ।
text: They are nine, (viz.) Shaṇn ivartanī, Kauddāli, Dhruvā, Samprakshālanī, Samūhā, Pālanī, Silo ñ kh ā, Kapotā, and Siddho ñ kh ā.

sanskrit_iast: tāsām eva vānyāpi daśamī vṛttir bhavati |
meaning: तासाम् एव वान्यापि दशमी वृत्तिर् भवति ।
text: (In addition) to these there is a tenth way of living, viz. forest-life.

sanskrit_iast: ā navavṛtteḥ |
meaning: आ नववृत्तेः ।
text: (If he desires to adopt) any of the nine ways of living,

sanskrit_iast: keśaśmaśrulomanakhāni vāpayitvopakalpayate |
meaning: केशश्मश्रुलोमनखानि वापयित्वोपकल्पयते ।
text: He causes the hair of his head, his beard, the hair on his body, and his nails to be cut, and besides gets ready (the following objects),

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇājinaṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ yaṣṭiṃ vīvadhaṃ kutapahāram iti |
meaning: कृष्णाजिनं कमण्डलुं यष्टिं वीवधं कुतपहारम् इति ।
text: (Viz.) the skin of a black antelope, a water-pot, a staff, a yoke for carrying burdens, (and) a sickle.

sanskrit_iast: traidhātavīyeneṣṭvā prasthāsyati vaiśvānaryā vā |
meaning: त्रैधातवीयेनेष्ट्वा प्रस्थास्यति वैश्वानर्या वा ।
text: He desires to go forth, after having offered a Traidhātavīya (offering) or a Vaiśvānarī (ishṭi).

sanskrit_iast: atha prātar udita āditye yathāsūtram agnīn prajvālya gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya sruksruvaṃ niṣṭapya saṃmṛjya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīye vāstoṣpatīyaṃ juhoti |
meaning: अथ प्रातर् उदित आदित्ये यथासूत्रम् अग्नीन् प्रज्वाल्य गार्हपत्य आज्यं विलाप्योत्पूय स्रुक्स्रुवं निष्टप्य संमृज्य स्रुचि चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वाहवनीये वास्तोष्पतीयं जुहोति ।
text: Now on the (following) morning, after the sun has risen, he makes the sacred fires burn brightly, melts butter on the Gārhapatya fire, cleanses it (with Kuśa grass), heats the (spoons called) Sru k and Sruva, cleans (them), takes out four (spoonfuls of butter) in the Sru k , and offers the Vāstoshpatīya (oblation) in the Āhavanīya fire according to (the rules of his) Sūtra.

sanskrit_iast: vāstoṣpate prati jānīhy asmān iti puronuvākyām anūcya | vāstoṣpate śagmayā saṃsadā ta iti yājyayā juhoti |
meaning: वास्तोष्पते प्रति जानीह्य् अस्मान् इति पुरोनुवाक्याम् अनूच्य । वास्तोष्पते शग्मया संसदा त इति याज्यया जुहोति ।
text: Having recited the Puronuvākyā (verse), 'O lord of the dwelling, permit us,' &c., he offers (the oblation) with the Yā g yā verse, 'O lord of the dwelling, with thy kind company,' &c.

sanskrit_iast: sarva evāhitāgnir ity eke |
meaning: सर्व एवाहिताग्निर् इत्य् एके ।
text: Some (declare that) every person who has kindled the sacred fires (shall offer these Homas).

sanskrit_iast: yāyāvara ity eke |
meaning: यायावर इत्य् एके ।
text: Others (say that) a Yāyāvara alone (shall do it).

sanskrit_iast: nirgatya grāmānte grāmasīmānte vāvatiṣṭhate | tatrakuṭīṃ maṭhaṃ vā karoti kṛtaṃ vā praviśati |
meaning: निर्गत्य ग्रामान्ते ग्रामसीमान्ते वावतिष्ठते । तत्रकुटीं मठं वा करोति कृतं वा प्रविशति ।
text: After departing (from his house), he stops at the extremity of the village, or at the extremity of the boundary of the village, builds there a hut or a cottage, and enters that.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇājinādīnām upakḷptānāṃ yasminn arthe yena yena yatprayojanaṃ tena tena tat kuryāt |
meaning: कृष्णाजिनादीनाम् उपकॢप्तानां यस्मिन्न् अर्थे येन येन यत्प्रयोजनं तेन तेन तत् कुर्यात् ।
text: Let him use the skin of the black antelope and the other (objects) which he has prepared for the several purposes which they are intended to serve.

sanskrit_iast: prasiddham agnīnāṃ paricaraṇam | prasiddhaṃdarśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajanam | prasiddhaḥ pañcānāṃ mahatāṃ yajñānāmanuprayogaḥ | utpannānām oṣadhīnāṃ nirvāpaṇaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ bhavati |
meaning: प्रसिद्धम् अग्नीनां परिचरणम् । प्रसिद्धंदर्शपूर्णमासाभ्यां यजनम् । प्रसिद्धः पञ्चानां महतां यज्ञानामनुप्रयोगः । उत्पन्नानाम् ओषधीनां निर्वापणं दृष्टं भवति ।
text: Known (is) the (duty of) serving the fires; known (is) the (duty of) offering the new and full moon sacrifices; known (is) the successive performance of the five Mahāya g ñ as; it is seen that the vegetables, which have been produced, are offered.

sanskrit_iast: viśvebhyo devebhyo juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmīti vā tūṣṇīṃ vā tāḥ saṃskṛtya sādhayati |
meaning: विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो जुष्टं निर्वपामीति वा तूष्णीं वा ताः संस्कृत्य साधयति ।
text: He hallows those (vegetables), either (reciting the text),' I offer what is agreeable to all the gods,' or silently, and cooks (them).

sanskrit_iast: tasyādhyāpanayājanapratigrahā nivartante 'nye cayajñakratava iti |
meaning: तस्याध्यापनयाजनप्रतिग्रहा निवर्तन्ते ऽन्ये चयज्ञक्रतव इति ।
text: For such (a man the duty of) teaching, sacrificing for others, accepting gifts, and (performing) other sacrifices (than those mentioned) ceases.

sanskrit_iast: haviṣyaṃ ca vratopāyanīyaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ bhavati |
meaning: हविष्यं च व्रतोपायनीयं दृष्टं भवति ।
text: (The use of) sacrificial food fit to be eaten during the performance of a vow is seen;

sanskrit_iast: tad yathā sarpirmiśraṃ dadhimiśramakṣāralavaṇam apiśitam aparyuṣitam |
meaning: तद् यथा सर्पिर्मिश्रं दधिमिश्रमक्षारलवणम् अपिशितम् अपर्युषितम् ।

sanskrit_iast: brahmacaryam ṛtau vā gacchati |
meaning: ब्रह्मचर्यम् ऋतौ वा गच्छति ।

sanskrit_iast: parvaṇiparvaṇi keśaśmaśrulomanakhavāpanaṃ śaucavidhiś ca |
meaning: पर्वणिपर्वणि केशश्मश्रुलोमनखवापनं शौचविधिश् च ।
text: (It is necessary) to have the hair of his head, his beard, the hair on his body, and his nails cut on each Parva day, and the rules of purification (are obligatory on him).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | śrūyate dvividhaṃ śaucaṃ yac chiṣṭaiḥ paryupāsitam | bāhyaṃ nirlepanirgandham antaḥśaucam ahiṃsakam |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । श्रूयते द्विविधं शौचं यच् छिष्टैः पर्युपासितम् । बाह्यं निर्लेपनिर्गन्धम् अन्तःशौचम् अहिंसकम् ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'Two kinds of purification, which the Śishṭas reverentially practise, are mentioned in the Veda,--external (purification), which consists in the removal of impure stains and foul smells, and internal (purification), which consists in the abstention from injuring live creatures.'

sanskrit_iast: adbhiḥ śudhyanti gātrāṇi buddhir jñānena śudhyati | ahiṃsayā ca bhūtātmā manaḥ satyena śudhyati || iti |
meaning: अद्भिः शुध्यन्ति गात्राणि बुद्धिर् ज्ञानेन शुध्यति । अहिंसया च भूतात्मा मनः सत्येन शुध्यति ॥ इति ।
text: 'The body is purified by water, the understanding by knowledge, the soul of beings by abstention from injuring, (and) the internal organ by truth.'

sanskrit_iast: yatho etat ṣaṇṇivartanīti |
meaning: यथो एतत् षण्णिवर्तनीति ।
text: As regards (the mode of subsistence called) Shaṇn ivartanī, (that) is (as follows):

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍ eva nivartanāni nirupahatāni karoti | svāmine bhāgam utsṛjaty anujñātaṃ vā gṛhṇāti |
meaning: षड् एव निवर्तनानि निरुपहतानि करोति । स्वामिने भागम् उत्सृजत्य् अनुज्ञातं वा गृह्णाति ।
text: He cultivates six Nivartanas (of) fallow (land); he gives a share to the owner (of the soil), or solicits his permission (to keep the whole produce).

sanskrit_iast: prāk prātarāśāt karṣī syād asyūtanāsikābhyāṃsamuṣkābhyām atudann ārayā muhurmuhur abhyucchandayan |
meaning: प्राक् प्रातराशात् कर्षी स्याद् अस्यूतनासिकाभ्यांसमुष्काभ्याम् अतुदन्न् आरया मुहुर्मुहुर् अभ्युच्छन्दयन् ।
text: Let him plough before breakfast with two bulls whose noses have not been pierced, not striking (them) with the goad, (but) frequently coaxing (them).

sanskrit_iast: etena vidhinā ṣaṇnivartanāni karotītiṣaṇṇivartanī |
meaning: एतेन विधिना षण्निवर्तनानि करोतीतिषण्णिवर्तनी ।
text: If he cultivates six Nivartanas in this manner (and subsists thereby), that is (the mode of living called) Shaṇn ivartanī (subsistence on six Nivartanas).

sanskrit_iast: kauddālīti | jalābhyāśe kuddālena vā phālena vā tīkṣṇakāṣṭhena vā khanati bījāny āvapati kandamūlaphalaśākauṣadhīr niṣpādayati |
meaning: कौद्दालीति । जलाभ्याशे कुद्दालेन वा फालेन वा तीक्ष्णकाष्ठेन वा खनति बीजान्य् आवपति कन्दमूलफलशाकौषधीर् निष्पादयति ।
text: (As regards the mode of subsistence called) Kauddālī, he digs up (the soil) near a water(-course or tank) with a spade, a ploughshare, or a pointed piece of wood, sows seed, (and) grows bulbs, roots, fruit, pot-herbs, and vegetables.

sanskrit_iast: kuddālena karotīti kauddālī |
meaning: कुद्दालेन करोतीति कौद्दाली ।
text: (If he thus) cultivates (land) with a spade (and lives on its produce), that is the (mode of life called) Kauddālī (subsistence by the spade).

sanskrit_iast: dhruvayā vartamānaḥ śuklena vāsasā śiro veṣṭayati | bhūtyaitvā śiro veṣṭayāmīti | brahmavarcasam asi brahmavarcasāya tvetikṛṣṇājinam ādatte 'bliṅgābhiḥ pavitram | balam asi balāya tveti kamaṇḍalum | dhānyam asi puṣṭyai tveti vīvadham | sakhā mā gopāyeti daṇḍam |
meaning: ध्रुवया वर्तमानः शुक्लेन वाससा शिरो वेष्टयति । भूत्यैत्वा शिरो वेष्टयामीति । ब्रह्मवर्चसम् असि ब्रह्मवर्चसाय त्वेतिकृष्णाजिनम् आदत्ते ऽब्लिङ्गाभिः पवित्रम् । बलम् असि बलाय त्वेति कमण्डलुम् । धान्यम् असि पुष्ट्यै त्वेति वीवधम् । सखा मा गोपायेति दण्डम् ।
text: He who lives by the (mode of subsistence called) Dhruvā, wraps up his head in a white dress (saying), 'For the sake of welfare I wrap thee up, O head,' (and) takes the skin of a black antelope (with the words), '(Thou art) spiritual pre-eminence, (I take thee) for the sake of spiritual pre-eminence;' the Pavitra (reciting) the Abliṅga texts; the water-pot (saying), 'Thou art strength, (I take) thee for the sake of strength;' the yoke for carrying burdens (saying), 'Thou art grain, (I take) thee for the sake of prosperity;' the staff (saying), '(Thou art) a friend, protect me.'

sanskrit_iast: athopaniṣkramya vyāhṛtīr japitvā diśām anumantraṇaṃ japati | pṛthivī cāntarikṣaṃ ca dyaur nakṣatrāṇi yā diśaḥ | agnir vāyuś ca sūryaś ca pāntu māṃ pathi devatāḥ || iti |
meaning: अथोपनिष्क्रम्य व्याहृतीर् जपित्वा दिशाम् अनुमन्त्रणं जपति । पृथिवी चान्तरिक्षं च द्यौर् नक्षत्राणि या दिशः । अग्निर् वायुश् च सूर्यश् च पान्तु मां पथि देवताः ॥ इति ।
text: On leaving (his hut), he mutters the Vyāh ri tis, and (afterwards the verse used for) hallowing the quarters of the horizon, 'May the earth, the middle sphere, the sky, the constellations, and all the quarters of the horizon, fire, air, and sun, (may all these) deities protect me on my road.'

sanskrit_iast: mānastokīyaṃ japitvā grāmaṃ praviśya gṛhadvāregṛhadvāraātmānaṃ vīvadhena saha darśanāt saṃdarśanīty ācakṣate |
meaning: मानस्तोकीयं जपित्वा ग्रामं प्रविश्य गृहद्वारेगृहद्वारआत्मानं वीवधेन सह दर्शनात् संदर्शनीत्य् आचक्षते ।
text: Because, after muttering the Mānastokīya (text) and entering the village, he shows himself with the yoke (on his shoulder) at the door of each house, they call it 'showing oneself.'

sanskrit_iast: vṛtter vṛtter avārttāyāṃ tayaiva tasya dhruvaṃ vartanāddhruveti parikīrtitā |
meaning: वृत्तेर् वृत्तेर् अवार्त्तायां तयैव तस्य ध्रुवं वर्तनाद्ध्रुवेति परिकीर्तिता ।
text: Because, if every (other) livelihood fails, he persistently (dhruvam) supports himself by this (mode of living), it is called Dhruvā (the unchangeable).

sanskrit_iast: saṃprakṣālanīti | utpannānām oṣadhīnāṃ prakṣepaṇam | nikṣepaṇaṃ nāsti nicayo vā | bhājanāni saṃprakṣālya nyubjatītisaṃprakṣālanī |
meaning: संप्रक्षालनीति । उत्पन्नानाम् ओषधीनां प्रक्षेपणम् । निक्षेपणं नास्ति निचयो वा । भाजनानि संप्रक्षाल्य न्युब्जतीतिसंप्रक्षालनी ।
text: (As regards the mode of life called) Samprakshālanī, (if, in order to show that) there is no waste of the vegetable (substances) obtained nor any hoarding, he turns the dishes, after washing them, upside down, (that is the livelihood called) Samprakshālanī (living by washing).

sanskrit_iast: samūheti | avāritasthāneṣu pathiṣu vā kṣetreṣuvāpratihatāvakāśeṣu vā yatra yatrauṣadhayo vidyante tatra tatrasamūhanyā samuhya tābhir vartayatīti samūhā |
meaning: समूहेति । अवारितस्थानेषु पथिषु वा क्षेत्रेषुवाप्रतिहतावकाशेषु वा यत्र यत्रौषधयो विद्यन्ते तत्र तत्रसमूहन्या समुह्य ताभिर् वर्तयतीति समूहा ।
text: As to the (mode of subsistence called) Samūhā, (if) he sweeps up (grain) with a broom in permitted places where (grain-bearing) plants are found, either on a road or in fields the access to which is not obstructed (by hedges), and lives on (what he has thus obtained), that (livelihood is called) Samūhā (living by sweeping).

sanskrit_iast: phālanīty ahiṃsikety evedam uktaṃ bhavati | tuṣavihīnāṃs taṇḍulān icchati sajjanebhyo bījāni vā | phālayatīti phālanī |
meaning: फालनीत्य् अहिंसिकेत्य् एवेदम् उक्तं भवति । तुषविहीनांस् तण्डुलान् इच्छति सज्जनेभ्यो बीजानि वा । फालयतीति फालनी ।
text: As to the (mode of life called) Pālanī, it is also named Ahiṃsakā (not hurting), and the following (definition) is given. (If) he tries to obtain from virtuous men husked rice or seeds, and maintains (himself) thereby, that (is the mode of subsistence called) Pālanī.

sanskrit_iast: śiloñcheti | avāritasthāneṣu pathiṣu vākṣetreṣu vāpratihatāvakāśeṣu vā yatra yatrauṣadhayo vidyante tatratatraikaikaṃ kaṇiśam uñchayitvā kālekāle śilair vartayatītiśiloñchā |
meaning: शिलोञ्छेति । अवारितस्थानेषु पथिषु वाक्षेत्रेषु वाप्रतिहतावकाशेषु वा यत्र यत्रौषधयो विद्यन्ते तत्रतत्रैकैकं कणिशम् उञ्छयित्वा कालेकाले शिलैर् वर्तयतीतिशिलोञ्छा ।
text: As to the (mode of life called) Silo ñ kh ā, (if) he gleans single ears in permitted places where (grain-bearing) plants grow, on a road or in fields the access to which is not obstructed, and supports himself by (these) gleanings, (collected) from time to time, that (is the mode of subsistence called) Silo ñ kh ā (gleaning).

sanskrit_iast: kāpoteti | avāritasthāneṣu pathiṣu vā kṣetreṣu vāpratihatāvakāśeṣu vā yatra yatrauṣadhayo vidyante tatratatrāṅgulībhyām ekaikām oṣadhim uñchayitvā saṃdaṃśanāt kapotavad iti kāpotā |
meaning: कापोतेति । अवारितस्थानेषु पथिषु वा क्षेत्रेषु वाप्रतिहतावकाशेषु वा यत्र यत्रौषधयो विद्यन्ते तत्रतत्राङ्गुलीभ्याम् एकैकाम् ओषधिम् उञ्छयित्वा संदंशनात् कपोतवद् इति कापोता ।
text: As to the (livelihood called) Kapotā, (if) he picks up with two fingers single grains in permitted places, where (grain-bearing) plants grow, either on the road or in fields the access to which is not obstructed, that (is called), because he acts like a pigeon, Kapotā (pigeon-life).

sanskrit_iast: siddheccheti | vṛttibhiḥ śrānto vṛddhatvād dhātukṣayād vāsajjanebhyaḥ siddham annam icchatīti siddhecchā |
meaning: सिद्धेच्छेति । वृत्तिभिः श्रान्तो वृद्धत्वाद् धातुक्षयाद् वासज्जनेभ्यः सिद्धम् अन्नम् इच्छतीति सिद्धेच्छा ।
text: As to (the mode of life called) Siddho ñ kh ā, (if) tired with the (other) ways of subsistence, he asks, because he has become old or diseased, virtuous men for cooked food, that (is the livelihood called) Siddho ñ kh ā (gleaning cooked food).

sanskrit_iast: tasyātmani samāropaṇaṃ vidyatesaṃnyāsivad upacāraḥ pavitrakāṣāyavāsovarjam |
meaning: तस्यात्मनि समारोपणं विद्यतेसंन्यासिवद् उपचारः पवित्रकाषायवासोवर्जम् ।
text: If (he adopts) the latter, he must reposit (the sacred fires) in his soul and behave like an ascetic, except (in using) the cloth for straining water and (wearing) a reddish-brown dress.

sanskrit_iast: vānyāpi vṛkṣalatāvallyoṣadhīnāṃ ca tṛṇauṣadhīnāṃ caśyāmākajartilādīnām | vanyābhir vartayatītivānyā |
meaning: वान्यापि वृक्षलतावल्ल्योषधीनां च तृणौषधीनां चश्यामाकजर्तिलादीनाम् । वन्याभिर् वर्तयतीतिवान्या ।
text: If he subsists on the produce of the forest, (the fruits) of trees, creepers. and lianas, and of grasses, such as wild millet ( s yāmāka) and wild sesamum, that (is called) forest-life.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | mṛgaiḥ saha parispandaḥ saṃvāsas tebhir eva ca | tair eva sadṛśī vṛttiḥ pratyakṣaṃ svargalakṣaṇam | pratyakṣaṃ svargalakṣaṇam iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । मृगैः सह परिस्पन्दः संवासस् तेभिर् एव च । तैर् एव सदृशी वृत्तिः प्रत्यक्षं स्वर्गलक्षणम् । प्रत्यक्षं स्वर्गलक्षणम् इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'Moving about with the beasts, dwelling together with them, and maintaining oneself in a manner similar to theirs, that is clearly the road to heaven.'

sanskrit_iast: atha vānaprasthadvaividhyam |
meaning: अथ वानप्रस्थद्वैविध्यम् ।
text: Now the hermits in the wood belong to two classes,

sanskrit_iast: pacamānakā apacamānakāś ceti |
meaning: पचमानका अपचमानकाश् चेति ।
text: Those who cook (their food), and those who do not cook it.

sanskrit_iast: tatra pacamānakāḥ pañcavidhāḥ sarvāraṇyakā vaituṣikāḥkandamūlabhakṣāḥ phalabhakṣāḥ śākabhakṣāś ceti |
meaning: तत्र पचमानकाः पञ्चविधाः सर्वारण्यका वैतुषिकाःकन्दमूलभक्षाः फलभक्षाः शाकभक्षाश् चेति ।
text: Among them, those who cook (their food are divided) into five subdivisions, (viz.) those who eat everything which the forest contains, those who live on unhusked (wild-growing grain), those who eat bulbs and roots, those who eat fruit, and those who eat pot-herbs.

sanskrit_iast: tatra sarvāraṇyakā nāma dvividhā dvividham āraṇyamāśrayanta indrāvasiktā retovasiktāś ceti |
meaning: तत्र सर्वारण्यका नाम द्विविधा द्विविधम् आरण्यमाश्रयन्त इन्द्रावसिक्ता रेतोवसिक्ताश् चेति ।
text: Those who eat everything which the forest produces are, again, of two kinds: they either subsist on forest-produce generated by Indra, or on that which has been generated from semen.

sanskrit_iast: tatrendrāvasiktā nāma vallīgulmalatāvṛkṣāṇām ānayitvā śrapayitvā sāyaṃprātaragnihotraṃ hutvāyatyatithivratibhyaś ca dattvāthetarac cheṣabhakṣāḥ |
meaning: तत्रेन्द्रावसिक्ता नाम वल्लीगुल्मलतावृक्षाणाम् आनयित्वा श्रपयित्वा सायंप्रातरग्निहोत्रं हुत्वायत्यतिथिव्रतिभ्यश् च दत्त्वाथेतरच् छेषभक्षाः ।
text: Among these, that which has been generated by Indra (is the produce) of lianas, shrubs, creepers, and trees. Fetching (that) and cooking it, they offer the Agnihotra in the evening and in the morning, give (food) to ascetics, guests, and students, and eat the remainder.

sanskrit_iast: retovasiktā nāma māṃsaṃvyāghravṛkaśyenādibhir anyatamena vā hatam ānayitvā śrapayitvāsāyaṃprātaragnihotraṃ hutvā yatyatithivratibhyaś ca dattvāthetarac cheṣabhakṣāḥ |
meaning: रेतोवसिक्ता नाम मांसंव्याघ्रवृकश्येनादिभिर् अन्यतमेन वा हतम् आनयित्वा श्रपयित्वासायंप्रातरग्निहोत्रं हुत्वा यत्यतिथिव्रतिभ्यश् च दत्त्वाथेतरच् छेषभक्षाः ।
text: That which is generated from semen is the flesh (of animals) slain by tigers, wolves, falcons, and other (carnivorous beasts), or by one of them. Fetching (that) and cooking it, they offer the Agnihotra in the evening and in the morning, give (shares) to ascetics, guests, and students, and eat the remainder.

sanskrit_iast: vaituṣikās tuṣadhānyavarjaṃ taṇḍulān ānayitvā śrapayitvāsāyaṃprātaragnihotraṃ hutvā yatyatithivratibhyaś ca dattvāthetarac cheṣabhakṣāḥ |
meaning: वैतुषिकास् तुषधान्यवर्जं तण्डुलान् आनयित्वा श्रपयित्वासायंप्रातरग्निहोत्रं हुत्वा यत्यतिथिव्रतिभ्यश् च दत्त्वाथेतरच् छेषभक्षाः ।
text: Those who eat unhusked grain only, fetch rice, avoiding (husked) corn, boil it, offer the Agnihotra both in the evening and in the morning, give (food) to ascetics, guests, and students, and eat the remainder.

sanskrit_iast: kandamūlaphalaśākabhakṣāṇām apy evam eva |
meaning: कन्दमूलफलशाकभक्षाणाम् अप्य् एवम् एव ।
text: Those who eat bulbs and roots, or fruit, or pot-herbs, (act) exactly in the same manner.

sanskrit_iast: pañcaivāpacamānakā unmajjakāḥ pravṛttāśino mukhenādāyinastoyāhārā vāyubhakṣāś ceti |
meaning: पञ्चैवापचमानका उन्मज्जकाः प्रवृत्ताशिनो मुखेनादायिनस्तोयाहारा वायुभक्षाश् चेति ।
text: Those (hermits) who do not cook (their food are divided into) five (classes), Unma g g akas, Prav ri ttāśins, [paragraph continues] Mukhenādāyins, Toyāhāras, and Vāyubhakshas.

sanskrit_iast: tatronmajjakā nāma lohāśmakaraṇavarjam |
meaning: तत्रोन्मज्जका नाम लोहाश्मकरणवर्जम् ।
text: Among these, the Unma g g akas (collect and prepare their food), avoiding (the use of) iron and stone implements,

sanskrit_iast: hastenādāya pravṛttāśinaḥ |
meaning: हस्तेनादाय प्रवृत्ताशिनः ।
text: The Prav ri ttāśins take it with the hand,

sanskrit_iast: mukhenādāyino mukhenādadate |
meaning: मुखेनादायिनो मुखेनाददते ।
text: The Mukhenādāyins take it with the mouth (only, like beasts),

sanskrit_iast: toyāhārāḥ kevalaṃ toyāhārāḥ |
meaning: तोयाहाराः केवलं तोयाहाराः ।
text: The Toyāhāras subsist on water only,

sanskrit_iast: vāyubhakṣā nirāhārāś ca |
meaning: वायुभक्षा निराहाराश् च ।
text: And the Vāyubhakshas (air-eaters) eat nothing.

sanskrit_iast: iti vaikhānasānāṃ vihitā daśa dīkṣāḥ |
meaning: इति वैखानसानां विहिता दश दीक्षाः ।
text: In this manner ten (different) initiations are prescribed for hermits who follow the rule of Vikhanas (vaikhānasa).

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ svaśāstram abhyupetya daṇḍaṃ ca maunaṃ cāpramādaṃ ca |
meaning: यः स्वशास्त्रम् अभ्युपेत्य दण्डं च मौनं चाप्रमादं च ।
text: He who has agreed (to obey) the Institutes of his (order, shall wear) a staff, (shall keep) rigid silence, and (shall) abstain from rash acts.

sanskrit_iast: vaikhānasāḥ śudhyanti nirāhārāś ceti |
meaning: वैखानसाः शुध्यन्ति निराहाराश् चेति ।
text: Hermits following the rule of Vikhanas (vaikhānasa) are purified (from sin), and (especially) those who abstain from food.

sanskrit_iast: śāstraparigrahaḥ sarveṣāṃ brahmavaikhānasānām |
meaning: शास्त्रपरिग्रहः सर्वेषां ब्रह्मवैखानसानाम् ।
text: The sum of the rules applicable to all Brahma-Vaikhānasas (is as follows):

sanskrit_iast: na druhyed daṃśamaśakān himavāṃs tāpaso bhavet | vanapratiṣṭhaḥ saṃtuṣṭaś cīracarmajalapriyaḥ |
meaning: न द्रुह्येद् दंशमशकान् हिमवांस् तापसो भवेत् । वनप्रतिष्ठः संतुष्टश् चीरचर्मजलप्रियः ।
text: 'Let him not injure (even) gadflies or gnats; let him bear cold and perform austerities; let him constantly reside in the forest, be contented, and delight in (dresses made of) bark and skins, (and in carrying) water (in his pot).'

sanskrit_iast: atithīn pūjayet pūrvaṃ kāle tv āśramam āgatān | devaviprāgnihotre ca yuktas tapasi tāpasaḥ |
meaning: अतिथीन् पूजयेत् पूर्वं काले त्व् आश्रमम् आगतान् । देवविप्राग्निहोत्रे च युक्तस् तपसि तापसः ।
text: 'A devotee shall first honour the guests who have come to his hermitage at (dinner) time; he shall be sedulous in (worshipping) gods and Brāhmaṇas, in (offering) the Agnihotra, and in practising austerities.'

sanskrit_iast: kṛcchrāṃ vṛttim asaṃhāryāṃ sāmānyāṃ mṛgapakṣibhiḥ | tad ahar janasaṃbhārāṃ kaṣāyakaṭukāśrayām | parigṛhya śubhāṃ vṛttim etāṃ durjanavarjitām | vanavāsam upāśritya brāhmaṇo nāvasīdati |
meaning: कृच्छ्रां वृत्तिम् असंहार्यां सामान्यां मृगपक्षिभिः । तद् अहर् जनसंभारां कषायकटुकाश्रयाम् । परिगृह्य शुभां वृत्तिम् एतां दुर्जनवर्जिताम् । वनवासम् उपाश्रित्य ब्राह्मणो नावसीदति ।
text: "A Brāhmaṇa who has taken to forest-life, and who has adopted this difficult (but) pure mode of existence, which keeps him apart from wicked men, which must never be given up, which is similar to (that of the) beasts and birds, which allows the collection of the necessaries of life for one day only, and which necessitates the consumption of astringent and bitter (food), never sinks low.'

sanskrit_iast: mṛgaiḥ saha parispandaḥ saṃvāsas tebhir eva ca | tair eva sadṛśī vṛttiḥ pratyakṣaṃ svargalakṣaṇam | pratyakṣaṃ svargalakṣaṇam iti |
meaning: मृगैः सह परिस्पन्दः संवासस् तेभिर् एव च । तैर् एव सदृशी वृत्तिः प्रत्यक्षं स्वर्गलक्षणम् । प्रत्यक्षं स्वर्गलक्षणम् इति ।
text: 'Moving about with the beasts, dwelling together with them, and maintaining oneself in a manner similar to theirs, that is clearly the road to heaven.'

sanskrit_iast: atha yadi brahmacāry avratyam iva caren māṃsaṃ vāśnīyātstriyaṃ vopeyāt sarvāsv evārtiṣu |
meaning: अथ यदि ब्रह्मचार्य् अव्रत्यम् इव चरेन् मांसं वाश्नीयात्स्त्रियं वोपेयात् सर्वास्व् एवार्तिषु ।
text: Now if a student commits any act against his vow, eats meat, or approaches a woman, whenever any evil befals him,

sanskrit_iast: antarāgāre 'gnim upasamādhāya saṃparistīryāgnimukhāt kṛtvāthājyāhutīr upajuhoti | kāmena kṛtaṃkāmaḥ karoti kāmāyaivedaṃ sarvaṃ yo mā kārayati tasmai svāhā | manasā kṛtaṃ manaḥ karoti manasa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yo mā kārayati tasmaisvāhā | rajasā kṛtaṃ rajaḥ karoti rajasa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yo mā kārayati tasmai svāhā | tamasā kṛtaṃ tamaḥ karoti tamasa evedaṃsarvaṃ yo mā kārayati tasmai svāhā | pāpmanā kṛtaṃ pāpmā karotipāpmana evedaṃ sarvaṃ yo mā kārayati tasmai svāhā | manyunā kṛtaṃmanyuḥ karoti manyava evedaṃ sarvaṃ yo mā kārayati tasmai svāheti |
meaning: अन्तरागारे ऽग्निम् उपसमाधाय संपरिस्तीर्याग्निमुखात् कृत्वाथाज्याहुतीर् उपजुहोति । कामेन कृतंकामः करोति कामायैवेदं सर्वं यो मा कारयति तस्मै स्वाहा । मनसा कृतं मनः करोति मनस एवेदं सर्वं यो मा कारयति तस्मैस्वाहा । रजसा कृतं रजः करोति रजस एवेदं सर्वं यो मा कारयति तस्मै स्वाहा । तमसा कृतं तमः करोति तमस एवेदंसर्वं यो मा कारयति तस्मै स्वाहा । पाप्मना कृतं पाप्मा करोतिपाप्मन एवेदं सर्वं यो मा कारयति तस्मै स्वाहा । मन्युना कृतंमन्युः करोति मन्यव एवेदं सर्वं यो मा कारयति तस्मै स्वाहेति ।
text: He heaps fuel on the fire in the interior of the house, scatters (Kuśa grass) around it, and performs the ceremonies up to the end of the Agnimukha; then he offers oblations of clarified butter, (reciting the following texts): 'It was done by lust, lust does it, to lust (belongs) all this, to him who draws me on, Svāhā;' 'It was done by the internal organ, the internal organ does it, to the internal organ (belongs) all this, to him who draws me on, Svāhā;' 'It was done by passion, passion does it, to passion (belongs) all this, to him who draws me on, Svāhā;' 'It was done by ignorance, ignorance does it, to ignorance (belongs) all this, to him who draws me on, Svāhā;' 'It was done by sin, sin does it, to sin (belongs) all this, to him who draws me on, Svāhā;' 'It was done by wrath, wrath does it, to wrath (belongs) all this, to him who draws me on, Svāhā.'

sanskrit_iast: jayaprabhṛti siddham ā dhenuvarapradānāt |
meaning: जयप्रभृति सिद्धम् आ धेनुवरप्रदानात् ।
text: That which begins with the muttering (of the Vedic texts) and ends with the gift of a fee (consisting of) a cow is known,

sanskrit_iast: apareṇāgniṃ kṛṣṇājinena prācīnagrīveṇottaralomnāprāvṛtya vasati |
meaning: अपरेणाग्निं कृष्णाजिनेन प्राचीनग्रीवेणोत्तरलोम्नाप्रावृत्य वसति ।
text: (Afterwards) he stays (during the night) behind (i. e. to the west of) the fire, wrapping himself in the skin of a black antelope, the neck of which is turned towards the east and the hair of which is turned outside.

sanskrit_iast: vyuṣṭāyāṃ jaghanārdhād ātmānam apakṛṣya tīrthaṃ gatvā prasiddhaṃ snātvāntarjalagato 'ghamarṣaṇena ṣoḍaśa prāṇāyāmān dhārayitvā prasiddham ādityopasthānāt kṛtvācāryasya gṛhān eti |
meaning: व्युष्टायां जघनार्धाद् आत्मानम् अपकृष्य तीर्थं गत्वा प्रसिद्धं स्नात्वान्तर्जलगतो ऽघमर्षणेन षोडश प्राणायामान् धारयित्वा प्रसिद्धम् आदित्योपस्थानात् कृत्वाचार्यस्य गृहान् एति ।
text: When the day dawns, he drags himself away from the hinder part (of the skin), goes to a bathing-place, bathes (there) in the manner which is known, (but) performs, while in the water, sixteen suppressions of breath with the Aghamarshaṇa hymn; next he performs the known (ceremonies) up to the worship of the sun, and afterwards goes to the house of his teacher.

sanskrit_iast: yathāśvamedhāvabhṛtha evam evaitad vijānīyād iti |
meaning: यथाश्वमेधावभृथ एवम् एवैतद् विजानीयाद् इति ।
text: Let him know for certain that that is equally (effective) as bathing (with the priests) at the end of a horse-sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: athātaḥ pavitrātipavitrasyāghamarṣaṇasya kalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ |
meaning: अथातः पवित्रातिपवित्रस्याघमर्षणस्य कल्पं व्याख्यास्यामः ।
text: Now we will explain the rule of the most holy Aghamarshaṇa.
