sanskrit_iast: tīrthaṃ gatvā snātaḥ śucivāsā udakānte sthaṇḍilam uddhṛtya sakṛtklinnena vāsasā sakṛtpūrṇenapāṇinādityābhimukho 'ghamarṣaṇaṃ svādhyāyam adhīyīta |
meaning: तीर्थं गत्वा स्नातः शुचिवासा उदकान्ते स्थण्डिलम् उद्धृत्य सकृत्क्लिन्नेन वाससा सकृत्पूर्णेनपाणिनादित्याभिमुखो ऽघमर्षणं स्वाध्यायम् अधीयीत ।
text: He goes to a bathing-place and bathes (there). Dressed in a pure dress let him raise, close to the water, an altar, and moistening his clothes by one (application of water), and filling his hand once (with water), let him recite the Aghamarshaṇa hymn (in the manner of his daily) private recitation.

sanskrit_iast: prātaḥ śataṃ madhyāhne śatam aparāhṇe śatam aparimitaṃ vā |
meaning: प्रातः शतं मध्याह्ने शतम् अपराह्णे शतम् अपरिमितं वा ।
text: (Let him repeat it) one hundred times in the morning, one hundred times at midday, and one hundred times or an unlimited number of times in the afternoon.

sanskrit_iast: uditeṣu nakṣatreṣu prasṛtiyāvakaṃ prāśnīyāt |
meaning: उदितेषु नक्षत्रेषु प्रसृतियावकं प्राश्नीयात् ।
text: When the stars have risen, let him partake of gruel prepared of one handful of barley.

sanskrit_iast: jñānakṛtebhyo 'jñānakṛtebhyaś copapātakebhyaḥ saptarātrāt pramucyate dvādaśarātrād bhrūṇahananaṃ gurutalpagamanaṃsuvarṇastainyaṃ surāpānam iti ca varjayitvā |
meaning: ज्ञानकृतेभ्यो ऽज्ञानकृतेभ्यश् चोपपातकेभ्यः सप्तरात्रात् प्रमुच्यते द्वादशरात्राद् भ्रूणहननं गुरुतल्पगमनंसुवर्णस्तैन्यं सुरापानम् इति च वर्जयित्वा ।
text: After seven (days and) nights he is freed from all minor sins (upapātaka), whether they have been committed intentionally or unintentionally, after twelve (days and) nights (from all other sins) excepting the murder of a learned Brāhmaṇa, the violation of a Guru's bed, stealing gold, and drinking Surā.

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśatirātrāt tāny api tarati tāny api jayati |
meaning: एकविंशतिरात्रात् तान्य् अपि तरति तान्य् अपि जयति ।
text: After twenty-one (days and) nights he over-comes even those (crimes) and conquers them.

sanskrit_iast: sarvaṃ tarati sarvaṃ jayati sarvakratuphalam avāpnoti sarveṣutīrtheṣu snāto bhavati sarveṣu vedeṣu cīrṇavrato bhavati sarvairdevair jñāto bhavaty ā cakṣuṣaḥ paṅktiṃ punāti karmāṇi cāsya sidhyantīti baudhāyanaḥ |
meaning: सर्वं तरति सर्वं जयति सर्वक्रतुफलम् अवाप्नोति सर्वेषुतीर्थेषु स्नातो भवति सर्वेषु वेदेषु चीर्णव्रतो भवति सर्वैर्देवैर् ज्ञातो भवत्य् आ चक्षुषः पङ्क्तिं पुनाति कर्माणि चास्य सिध्यन्तीति बौधायनः ।
text: He overcomes everything, he conquers all, he obtains the reward of all sacrifices, he has bathed at all sacred bathing-places, he has performed the vows required for (the study of) all the Vedas, he becomes known to all the gods, he sanctifies a company (of Brāhmaṇas) by merely looking (at them), and his undertakings are successful. Thus speaks Baudhāyana.

sanskrit_iast: atha karmabhir ātmakṛtair gurum ivātmānaṃ manyetātmārthe prasṛtiyāvakaṃ śrapayeduditeṣu nakṣatreṣu |
meaning: अथ कर्मभिर् आत्मकृतैर् गुरुम् इवात्मानं मन्येतात्मार्थे प्रसृतियावकं श्रपयेदुदितेषु नक्षत्रेषु ।
text: Now if a man feels his conscience charged with (evil) actions committed by himself, let him boil for himself (alone), when the stars have risen, a handful of barley, (and prepare) gruel (with that).

sanskrit_iast: na tato 'gnau juhuyāt |
meaning: न ततो ऽग्नौ जुहुयात् ।
text: Let him not perform the Vaiśvadeva oblation with (a portion of) that,

sanskrit_iast: na cātra balikarma |
meaning: न चात्र बलिकर्म ।
text: Nor (shall) a Bali offering (be performed) on that (occasion).

sanskrit_iast: aśṛtaṃ śrapyamāṇaṃ śṛtaṃ cābhimantrayeta |
meaning: अशृतं श्रप्यमाणं शृतं चाभिमन्त्रयेत ।
text: Let him consecrate the barley before it is boiled, while it is being boiled, and after it has been boiled, with the (following) Mantras

sanskrit_iast: yavo 'si dhānyarājo 'si vāruṇo madhusaṃyutaḥ | nirṇodaḥ sarvapāpānāṃ pavitram ṛṣibhiḥ smṛtam | ghṛtaṃ yavā madhu yavā āpo vā amṛtaṃ yavāḥ | sarvaṃ punīta me pāpaṃ yan mayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam | vācā kṛtaṃ karma kṛtaṃ manasā durvicintitam | alakṣmīṃ kālakarṇīṃ ca sarvaṃ punīta me yavāḥ | śvasūkarāvadhūtaṃ ca kākocchiṣṭahataṃ ca yat | mātāpitror aśuśrūṣāṃ sarvaṃ punīta me yavāḥ | mahāpātakasaṃyuktaṃ dāruṇaṃ rājakilbiṣam | bālavṛddham adharmaṃ ca sarvaṃ punīta me yavāḥ | suvarṇastainyam avratyam ayājyasya ca yājanam | brāhmaṇānāṃ parīvādaṃ sarvaṃ punīta me yavāḥ | gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ca śūdrānnaṃ śrāddhasūtakam | corasyānnaṃ navaśrāddhaṃ sarvaṃ punīta meyavāḥ || iti |
meaning: यवो ऽसि धान्यराजो ऽसि वारुणो मधुसंयुतः । निर्णोदः सर्वपापानां पवित्रम् ऋषिभिः स्मृतम् । घृतं यवा मधु यवा आपो वा अमृतं यवाः । सर्वं पुनीत मे पापं यन् मया दुष्कृतं कृतम् । वाचा कृतं कर्म कृतं मनसा दुर्विचिन्तितम् । अलक्ष्मीं कालकर्णीं च सर्वं पुनीत मे यवाः । श्वसूकरावधूतं च काकोच्छिष्टहतं च यत् । मातापित्रोर् अशुश्रूषां सर्वं पुनीत मे यवाः । महापातकसंयुक्तं दारुणं राजकिल्बिषम् । बालवृद्धम् अधर्मं च सर्वं पुनीत मे यवाः । सुवर्णस्तैन्यम् अव्रत्यम् अयाज्यस्य च याजनम् । ब्राह्मणानां परीवादं सर्वं पुनीत मे यवाः । गणान्नं गणिकान्नं च शूद्रान्नं श्राद्धसूतकम् । चोरस्यान्नं नवश्राद्धं सर्वं पुनीत मेयवाः ॥ इति ।
text: 'Thou art barley, thou art the king of grains, thou art sacred to Varuṇa and mixed with honey, the sages have proclaimed thee an expeller of all guilt and a means of purification.' 'Ye barley-grains are clarified butter and honey, ye barley-grains are water and ambrosia. May you remove my guilt and all my sins:' 'Those committed by words, by acts, and by evil thoughts; ill-fortune and the night of all-destroying time,--all that avert from me, ye barley-grains.' '(From the sin of eating) food which had been worried by dogs or pigs, or which had been defiled by crows and impure men, from the sin of disobedience towards mother and father,--from all that purify me, ye barley-grains.' 'From the dreadful (guilt of) mortal sins and of the crime (of serving) a king, from the wrong done to infants or aged men, from (the guilt) of stealing gold, of breaking my vows, of sacrificing for an un-worthy man, of speaking evil of Brāhmaṇas,--from all that purify me, ye barley-grains.' 'From (the sin of eating) the food of many men, of harlots and of Śūdras, of (partaking of) funeral dinners and of (the food given by) persons who are unclean on account of a death or a birth, of that given by thieves, or at a funeral sacrifice offered to one who lately died,--from all that purify me, ye barley-grains.'

sanskrit_iast: śrapyamāṇe rakṣāṃ kuryāt | namo rudrāya bhūtādhipataye | dyauḥ śāntā | kṛṇuṣva pājaḥ prasitiṃ na pṛthvīm ity etenānuvākena | ye devāḥ puraḥsado 'gninetrāḥ rakṣohaṇa iti pañcabhiḥ paryāyaiḥ | mā nas toke | brahmā devānām itidvābhyām |
meaning: श्रप्यमाणे रक्षां कुर्यात् । नमो रुद्राय भूताधिपतये । द्यौः शान्ता । कृणुष्व पाजः प्रसितिं न पृथ्वीम् इत्य् एतेनानुवाकेन । ये देवाः पुरःसदो ऽग्निनेत्राः रक्षोहण इति पञ्चभिः पर्यायैः । मा नस् तोके । ब्रह्मा देवानाम् इतिद्वाभ्याम् ।
text: (While the barley) is being boiled, he must protect it (and recite the text), 'Adoration to Rudra, the lord of created beings; pacified is the sky;' the Anuvāka (beginning), 'Give strength;' the five sentences (beginning), 'The gods who are seated in front, led by Agni;' the two (texts), 'Do not hurt our offspring,' (and) 'The Brahman-priest among the gods.'

sanskrit_iast: śṛtaṃ ca laghv aśnīyāt prayataḥ pātre niṣicya |
meaning: शृतं च लघ्व् अश्नीयात् प्रयतः पात्रे निषिच्य ।
text: Having purified himself (by sipping water, &c.), he shall eat a little of the boiled (mess), after pouring it into (another) vessel.

sanskrit_iast: ye devā manojātā manoyujaḥ sudakṣā dakṣapitāras te naḥ pāntu te no 'vantu tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāheti | ātmani juhuyāt |
meaning: ये देवा मनोजाता मनोयुजः सुदक्षा दक्षपितारस् ते नः पान्तु ते नो ऽवन्तु तेभ्यो नमस् तेभ्यः स्वाहेति । आत्मनि जुहुयात् ।
text: Let him offer it as a sacrifice to the soul, (reciting the text), 'May the gods, who are born from the internal organ and joined to the internal organ, who are very strong, whose father is Daksha, protect us (and) guard us; adoration to them, to them Svāhā.'

sanskrit_iast: trirātraṃ medhārthī |
meaning: त्रिरात्रं मेधार्थी ।
text: Let him who desires intelligence (subsist on such food during three (days and) nights.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍrātraṃ pītvā pāpakṛc chuddho bhavati |
meaning: षड्रात्रं पीत्वा पापकृच् छुद्धो भवति ।
text: A sinner who drinks it during six (days and) nights becomes pure.

sanskrit_iast: saptarātraṃ pītvā bhrūṇahananaṃ gurutalpagamanaṃsuvarṇastainyaṃ surāpānam iti ca punāti |
meaning: सप्तरात्रं पीत्वा भ्रूणहननं गुरुतल्पगमनंसुवर्णस्तैन्यं सुरापानम् इति च पुनाति ।
text: He who drinks it during seven (days and) nights is purified from (the guilt of) the murder of a learned Brāhmaṇa, of violating a Guru's bed, of stealing gold, and of drinking Surā.

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśarātraṃ pītvā pūrvapuruṣakṛtam api pāpaṃ nirṇudati |
meaning: एकादशरात्रं पीत्वा पूर्वपुरुषकृतम् अपि पापं निर्णुदति ।
text: He who drinks it during eleven (days and) nights, removes even the sins committed by his ancestors.

sanskrit_iast: api vā goniṣkrāntānāṃ yavānām ekaviṃśatirātraṃ pītvāgaṇān paśyati gaṇādhipatiṃ paśyati vidyāṃ paśyati vidyādhipatiṃ paśyatīty āha bhagavān baudhāyanaḥ |
meaning: अपि वा गोनिष्क्रान्तानां यवानाम् एकविंशतिरात्रं पीत्वागणान् पश्यति गणाधिपतिं पश्यति विद्यां पश्यति विद्याधिपतिं पश्यतीत्य् आह भगवान् बौधायनः ।
text: 'But he who during twenty-one days (drinks gruel made) of barley-grains which have passed through a cow, sees the G aṇas and the lord of the G aṇas, sees the goddess of learning and the lord of learning.' Thus speaks the venerable Baudhāyana.

sanskrit_iast: kūśmāṇḍair juhuyād yo 'pūta iva manyeta |
meaning: कूश्माण्डैर् जुहुयाद् यो ऽपूत इव मन्येत ।

sanskrit_iast: yathā steno yathā bhrūṇahaivam eṣa bhavati yo 'yonau retaḥ siñcati |
meaning: यथा स्तेनो यथा भ्रूणहैवम् एष भवति यो ऽयोनौ रेतः सिञ्चति ।

sanskrit_iast: yad arvācīnam eno bhrūṇahatyāyās tasmān mucyata iti |
meaning: यद् अर्वाचीनम् एनो भ्रूणहत्यायास् तस्मान् मुच्यत इति ।
text: 'He is freed from any sin which is less than the crime of slaying a learned Brāhmaṇa.'

sanskrit_iast: ayonau retaḥ siktvānyatra svapnād arepā vā pavitrakāmaḥ |
meaning: अयोनौ रेतः सिक्त्वान्यत्र स्वप्नाद् अरेपा वा पवित्रकामः ।
text: If, after wasting his strength except in his sleep, he desires to become free from the stain and holy,

sanskrit_iast: amāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā keśaśmaśrulomanakhāni vāpayitvā brahmacārikalpena vratam upaiti |
meaning: अमावास्यायां पौर्णमास्यां वा केशश्मश्रुलोमनखानि वापयित्वा ब्रह्मचारिकल्पेन व्रतम् उपैति ।
text: He causes the hair of his head, his beard, the hair on his body, and his nails to be cut on the day of the new moon or of the full moon, and takes upon himself a vow according to the rule prescribed for students,

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaraṃ māsaṃ caturviṃśatyahaṃ dvādaśarātrīḥ ṣaṭ tisro vā |
meaning: संवत्सरं मासं चतुर्विंशत्यहं द्वादशरात्रीः षट् तिस्रो वा ।
text: (To be kept) during a year, or a month, or twenty-four days, or twelve nights, or six or three nights.

sanskrit_iast: na māṃsam aśnīyān na striyam upeyān noparyāsīta jugupsetānṛtāt |
meaning: न मांसम् अश्नीयान् न स्त्रियम् उपेयान् नोपर्यासीत जुगुप्सेतानृतात् ।
text: Let him not eat meat, nor approach a woman, not sit on (a couch or seat, and) beware of (speaking an) untruth.

sanskrit_iast: payobhakṣa iti prathamaḥ kalpaḥ | yāvakaṃ vopayuñjānaḥkṛcchradvādaśarātraṃ cared bhikṣed vā |
meaning: पयोभक्ष इति प्रथमः कल्पः । यावकं वोपयुञ्जानःकृच्छ्रद्वादशरात्रं चरेद् भिक्षेद् वा ।
text: To subsist on milk (alone is) the most excellent mode of living; or, using barley-gruel (as his food), he may perform a K ri k kh ra (penance) of twelve days, or he may (maintain himself by) begging.

sanskrit_iast: tadvidheṣu yavāgūṃ rājanyo vaiśya āmikṣām |
meaning: तद्विधेषु यवागूं राजन्यो वैश्य आमिक्षाम् ।
text: On such (occasions) a Kshatriya (shall subsist on) barley-gruel, a Vaiśya on curds of two-milk whey.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvāhṇe pākayajñikadharmeṇāgnim upasamādhāya saṃparistīryāgnimukhāt kṛtvāthājyāhutīr upajuhoti | yad devā devaheḍanam | yad adīvyann ṛṇam ahaṃ babhūva | āyuṣ ṭe viśvato dadhad iti | etaistribhir anuvākaiḥ |
meaning: पूर्वाह्णे पाकयज्ञिकधर्मेणाग्निम् उपसमाधाय संपरिस्तीर्याग्निमुखात् कृत्वाथाज्याहुतीर् उपजुहोति । यद् देवा देवहेडनम् । यद् अदीव्यन्न् ऋणम् अहं बभूव । आयुष् टे विश्वतो दधद् इति । एतैस्त्रिभिर् अनुवाकैः ।
text: Having kindled the sacred fire in the morning according to the rule for Pākaya g ñ as, having scattered (Kuśa grass) around it, and having performed (the preliminary ceremonies) up to the end of the Agnimukha, he next offers in addition burnt oblations, reciting the three Anuvākas (beginning), 'What cause of anger to the gods, ye gods,' 'The debts which I contracted,' (and) 'May worshipful Agni give thee by every means long life.'

sanskrit_iast: pratyṛcam ājyasya juhuyāt |
meaning: प्रत्यृचम् आज्यस्य जुहुयात् ।
text: Let him offer with each Ri k-verse a portion of clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: siṃhe vyāghra uta yā pṛdākāv iti catasraḥ sruvāhutīḥ | agne 'bhyāvartin | agne aṅgiraḥ | punar ūrjā | saha rayyeticatasro 'bhyāvartinīr hutvā samitpāṇir yajamānaloke 'vasthāya | vaiśvānarāya prati vedayāma iti dvādaśarcena sūktenopatiṣṭhate |
meaning: सिंहे व्याघ्र उत या पृदाकाव् इति चतस्रः स्रुवाहुतीः । अग्ने ऽभ्यावर्तिन् । अग्ने अङ्गिरः । पुनर् ऊर्जा । सह रय्येतिचतस्रो ऽभ्यावर्तिनीर् हुत्वा समित्पाणिर् यजमानलोके ऽवस्थाय । वैश्वानराय प्रति वेदयाम इति द्वादशर्चेन सूक्तेनोपतिष्ठते ।
text: After having offered four oblations with (the spoon called) Sruva, reciting (the texts), 'That strength which lies in the lion, in the tiger, and in the panther,' &c., and the four Abhyāvartinīs (i.e. the texts), 'Thou, O fire, who turnest back,' &c., 'O Aṅgiras,' &c., 'Again with strength,' &c., (and) 'With wealth,' &c., after having taken his position, with sacred fuel in his hands, in the place allotted to the sacrificer, he worships (the fire) with the hymn which contains twelve verses (and begins), 'To Vaiśvānara we announce.'

sanskrit_iast: yan mayā manasā vācā kṛtam enaḥ kadācana | sarvasmāttasmān meḍito mogdhi tvaṃ hi vetthayathātathaṃ svāheti | samidham ādhāya varaṃ dadāti |
meaning: यन् मया मनसा वाचा कृतम् एनः कदाचन । सर्वस्मात्तस्मान् मेडितो मोग्धि त्वं हि वेत्थयथातथं स्वाहेति । समिधम् आधाय वरं ददाति ।
text: Having placed the piece of sacred fuel (on the fire with the text), 'Whatever sin I ever committed by thoughts or words, from all that free me (O fire, being duly) praised, for thou knowest the truth, Svāhā,' he gives a fee.

sanskrit_iast: jayaprabhṛti siddham ā dhenuvarapradānāt |
meaning: जयप्रभृति सिद्धम् आ धेनुवरप्रदानात् ।
text: (The ceremonies) which begin with the muttering (of the texts) and end with the gift of a cow as a fee are known.

sanskrit_iast: eka evāgnau paricārī |
meaning: एक एवाग्नौ परिचारी ।
text: One (person) only (shall) perform the service of the fire.

sanskrit_iast: athāgnyādheye | yad devā devaheḍanam | yad adīvyann ṛṇam ahaṃ babhūva | āyuṣ ṭe viśvato dadhad iti | pūrṇāhutīḥ |
meaning: अथाग्न्याधेये । यद् देवा देवहेडनम् । यद् अदीव्यन्न् ऋणम् अहं बभूव । आयुष् टे विश्वतो दधद् इति । पूर्णाहुतीः ।
text: Now (let him offer) at the Agnyādheya full oblations (pūrṇāhuti, with the texts), 'Whatever cause of anger to the gods, ye gods;' 'The debts which I contracted;" May worshipful Agni give thee by every means long life.'

sanskrit_iast: hutvāgnihotram ārapsyamāno daśahotrā | hutvādarśapūrṇamāsāv ārapsyamānaś caturhotrā | hutvā cāturmāsyānyārapsyamānaḥ pañcahotrā | hutvā paśubandhe ṣaḍḍhotrā | hutvā some saptahotrā |
meaning: हुत्वाग्निहोत्रम् आरप्स्यमानो दशहोत्रा । हुत्वादर्शपूर्णमासाव् आरप्स्यमानश् चतुर्होत्रा । हुत्वा चातुर्मास्यान्यारप्स्यमानः पञ्चहोत्रा । हुत्वा पशुबन्धे षड्ढोत्रा । हुत्वा सोमे सप्तहोत्रा ।
text: Having offered (it), he who is about to perform the Agnihotra, (worships) with the Daśahot ri (texts); having offered (it), he who is about to perform the new and full moon sacrifices (worships) with the K aturhot ri (texts); having offered (it), he who is about to offer the K āturmāsya sacrifices (worships) with the Pa ñ k ahot ri (texts); having offered it, (he worships) at an animal sacrifice with the Shaḍdh ot ri (texts), at a Soma-sacrifice with the Saptahot ri (texts).

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyate ca | karmādiṣv etair juhuyāt | pūto devalokān samaśnuta iti hi brāhmaṇam | iti hi brāhmaṇam |
meaning: विज्ञायते च । कर्मादिष्व् एतैर् जुहुयात् । पूतो देवलोकान् समश्नुत इति हि ब्राह्मणम् । इति हि ब्राह्मणम् ।
text: And it is declared in the Veda, 'Let him sacrifice (with the Kūshmāṇd a texts) at the beginning of the rites; purified (thereby) he gains the world of the gods.' Thus (speaks) the Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: athātaś cāndrāyaṇasya kalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ |
meaning: अथातश् चान्द्रायणस्य कल्पं व्याख्यास्यामः ।
text: Now, therefore, we will explain the rule of the K āndrāyaṇa (lunar penance).

sanskrit_iast: śuklacaturdaśīm upavaset |
meaning: शुक्लचतुर्दशीम् उपवसेत् ।
text: Let him fast on the fourteenth day of the bright half of the month.

sanskrit_iast: keśaśmaśrulomanakhāni vāpayitvāpi vā śmaśrūṇy evāhataṃvāso vasānaḥ satyaṃ bruvann āvasatham abhyupeyāt |
meaning: केशश्मश्रुलोमनखानि वापयित्वापि वा श्मश्रूण्य् एवाहतंवासो वसानः सत्यं ब्रुवन्न् आवसथम् अभ्युपेयात् ।
text: Having had the hair on his head, his beard, the hair on his body, and his nails, or his beard alone, cut, let him enter, dressed, in new clothes and speaking the truth, the place where the sacrificial fire is preserved.

sanskrit_iast: tasminn asya sakṛtpraṇīto 'gnir araṇyor nirmanthyo vā |
meaning: तस्मिन्न् अस्य सकृत्प्रणीतो ऽग्निर् अरण्योर् निर्मन्थ्यो वा ।
text: There a (common) fire, (which may be) fetched once (only, shall serve) him; or (the fire) must be produced by friction with the Araṇis.

sanskrit_iast: brahmacārī suhṛt praiṣāyopakalpī syāt |
meaning: ब्रह्मचारी सुहृत् प्रैषायोपकल्पी स्यात् ।
text: Let a student, who is a friend (of the performer), be ready at hand to (carry out his) directions;

sanskrit_iast: haviṣyaṃ ca vratopāyanīyam |
meaning: हविष्यं च व्रतोपायनीयम् ।
text: And sacrificial viands (shall be his) food during the performance of the vow.

sanskrit_iast: agnim upasamādhāya saṃparistīryāgnimukhāt kṛtvāpakvāj juhoti |
meaning: अग्निम् उपसमाधाय संपरिस्तीर्याग्निमुखात् कृत्वापक्वाज् जुहोति ।
text: Having heaped fuel on the fire, scattered (Kuśa grass) around it, and performed (the ceremonies) up to the end of the Agnimukha, he offers burnt oblations, (cutting off portions) from the cooked food,

sanskrit_iast: agnaye yā tithiḥ syān nakṣatrāya sadaivatāya | atrāha gor amanvateti cāndramasīṃ pañcamīṃ dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīmahorātrābhyāṃ saptamīṃ raudrīm aṣṭamīṃ saurīṃ navamīṃ vāruṇīṃdaśamīm aindrīm ekādaśīṃ vaiśvadevīṃ dvādaśīm iti |
meaning: अग्नये या तिथिः स्यान् नक्षत्राय सदैवताय । अत्राह गोर् अमन्वतेति चान्द्रमसीं पञ्चमीं द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां षष्ठीमहोरात्राभ्यां सप्तमीं रौद्रीम् अष्टमीं सौरीं नवमीं वारुणींदशमीम् ऐन्द्रीम् एकादशीं वैश्वदेवीं द्वादशीम् इति ।
text: (The first) to Agni, (the second) to the lunar day whichever it may be, (the third and the fourth) to the lunar mansion together with its guardian deity, the fifth to the moon (with the verse), 'Atrāha gor amanvata,' the sixth to the sky and the earth, the seventh to day and night, the eighth to Rudra, the ninth to the sun, the tenth to Varuṇa, the eleventh to Indra, and the twelfth to all the gods.

sanskrit_iast: athāparāḥ samāmananti digbhyaś ca sadaivatābhya urorantarikṣāya sadaivatāya |
meaning: अथापराः समामनन्ति दिग्भ्यश् च सदैवताभ्य उरोरन्तरिक्षाय सदैवताय ।
text: Now they mention (the following) other (oblations which are to be offered) to the points of the horizon and to their (guardian) deities, to the wide middle sphere and to its (guardian) deity.

sanskrit_iast: navonavo bhavati jāyamāna iti sauviṣṭakṛtīṃ hutvāthaitad havirucchiṣṭaṃ kaṃse vā camase vā vyuddhṛtyahaviṣyair vyañjanair upasicya pañcadaśa piṇḍān prakṛtisthān prāśnāti |
meaning: नवोनवो भवति जायमान इति सौविष्टकृतीं हुत्वाथैतद् हविरुच्छिष्टं कंसे वा चमसे वा व्युद्धृत्यहविष्यैर् व्यञ्जनैर् उपसिच्य पञ्चदश पिण्डान् प्रकृतिस्थान् प्राश्नाति ।
text: Having offered (the oblation) to Agni Svishṭak ri t (with the verse), 'Ever new,' &c., he then places the remainder of the sacrificial viands into a goblet (kaṃsa) or a cup ( k amasa), pours seasoning, that is fit for sacrifices, over them, and eats fifteen morsels of ordinary size,

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāya tveti prathamam | apānāya tveti dvitīyam | vyānāya tveti tṛtīyam | udānāya tveti caturtham | samānāyatveti pañcamam | yadā catvāro dvābhyāṃ pūrvam | yadā trayodvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ pūrvau | yadā dvau dvābhyāṃ pūrvaṃ tribhiruttaram | ekaṃ sarvaiḥ |
meaning: प्राणाय त्वेति प्रथमम् । अपानाय त्वेति द्वितीयम् । व्यानाय त्वेति तृतीयम् । उदानाय त्वेति चतुर्थम् । समानायत्वेति पञ्चमम् । यदा चत्वारो द्वाभ्यां पूर्वम् । यदा त्रयोद्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां पूर्वौ । यदा द्वौ द्वाभ्यां पूर्वं त्रिभिरुत्तरम् । एकं सर्वैः ।
text: The first (saying, 'I offer) thee to Prāṇa,' the second (saying,' I offer) thee to Apāna,' the third (saying, 'I offer) thee to Vyāna,' the fourth (saying, 'I offer) thee to Udāna,' the fifth (saying, 'I offer) thee to Samāna.' If there are only four (mouthfuls, he eats) the first reciting two (texts); if there are three, (he eats) the first two reciting two (texts) with each; if there are two, (he eats) the first reciting two (texts and) the second reciting three texts; (if, there is only) one, (he recites) all (the five texts) together.

sanskrit_iast: nigrābhyā stheti | apaḥ pītvāthājyāhutīr upajuhoti | prāṇāpānavyānodānasamānā me śudhyantāṃ jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā | vāṅmanaḥ | śiraḥpāṇi | tvakcarmamāṃsa | śabdasparśarūpa | pṛthivyaptejo | annamayaprāṇamayamanomayavijñānamayānandamayā me śudhyantāṃjyotir ahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāheti saptabhir anuvākaiḥ |
meaning: निग्राभ्या स्थेति । अपः पीत्वाथाज्याहुतीर् उपजुहोति । प्राणापानव्यानोदानसमाना मे शुध्यन्तां ज्योतिरहं विरजा विपाप्मा भूयासं स्वाहा । वाङ्मनः । शिरःपाणि । त्वक्चर्ममांस । शब्दस्पर्शरूप । पृथिव्यप्तेजो । अन्नमयप्राणमयमनोमयविज्ञानमयानन्दमया मे शुध्यन्तांज्योतिर् अहं विरजा विपाप्मा भूयासं स्वाहेति सप्तभिर् अनुवाकैः ।
text: Having drunk water (with the text), 'Thou art water used for moistening Soma,' &c., he then offers the (following) additional oblations of clarified butter, with the seven Anuvākas (beginning), 'May my Prāṇa, Apāna, Vyāna, Udāna, and Samāna be purified;' 'May my voice, mind, eye, ear,' &c.; 'May my head, hands, feet;' 'May my skin;' 'May the sense of hearing, touch;' 'May earth, water;' 'May that which consists of food.'

sanskrit_iast: jayaprabhṛti siddham ā dhenuvarapradānāt |
meaning: जयप्रभृति सिद्धम् आ धेनुवरप्रदानात् ।
text: (The ceremonies) beginning with the muttering (of sacred texts) and ending with the gift of a cow as a fee are known.

sanskrit_iast: saurībhir ādityam upatiṣṭhate cāndramasībhiś candramasam |
meaning: सौरीभिर् आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठते चान्द्रमसीभिश् चन्द्रमसम् ।
text: He worships the sun with (three verses) ad--dressed to Sūrya and the moon with (three verses) addressed to K andramas.

sanskrit_iast: agne tvaṃ su jāgṛhīti saṃviśañ japati |
meaning: अग्ने त्वं सु जागृहीति संविशञ् जपति ।
text: When he goes to rest, he mutters (the verse), 'O fire, keep thou good watch,'

sanskrit_iast: tvam agne vratapā asīti prabuddhaḥ |
meaning: त्वम् अग्ने व्रतपा असीति प्रबुद्धः ।
text: When he awakes (in the morning, the verse), 'O fire, thou art the protector of vows.'

sanskrit_iast: strīśūdrair nābhibhāṣeta mūtrapurīṣe nāvekṣeta |
meaning: स्त्रीशूद्रैर् नाभिभाषेत मूत्रपुरीषे नावेक्षेत ।
text: Let him not talk with women and Śūdras addressing them first; let him not look at urine and ordure.

sanskrit_iast: amedhyaṃ dṛṣṭvā japati | abaddhaṃ mano daridraṃ cakṣuḥ sūryojyotiṣāṃ śreṣṭho dīkṣe mā mā hāsīr iti |
meaning: अमेध्यं दृष्ट्वा जपति । अबद्धं मनो दरिद्रं चक्षुः सूर्योज्योतिषां श्रेष्ठो दीक्षे मा मा हासीर् इति ।
text: If he has seen any impure substance, he mutters (the text), 'Unrestrained (was) the internal organ, wretched my eye; the sun is the most excellent among the lights of heaven; O initiation, mayest thou not forsake me.'

sanskrit_iast: prathamāyām aparapakṣasya caturdaśa grāsān |
meaning: प्रथमायाम् अपरपक्षस्य चतुर्दश ग्रासान् ।
text: On the first day of the latter half (of the month he eats) fourteen mouthfuls.

sanskrit_iast: evam ekāpacayenāmāvāsyāyāḥ |
meaning: एवम् एकापचयेनामावास्यायाः ।
text: Thus (he takes every day) one (mouthful) less up to the day of the new moon.

sanskrit_iast: amāvāsyāyāṃ grāso na vidyate |
meaning: अमावास्यायां ग्रासो न विद्यते ।
text: On the day of the new moon there is not (even) one mouthful (left to take).

sanskrit_iast: atha prathamāyāṃ pūrvapakṣasyaikaḥ | dvaudvitīyāyām |
meaning: अथ प्रथमायां पूर्वपक्षस्यैकः । द्वौद्वितीयायाम् ।
text: On the first day of the first half (of the month) one (mouthful may be eaten), on the second two.

sanskrit_iast: evam ekopacayenā paurṇamāsyāḥ |
meaning: एवम् एकोपचयेना पौर्णमास्याः ।
text: Thus he daily increases (his meal) by one (mouthful) up to the day of the full moon.

sanskrit_iast: paurṇamāsyāṃ sthālīpākasya juhoty agnaye yā tithiḥ syānnakṣatrebhyaś ca sadaivatebhyaḥ |
meaning: पौर्णमास्यां स्थालीपाकस्य जुहोत्य् अग्नये या तिथिः स्यान्नक्षत्रेभ्यश् च सदैवतेभ्यः ।
text: On the day of the full moon he offers a Sthālīpāka to Agni, to the lunar day whichever it may be, and to the lunar mansions as well as to their (guardian) deities.

sanskrit_iast: purastāc chroṇāyā abhijitaḥ sadaivatasya hutvā gāṃbrāhmaṇebhyo dadyāt |
meaning: पुरस्ताच् छ्रोणाया अभिजितः सदैवतस्य हुत्वा गांब्राह्मणेभ्यो दद्यात् ।
text: Having offered a burnt oblation to (the lunar mansion) Abhi g it (which stands) before Śroṇā, and to its (guardian) deity, he must give a cow to the Brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast: tad etac cāndrāyaṇaṃ pipīlikāmadhyam | viparītaṃ yavamadhyam |
meaning: तद् एतच् चान्द्रायणं पिपीलिकामध्यम् । विपरीतं यवमध्यम् ।
text: That is the ant-shaped lunar penance; (that which is performed in the) inverted (order is called) the barleycorn-shaped (lunar penance).

sanskrit_iast: ato 'nyatarac caritvā sarvebhyaḥ pātakebhyaḥ pāpakṛc chuddho bhavati |
meaning: अतो ऽन्यतरच् चरित्वा सर्वेभ्यः पातकेभ्यः पापकृच् छुद्धो भवति ।
text: A sinner who has performed either of these two (penances) becomes free from all mortal sins (pātaka).

sanskrit_iast: kāmāya kāmāyaitad āhāryam ity ācakṣate |
meaning: कामाय कामायैतद् आहार्यम् इत्य् आचक्षते ।
text: They declare that the ( K āndrāyaṇa) shall be performed for the sake of the fulfilment of wishes of all kinds.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayate tam etenāpnoti |
meaning: यं कामं कामयते तम् एतेनाप्नोति ।
text: 'Thereby man obtains every wish which he may conceive.'

sanskrit_iast: etena vā ṛṣaya ātmānaṃ śodhayitvā purā karmāṇy asādhayan | tad etad dhanyaṃ puṇyaṃ putryaṃ pautryaṃ paśavyam āyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃyaśasyaṃ sārvakāmikam |
meaning: एतेन वा ऋषय आत्मानं शोधयित्वा पुरा कर्माण्य् असाधयन् । तद् एतद् धन्यं पुण्यं पुत्र्यं पौत्र्यं पशव्यम् आयुष्यं स्वर्ग्यंयशस्यं सार्वकामिकम् ।
text: 'Thereby the sages formerly purified themselves and accomplished their objects. That (rite) procures wealth, spiritual merit, sons, cattle, long life, heavenly bliss, and fame; it secures the fulfilment of all desires.'

sanskrit_iast: nakṣatrāṇāṃ dyutiṃ sūryācandramasor eva sāyujyaṃ salokatām āpnoti ya u cainad adhīte | ya u cainad adhīte |
meaning: नक्षत्राणां द्युतिं सूर्याचन्द्रमसोर् एव सायुज्यं सलोकताम् आप्नोति य उ चैनद् अधीते । य उ चैनद् अधीते ।
text: 'He who studies this, becomes the companion of the lunar constellations, of sun and moon, and dwells in their world.'

sanskrit_iast: athāto 'naśnatpārāyaṇavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ |
meaning: अथातो ऽनश्नत्पारायणविधिं व्याख्यास्यामः ।
text: Now, therefore, we will explain the rule of the Anaśnatpārāyaṇa (recitation of the whole Veda during a fast).

sanskrit_iast: śucivāsāḥ syāc cīravāsā vā |
meaning: शुचिवासाः स्याच् चीरवासा वा ।
text: Let him wear a clean garment or a dress made of bark (or grass).

sanskrit_iast: haviṣyam annam icched apaḥ phalāni vā |
meaning: हविष्यम् अन्नम् इच्छेद् अपः फलानि वा ।
text: Let him desire food, fit for a sacrifice, or water and fruit.

sanskrit_iast: grāmāt prācīṃ vodīcīṃ vā diśam upaniṣkramya gomayenagocarmamātraṃ caturaśraṃ sthaṇḍilam upalipya prokṣya lakṣaṇam ullikhya adbhir abhyukṣya agnim upasamādhāya saṃparistīryaitābhyodevatābhyo juhuyāt | agnaye svāhā | prajāpataye svāhā | somāyasvāhā viśvebhyo devebhyaḥsvayaṃbhuva ṛgbhyo yajurbhyaḥ sāmabhyo 'tharvabhyaḥ śraddhāyai prajñāyaimedhāyai śriyai hriyai savitre sāvitryai sadasaspataye 'numataye ca |
meaning: ग्रामात् प्राचीं वोदीचीं वा दिशम् उपनिष्क्रम्य गोमयेनगोचर्ममात्रं चतुरश्रं स्थण्डिलम् उपलिप्य प्रोक्ष्य लक्षणम् उल्लिख्य अद्भिर् अभ्युक्ष्य अग्निम् उपसमाधाय संपरिस्तीर्यैताभ्योदेवताभ्यो जुहुयात् । अग्नये स्वाहा । प्रजापतये स्वाहा । सोमायस्वाहा विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यःस्वयंभुव ऋग्भ्यो यजुर्भ्यः सामभ्यो ऽथर्वभ्यः श्रद्धायै प्रज्ञायैमेधायै श्रियै ह्रियै सवित्रे सावित्र्यै सदसस्पतये ऽनुमतये च ।
text: Going forth from the village in an easterly or northerly direction, smearing a quadrangular sthaṇd ila, 'a bull's hide' in size, with cowdung, sprinkling it, drawing the marks on it, sprinkling it with water, heaping fuel on the fire and scattering (Kuśa grass) around it, he offers burnt oblations to the following deities, to Agni Svāhā, to Pra g āpati [paragraph continues] Svāhā, to Soma Svāhā, to all the gods Svāhā, to Svayaṃbhu, to the Ri k as, to the Ya g us, to the Sāmans, to the Atharvans, to faith, to right knowledge, to wisdom, to fortune, to modesty, to Savit ri , to the Sāvitrī (verse), to Sadasaspati, and to Anumati.

sanskrit_iast: hutvā vedādim ārabheta saṃtatam adhīyīta |
meaning: हुत्वा वेदादिम् आरभेत संततम् अधीयीत ।
text: Having offered (these oblations), he must begin with the beginning of the Veda and continuously recite (it).

sanskrit_iast: nāntarā vyāharen na cāntarā viramet |
meaning: नान्तरा व्याहरेन् न चान्तरा विरमेत् ।
text: Let him not interrupt (the recitation) by talking, nor by stopping,

sanskrit_iast: athāntarā vyāhared athāntarā viramet triḥ prāṇān āyamya vṛttāntād evārabheta |
meaning: अथान्तरा व्याहरेद् अथान्तरा विरमेत् त्रिः प्राणान् आयम्य वृत्तान्ताद् एवारभेत ।
text: Now if he converses in between or stops, let him thrice suppress his breath, and begin just there where he left off.

sanskrit_iast: apratibhāyāṃ yāvatā kālena na veda tāvantaṃ kālaṃ tad adhīyīta sa yadā jānīyād ṛkto yajuṣṭaḥ sāmataiti |
meaning: अप्रतिभायां यावता कालेन न वेद तावन्तं कालं तद् अधीयीत स यदा जानीयाद् ऋक्तो यजुष्टः सामतैति ।
text: If he has forgotten (a passage), he shall recite for as long a time as he does not recollect it, what (he may know, Ri k-verses) for Ri k-verses, (Ya g us-formulas) for Ya g us-formulas, (Sāmans) for Sāmans.

sanskrit_iast: tadbrāhmaṇaṃ tacchāndasaṃ taddaivatam adhīyīta |
meaning: तद्ब्राह्मणं तच्छान्दसं तद्दैवतम् अधीयीत ।
text: He may (also) recite the Brāhmaṇa of that (forgotten passage) or (the passage from the Anukramaṇī regarding) its metre and its deities.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa vedasaṃhitā adhīyīta | yadanenānadhyāye 'dhīyīta yad guravaḥ kopitā yāny akāryāṇi bhavantitābhiḥ punīte | śuddham asya pūtaṃ brahma bhavati |
meaning: द्वादश वेदसंहिता अधीयीत । यदनेनानध्याये ऽधीयीत यद् गुरवः कोपिता यान्य् अकार्याणि भवन्तिताभिः पुनीते । शुद्धम् अस्य पूतं ब्रह्म भवति ।
text: Let him recite the Saṃhitā of (his) Veda twelve (times). He thereby removes (faults committed by) studying on forbidden (days, by) angering his teacher, (and through) improper acts. His (knowledge of the) Veda is sanctified, is purified.

sanskrit_iast: ata ūrdhvaṃ saṃcayaḥ |
meaning: अत ऊर्ध्वं संचयः ।
text: (If he reads) more than that, a cumulation (of rewards will be the result).

sanskrit_iast: aparā dvādaśa vedasaṃhitā adhītya tābhir uśanaso lokam avāpnoti |
meaning: अपरा द्वादश वेदसंहिता अधीत्य ताभिर् उशनसो लोकम् अवाप्नोति ।
text: If he recites the Saṃhitā of the Veda another twelve (times), he gains thereby the world of Uśanas.

sanskrit_iast: aparā dvādaśa vedasaṃhitā adhītya tābhir bṛhaspater lokam avāpnoti |
meaning: अपरा द्वादश वेदसंहिता अधीत्य ताभिर् बृहस्पतेर् लोकम् अवाप्नोति ।
text: If he recites the Saṃhitā of the Veda another twelve (times), he gains thereby the world of B ri haspati.

sanskrit_iast: aparā dvādaśa vedasaṃhitā adhītya tābhiḥ prajāpater lokam avāpnoti |
meaning: अपरा द्वादश वेदसंहिता अधीत्य ताभिः प्रजापतेर् लोकम् अवाप्नोति ।
text: If he recites the Saṃhitā of the Veda another twelve (times), he gains thereby the world of Pra g āpati.

sanskrit_iast: anaśnan saṃhitā sahasram adhīyīta | brahmabhūto virajo brahma bhavati |
meaning: अनश्नन् संहिता सहस्रम् अधीयीत । ब्रह्मभूतो विरजो ब्रह्म भवति ।
text: If, fasting, he recites the Saṃhitā one thou-sand (times), he becomes one with Brahman, resplendent like Brahman (and) Brahman (itself).

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaraṃ bhaikṣaṃ prayuñjāno divyaṃ cakṣur labhate |
meaning: संवत्सरं भैक्षं प्रयुञ्जानो दिव्यं चक्षुर् लभते ।
text: If he subsists during a year on food obtained by begging, he gains (the power of) supernatural vision.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṇ māsān yāvakabhakṣaś caturo māsān udakasaktubhakṣo dvaumāsau phalabhakṣo māsam abbhakṣo dvādaśarātraṃ vāprāśnan kṣipram antardhīyate jñātīn punāti saptāvarān sapta pūrvān ātmānaṃpañcadaśaṃ paṅktiṃ ca punāti |
meaning: षण् मासान् यावकभक्षश् चतुरो मासान् उदकसक्तुभक्षो द्वौमासौ फलभक्षो मासम् अब्भक्षो द्वादशरात्रं वाप्राश्नन् क्षिप्रम् अन्तर्धीयते ज्ञातीन् पुनाति सप्तावरान् सप्त पूर्वान् आत्मानंपञ्चदशं पङ्क्तिं च पुनाति ।
text: If during six months he subsists on barley-gruel, during four months on water and barley-flour, during two months on fruit, (and) during one month on water, or performs K ri k kh ra penances of twelve days, he (obtains the power of) suddenly disappearing, and sanctifies seven descendants, seven ancestors, and himself as the fifteenth, and (any) company (of Brāhmaṇas) which he may enter.

sanskrit_iast: tām etāṃ devaniśrayaṇīty ācakṣate |
meaning: ताम् एतां देवनिश्रयणीत्य् आचक्षते ।
text: They call that the ladder of the gods.

sanskrit_iast: etayā vai devā devatvam agacchann ṛṣaya ṛṣitvam |
meaning: एतया वै देवा देवत्वम् अगच्छन्न् ऋषय ऋषित्वम् ।
text: By means of that the gods reached their divine station and the sages the position of Ri shis.

sanskrit_iast: tasya ha vā etasya yajñasya trividha evārambhakālaḥprātaḥsavane mādhyaṃdine savane brāhme vāpararātre |
meaning: तस्य ह वा एतस्य यज्ञस्य त्रिविध एवारम्भकालःप्रातःसवने माध्यंदिने सवने ब्राह्मे वापररात्रे ।
text: The periods for beginning this sacrifice, forsooth, are three, the time of the morning libation, the time of the midday libation, and the last part of the night, (the Muhūrta) sacred to Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ vā etaṃ prajāpatiḥ saptarṣibhyaḥ provāca saptarṣayomahājajñave mahājajñur brāhmaṇebhyaḥ | brāhmaṇebhyaḥ |
meaning: तं वा एतं प्रजापतिः सप्तर्षिभ्यः प्रोवाच सप्तर्षयोमहाजज्ञवे महाजज्ञुर् ब्राह्मणेभ्यः । ब्राह्मणेभ्यः ।
text: Pra g āpati, forsooth, proclaimed this (rite) to the seven Ri shis, the seven Ri shis to Mahā g a g ñ u, and Mahā g a g ñ u to the Brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast: ukto varṇadharmaś cāśramadharmaś ca |
meaning: उक्तो वर्णधर्मश् चाश्रमधर्मश् च ।
text: The law of castes and of orders has been declared.

sanskrit_iast: atha khalv ayaṃ puruṣo yāpyena karmaṇā mithyā vā caratyayājyaṃ vā yājayaty apratigrāhyasya vā pratigṛhṇāty anāśyānnasyavānnam aśnāty acaraṇīyena vā carati |
meaning: अथ खल्व् अयं पुरुषो याप्येन कर्मणा मिथ्या वा चरत्ययाज्यं वा याजयत्य् अप्रतिग्राह्यस्य वा प्रतिगृह्णात्य् अनाश्यान्नस्यवान्नम् अश्नात्य् अचरणीयेन वा चरति ।
text: Now, indeed, man (in) this (world is polluted) by a vile action or acts wrongly, (e.g.) sacrifices for men. unworthy to offer a sacrifice, accepts presents from those whose gifts ought not to be accepted, eats the food of those whose food ought not to be eaten, (and) practises what is forbidden.

sanskrit_iast: tatra prāyaścittaṃ kuryān na kuryād iti mīmāṃsante |
meaning: तत्र प्रायश्चित्तं कुर्यान् न कुर्याद् इति मीमांसन्ते ।
text: They are in doubt if he shall perform a penance for such (a deed) or if he shall not do it.

sanskrit_iast: nahi karma kṣīyata iti |
meaning: नहि कर्म क्षीयत इति ।
text: (They declare that he shall not do it) because the deed does not perish.

sanskrit_iast: kuryād ity eva |
meaning: कुर्याद् इत्य् एव ।
text: (The correct opinion is) that he shall perform (a penance).

sanskrit_iast: punastomeneṣṭvā punaḥ savanamāyāntīti vijñāyate |
meaning: पुनस्तोमेनेष्ट्वा पुनः सवनमायान्तीति विज्ञायते ।
text: It is declared in the Veda, 'Let him offer a Punastoma; (those who offer it, may) again come to (partake of) the libations of Soma.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | sarvaṃ pāpmānaṃ tarati taratibrahmahatyāṃ yo 'śvamedhena yajata iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । सर्वं पाप्मानं तरति तरतिब्रह्महत्यां यो ऽश्वमेधेन यजत इति ।
text: He who offers a horse-sacrifice conquers all sin, he effaces the guilt of the murder of a Brāhmaṇa.'

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭutā vābhiśaṃsyamāno yajeteti ca |
meaning: अग्निष्टुता वाभिशंस्यमानो यजेतेति च ।
text: Moreover, 'He who is being accused (of a heinous crime) shall perform an Agnishṭut sacrifice.'

sanskrit_iast: tasya niṣkrayaṇāni japas tapo homa upavāso dānam |
meaning: तस्य निष्क्रयणानि जपस् तपो होम उपवासो दानम् ।
text: Reciting the Veda, austerity, a sacrifice, fasting, giving gifts are the means for expiating such (a blamable act).

sanskrit_iast: upaniṣado vedādayo vedāntāḥ sarvacchandaḥsu saṃhitā madhūnyaghamarṣaṇam atharvaśiro rudrāḥ puruṣasūktaṃ rājanarauhiṇe sāmanībṛhadrathaṃtare puruṣagatir mahānāmnyo mahāvairājaṃ mahādivākīrtyaṃjyeṣṭhasāmnām anyatamaṃ bahiṣpavamānaḥ kūśmāṇḍyaḥ pāvamānyaḥ sāvitrī ceti pāvanāni |
meaning: उपनिषदो वेदादयो वेदान्ताः सर्वच्छन्दःसु संहिता मधून्यघमर्षणम् अथर्वशिरो रुद्राः पुरुषसूक्तं राजनरौहिणे सामनीबृहद्रथंतरे पुरुषगतिर् महानाम्न्यो महावैराजं महादिवाकीर्त्यंज्येष्ठसाम्नाम् अन्यतमं बहिष्पवमानः कूश्माण्ड्यः पावमान्यः सावित्री चेति पावनानि ।
text: The purificatory (texts are), the Upanishads, the initial (verses) of the Vedas, the ends of the Vedas (vedāntas), the Saṃhitās of all the Vedas, (the Anuvākas called) Madhu, (the hymn of) Aghamarshaṇa, the Atharvaśiras, (the Anuvākas called the) Rudras, the Purusha hymn, the two Sāmans (called) Rā g ina and Rauhiṇeya, the B ri hat (Sāman) and the Rathantara, the Purushagati (Sāman), the Mahānāmnīs, the Mahāvairā g a (Sāman), the Mahādivākīrtya (Sāman), any of the G yesh th a Sāmans, the Bahishpavamāna Sāman, the Kūshmāṇd īs, the Pāvamānīs, and the Sāvitrī.

sanskrit_iast: upasannyāyena payovratatā śākabhakṣatā phalabhakṣatāmūlabhakṣatā prasṛtiyāvako hiraṇyaprāśanaṃ ghṛtaprāśanaṃsomapānam iti medhyāni |
meaning: उपसन्न्यायेन पयोव्रतता शाकभक्षता फलभक्षतामूलभक्षता प्रसृतियावको हिरण्यप्राशनं घृतप्राशनंसोमपानम् इति मेध्यानि ।
text: To live on milk alone, as if one were fasting, to eat vegetables only, to eat fruit only, (to live on) gruel prepared of a handful of barley-grains, to eat gold, to eat clarified butter (are the modes of subsistence) which purify.

sanskrit_iast: sarve śiloccayāḥ sarvāḥ sravantyaḥ saritaḥ puṇyā hradāstīrthāny ṛṣiniketanāni goṣṭhakṣetrapariṣkandā iti deśāḥ |
meaning: सर्वे शिलोच्चयाः सर्वाः स्रवन्त्यः सरितः पुण्या ह्रदास्तीर्थान्य् ऋषिनिकेतनानि गोष्ठक्षेत्रपरिष्कन्दा इति देशाः ।
text: All mountains, all rivers, holy lakes, bathing-places, the dwellings of Ri shis, cowpens, (holy) plains and temples of the gods (are) places (which destroy sin)

sanskrit_iast: ahiṃsā satyam astainyaṃ savaneṣūdakopasparśanaṃguruśuśrūṣā brahmacaryam adhaḥśayanam ekavastratānāśaka ititapāṃsi |
meaning: अहिंसा सत्यम् अस्तैन्यं सवनेषूदकोपस्पर्शनंगुरुशुश्रूषा ब्रह्मचर्यम् अधःशयनम् एकवस्त्रतानाशक इतितपांसि ।
text: Abstention from injuring living beings, truthfulness, abstention from theft (or unrighteously appropriating anything), bathing in the morning, at noon, and in the evening, obedience towards Gurus, continence, sleeping on the ground, dressing in one garment only, and abstaining from food (are the various kinds of) austerity.

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyaṃ gaur vāso 'śvo bhūmis tilā ghṛtam annam iti deyāni |
meaning: हिरण्यं गौर् वासो ऽश्वो भूमिस् तिला घृतम् अन्नम् इति देयानि ।
text: Gold, a cow, a dress, a horse, land, sesamum, clarified butter, and food (are) the gifts.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaraḥ ṣaṇmāsāś catvāras trayo dvāv ekaścaturviṃśatyaho dvādaśāhaḥ ṣaḍahas tryaho 'horātra ekāha itikālāḥ |
meaning: संवत्सरः षण्मासाश् चत्वारस् त्रयो द्वाव् एकश्चतुर्विंशत्यहो द्वादशाहः षडहस् त्र्यहो ऽहोरात्र एकाह इतिकालाः ।
text: A year, six months, four (months), three (months), two (months), one (month), twenty-four days, twelve days, six days, three days, a day and a night, (and) one day are the periods (for penances).

sanskrit_iast: etāny anādeśe kriyeran |
meaning: एतान्य् अनादेशे क्रियेरन् ।
text: These (acts) may be optionally performed if no (particular penance) has been prescribed,

sanskrit_iast: enaḥsu guruṣu gurūṇi laghuṣu laghūni |
meaning: एनःसु गुरुषु गुरूणि लघुषु लघूनि ।
text: (Viz.) for great crimes difficult (penances) and for trivial faults easy ones.

sanskrit_iast: kṛcchrātikṛcchrau cāndrāyaṇam iti sarvaprāyaścittiḥ | sarvaprāyaścittiḥ |
meaning: कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रौ चान्द्रायणम् इति सर्वप्रायश्चित्तिः । सर्वप्रायश्चित्तिः ।
text: The K ri k kh ra and the Atik ri k kh ra, as well as the K āndrāyaṇa, are penances for all (offences).

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścittāni vakṣyāmo nānārthāni pṛthakpṛthak | teṣuteṣu ca doṣeṣu garīyāṃsi laghūni ca |
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तानि वक्ष्यामो नानार्थानि पृथक्पृथक् । तेषुतेषु च दोषेषु गरीयांसि लघूनि च ।
text: We will separately explain the various penances for the several offences, both heavier and lighter ones.

sanskrit_iast: yady atra hi bhaved yuktaṃ tad hi tatraiva nirdiśet | bhūyobhūyo garīyaḥsu laghuṣv alpīyasas tathā |
meaning: यद्य् अत्र हि भवेद् युक्तं तद् हि तत्रैव निर्दिशेत् । भूयोभूयो गरीयःसु लघुष्व् अल्पीयसस् तथा ।
text: Let him prescribe whatever may be befitting for each (case),--heavier (penances) for great (crimes) and easier ones for trivial (faults).

sanskrit_iast: vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena prāṇāyāmān samācaret | yad upasthakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ padbhyāṃ vā yat kṛtaṃ bhavet | bāhubhyāṃ manasā vācā śrotratvagghrāṇacakṣuṣā |
meaning: विधिना शास्त्रदृष्टेन प्राणायामान् समाचरेत् । यद् उपस्थकृतं पापं पद्भ्यां वा यत् कृतं भवेत् । बाहुभ्यां मनसा वाचा श्रोत्रत्वग्घ्राणचक्षुषा ।
text: Let him perform the penances according to the rule given in the Institutes (of the Sacred Law in cases) where an offence has been committed with the organ or with the feet (and) the arms, through thoughts or speech, through the ear, the skin, the nose or the eye.

sanskrit_iast: api vā cakṣuḥśrotratvagghrāṇamanovyatikrameṣu tribhiḥ prāṇāyāmaiḥ śudhyati |
meaning: अपि वा चक्षुःश्रोत्रत्वग्घ्राणमनोव्यतिक्रमेषु त्रिभिः प्राणायामैः शुध्यति ।
text: Or, in (the case of) transgressions committed through the organ of vision, of hearing, of sensation, of smelling, and through thoughts, he also becomes pure by three suppressions of the breath.

sanskrit_iast: śūdrānnastrīgamanabhojaneṣu kevaleṣu pṛthakpṛthaksaptāhaṃ saptasapta prāṇāyāmān dhārayet |
meaning: शूद्रान्नस्त्रीगमनभोजनेषु केवलेषु पृथक्पृथक्सप्ताहं सप्तसप्त प्राणायामान् धारयेत् ।
text: In case (he commits the offences) of eating the food of a Śūdra or of cohabiting with a Śūdra female, severally, he must perform, during seven days, seven suppressions of the breath on each day.

sanskrit_iast: abhakṣyābhojyāpeyānādyaprāśaneṣu tathāpaṇyavikrayeṣumadhumāṃsaghṛtatailakṣāralavaṇāvarānnavarjeṣu yac cānyad apyevaṃyuktaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ dvādaśadvādaśa prāṇāyāmān dhārayet |
meaning: अभक्ष्याभोज्यापेयानाद्यप्राशनेषु तथापण्यविक्रयेषुमधुमांसघृततैलक्षारलवणावरान्नवर्जेषु यच् चान्यद् अप्येवंयुक्तं द्वादशाहं द्वादशद्वादश प्राणायामान् धारयेत् ।
text: For partaking of food unfit for eating or drinking, and for selling forbidden merchandise, excepting honey, meat, clarified butter, oil, pungent condiments and bad food, and for similar (offences), he must perform, during twelve days, twelve suppressions of the breath on each day.

sanskrit_iast: pātakapatanīyopapātakavarjeṣu yac cānyad apy evaṃyuktamardhamāsaṃ dvādaśadvādaśa prāṇāyāmān dhārayet |
meaning: पातकपतनीयोपपातकवर्जेषु यच् चान्यद् अप्य् एवंयुक्तमर्धमासं द्वादशद्वादश प्राणायामान् धारयेत् ।
text: For other transgressions excepting mortal sins (pātaka), crimes causing loss of caste (patanīya), and the minor faults (called upapātaka), he must perform, during half a month, twelve suppressions of the breath on each day.

sanskrit_iast: pātakapatanīyavarjeṣu yac cānyad apy evaṃyuktaṃ dvādaśadvādaśāhān dvādaśadvādaśa prāṇāyāmān dhārayet |
meaning: पातकपतनीयवर्जेषु यच् चान्यद् अप्य् एवंयुक्तं द्वादशद्वादशाहान् द्वादशद्वादश प्राणायामान् धारयेत् ।
text: For other transgressions excepting mortal sins and crimes causing loss of caste, he must perform, during twelve periods of twelve days, twelve suppressions of the breath on each day.

sanskrit_iast: pātakavarjeṣu yac cānyad apy evaṃyuktaṃ dvādaśārdhamāsāndvādaśadvādaśa prāṇāyāmān dhārayet |
meaning: पातकवर्जेषु यच् चान्यद् अप्य् एवंयुक्तं द्वादशार्धमासान्द्वादशद्वादश प्राणायामान् धारयेत् ।
text: For other transgressions excepting mortal sins he must perform, during twelve half-months, twelve suppressions of the breath on each day.

sanskrit_iast: atha pātakeṣu saṃvatsaraṃ dvādaśadvādaśa prāṇāyāmān dhārayet |
meaning: अथ पातकेषु संवत्सरं द्वादशद्वादश प्राणायामान् धारयेत् ।
text: But for mortal sins he must perform, during a year, twelve suppressions of the breath on each day.

sanskrit_iast: dadyād guṇavate kanyāṃ nagnikāṃ brahmacāriṇe | api vā guṇahīnāya noparundhyād rajasvalām |
meaning: दद्याद् गुणवते कन्यां नग्निकां ब्रह्मचारिणे । अपि वा गुणहीनाय नोपरुन्ध्याद् रजस्वलाम् ।
text: Let him give his daughter, while she still goes naked, to a man who has not broken the vow of chastity and who possesses good qualities, or even to one destitute of good qualities; let him not keep (the maiden) in (his house) after she has reached the age of puberty.

sanskrit_iast: trīṇi varṣāṇy ṛtumatīṃ yaḥ kanyāṃ na prayacchati | sa tulyaṃ bhrūṇahatyāyai doṣam ṛcchaty asaṃśayam |
meaning: त्रीणि वर्षाण्य् ऋतुमतीं यः कन्यां न प्रयच्छति । स तुल्यं भ्रूणहत्यायै दोषम् ऋच्छत्य् असंशयम् ।
text: He who does not give away a marriageable daughter during three years doubtlessly contracts a guilt equal to (that of) destroying an embryo.

sanskrit_iast: na yācate ced evaṃ syād yācate cet pṛthakpṛthak | ekaikasminn ṛtau doṣaṃ pātakaṃ manur abravīt |
meaning: न याचते चेद् एवं स्याद् याचते चेत् पृथक्पृथक् । एकैकस्मिन्न् ऋतौ दोषं पातकं मनुर् अब्रवीत् ।
text: Such will be the case if anybody asks her in marriage, and also if nobody demands her. Manu has declared that at each appearance of the menses (the father incurs the guilt of) a mortal sin.

sanskrit_iast: trīṇi varṣāṇy ṛtumatī kāṅkṣeta pitṛśāsanam | tataś caturthe varṣe tu vindeta sadṛśaṃ patim | avidyamāne sadṛśe guṇahīnam api śrayet |
meaning: त्रीणि वर्षाण्य् ऋतुमती काङ्क्षेत पितृशासनम् । ततश् चतुर्थे वर्षे तु विन्देत सदृशं पतिम् । अविद्यमाने सदृशे गुणहीनम् अपि श्रयेत् ।
text: Three years let a marriageable damsel wait for the order of her father. But after (that) time let her choose for herself in the fourth year a husband (of) equal (rank). If no man (of) equal (rank) be found, she may take even one destitute of good qualities.

sanskrit_iast: balāc cet prahṛtā kanyā mantrair yadi na saṃskṛtā | anyasmai vidhivad deyā yathā kanyā tathaiva sā |
meaning: बलाच् चेत् प्रहृता कन्या मन्त्रैर् यदि न संस्कृता । अन्यस्मै विधिवद् देया यथा कन्या तथैव सा ।
text: If a damsel has been abducted by force, and has not been wedded with sacred texts, she may lawfully be given to another man; she is even like a maiden.

sanskrit_iast: nisṛṣṭāyāṃ hute vāpi yasyai bhartā mriyeta saḥ | sā ced akṣatayoniḥ syād gatapratyāgatā satī | paunarbhavena vidhinā punaḥsaṃskāram arhati |
meaning: निसृष्टायां हुते वापि यस्यै भर्ता म्रियेत सः । सा चेद् अक्षतयोनिः स्याद् गतप्रत्यागता सती । पौनर्भवेन विधिना पुनःसंस्कारम् अर्हति ।
text: If, after (a damsel) has been given away, or even after (the nuptial sacrifices) have been offered, the husband dies, she who (thus) has left (her father's house) and has returned, may be again wedded according to the rule applicable to second weddings, provided the marriage had not been consummated.

sanskrit_iast: trīṇi varṣāṇy ṛtumatīṃ yo bhāryāṃ nādhigacchati | sa tulyaṃ bhrūṇahatyāyai doṣam ṛcchaty asaṃśayam |
meaning: त्रीणि वर्षाण्य् ऋतुमतीं यो भार्यां नाधिगच्छति । स तुल्यं भ्रूणहत्यायै दोषम् ऋच्छत्य् असंशयम् ।
text: He who does not approach, during three years, a wife who is marriageable, incurs, without doubt, a guilt equal to that of destroying an embryo.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtusnātāṃ tu yo bhāryāṃ saṃnidhau nopagacchati | pitaras tasya taṃ māsaṃ tasmin rajasi śerate |
meaning: ऋतुस्नातां तु यो भार्यां संनिधौ नोपगच्छति । पितरस् तस्य तं मासं तस्मिन् रजसि शेरते ।
text: But the ancestors of that man who does not approach his wife who bathed after her temporary uncleanness, though he dwells near her, lie during that month in the menstrual excretions (of the wife).

sanskrit_iast: ṛtau nopaiti yo bhāryām anṛtau yaś ca gacchati | tulyam āhus tayor doṣam ayonau yaś ca siñcati |
meaning: ऋतौ नोपैति यो भार्याम् अनृतौ यश् च गच्छति । तुल्यम् आहुस् तयोर् दोषम् अयोनौ यश् च सिञ्चति ।
text: They declare that the guilt of the husband who does not approach his wife in due season, of him who approaches her during her temporary uncleanness, and of him who commits an unnatural crime (with her), is equally (great).

sanskrit_iast: bhartuḥ pratiniveśena yā bhāryā skandayed ṛtum | tāṃ grāmamadhye vikhyāpya bhrūṇaghnīṃ nirdhamed gṛhāt |
meaning: भर्तुः प्रतिनिवेशेन या भार्या स्कन्दयेद् ऋतुम् । तां ग्राममध्ये विख्याप्य भ्रूणघ्नीं निर्धमेद् गृहात् ।
text: Let him proclaim in the village a wife who, being obdurate against her husband, makes herself sterile, as one who destroys embryos, and drive her from his house.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtusnātāṃ na ced gacchen niyatāṃ dharmacāriṇīm | niyamātikrame tasya prāṇāyāmaśataṃ smṛtam |
meaning: ऋतुस्नातां न चेद् गच्छेन् नियतां धर्मचारिणीम् । नियमातिक्रमे तस्य प्राणायामशतं स्मृतम् ।
text: But for the transgression of that husband who does not approach a wife who bathed after temporary uncleanness, (the performance of) one hundred suppressions of the breath is prescribed (as a penance).

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāyāmān pavitrāṇi vyāhṛtīḥ praṇavaṃ tathā | pavitrapāṇir āsīno brahma naityakam abhyaset |
meaning: प्राणायामान् पवित्राणि व्याहृतीः प्रणवं तथा । पवित्रपाणिर् आसीनो ब्रह्म नैत्यकम् अभ्यसेत् ।
text: Seated with Kuśa grass in his hands, let him repeatedly suppress his breath, and again and again recite purificatory texts, the Vyāh ri tis, the syllable Om, and the daily portion of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: āvartayet sadā yuktaḥ prāṇāyāmān punaḥpunaḥ | ā keśāntān nakhāgrāc ca tapas tapyata uttamam |
meaning: आवर्तयेत् सदा युक्तः प्राणायामान् पुनःपुनः । आ केशान्तान् नखाग्राच् च तपस् तप्यत उत्तमम् ।
text: Always intent on the practice of Yoga, let him again and again suppress his breath. (Thus) he performs the highest austerity up to the ends of his hair and up to the ends of his nails.

sanskrit_iast: nirodhāj jāyate vāyur vāyor agniś ca jāyate | tāpenāpo 'dhijāyante tato 'ntaḥ śudhyate tribhiḥ |
meaning: निरोधाज् जायते वायुर् वायोर् अग्निश् च जायते । तापेनापो ऽधिजायन्ते ततो ऽन्तः शुध्यते त्रिभिः ।
text: Through the obstruction (of the respiration) air is generated, through air fire is produced, then through heat water is formed; hence he is internally purified by (those) three.

sanskrit_iast: yogenāvāpyate jñānaṃ yogo dharmasya lakṣaṇam | yogamūlā guṇāḥ sarve tasmād yuktaḥ sadā bhavet |
meaning: योगेनावाप्यते ज्ञानं योगो धर्मस्य लक्षणम् । योगमूला गुणाः सर्वे तस्माद् युक्तः सदा भवेत् ।
text: Through the practice of Yoga (true) knowledge is obtained, Yoga is the sum of the sacred law, all good qualities are gained through Yoga; therefore let him always be absorbed in the practice of Yoga.

sanskrit_iast: praṇavādyās trayo vedāḥ praṇave paryavasthitāḥ | praṇavo vyāhṛtayaś caiva nityaṃ brahma sanātanam |
meaning: प्रणवाद्यास् त्रयो वेदाः प्रणवे पर्यवस्थिताः । प्रणवो व्याहृतयश् चैव नित्यं ब्रह्म सनातनम् ।
text: The Vedas likewise begin with the syllable Om, and they end with the syllable Om. The syllable Om and the Vyāh ri tis are the eternal, everlasting Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: praṇave nityayuktasya vyāhṛtīṣu ca saptasu | tripadāyāṃ ca gāyatryāṃ na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit |
meaning: प्रणवे नित्ययुक्तस्य व्याहृतीषु च सप्तसु । त्रिपदायां च गायत्र्यां न भयं विद्यते क्वचित् ।
text: For him who is constantly engaged in (reciting) the syllable Om, the seven Vyāh ri tis, and the three-footed Gāyatrī, no danger exists anywhere.

sanskrit_iast: savyāhṛtikāṃ sapraṇavāṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha | triḥ paṭhed āyataprāṇaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate |
meaning: सव्याहृतिकां सप्रणवां गायत्रीं शिरसा सह । त्रिः पठेद् आयतप्राणः प्राणायामः स उच्यते ।
text: If, restraining his breath, he thrice recites the Gāyatrī together with the syllable Om and with the (text called) Śiras, that is called one suppression of breath.

sanskrit_iast: savyāhṛtikāḥ sapraṇavāḥ prāṇāyāmās tu ṣoḍaśa | api bhrūṇahanaṃ māsāt punanty aharahardhṛtāḥ |
meaning: सव्याहृतिकाः सप्रणवाः प्राणायामास् तु षोडश । अपि भ्रूणहनं मासात् पुनन्त्य् अहरहर्धृताः ।
text: But sixteen suppressions of breath, accompanied by (the recitation of) the Vyāh ri tis and of the syllable Om, repeated daily, purify after a month even the slayer of a learned Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: etadādyaṃ tapaḥ śreṣṭham etad dharmasya lakṣaṇam | sarvadoṣopaghātārtham etad eva viśiṣyate | etad eva viśiṣyata iti |
meaning: एतदाद्यं तपः श्रेष्ठम् एतद् धर्मस्य लक्षणम् । सर्वदोषोपघातार्थम् एतद् एव विशिष्यते । एतद् एव विशिष्यत इति ।
text: That is the highest austerity, that is the best description of the sacred law. That, indeed, is the best means of removing all sin.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścittāni vakṣyāmo nānārthāni pṛthakpṛthak | teṣuteṣu ca doṣeṣu garīyāṃsi laghūni ca |
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तानि वक्ष्यामो नानार्थानि पृथक्पृथक् । तेषुतेषु च दोषेषु गरीयांसि लघूनि च ।
text: We will separately explain the various penances for the several offences, both heavier and lighter ones.

sanskrit_iast: yady atra hi bhaved yuktaṃ tad hi tatraiva nirdiśet | bhūyobhūyo garīyaḥsu laghuṣv alpīyasas tathā |
meaning: यद्य् अत्र हि भवेद् युक्तं तद् हि तत्रैव निर्दिशेत् । भूयोभूयो गरीयःसु लघुष्व् अल्पीयसस् तथा ।
text: Let him prescribe whatever may be befitting for each (case),--heavier penances for great (crimes), and lighter ones for trivial (faults).

sanskrit_iast: vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena prāyaścittāni nirdiśet |
meaning: विधिना शास्त्रदृष्टेन प्रायश्चित्तानि निर्दिशेत् ।
text: Let him perform the penances according to the rule given in the Institutes of the Sacred Law.

sanskrit_iast: pratigrahīṣyamāṇas tu pratigṛhya tathaiva ca | ṛcas taratsamandyas tu catasraḥ parivartayet |
meaning: प्रतिग्रहीष्यमाणस् तु प्रतिगृह्य तथैव च । ऋचस् तरत्समन्द्यस् तु चतस्रः परिवर्तयेत् ।
text: He who is about to accept gifts, or he who has accepted gifts, must repeatedly recite the four Ri k-verses (called) Taratsamandīs.

sanskrit_iast: abhojyānāṃ tu sarveṣām abhojyānnasya bhojane | ṛgbhis taratsamandībhir mārjanaṃpāpaśodhanam |
meaning: अभोज्यानां तु सर्वेषाम् अभोज्यान्नस्य भोजने । ऋग्भिस् तरत्समन्दीभिर् मार्जनंपापशोधनम् ।
text: But in case one has eaten any kind of forbidden food; or that given by a person whose food must not be eaten, the means of removing the guilt is to sprinkle water (over one's head) while one recites the Taratsamandī Ri k as.

sanskrit_iast: bhrūṇahatyāvidhis tv anyas taṃ tu vakṣyāmy ataḥ param | vidhinā yena mucyante pātakebhyo 'pi sarvaśaḥ |
meaning: भ्रूणहत्याविधिस् त्व् अन्यस् तं तु वक्ष्याम्य् अतः परम् । विधिना येन मुच्यन्ते पातकेभ्यो ऽपि सर्वशः ।
text: But we will, hereafter, declare another rule for (the expiation of) the murder of a learned Brāhmaṇa, whereby (men) are freed also from mortal sins of all (kinds).

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāyāmān pavitrāṇi vyāhṛtīḥ praṇavaṃ tathā | japed aghamarṣaṇaṃ sūktaṃ payasā dvādaśa kṣapāḥ |
meaning: प्राणायामान् पवित्राणि व्याहृतीः प्रणवं तथा । जपेद् अघमर्षणं सूक्तं पयसा द्वादश क्षपाः ।
text: Let him (perform), during twelve nights, suppressions of the breath (and) mutter purificatory texts, the Vyāh ri tis, the syllable Om, (and) the Aghamarshaṇa hymn, (living) on milk;

sanskrit_iast: trirātraṃ vāyubhakṣo vā klinnavāsāḥ plutaḥ śuciḥ |
meaning: त्रिरात्रं वायुभक्षो वा क्लिन्नवासाः प्लुतः शुचिः ।
text: Or (he becomes) pure if he bathes, and during three (days and) nights subsists on air and (remains dressed) in wet clothes.

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣiddhāṃs tathācārān abhyasyāpi punaḥpunaḥ | vāruṇībhir upasthāya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || iti |
meaning: प्रतिषिद्धांस् तथाचारान् अभ्यस्यापि पुनःपुनः । वारुणीभिर् उपस्थाय सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥ इति ।
text: But if he has repeatedly committed forbidden acts of all kinds, and has (afterwards) worshipped reciting the Vāruṇī (texts), he is freed from all sin.

sanskrit_iast: athāvakīrṇy amāvāsyāyāṃ niśy agnim upasamādhāyadārvihomikīṃ pariceṣṭāṃ kṛtvā dve ājyāhutī juhoti | kāmaavakīrṇo 'smy avakīrṇo 'smi kāma kāmāya svāhā | kāmaabhidrugdho 'smy abhidrugdho 'smi kāma kāmāya svāheti |
meaning: अथावकीर्ण्य् अमावास्यायां निश्य् अग्निम् उपसमाधायदार्विहोमिकीं परिचेष्टां कृत्वा द्वे आज्याहुती जुहोति । कामअवकीर्णो ऽस्म्य् अवकीर्णो ऽस्मि काम कामाय स्वाहा । कामअभिद्रुग्धो ऽस्म्य् अभिद्रुग्धो ऽस्मि काम कामाय स्वाहेति ।
text: Now a student who has broken his vow (avakīrṇin) shall heap fuel on the fire on the night of the new moon, perform the preparatory ceremonies required for a Darvīhoma, and offer two oblations of clarified butter (reciting the following texts): 'O Lust, I have broken my vow, my vow I have broken, O Lust, to. Lust Svāhā;' 'O Lust, I have done evil, I have done evil, O Lust, to Lust Svāhā.'

sanskrit_iast: hutvā prayatāñjaliḥ kavātiryaṅṅ agnim upatiṣṭheta | saṃ mā siñcantu marutaḥ sam indraḥ saṃ bṛhaspatiḥ | saṃ māyam agniḥ siñcatvāyuṣā ca balena cāyuṣmantaṃ karota meti | prati hāsmai marutaḥ prāṇān dadhati prati indro balaṃ pratibṛhaspatir brahmavarcasaṃ praty agnir itarat sarvam | sarvatanur bhūtvāsarvam āyur eti | trir abhimantrayeta | triṣatyā hi devā iti vijñāyate |
meaning: हुत्वा प्रयताञ्जलिः कवातिर्यङ्ङ् अग्निम् उपतिष्ठेत । सं मा सिञ्चन्तु मरुतः सम् इन्द्रः सं बृहस्पतिः । सं मायम् अग्निः सिञ्चत्वायुषा च बलेन चायुष्मन्तं करोत मेति । प्रति हास्मै मरुतः प्राणान् दधति प्रति इन्द्रो बलं प्रतिबृहस्पतिर् ब्रह्मवर्चसं प्रत्य् अग्निर् इतरत् सर्वम् । सर्वतनुर् भूत्वासर्वम् आयुर् एति । त्रिर् अभिमन्त्रयेत । त्रिषत्या हि देवा इति विज्ञायते ।
text: After he has made the offering, he shall address the fire, closely joining his hands and turning sideways, (with the following texts): 'May the Maruts grant me, may Indra, may B ri haspati,, may this fire grant me long life and strength, make me long-lived.' The Maruts, forsooth, give back to him the vital airs, Indra gives back to him strength, B ri haspati the lustre of Brahman, Fire all the remainder. (Thus) his body is made whole, and he attains the full length of life. Let him next address (the gods) with three (repetitions of the texts). [paragraph continues] For the gods are trebly true. (All that) has been declared in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: yo 'pūta iva manyeta ātmānam upapātakaiḥ | sa hutvaitena vidhinā sarvasmāt pāpāt pramucyate |
meaning: यो ऽपूत इव मन्येत आत्मानम् उपपातकैः । स हुत्वैतेन विधिना सर्वस्मात् पापात् प्रमुच्यते ।
text: He who considers himself defiled by minor offences (upapātaka), will be freed from all guilt if he offers burnt oblations according to this same rule;

sanskrit_iast: api vānādyāpeyapratiṣiddhabhojaneṣu doṣavac ca karma kṛtvābhisaṃdhipūrvam anabhisaṃdhipūrvaṃ vā śūdrāyāṃ ca retaḥ siktvāyonau vābliṅgābhir vāruṇībhiś copaspṛśya prayato bhavati |
meaning: अपि वानाद्यापेयप्रतिषिद्धभोजनेषु दोषवच् च कर्म कृत्वाभिसंधिपूर्वम् अनभिसंधिपूर्वं वा शूद्रायां च रेतः सिक्त्वायोनौ वाब्लिङ्गाभिर् वारुणीभिश् चोपस्पृश्य प्रयतो भवति ।
text: Or if he has partaken of food unfit to be eaten or to be drunk or of forbidden food, and if he has committed sinful acts or performed sinful rites either unintentionally or intentionally, and if he has had connexion with a female of the Śūdra caste or committed an unnatural crime, he becomes pure by bathing (and reciting) the Abliṅga (verses) and (those called) Vāruṇīs.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | anādyāpeyapratiṣiddhabhojane viruddhadharmācarite ca karmaṇi | matipravṛtte 'pi ca pātakopamair viśudhyate 'thāpi casarvapātakaiḥ |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अनाद्यापेयप्रतिषिद्धभोजने विरुद्धधर्माचरिते च कर्मणि । मतिप्रवृत्ते ऽपि च पातकोपमैर् विशुध्यते ऽथापि चसर्वपातकैः ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): If he has partaken of food unfit to be eaten or to be drunk, or of forbidden food, and if he has committed forbidden acts or performed forbidden rites, he will, nevertheless, be freed from (crimes) committed intentionally which are similar to mortal sins, nay, even from mortal sins (pātaka).'

sanskrit_iast: trirātraṃ vāpy upavasaṃs trir ahno 'bhyupayann apaḥ | prāṇān ātmani saṃyamya triḥ paṭhed aghamarṣaṇam | yathāśvamedhāvabhṛtha evaṃ tan manur abravīt |
meaning: त्रिरात्रं वाप्य् उपवसंस् त्रिर् अह्नो ऽभ्युपयन्न् अपः । प्राणान् आत्मनि संयम्य त्रिः पठेद् अघमर्षणम् । यथाश्वमेधावभृथ एवं तन् मनुर् अब्रवीत् ।
text: Or let him fast during three (days and) nights, bathe thrice a day, and, suppressing his breath, thrice recite the Aghamarshaṇa. Manu has declared that that is equal (in efficacy) to the final bath at a horse-sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyate ca | caraṇaṃ pavitraṃ vitataṃ purāṇaṃ yena pūtas tarati duṣkṛtāni | tena pavitreṇa śuddhena pūtā ati pāpmānam arātiṃ tarema || iti |
meaning: विज्ञायते च । चरणं पवित्रं विततं पुराणं येन पूतस् तरति दुष्कृतानि । तेन पवित्रेण शुद्धेन पूता अति पाप्मानम् अरातिं तरेम ॥ इति ।
text: And it is declared in the Veda, '(That is) the ancient purificatory rite, which is widely known (in the Institutes of the Sacred Law); purified thereby man conquers sin. May we, sanctified by this holy means of purification, conquer our enemy, sin.'

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścittāni vakṣyāmo 'vikhyātāni viśeṣataḥ | samāhitānāṃ yuktānāṃ pramādeṣu kathaṃ bhavet |
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तानि वक्ष्यामो ऽविख्यातानि विशेषतः । समाहितानां युक्तानां प्रमादेषु कथं भवेत् ।
text: We will explain the (secret) penances which are not prescribed (by others, but by the offender himself, and) particularly what shall be done in (case) faults (have been committed) by men who, with concentrated minds, (are) intent (on the performance of their duties).

sanskrit_iast: oṃpūrvābhir vyāhṛtibhiḥ sarvābhiḥ sarvapātakeṣv ācāmet |
meaning: ओंपूर्वाभिर् व्याहृतिभिः सर्वाभिः सर्वपातकेष्व् आचामेत् ।
text: (Such a man) may sip water, (in order to atone) for all mortal sins, reciting the syllable Om and all the Vyāh ri tis.

sanskrit_iast: yat prathamam ācāmati tenargvedaṃ prīṇāti yad dvitīyaṃ tenayajurvedaṃ yat tṛtīyaṃ tena sāmavedam |
meaning: यत् प्रथमम् आचामति तेनर्ग्वेदं प्रीणाति यद् द्वितीयं तेनयजुर्वेदं यत् तृतीयं तेन सामवेदम् ।
text: When he sips water the first time, he gladdens the Rig-veda, the second time the Ya g ur-veda, the third time the Sāma-veda.

sanskrit_iast: yat prathamaṃ parimārṣṭi tenātharvavedaṃ yad dvitīyaṃtenetihāsapurāṇam |
meaning: यत् प्रथमं परिमार्ष्टि तेनाथर्ववेदं यद् द्वितीयंतेनेतिहासपुराणम् ।
text: When he wipes (his lips) the first time, he gladdens the Atharva-veda, the second time the Itihāsas and Purāṇas.

sanskrit_iast: yat savyaṃ pāṇiṃ prokṣati pādau śiro hṛdayaṃ nāsike cakṣuṣīśrotre nābhiṃ copaspṛśati tenauṣadhivanaspatayaḥ sarvāś ca devatāḥ prīṇāti | tasmād ācamanād eva sarvasmāt pāpāt pramucyate |
meaning: यत् सव्यं पाणिं प्रोक्षति पादौ शिरो हृदयं नासिके चक्षुषीश्रोत्रे नाभिं चोपस्पृशति तेनौषधिवनस्पतयः सर्वाश् च देवताः प्रीणाति । तस्माद् आचमनाद् एव सर्वस्मात् पापात् प्रमुच्यते ।
text: When he sprinkles water on the right hand, the feet, the head, the heart, the nostrils, the eyes, the ears, and the navel, he gladdens the trees and herbs and all deities. Therefore he is freed from all sin by sipping water.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭau vā samidha ādadhyāt | devakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asisvāhā | manuṣyakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi svāhā | pitṛkṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi svāhā | ātmakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi svāhā | yad divā ca naktaṃ cainaś cakṛma tasyāvayajanam asisvāhā | yat svapantaś ca jāgrataś cainaś cakṛma tasyāvayajanam asisvāhā | yad vidvāṃsaś cāvidvāṃsaś cainaś cakṛma tasyāvayajanam asi svāhā | enasa enaso 'vayajanam asi svāheti |
meaning: अष्टौ वा समिध आदध्यात् । देवकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असिस्वाहा । मनुष्यकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि स्वाहा । पितृकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि स्वाहा । आत्मकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि स्वाहा । यद् दिवा च नक्तं चैनश् चकृम तस्यावयजनम् असिस्वाहा । यत् स्वपन्तश् च जाग्रतश् चैनश् चकृम तस्यावयजनम् असिस्वाहा । यद् विद्वांसश् चाविद्वांसश् चैनश् चकृम तस्यावयजनम् असि स्वाहा । एनस एनसो ऽवयजनम् असि स्वाहेति ।
text: Or let him offer in the fire eight pieces of sacred fuel, reciting (the following) eight (texts): 'Thou art the expiation of sin committed by the gods, Svāhā;' 'Thou art the expiation of sin committed by men, Svāhā;' 'Thou art the expiation of sin committed by the manes, Svāhā;' 'Thou art the expiation of sin committed by myself, Svāhā;' 'Thou art the expiation of the sift which we have committed either by day or by night, Svāhā;" Thou art the expiation of the sin which we have committed either sleeping or waking, Svāhā;' 'Thou art the expiation of the sin which we have committed either intentionally or unintentionally, Svāhā;' Thou art the expiation of every sin, Svāhā.'

sanskrit_iast: etair aṣṭābhir hutvā sarvasmāt pāpāt pramucyate |
meaning: एतैर् अष्टाभिर् हुत्वा सर्वस्मात् पापात् प्रमुच्यते ।
text: When he has offered (these eight oblations) he will be freed from all guilt.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | aghamarṣaṇaṃ devakṛtaṃ śuddhavatyas taratsamāḥ | kūśmāṇḍyaḥ pāvamānyaś ca virajā mṛtyulāṅgalam | durgā vyāhṛtayo rudrā mahādoṣavināśanāḥ | mahādoṣavināśanā iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अघमर्षणं देवकृतं शुद्धवत्यस् तरत्समाः । कूश्माण्ड्यः पावमान्यश् च विरजा मृत्युलाङ्गलम् । दुर्गा व्याहृतयो रुद्रा महादोषविनाशनाः । महादोषविनाशना इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'The Aghamarshaṇa, the Devak ri ta, the Suddhavatīs, the Taratsamās, the Kūshmāṇd īs, the Pāvamānīs, the Virā g ās, the M ri tyulāṅgala, the Durgā (Sāvitrī), the Vyāh ri tis, and the Rudras (are texts) which are very efficacious for effacing sin.'

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścittāni vakṣyāmo 'vikhyātāni viśeṣataḥ | samāhitānāṃ yuktānāṃ pramādeṣu kathaṃ bhavet |
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तानि वक्ष्यामो ऽविख्यातानि विशेषतः । समाहितानां युक्तानां प्रमादेषु कथं भवेत् ।
text: We will explain the (secret) penances which are not prescribed (by others, but by the offender himself, and) particularly what shall be done in (case) faults (have been committed) by men who, with concentrated minds, (are) intent (on the performance of their duties).

sanskrit_iast: ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ ceti | etad aghamarṣaṇaṃ trir antarjale paṭhansarvasmāt pāpāt pramucyate |
meaning: ऋतं च सत्यं चेति । एतद् अघमर्षणं त्रिर् अन्तर्जले पठन्सर्वस्मात् पापात् प्रमुच्यते ।
text: He who, standing in water, thrice recites that (hymn of) Aghamarshaṇa (which begins), 'Both right and truth,' will be freed from all guilt.

sanskrit_iast: āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnir akramīd iti | etām ṛcaṃ trir antarjale paṭhansarvasmāt pāpāt pramucyate |
meaning: आयं गौः पृश्निर् अक्रमीद् इति । एताम् ऋचं त्रिर् अन्तर्जले पठन्सर्वस्मात् पापात् प्रमुच्यते ।
text: He who, standing in water, thrice recites the verse, 'This spotted bull,' &c., will be freed from all guilt;

sanskrit_iast: drupadād iven mumucāna iti | etām ṛcaṃ trir antarjalepaṭhan sarvasmāt pāpāt pramucyate |
meaning: द्रुपदाद् इवेन् मुमुचान इति । एताम् ऋचं त्रिर् अन्तर्जलेपठन् सर्वस्मात् पापात् प्रमुच्यते ।
text: He who, standing in water, thrice recites the verse, 'Freed from the post as it were,' will be freed from all guilt.

sanskrit_iast: haṃsaḥ śuciṣad iti | etām ṛcaṃ trir antarjale paṭhan sarvasmātpāpāt pramucyate |
meaning: हंसः शुचिषद् इति । एताम् ऋचं त्रिर् अन्तर्जले पठन् सर्वस्मात्पापात् प्रमुच्यते ।
text: He who, standing in water, thrice recites the verse, 'A swan dwelling in purity,' will be freed from all guilt;

sanskrit_iast: api vā sāvitrīṃ paccho 'rdharcaśastataḥ samastāṃ trir antarjale paṭhan sarvasmātpāpāt pramucyate |
meaning: अपि वा सावित्रीं पच्छो ऽर्धर्चशस्ततः समस्तां त्रिर् अन्तर्जले पठन् सर्वस्मात्पापात् प्रमुच्यते ।
text: Or, he who, standing in water, thrice recites the Sāvitrī, foot by foot, half verse by half verse, and afterwards entire, will be freed from all guilt;

sanskrit_iast: api vā vyāhṛtīr vyastāḥ samastāś ceti trir antarjale paṭhansarvasmāt pāpāt pramucyate |
meaning: अपि वा व्याहृतीर् व्यस्ताः समस्ताश् चेति त्रिर् अन्तर्जले पठन्सर्वस्मात् पापात् प्रमुच्यते ।
text: Or, he who, standing in water, thrice recites the Vyāh ri tis, both separately and altogether, will be freed from all guilt;

sanskrit_iast: api vā praṇavam eva trir antarjale paṭhan sarvasmāt pāpāt pramucyate |
meaning: अपि वा प्रणवम् एव त्रिर् अन्तर्जले पठन् सर्वस्मात् पापात् प्रमुच्यते ।
text: Or, he who, standing in water, thrice recites the syllable Om alone, will be freed from all guilt.

sanskrit_iast: tad etad dharmaśāstraṃ nāputrāya nāśiṣyāya nāsaṃvatsaroṣitāya dadyāt |
meaning: तद् एतद् धर्मशास्त्रं नापुत्राय नाशिष्याय नासंवत्सरोषिताय दद्यात् ।
text: Let him not teach these Institutes of the Sacred Law to one who is neither his son nor his pupil, nor has resided (in his house) less than a year.

sanskrit_iast: sahasraṃ dakṣiṇa ṛṣabhaikādaśaṃ guruprasādo vā | guruprasādo vā |
meaning: सहस्रं दक्षिण ऋषभैकादशं गुरुप्रसादो वा । गुरुप्रसादो वा ।
text: The fee (for teaching it) is one thousand (paṇas, or) ten cows and a bull, or the worship of the teacher.

sanskrit_iast: athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi sāmargyajuratharvaṇām | karmabhir yair avāpnoti kṣipraṃ kāmān manogatān |
meaning: अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि सामर्ग्यजुरथर्वणाम् । कर्मभिर् यैर् अवाप्नोति क्षिप्रं कामान् मनोगतान् ।
text: Now, therefore, I will proclaim by what rites, connected with the Sāman, Rik, Ya g us, and Atharva-vedas, [paragraph continues] (man) quickly attains the wishes of his heart.

sanskrit_iast: japahomeṣṭiyantrādyaiḥ śodhayitvā svavigraham | sādhayet sarvakarmāṇi nānyathā siddhim aśnute |
meaning: जपहोमेष्टियन्त्राद्यैः शोधयित्वा स्वविग्रहम् । साधयेत् सर्वकर्माणि नान्यथा सिद्धिम् अश्नुते ।
text: Having purified his body by muttered prayers, burnt oblations, Ishṭis, restraints, and the like, he will accomplish all his objects. He will not attain success in any other way.

sanskrit_iast: japahomeṣṭiyantrāṇi kariṣyann ādito dvijaḥ | śuklapuṇyadinarkṣeṣu keśaśmaśrūṇi vāpayet |
meaning: जपहोमेष्टियन्त्राणि करिष्यन्न् आदितो द्विजः । शुक्लपुण्यदिनर्क्षेषु केशश्मश्रूणि वापयेत् ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa, who is going to mutter prayers, to offer burnt oblations or Ishṭis, or to practise restraints, shall, first, during the bright half of the month, on a lucky day and under a lucky constellation, cause his hair and beard to be cut.

sanskrit_iast: snāyāt triṣavaṇaṃ pāyād ātmānaṃkrodhato 'nṛtāt | strīśūdrair nābhibhāṣeta brahmacārī havirvrataḥ |
meaning: स्नायात् त्रिषवणं पायाद् आत्मानंक्रोधतो ऽनृतात् । स्त्रीशूद्रैर् नाभिभाषेत ब्रह्मचारी हविर्व्रतः ।
text: Let him bathe in the morning, at noon, and in the evening; let him beware of anger and untruth; let him not address women and Śūdras; let him be continent, and subsist solely on food fit for offerings.

sanskrit_iast: goviprapitṛdevebhyo namaskuryād divāsvapan | japahomeṣṭiyantrastho divāsthāno niśāsanaḥ |
meaning: गोविप्रपितृदेवेभ्यो नमस्कुर्याद् दिवास्वपन् । जपहोमेष्टियन्त्रस्थो दिवास्थानो निशासनः ।
text: Avoiding to sleep in the day-time, let him worship cows, Brāhmaṇas, manes, and gods. As long as he is engaged in muttering prayers, offering Homas and Ishṭis, and practising restraints, let him stand during the day and sit during the night.

sanskrit_iast: prājāpatyo bhavet kṛcchro divā rātrāv ayācitam | kramaśo vāyubhakṣaś ca dvādaśāhaṃ tryahaṃtryaham |
meaning: प्राजापत्यो भवेत् कृच्छ्रो दिवा रात्राव् अयाचितम् । क्रमशो वायुभक्षश् च द्वादशाहं त्र्यहंत्र्यहम् ।
text: The K ri k kh ra (penance) revealed by Pra g āpati lasts twelve days, (which are divided into four separate) periods of three days; (during the first period of three days he eats) in the day-time (only, during the second) at night (only, during the third he subsists on) food given without asking, (and during the fourth) finally (he lives on) air.

sanskrit_iast: ahar ekaṃ tathā naktam ajñātaṃ vāyubhakṣaṇam | trivṛd eṣa parāvṛtto bālānāṃ kṛcchra ucyate |
meaning: अहर् एकं तथा नक्तम् अज्ञातं वायुभक्षणम् । त्रिवृद् एष परावृत्तो बालानां कृच्छ्र उच्यते ।
text: (If one eats on) one (day in) the morning (only), and (on the following day) at night (only, on the next day food) given without asking, (and on the fourth day) subsists on air, and repeats this three times, that is called the K ri k kh ra (penance) of children.

sanskrit_iast: ekaikaṃ grāsam aśnīyāt pūrvoktena tryahaṃtryaham | vāyubhakṣas tryahaṃ cānyad atikṛcchraḥ sa ucyate |
meaning: एकैकं ग्रासम् अश्नीयात् पूर्वोक्तेन त्र्यहंत्र्यहम् । वायुभक्षस् त्र्यहं चान्यद् अतिकृच्छ्रः स उच्यते ।
text: (If) one eats one mouthful only at each (meal), following, during (three) periods of three days, the rules given above, and subsists during another period of three days on air, that is called the Atik ri k kh ra penance.

sanskrit_iast: ambubhakṣas tryahān etān vāyubhakṣas tataḥ param | kṛcchrātikṛcchras tṛtīyo vijñeyaḥ so 'tipāvanaḥ |
meaning: अम्बुभक्षस् त्र्यहान् एतान् वायुभक्षस् ततः परम् । कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रस् तृतीयो विज्ञेयः सो ऽतिपावनः ।
text: (If) during those (first) three periods of three days one partakes of water only, and subsists afterwards (during three days) on air, that third (variety) must be known to be the most efficacious K ri k kh rātik ri k kh ra penance.

sanskrit_iast: tryahaṃtryahaṃ pibed uṣṇaṃ payaḥ sarpiḥ kuśodakam | vāyubhakṣas tryahaṃ cānyat taptakṛcchraḥ sa ucyate |
meaning: त्र्यहंत्र्यहं पिबेद् उष्णं पयः सर्पिः कुशोदकम् । वायुभक्षस् त्र्यहं चान्यत् तप्तकृच्छ्रः स उच्यते ।
text: If one drinks hot milk, (hot) clarified butter, (and a hot) decoction of Kuśa grass, each during three days, and fasts during another three days, that is called the Taptak ri k kh ra.

sanskrit_iast: gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam | ekarātropavāsaś ca kṛcchraḥ sāṃtapanaḥ smṛtaḥ |
meaning: गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकम् । एकरात्रोपवासश् च कृच्छ्रः सांतपनः स्मृतः ।
text: (If one lives during one day) on cow's urine, (during one day) on cowdung, (during one day) on milk, (during one day) on sour milk, (during one day) on clarified butter, (during one day) on a decoction of Kuśa grass, and during one (day and) night on air, that is called the Sāṃtāpana K ri k kh ra.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatryādāya gomūtraṃgandhadvāreti gomayam | ā pyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhi | śukram asi jyotir ity ājyaṃ devasyatveti kuśodakam |
meaning: गायत्र्यादाय गोमूत्रंगन्धद्वारेति गोमयम् । आ प्यायस्वेति च क्षीरं दधिक्राव्णेति वै दधि । शुक्रम् असि ज्योतिर् इत्य् आज्यं देवस्यत्वेति कुशोदकम् ।
text: Let him take the cow's urine, reciting the Gāyatrī; the cowdung, (reciting the text), 'Gandhadvārām;' the milk, (reciting the verse), 'Āpyāyasva;' the sour milk, reciting (the verse), 'Dadhikrāvṇā;' the clarified butter, (saying), ' Śukram asi;' the decoction of Kuśa grass (with the text), 'Devasya tvā;'

sanskrit_iast: gomūtrabhāgas tasyārdhaṃ śakṛt kṣīrasya tu trayam | dvayaṃ dadhno ghṛtasyaika ekaś ca kuśavāriṇaḥ | evaṃ sāṃtapanaḥ kṛcchraḥ śvapākam api śodhayet |
meaning: गोमूत्रभागस् तस्यार्धं शकृत् क्षीरस्य तु त्रयम् । द्वयं दध्नो घृतस्यैक एकश् च कुशवारिणः । एवं सांतपनः कृच्छ्रः श्वपाकम् अपि शोधयेत् ।
text: (And mix together) one part of cow's urine, half as much .cowdung, three parts of milk, two of sour milk, one part of clarified butter, and one part of water boiled with Kuśa grass;' a Sāṃtāpana K ri k kh ra (performed) in this manner will purify even a Śvapāka.

sanskrit_iast: gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ caiva kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ tathā | pañcarātraṃ tadāhāraḥ pañcagavyena śudhyati |
meaning: गोमूत्रं गोमयं चैव क्षीरं दधि घृतं तथा । पञ्चरात्रं तदाहारः पञ्चगव्येन शुध्यति ।
text: He who subsists during five (days and) nights on cow's urine, cowdung, milk, sour milk, and clarified butter will be purified by (that) Pa ñ k agavya (the five products of the cow).

sanskrit_iast: yat ātmano 'pramattasya dvādaśāham abhojanam | parāko nāma kṛcchro 'yaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ |
meaning: यत् आत्मनो ऽप्रमत्तस्य द्वादशाहम् अभोजनम् । पराको नाम कृच्छ्रो ऽयं सर्वपापप्रणाशनः ।
text: If, self-restrained and attentive, he fasts during twelve days, that is called a Parāka K ri k kh ra, which destroys all sin.

sanskrit_iast: gomūtrādibhir abhyastam ekaikaṃ taṃ trisaptakam | mahāsāṃtapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ vadanti brahmavādinaḥ |
meaning: गोमूत्रादिभिर् अभ्यस्तम् एकैकं तं त्रिसप्तकम् । महासांतपनं कृच्छ्रं वदन्ति ब्रह्मवादिनः ।
text: If he subsists on cow's urine and the other (substances named above), one day on each, and continues (this mode of life) during thrice seven days, the theologians call that a Mahāsāṃtāpana K ri k kh ra.

sanskrit_iast: ekavṛddhyā site piṇḍān ekahānyāsite tataḥ | pakṣayor upavāsau dvau tad hi cāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam |
meaning: एकवृद्ध्या सिते पिण्डान् एकहान्यासिते ततः । पक्षयोर् उपवासौ द्वौ तद् हि चान्द्रायणं स्मृतम् ।
text: If he daily adds to his food one mouthful during the bright (half of the month) and diminishes it daily by one mouthful during the dark (half of the month), and keeps two fasts in the two halves of the month, that is called a K āndrāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: caturaḥ prātar aśnīyāt piṇḍān vipraḥ samāhitaḥ | caturo 'stamite sūrye śiśucāndrāyaṇaṃ caret |
meaning: चतुरः प्रातर् अश्नीयात् पिण्डान् विप्रः समाहितः । चतुरो ऽस्तमिते सूर्ये शिशुचान्द्रायणं चरेत् ।
text: If, with concentrated mind, a Brāhmaṇa eats four mouthfuls in the morning and four mouthfuls when the sun has set, he will perform the K āndrāyaṇa of children.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāvaṣṭau māsam ekaṃ piṇḍān madhyaṃdine sthite | niyatātmā haviṣyasya yaticāndrāyaṇaṃ caret |
meaning: अष्टावष्टौ मासम् एकं पिण्डान् मध्यंदिने स्थिते । नियतात्मा हविष्यस्य यतिचान्द्रायणं चरेत् ।
text: If, self-restrained, he daily eats, during a month, at midday eight mouthfuls of food, fit for a sacrifice, he will perform the K āndrāyaṇa of ascetics.

sanskrit_iast: yathā kathaṃcit piṇḍānāṃ dvijas tisras tv aśītayaḥ | māsenāśnan haviṣyasya candrasyaiti salokatām |
meaning: यथा कथंचित् पिण्डानां द्विजस् तिस्रस् त्व् अशीतयः । मासेनाश्नन् हविष्यस्य चन्द्रस्यैति सलोकताम् ।
text: But a Brāhmaṇa who eats anyhow, during a month, thrice eighty mouthfuls of food, fit for a sacrifice, goes to the world of the moon.

sanskrit_iast: yathodyaṃś candramā hanti jagatas tamaso bhayam | evaṃ pāpād bhayaṃ hanti dvijaś cāndrāyaṇaṃ caran |
meaning: यथोद्यंश् चन्द्रमा हन्ति जगतस् तमसो भयम् । एवं पापाद् भयं हन्ति द्विजश् चान्द्रायणं चरन् ।
text: As the rising moon frees the world from the fear of darkness, even so a Brāhmaṇa who performs a K āndrāyaṇa removes the fear of sin.

sanskrit_iast: kaṇapiṇyākatakrāṇi yavācāmo 'nilāśanaḥ | ekatripañcasapteti pāpaghno 'yaṃ tulāpumān |
meaning: कणपिण्याकतक्राणि यवाचामो ऽनिलाशनः । एकत्रिपञ्चसप्तेति पापघ्नो ऽयं तुलापुमान् ।
text: He who lives one day on (rice)-grains, three days on oil-cakes, 'five days on buttermilk mixed with water, seven days on water, and (one day) on air, (performs) the guilt-destroying Tulāpurusha.

sanskrit_iast: yāvakaḥ saptarātreṇa vṛjinaṃ hanti dehinām | saptarātropavāso vā dṛṣṭam etan manīṣibhiḥ |
meaning: यावकः सप्तरात्रेण वृजिनं हन्ति देहिनाम् । सप्तरात्रोपवासो वा दृष्टम् एतन् मनीषिभिः ।
text: Living on barley-gruel (yāvaka) removes the guilt of corporeal beings after seven days, and so does a fast of seven days; that has been recognised by wise men.
