sanskrit_iast: pauṣabhādrapadajyeṣṭhāsv ārdrākāśātapāśrayāt | trīñ śuklān mucyate pāpāt patanīyād ṛte dvijaḥ |
meaning: पौषभाद्रपदज्येष्ठास्व् आर्द्राकाशातपाश्रयात् । त्रीञ् शुक्लान् मुच्यते पापात् पतनीयाद् ऋते द्विजः ।
text: By dressing in wet clothes, by living in the open air, and by exposing himself to the sun during the light halves of the months Pausha (December-January), Bhādrapada (August-September), and Gyesh th a (May-June), a Brāhmaṇa is freed from (all) sin excepting crimes causing loss of caste (patanīya).

sanskrit_iast: gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam | yavācāmena saṃyukto brahmakūrco 'tipāvanaḥ |
meaning: गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकम् । यवाचामेन संयुक्तो ब्रह्मकूर्चो ऽतिपावनः ।
text: (If one swallows) cows' urine, cowdung, milk, sour milk, clarified butter, and a decoction of Kuśa grass, mixed with barley gruel, that is the most sanctifying Brahmakūr k a.

sanskrit_iast: amāvāsyāṃ nirāhāraḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ tilāśanaḥ | śuklakṛṣṇakṛtāt pāpān mucyate abdasya parvabhiḥ |
meaning: अमावास्यां निराहारः पौर्णमास्यां तिलाशनः । शुक्लकृष्णकृतात् पापान् मुच्यते अब्दस्य पर्वभिः ।
text: He who fasts on the new moon day and eats sesamum grains on the full moon day, will be freed in the course of a year from the sins which he committed in the bright and the dark halves of the month.

sanskrit_iast: bhaikṣāhāro 'gnihotribhyo māsenaikena śudhyati | yāyāvaravanasthebhyo daśabhiḥ pañcabhir dinaiḥ |
meaning: भैक्षाहारो ऽग्निहोत्रिभ्यो मासेनैकेन शुध्यति । यायावरवनस्थेभ्यो दशभिः पञ्चभिर् दिनैः ।
text: He who lives on alms obtained from Agnihotrins is purified in one month; (he who obtains his food) from a Yāyāvara. in ten days; he who receives it from a hermit in the forest, in five days;

sanskrit_iast: ekāhadhanino 'nnena dinenaikena śudhyati | kāpotavṛttiniṣṭhasya pītvāpaḥ śudhyate tribhiḥ |
meaning: एकाहधनिनो ऽन्नेन दिनेनैकेन शुध्यति । कापोतवृत्तिनिष्ठस्य पीत्वापः शुध्यते त्रिभिः ।
text: (He who lives) on food given by a person who has a store sufficient for one day only, will be purified in one day; he who drinks water given by a person subsisting by the Kapota-v ri tti (pigeon-life), is purified in three (days).

sanskrit_iast: ṛgyajuḥsāmavedānāṃ vedasyānyatamasya vā | pārāyaṇaṃ trir abhyasyed anaśnan so 'tipāvanaḥ |
meaning: ऋग्यजुःसामवेदानां वेदस्यान्यतमस्य वा । पारायणं त्रिर् अभ्यस्येद् अनश्नन् सो ऽतिपावनः ।
text: If one recites the whole Ri g-veda, Ya g ur-veda, and Sāma-veda, or thrice reads one of these Vedas and fasts, (that is) a most efficient means of purification.

sanskrit_iast: atha cet tvarate kartuṃ divasaṃ mārutāśanaḥ | rātrau jalasthito vyuṣṭaḥ prājāpatyena tatsamam |
meaning: अथ चेत् त्वरते कर्तुं दिवसं मारुताशनः । रात्रौ जलस्थितो व्युष्टः प्राजापत्येन तत्समम् ।
text: Now if one is in haste to finish, one may live on air during a day, and pass the night standing in water, that is equal (in efficacy) to a Prā g āpatya (K ri k kh ra).

sanskrit_iast: gāyatryāṣṭasahasraṃ tu japaṃ kṛtvotthite ravau | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo yadi na bhrūṇahā bhavet |
meaning: गायत्र्याष्टसहस्रं तु जपं कृत्वोत्थिते रवौ । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो यदि न भ्रूणहा भवेत् ।
text: He who at sunrise mutters the Gāyatrī one thousand and eight times, is free from all sin, provided he has not slain a learned Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: yo 'nnadaḥ satyavādī ca bhūteṣu kṛpayā sthitaḥ | pūrvoktayantraśuddhebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ so 'tiricyate |
meaning: यो ऽन्नदः सत्यवादी च भूतेषु कृपया स्थितः । पूर्वोक्तयन्त्रशुद्धेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः सो ऽतिरिच्यते ।
text: He who distributes food, speaks the truth, and has compassion on all living beings, is more (holy) than all those who have been purified by the restraints mentioned above.

sanskrit_iast: samādhucchandasā rudrā gāyatrī praṇavānvitā | sapta vyāhṛtayaś caiva japyāḥ pāpavināśanāḥ |
meaning: समाधुच्छन्दसा रुद्रा गायत्री प्रणवान्विता । सप्त व्याहृतयश् चैव जप्याः पापविनाशनाः ।
text: The (eleven Anuvākas called) Rudras together with (the ten hymns) seen by Madhu k kh andas, the Gāyatrī with the syllable Om, and likewise the seven Vyāh ri tis (are the texts) which should be muttered (and) which remove guilt.

sanskrit_iast: mṛgāreṣṭiḥ pavitreṣṭis trihaviḥ pāvamāny api | iṣṭayaḥ pāpanāśinyo vaiśvānaryā samanvitāḥ |
meaning: मृगारेष्टिः पवित्रेष्टिस् त्रिहविः पावमान्य् अपि । इष्टयः पापनाशिन्यो वैश्वानर्या समन्विताः ।
text: The M ri gāreshṭi, the Pavitreshṭi, the Trihavis, the Pāvamānī are the Ishṭis which efface sin, if they are (each) combined with the Vaiśvānara (Dvādaśakapāla).

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ caivāparaṃ guhyam ucyamānaṃ nibodhata | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo mahataḥ pātakād ṛte |
meaning: इदं चैवापरं गुह्यम् उच्यमानं निबोधत । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो महतः पातकाद् ऋते ।

sanskrit_iast: pavitrair mārjanaṃ kurvan rudraikādaśinīṃ japan | pavitrāṇi ghṛtair juhvat prayacchan hemagotilān |
meaning: पवित्रैर् मार्जनं कुर्वन् रुद्रैकादशिनीं जपन् । पवित्राणि घृतैर् जुह्वत् प्रयच्छन् हेमगोतिलान् ।

sanskrit_iast: yo 'śnīyād yāvakaṃ pakvaṃ gomūtre saśakṛdrase | sadadhikṣīrasarpiṣke mucyate so 'ṃhasaḥ kṣaṇāt |
meaning: यो ऽश्नीयाद् यावकं पक्वं गोमूत्रे सशकृद्रसे । सदधिक्षीरसर्पिष्के मुच्यते सो ऽंहसः क्षणात् ।
text: He who partakes of boiled barley-gruel, mixed with cow's urine, liquid cowdung, sour milk, milk, and butter, is quickly freed from sin.

sanskrit_iast: prasūto yaś ca śūdrāyāṃ yenāgamyā ca laṅghitā | saptarātrāt pramucyete vidhinaitena tāv ubhau |
meaning: प्रसूतो यश् च शूद्रायां येनागम्या च लङ्घिता । सप्तरात्रात् प्रमुच्येते विधिनैतेन ताव् उभौ ।
text: Both he who has begotten a child on a Śūdra woman and he who has had connexion with a female, intercourse with whom is forbidden (agamyā), are purified (if they live) according to this rule during seven days.

sanskrit_iast: retomūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ prāśane 'bhojyabhojane | paryādhānejyayor etat parivitte ca bheṣajam |
meaning: रेतोमूत्रपुरीषाणां प्राशने ऽभोज्यभोजने । पर्याधानेज्ययोर् एतत् परिवित्ते च भेषजम् ।
text: (That is likewise) the remedy when one has swallowed semen, ordure, and urine, or eaten the food of persons whose food must not be eaten, (and also) when a younger brother has kindled the sacred fire, has offered a Śrauta sacrifice, or taken a wife before the elder.

sanskrit_iast: apātakāni karmāṇi kṛtvaiva subahūny api | mucyate sarvapāpebhya ity etad vacanaṃ satām |
meaning: अपातकानि कर्माणि कृत्वैव सुबहून्य् अपि । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्य इत्य् एतद् वचनं सताम् ।
text: He who has committed even a great number of (wicked) actions, excepting mortal sins, will be freed (by that rule) from all guilt. That is the statement of the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast: mantramārgapramāṇaṃ tu vidhānaṃ samudīritam | bharadvājādayo yena brahmaṇaḥ sātmatāṃ gatāḥ |
meaning: मन्त्रमार्गप्रमाणं तु विधानं समुदीरितम् । भरद्वाजादयो येन ब्रह्मणः सात्मतां गताः ।
text: But (this) ordinance, which is based on the authority of the sacred texts, is stated (to be that) through which Bharadvā g a and others became equal to Brahman,

sanskrit_iast: prasannahṛdayo vipraḥ prayogād asya karmaṇaḥ | kāmāṃs tāṃs tān avāpnoti ye ye kāmā hṛdi sthitāḥ | ye ye kāmā hṛdi sthitā iti |
meaning: प्रसन्नहृदयो विप्रः प्रयोगाद् अस्य कर्मणः । कामांस् तांस् तान् अवाप्नोति ये ये कामा हृदि स्थिताः । ये ये कामा हृदि स्थिता इति ।
text: Through the performance of these rites a Brāhmaṇa, whose heart is full of peace, obtains whatever desires he may have in his heart.

sanskrit_iast: nivṛttaḥ pāpakarmabhyaḥ pravṛttaḥ puṇyakarmasu | yo vipras tasya sidhyanti vinā yantrair api kriyāḥ |
meaning: निवृत्तः पापकर्मभ्यः प्रवृत्तः पुण्यकर्मसु । यो विप्रस् तस्य सिध्यन्ति विना यन्त्रैर् अपि क्रियाः ।
text: The wishes of a Brāhmaṇa who has left off evil deeds and is (ever) engaged in holy works are fulfilled even without (the practice of) restraints.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇā ṛjavas tasmād yad yad icchanti cetasā | tat tad āsādayanty āśu saṃśuddhā ṛjukarmabhiḥ |
meaning: ब्राह्मणा ऋजवस् तस्माद् यद् यद् इच्छन्ति चेतसा । तत् तद् आसादयन्त्य् आशु संशुद्धा ऋजुकर्मभिः ।
text: Upright Brāhmaṇas quickly accomplish whatever they wish in their hearts, if they are purified by honest actions.

sanskrit_iast: evam etāni yantrāṇi tāvat kāryāṇi dhīmatā | kālena yāvatopaiti vigrahaḥ śuddhim ātmanaḥ |
meaning: एवम् एतानि यन्त्राणि तावत् कार्याणि धीमता । कालेन यावतोपैति विग्रहः शुद्धिम् आत्मनः ।
text: Thus a wise man should practise those restraints until he has purified his bodily frame.

sanskrit_iast: ebhir yantrair viśuddhātmā trirātropoṣitas tataḥ | tad ārabheta yenarddhiṃ karmaṇā prāptum icchati |
meaning: एभिर् यन्त्रैर् विशुद्धात्मा त्रिरात्रोपोषितस् ततः । तद् आरभेत येनर्द्धिं कर्मणा प्राप्तुम् इच्छति ।
text: He who has been purified by those restraints should, after fasting three (days and) nights, begin the performance of that sacred rite through which he wishes to gain the fulfilment of his desires,

sanskrit_iast: kṣmāpavitraḥ sahasrākṣo mṛgāro 'ṃhomucau gaṇau | pāvamānyaś ca kūśmāṇḍyo vaiśvānarya ṛcaś ca yāḥ |
meaning: क्ष्मापवित्रः सहस्राक्षो मृगारो ऽंहोमुचौ गणौ । पावमान्यश् च कूश्माण्ड्यो वैश्वानर्य ऋचश् च याः ।
text: (Reciting) the Kshāpavitra, the Sahasrāksha, the M ri gāra, the two G aṇas (called) Aṃhomu k , the Pāvamanīs, the Kūshmāṇd īs, and the Ri k as, addressed to Vaiśvānara,

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtaudanena tā juhvat saptāhaṃ savanatrayam | maunavratī haviṣyāśī nigṛhītendriyakriyaḥ |
meaning: घृतौदनेन ता जुह्वत् सप्ताहं सवनत्रयम् । मौनव्रती हविष्याशी निगृहीतेन्द्रियक्रियः ।
text: (And) offering with (each of) these (Mantras) boiled rice and clarified butter during seven days, in the morning, at midday, and in the evening, keeping a rigid silence, living on food fit for a sacrifice, restraining his senses and his actions,

sanskrit_iast: siṃhe ma ity apāṃ pūrṇe pātre 'vekṣya catuṣpathe | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo mahataḥ pātakād api |
meaning: सिंहे म इत्य् अपां पूर्णे पात्रे ऽवेक्ष्य चतुष्पथे । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो महतः पातकाद् अपि ।
text: He is freed from all crimes, even mortal sins, after looking on a cross-road at a pot filled with water, (and reciting the text), 'Siṃhe me manyu h .'

sanskrit_iast: vṛddhatve yauvane bālye yaḥ kṛtaḥ pāpasaṃcayaḥ | pūrvajanmasu cājñānāt tasmād api vimucyate |
meaning: वृद्धत्वे यौवने बाल्ये यः कृतः पापसंचयः । पूर्वजन्मसु चाज्ञानात् तस्माद् अपि विमुच्यते ।
text: He is freed from the multitude of sins, committed unintentionally in old age, in youth, and in infancy, and even from those belonging to former births;

sanskrit_iast: bhojayitvā dvijān ante pāyasena sasarpiṣā | gobhūmitilahemāni bhuktavadbhyaḥ pradāya ca |
meaning: भोजयित्वा द्विजान् अन्ते पायसेन ससर्पिषा । गोभूमितिलहेमानि भुक्तवद्भ्यः प्रदाय च ।
text: After feeding at the end (of the seven days) Brāhmaṇas with milk and rice, well. mixed with butter, and distributing to them after their dinner cows, land, sesamum, and gold,

sanskrit_iast: vipro bhavati pūtātmā nirdagdhavṛjinendhanaḥ | kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ yogyas tathādhānādikarmaṇām |
meaning: विप्रो भवति पूतात्मा निर्दग्धवृजिनेन्धनः । काम्यानां कर्मणां योग्यस् तथाधानादिकर्मणाम् ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa becomes internally pure, his guilt being consumed like fuel, and fit for the performance of rites which secure the fulfilment of wishes and of rites like the kindling of the sacred fire.

sanskrit_iast: atilobhāt pramādād vā yaḥ karoti kriyām imām | anyasya so 'ṃha āviṣṭo garagīr iva sīdati |
meaning: अतिलोभात् प्रमादाद् वा यः करोति क्रियाम् इमाम् । अन्यस्य सो ऽंह आविष्टो गरगीर् इव सीदति ।
text: He who, through excessive greed or carelessness, performs this rite for others, is tainted by sin, and perishes like one who has swallowed poison.

sanskrit_iast: ācāryasya pitur mātur ātmanaś ca kriyām imām | kurvan bhāty arkavad vipraḥ sā kāryaiṣām ataḥ kriyā |
meaning: आचार्यस्य पितुर् मातुर् आत्मनश् च क्रियाम् इमाम् । कुर्वन् भात्य् अर्कवद् विप्रः सा कार्यैषाम् अतः क्रिया ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa who performs this rite for his teacher, his father, his mother, or for himself is resplendent like the sun. Therefore this rite may be performed for those (persons).

sanskrit_iast: ka etena sahasrākṣaṃ pavitreṇākaroc chucim | agniṃ vāyuṃ raviṃ somaṃ yamādīṃś ca sureśvarān |
meaning: क एतेन सहस्राक्षं पवित्रेणाकरोच् छुचिम् । अग्निं वायुं रविं सोमं यमादींश् च सुरेश्वरान् ।
text: Ka (Pra g āpati) purified by means of this rite the god with a thousand eyes (Sahasrāksha), Fire, Wind, the Sun, Soma, Yama, and other lords of the gods.

sanskrit_iast: yat kiṃcit puṇyanāmeha triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam | viprādi tat kṛtaṃ kena pavitrakriyayānayā |
meaning: यत् किंचित् पुण्यनामेह त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् । विप्रादि तत् कृतं केन पवित्रक्रिययानया ।
text: Whatever there is in these three worlds, famed as possessing a holy name, Brāhmaṇas and the rest, (all) that was produced by Ka through this rite of sanctification.

sanskrit_iast: prājāpatyam idaṃ guhyaṃ pāpaghnaṃprathamodbhavam | samutpannāny ataḥ paścāt pavitrāṇi sahasraśaḥ |
meaning: प्राजापत्यम् इदं गुह्यं पापघ्नंप्रथमोद्भवम् । समुत्पन्नान्य् अतः पश्चात् पवित्राणि सहस्रशः ।
text: This sin-destroying secret of Pra g āpati was first produced; thereafter thousands of purificatory rites .came into existence.

sanskrit_iast: yo 'bdāyanartupakṣāhāñ juhoty aṣṭau gaṇān imān | punāti cātmano vaṃśyān daśa pūrvān daśāvarān |
meaning: यो ऽब्दायनर्तुपक्षाहाञ् जुहोत्य् अष्टौ गणान् इमान् । पुनाति चात्मनो वंश्यान् दश पूर्वान् दशावरान् ।
text: He who performs those eight Gaṇahomas on the (first) day of the year, of a half-year, of a season, or of a fortnight, sanctifies ten ancestors and ten descendants of his line;

sanskrit_iast: jñāyate cāmarair dyusthaiḥ puṇyakarmeti bhūsthitaḥ | devavan modate bhūyaḥ svargaloke 'pi puṇyakṛt |
meaning: ज्ञायते चामरैर् द्युस्थैः पुण्यकर्मेति भूस्थितः । देववन् मोदते भूयः स्वर्गलोके ऽपि पुण्यकृत् ।
text: And, while still on earth, he is known to the gods in heaven as a holy man, and (after death) that virtuous man rejoices for a very long time in heaven like a god.

sanskrit_iast: etān aṣṭau gaṇān hotuṃ na śaknoti yadi dvijaḥ | eko 'pi tena hotavyo rajas tenāsya naśyati |
meaning: एतान् अष्टौ गणान् होतुं न शक्नोति यदि द्विजः । एको ऽपि तेन होतव्यो रजस् तेनास्य नश्यति ।
text: If a Brāhmaṇa is unable to offer those eight Gaṇahomas, let him offer one; thereby his guilt is effaced.

sanskrit_iast: sūnavo yasya śiṣyā vā juhvaty aṣṭau gaṇān imān | adhyāpanaparikrītair aṃhasaḥ so 'pi mucyate |
meaning: सूनवो यस्य शिष्या वा जुह्वत्य् अष्टौ गणान् इमान् । अध्यापनपरिक्रीतैर् अंहसः सो ऽपि मुच्यते ।
text: He, also, whose sons or pupils offer those eight Gaṇahomas, is freed from his sin which is bought off by his having instructed (them).

sanskrit_iast: dhanenāpi parikrītair ātmapāpajighāṃsayā | hāvanīyā hy aśaktena nāvasādyaḥ śarīradhṛk |
meaning: धनेनापि परिक्रीतैर् आत्मपापजिघांसया । हावनीया ह्य् अशक्तेन नावसाद्यः शरीरधृक् ।
text: Through a desire of removing one's guilt one even may cause (these oblations) to be offered by men who have been engaged for money, in case oneself is unable (to do it); a man need not torment himself.

sanskrit_iast: dhanasya kriyate tyāgaḥ karmaṇāṃ sukṛtām api | puṃso 'nṛṇasya pāpasya vimokṣaḥ kriyate kvacit |
meaning: धनस्य क्रियते त्यागः कर्मणां सुकृताम् अपि । पुंसो ऽनृणस्य पापस्य विमोक्षः क्रियते क्वचित् ।
text: Even among the virtuous a distribution of wealth is made (for the success) of holy rites; some-times a man who is free from debt is (thereby) freed from guilt. 12, Liberated according to this rule from the ocean of guilt and debt, he considers himself pure and able to successfully perform the sacred rites.

sanskrit_iast: vimukto vidhinaitena sarvapāpārṇasāgarāt | ātmānaṃ manyate śuddhaṃ samarthaṃ karmasādhane |
meaning: विमुक्तो विधिनैतेन सर्वपापार्णसागरात् । आत्मानं मन्यते शुद्धं समर्थं कर्मसाधने ।

sanskrit_iast: sarvapāpārṇamuktātmā kriyā ārabhate tu yāḥ | ayatnenaiva tāḥ siddhiṃ yānti śuddhaśarīriṇaḥ |
meaning: सर्वपापार्णमुक्तात्मा क्रिया आरभते तु याः । अयत्नेनैव ताः सिद्धिं यान्ति शुद्धशरीरिणः ।

sanskrit_iast: prājāpatyam idaṃ puṇyam ṛṣiṇā samudīritam | idam adhyāpayen nityaṃ dhārayec chṛṇute 'pi vā | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo brahmaloke mahīyate |
meaning: प्राजापत्यम् इदं पुण्यम् ऋषिणा समुदीरितम् । इदम् अध्यापयेन् नित्यं धारयेच् छृणुते ऽपि वा । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते ।

sanskrit_iast: yān siṣādhayiṣur mantrān dvādaśāhāni tāñ japet | ghṛtena payasā dadhnā prāśya niśy odanaṃ sakṛt |
meaning: यान् सिषाधयिषुर् मन्त्रान् द्वादशाहानि ताञ् जपेत् । घृतेन पयसा दध्ना प्राश्य निश्य् ओदनं सकृत् ।

sanskrit_iast: daśavāraṃ tathā homaḥ sarpiṣā savanatrayam | pūrvasevā bhaved eṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ karmasādhane | mantrāṇāṃ karmasādhana iti || atilobhāt pramādād vā | nivṛttaḥ pāpakarmabhyaḥ || samādhuśchandasārudrāḥ || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi || prāyaścittāni vakṣyāmaḥ || prāyaścittāni vakṣyāmaḥ || prāyaścittāni vakṣyāmaḥ || prāyaścittānivakṣyāmaḥ || iti caturthaḥ praśnaḥ || iti baudhāyanadharmasūtraṃsamāptam |
meaning: दशवारं तथा होमः सर्पिषा सवनत्रयम् । पूर्वसेवा भवेद् एषां मन्त्राणां कर्मसाधने । मन्त्राणां कर्मसाधन इति ॥ अतिलोभात् प्रमादाद् वा । निवृत्तः पापकर्मभ्यः ॥ समाधुश्छन्दसारुद्राः ॥ अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि ॥ प्रायश्चित्तानि वक्ष्यामः ॥ प्रायश्चित्तानि वक्ष्यामः ॥ प्रायश्चित्तानि वक्ष्यामः ॥ प्रायश्चित्तानिवक्ष्यामः ॥ इति चतुर्थः प्रश्नः ॥ इति बौधायनधर्मसूत्रंसमाप्तम् ।
